      ]
    )[1 + (((series.n - 1) * 11) % 844)] as athlete_name,
    case ((series.n * 23) % 13)
      when 0 then 'AB' when 1 then 'BC' when 2 then 'MB'
      when 3 then 'NB' when 4 then 'NL' when 5 then 'NS'
      when 6 then 'NT' when 7 then 'NU' when 8 then 'ON'
      when 9 then 'PE' when 10 then 'QC' when 11 then 'SK' else 'YT'
    end as province,
    case
      when series.n <= 48 then
        (array['Rec', 'Rec', 'Rec', 'Open', 'Masters', 'Rec', 'Open', 'Masters'])[((series.n * 5) % 8) + 1]
      else
        (array['Youth D', 'Youth C', 'Youth B', 'Youth A', 'Junior', 'Youth B', 'Youth A', 'Junior'])[((series.n * 7) % 8) + 1]
    end as age_group,
    case
      when series.n <= 48 then
        (array['Men', 'Women', 'X', 'Women', 'Men', 'X'])[((series.n * 11) % 6) + 1]
      else
        (array['Men', 'Women', 'Men', 'Women', 'Men', 'Women', 'X'])[((series.n * 13) % 7) + 1]
    end as gender_division,
    case
      when series.n <= 48 and (series.n % 3) = 0 then 'Check-in - Recreational Scramble'
      when series.n <= 48 then 'Recreational Scramble'
      when (series.n % 4) in (0, 1) then 'Check-in / Isolation - Youth Competitive Qualifiers'
      else 'Event - Youth Competitive Qualifiers'
    end as slot_label
  from generate_series(1, 124) as series(n)
)
insert into public.climbers (
  competition_id,
  name,
  climber_number,
  province,
  category_id,
  gender_division,
  age_group,
  display_category,
  time_slot_id,
  access_token
)
select
  competition_map.id,
  athletes.athlete_name,
  lpad(athletes.athlete_number::text, 3, '0'),
  athletes.province,
  athletes.gender_division || '::' || athletes.age_group,
  athletes.gender_division,
  athletes.age_group,
  athletes.gender_division || ' / ' || athletes.age_group,
  slot_map.id,
  athletes.competition_slug || '-token-' || lpad(athletes.athlete_number::text, 3, '0')
from athletes
join competition_map on competition_map.slug = athletes.competition_slug
left join slot_map
  on slot_map.competition_id = competition_map.id
 and slot_map.label = athletes.slot_label;


--- sql\spring-send\03-seed-qualifier-attempts.sql ---

with athlete_profiles as (
  select
    c.id as climber_id,
    c.competition_id,
    c.climber_number::int as athlete_number,
    c.age_group,
    c.gender_division,
    case c.age_group
      when 'Open' then 14.6
      when 'Masters' then 12.8
      when 'Rec' then 9.4
      when 'Junior' then 14.1
      when 'Youth A' then 12.9
      when 'Youth B' then 11.8
      when 'Youth C' then 10.7
      else 10.1
    end
      + case c.gender_division when 'Men' then 0.75 when 'Women' then 0.35 else 0.15 end
      + round((((c.climber_number::int * 29) % 17)::numeric / 17.0) * 4.4 - 2.2, 2) as base_strength,
    4 + ((c.climber_number::int * 31) % 7) as consistency_band,
    4 + ((c.climber_number::int * 37) % 8) as endurance_band,
    3 + ((c.climber_number::int * 41) % 6) as volatility_band,
    ((c.climber_number::int * 43) % 9) - 4 as upset_band
  from public.climbers c
  where c.competition_id in (
    select id
    from public.competitions
    where slug in ('spring-send-recreational', 'spring-send-youth-competitive')
  )
),
qualifier_attempt_seed as (
  select
    profiles.competition_id,
    profiles.climber_id,
    profiles.athlete_number,
    profiles.age_group,
    profiles.base_strength,
    profiles.consistency_band,
    profiles.endurance_band,
    profiles.volatility_band,
    profiles.upset_band,
    climbs.climb_number,
    case
      when profiles.age_group = 'Rec' then least(20, 8 + profiles.endurance_band + ((profiles.athlete_number * 41) % 5))
      when profiles.age_group = 'Masters' then least(20, 9 + profiles.endurance_band + ((profiles.athlete_number * 43) % 4))
      else least(20, 7 + profiles.endurance_band + ((profiles.athlete_number * 47) % 4))
    end as max_logged_climb,
    (
      profiles.base_strength
      + (profiles.consistency_band * 0.38)
      + case
        when climbs.climb_number <= 5 then 0.9
        when climbs.climb_number <= 10 then 0.4
        else 0
      end
      - greatest(climbs.climb_number - profiles.endurance_band, 0) * 0.15
      + (((profiles.athlete_number * 53 + climbs.climb_number * 59 + profiles.volatility_band * 61) % 11) - 5) * 0.28
      + (profiles.upset_band * case when ((profiles.athlete_number + climbs.climb_number) % 6) = 0 then 0.36 else 0.1 end)
    ) as performance_score,
    case
      when profiles.competition_id = (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'spring-send-recreational')
        then 8.7
          + climbs.climb_number * 0.36
          + (((climbs.climb_number * 67 + profiles.volatility_band * 71) % 7) - 3) * 0.16
      else 10.1
        + climbs.climb_number * 0.52
        + (((climbs.climb_number * 73 + profiles.volatility_band * 79) % 9) - 4) * 0.18
    end as difficulty_score
  from athlete_profiles profiles
  cross join generate_series(1, 20) as climbs(climb_number)
),
qualifier_attempt_rows as (
  select
    competition_id,
    climber_id,
    climb_number,
    case
      when competition_id = (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'spring-send-recreational')
        then performance_score >= difficulty_score - 0.2
      else performance_score >= difficulty_score - 1.25
    end as zone,
    performance_score >= difficulty_score + case
      when competition_id = (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'spring-send-recreational') then 0.1
      else 0.7
    end as topped,
    case
      when performance_score >= difficulty_score
        then greatest(1, least(5, 1 + ((athlete_number * 83 + climb_number * 89 + volatility_band * 97) % 3) + greatest(climb_number - consistency_band, 0) / 4))
      else greatest(1, least(7, 2 + ((athlete_number * 101 + climb_number * 103 + endurance_band * 107) % 4) + greatest(climb_number - endurance_band, 0) / 3))
    end as attempt_count,
    case
      when performance_score >= difficulty_score + case
        when competition_id = (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'spring-send-recreational') then 0.1
        else 0.7
      end
        then greatest(1, least(5, 1 + ((athlete_number * 149 + climb_number * 151 + volatility_band * 157) % 3) + greatest(climb_number - consistency_band, 0) / 4))
      else null
    end as raw_top_attempts,
    case
      when competition_id = (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'spring-send-recreational')
        then case when performance_score >= difficulty_score - 0.2 then greatest(1, least(5, 1 + ((athlete_number * 163 + climb_number * 167) % 3))) else null end
      when performance_score >= difficulty_score - 1.25
        then greatest(1, least(6, 1 + ((athlete_number * 173 + climb_number * 179 + endurance_band) % 4) + greatest(climb_number - endurance_band, 0) / 4))
      else null
    end as raw_zone_attempts,
    case
      when competition_id = (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'spring-send-recreational')
        and (climb_number <= 10 or ((athlete_number * 109 + climb_number * 113) % 4) <> 0)
        then 'climber'
      when (athlete_number * 127 + climb_number * 131) % 3 = 0
        then 'climber'
      else 'staff'
    end as entered_by
  from qualifier_attempt_seed
  where climb_number <= max_logged_climb
    and not (
      competition_id <> (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'spring-send-recreational')
      and climb_number > 11
      and ((athlete_number * 137 + climb_number * 139 + volatility_band + consistency_band) % 5) = 0
    )
)
insert into public.qualifier_attempts (
  competition_id,
  climber_id,
  climb_number,
  attempt_count,
  zone,
  topped,
  attempts_to_top,
  attempts_to_zone,
  entered_by
)
select
  rows.competition_id,
  rows.climber_id,
  rows.climb_number,
  rows.attempt_count,
  rows.zone or rows.topped,
  rows.topped,
  case
    when rows.topped
      then greatest(1, rows.raw_top_attempts)
    else null
  end,
  case
    when rows.zone or rows.topped
      then case
        when rows.topped
          then least(greatest(1, rows.raw_zone_attempts), greatest(1, rows.raw_top_attempts))
        else greatest(1, rows.raw_zone_attempts)
      end
    else null
  end,
  rows.entered_by
from qualifier_attempt_rows rows;


--- sql\spring-send\03b-refresh-mock-youth-qualifier-attempts.sql ---

begin;

do $$
begin
  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.competitions
    where slug = 'spring-send-youth'
  ) then
    raise exception 'Missing spring-send-youth competition. Run sql/mock-events-seed.sql first.';
  end if;
end $$;

delete from public.qualifier_attempts
where competition_id = (
  select id
  from public.competitions
  where slug = 'spring-send-youth'
  limit 1
);

with scored_event as (
  select id, slug, format, total_climbs
  from public.competitions
  where slug = 'spring-send-youth'
),
attempt_source as (
  select
    c.competition_id,
    c.id as climber_id,
    se.slug,
    se.format,
    gs.climb_number,
    get_byte(decode(md5(c.id::text || ':' || gs.climb_number::text || ':a'), 'hex'), 0) as seed_a,
    get_byte(decode(md5(c.id::text || ':' || gs.climb_number::text || ':b'), 'hex'), 0) as seed_b,
    get_byte(decode(md5(c.id::text || ':' || gs.climb_number::text || ':c'), 'hex'), 0) as seed_c,
    get_byte(decode(md5(c.id::text || ':' || gs.climb_number::text || ':d'), 'hex'), 0) as seed_d
  from public.climbers c
  join scored_event se
    on se.id = c.competition_id
  cross join lateral generate_series(1, se.total_climbs) as gs(climb_number)
),
attempt_outcomes as (
  select
    competition_id,
    climber_id,
    climb_number,
    slug,
    format,
    seed_a < 90 as attempted,
    seed_b < case
      when climb_number <= 5 then 34
      when climb_number <= 10 then 24
      when climb_number <= 14 then 16
      else 10
    end as topped_raw,
    seed_c < case
      when climb_number <= 5 then 78
      when climb_number <= 10 then 62
      when climb_number <= 14 then 48
      else 34
    end as zone_raw,
    1 + (seed_b % 3) as top_tries,
    1 + (seed_c % 4) as zone_tries,
    1 + (seed_d % 5) as generic_tries
  from attempt_source
),
materialized_attempts as (
  select
    competition_id,
    climber_id,
    climb_number,
    (topped_raw or zone_raw) as zone,
    topped_raw as topped,
    case
      when topped_raw then top_tries
      when zone_raw then zone_tries
      else generic_tries
    end as attempt_count,
    case when topped_raw then top_tries end as attempts_to_top,
    case
      when topped_raw then top_tries
      when zone_raw then zone_tries
      else null
    end as attempts_to_zone,
    'staff' as entered_by
  from attempt_outcomes
  where attempted
)
insert into public.qualifier_attempts (
  competition_id,
  climber_id,
  climb_number,
  attempt_count,
  zone,
  topped,
  attempts_to_top,
  attempts_to_zone,
  entered_by
)
select
  competition_id,
  climber_id,
  climb_number,
  attempt_count,
  zone,
  topped,
  attempts_to_top,
  attempts_to_zone,
  entered_by
from materialized_attempts;

commit;


--- sql\spring-send\04-advance-to-finals.sql ---

update public.competition_schedule_blocks
set is_active = false
where competition_id = (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'spring-send-youth-competitive');

update public.competition_schedule_blocks
set is_active = true
where competition_id = (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'spring-send-youth-competitive')
  and phase_type = 'finals_round';

delete from public.final_attempts
where competition_id = (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'spring-send-youth-competitive');

delete from public.competition_finalists
where competition_id = (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'spring-send-youth-competitive');

with target as (
  select *
  from public.competitions
  where slug = 'spring-send-youth-competitive'
),
climber_scores as (
  select
    c.id as climber_id,
    c.name,
    c.category_id,
    c.display_category,
    c.gender_division,
    c.age_group,
    q.climb_number,
    q.attempt_count,
    q.topped,
    case
      when q.topped
        then greatest(0, q.climb_number * 1000 - least(greatest(q.attempt_count - 1, 0), 3) * 200)
      else 0
    end as score
  from public.climbers c
  join target on target.id = c.competition_id
  left join public.qualifier_attempts q on q.climber_id = c.id
),
counting_scores as (
  select *
  from (
    select
      climber_scores.*,
      row_number() over (
        partition by climber_id
        order by score desc, climb_number desc, attempt_count asc
      ) as score_row
    from climber_scores
    where score > 0
  ) ranked_scores
  where score_row <= (select qualifier_counting_climbs from target)
),
qualifier_totals as (
  select
    c.id as climber_id,
    c.name,
    c.category_id,
    c.display_category,
    c.gender_division,
    c.age_group,
    coalesce(sum(cs.score), 0) as total_score,
    coalesce(count(*) filter (where cs.topped), 0) as topped_count,
    coalesce(sum(cs.attempt_count), 0) as counting_attempt_total
  from public.climbers c
  join target on target.id = c.competition_id
  left join counting_scores cs on cs.climber_id = c.id
  group by c.id, c.name, c.category_id, c.display_category, c.gender_division, c.age_group
),
ranked as (
  select
    qualifier_totals.*,
    row_number() over (
      partition by category_id
      order by total_score desc, topped_count desc, counting_attempt_total asc, name asc
    ) as category_rank
  from qualifier_totals
  where gender_division in ('Men', 'Women')
    and age_group in (
      select jsonb_array_elements_text((select finals_eligible_age_groups from target))
    )
),
cutoff as (
  select
    category_id,
    total_score,
    topped_count,
    counting_attempt_total
  from ranked
  where category_rank = (select finals_cutoff from target)
)
insert into public.competition_finalists (
  competition_id,
  climber_id,
  name,
  category_id,
  display_category,
  gender_division,
  age_group,
  qualifier_rank,
  advanced_with_tie
)
select
  target.id,
  ranked.climber_id,
  ranked.name,
  ranked.category_id,
  ranked.display_category,
  ranked.gender_division,
  ranked.age_group,
  ranked.category_rank,
  ranked.category_rank > target.finals_cutoff
from ranked
cross join target
left join cutoff using (category_id)
where ranked.category_rank <= target.finals_cutoff
   or (
     target.finals_tie_advances
     and cutoff.category_id is not null
     and ranked.category_rank > target.finals_cutoff
     and ranked.total_score = cutoff.total_score
     and ranked.topped_count = cutoff.topped_count
     and ranked.counting_attempt_total = cutoff.counting_attempt_total
   );

update public.competitions
set
  format = 'ifsc_finals_format',
  stage_mode = 'finals',
  qualifier_locked_at = now(),
  finals_started_at = now(),
  finals_problem_count = 4
where slug = 'spring-send-youth-competitive';


--- sql\spring-send\05-seed-finals-attempts.sql ---

with finalist_pool as (
  select
    c.id as climber_id,
    c.competition_id,
    c.climber_number::int as athlete_number,
    ef.qualifier_rank,
    greatest(1, 12 - ef.qualifier_rank) as qualifier_bonus,
    1 + ((c.climber_number::int * 149) % 7) as finals_attack,
    1 + ((c.climber_number::int * 151) % 7) as finals_precision,
    1 + ((c.climber_number::int * 157) % 6) as finals_composure
  from public.climbers c
  join public.competition_finalists ef on ef.climber_id = c.id
  where c.competition_id = (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'spring-send-youth-competitive')
),
final_attempt_seed as (
  select
    finalists.competition_id,
    finalists.climber_id,
    finalists.athlete_number,
    finalists.qualifier_rank,
    finalists.qualifier_bonus,
    finalists.finals_attack,
    finalists.finals_precision,
    finalists.finals_composure,
    climbs.climb_number,
    case climbs.climb_number
      when 1 then 11
      when 2 then 14
      when 3 then 13
      else 16
    end as problem_difficulty
  from finalist_pool finalists
  cross join (values (1), (2), (3), (4)) as climbs(climb_number)
),
final_attempt_rows as (
  select
    competition_id,
    climber_id,
    climb_number,
    (
      qualifier_bonus
      + finals_precision
      + finals_composure
      + ((athlete_number * 163 + climb_number * 167) % 9)
      >= problem_difficulty + 2
    ) as top,
    (
      qualifier_bonus
      + finals_attack
      + ((athlete_number * 173 + climb_number * 179) % 8)
      >= problem_difficulty - 2
    ) as zone,
    1 + ((athlete_number * 181 + climb_number * 191 + finals_precision * 193) % 6) as raw_top_attempts,
    1 + ((athlete_number * 197 + climb_number * 199 + finals_attack * 211) % 8) as raw_zone_attempts
  from final_attempt_seed
)
insert into public.final_attempts (
  competition_id,
  climber_id,
  climb_number,
  top,
  zone,
  attempts_to_top,
  attempts_to_zone,
  entered_by
)
select
  rows.competition_id,
  rows.climber_id,
  rows.climb_number,
  rows.top,
  rows.top or rows.zone,
  case
    when rows.top then rows.raw_top_attempts
    else null
  end,
  case
    when rows.top or rows.zone
      then case
        when rows.top then least(rows.raw_zone_attempts, rows.raw_top_attempts)
        else rows.raw_zone_attempts
      end
    else null
  end,
  'staff'
from final_attempt_rows rows;


--- sql\spring-send\README.md ---

# Spring Send SQL

These scripts seed Spring Send as two separate competitions:

- `spring-send-recreational`
- `spring-send-youth-competitive`

Run them in this order:

1. `00-reset-and-configure.sql`
2. `01-load-schedule.sql`
3. `02-seed-registrations.sql`
4. `03-seed-qualifier-attempts.sql`
5. `04-advance-to-finals.sql`
6. `05-seed-finals-attempts.sql`

Notes:

- `00-reset-and-configure.sql` now creates the Spring Send competitions, categories, and default schedule blocks in one shot.
- `01-load-schedule.sql` is safe to rerun if you want to refresh just the schedule block set.
- The recreational scramble stays in qualifier mode.
- The youth competition advances to finals separately.
- Finals eligibility is driven by the competition's `finals_eligible_age_groups` setting.
- These scripts assume the multi-competition schema from `supabase-schema.sql` is already applied.
- Registration, qualifier attempts, and finals attempts are intentionally seeded with much higher variation now:
  - larger name pool
  - broader province/category mix
  - assigned schedule blocks
  - uneven climb logging
  - more realistic top / no-top / zone-only spread
  - less repetitive leaderboard clustering


--- src\app\api\demo\prepare-state\route.ts ---

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import {
  prepareDemoStoryState,
  getDemoStoryState,
  type DemoStoryTargetAct,
} from "@/lib/demo-story";
import { DEMO_COMPETITION_SLUG } from "@/lib/demo";

const DEMO_STORY_TARGET_ACTS = [
  "event_created",
  "score_corrected",
  "finalists_started",
  "public_ready",
] as const satisfies readonly DemoStoryTargetAct[];

type DemoPrepareStateRequest = {
  targetAct?: DemoStoryTargetAct;
  reset?: boolean;
};

function isAllowedDemoRequest(request: NextRequest) {
  const origin = request.headers.get("origin");
  if (origin && origin !== request.nextUrl.origin) {
    return false;
  }

  const referer = request.headers.get("referer");
  if (!referer) {
    return true;
  }

  try {
    const refererUrl = new URL(referer);
    if (refererUrl.origin !== request.nextUrl.origin) {
      return false;
    }

    return (
      refererUrl.pathname.startsWith("/demo") ||
      refererUrl.pathname.startsWith("/staff/demo") ||
      refererUrl.pathname.startsWith(`/staff/c/${DEMO_COMPETITION_SLUG}`) ||
      refererUrl.pathname.startsWith(`/c/${DEMO_COMPETITION_SLUG}`)
    );
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function isDemoStoryTargetAct(value: unknown): value is DemoStoryTargetAct {
  return typeof value === "string" && DEMO_STORY_TARGET_ACTS.includes(value as DemoStoryTargetAct);
}

export async function GET() {
  const state = await getDemoStoryState();
  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, state });
}

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  if (!isAllowedDemoRequest(request)) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { ok: false, error: "Demo state preparation is only available from demo pages." },
      { status: 401 }
    );
  }

  let payload: DemoPrepareStateRequest;

  try {
    payload = (await request.json()) as DemoPrepareStateRequest;
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Invalid request body." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  if (!isDemoStoryTargetAct(payload.targetAct)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Invalid demo story target." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  try {
    const state = await prepareDemoStoryState(payload.targetAct, { reset: payload.reset === true });
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, state });
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        ok: false,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unable to prepare the demo story state.",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}


--- src\app\api\demo\qualifier-attempt\route.ts ---

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { normalizeQualifierAttemptInput } from "@/lib/attempts";
import { createServiceRoleSupabaseClient } from "@/lib/server-supabase";

type DemoQualifierAttemptRequest = {
  competitionId?: string;
  climberId?: string;
  climbNumber?: number;
  attemptCount?: number;
  topped?: boolean;
  zone?: boolean;
  attemptsToTop?: number | null;
  attemptsToZone?: number | null;
  clientEventId?: string;
  scoredAt?: string;
  judgeDeviceId?: string | null;
  judgeSessionId?: string | null;
  replayedFromOffline?: boolean;
};

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  let payload: DemoQualifierAttemptRequest;

  try {
    payload = (await request.json()) as DemoQualifierAttemptRequest;
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid request body." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  if (!payload.competitionId || !payload.climberId || !payload.climbNumber) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing competition, climber, or boulder details." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const normalized = normalizeQualifierAttemptInput({
    attemptCount: payload.attemptCount ?? 0,
    topped: payload.topped ?? false,
    zone: payload.zone,
    attemptsToTop: payload.attemptsToTop,
    attemptsToZone: payload.attemptsToZone,
  });

  try {
    const supabase = createServiceRoleSupabaseClient();
    const { data: competition, error: competitionError } = await supabase
      .from("competitions")
      .select("id, is_demo, current_phase")
      .eq("id", payload.competitionId)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (competitionError) {
      throw new Error(competitionError.message);
    }

    if (!competition?.is_demo) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Only the seeded demo competition accepts public demo saves." }, { status: 403 });
    }

    if (competition.current_phase !== "qualifier_open") {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Demo qualifier scoring is only open during the live qualifier phase." }, { status: 409 });
    }

    const { data: round, error: roundError } = await supabase
      .from("competition_rounds")
      .select("id")
      .eq("competition_id", competition.id)
      .eq("scoring_bucket", "qualifier")
      .eq("is_active", true)
      .order("sort_order", { ascending: true })
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (roundError) {
      throw new Error(roundError.message);
    }

    if (!round) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "No active demo qualifier round is available." }, { status: 409 });
    }

    const { data: climber, error: climberError } = await supabase
      .from("climbers")
      .select("id")
      .eq("competition_id", competition.id)
      .eq("id", payload.climberId)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (climberError) {
      throw new Error(climberError.message);
    }

    if (!climber) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Climber not found in the demo competition." }, { status: 404 });
    }

    const { data, error: attemptError } = await supabase.rpc("append_qualifier_score_event", {
      p_competition_id: competition.id,
      p_round_id: round.id,
      p_climber_id: climber.id,
      p_climb_number: payload.climbNumber,
      p_attempt_count: normalized.attemptCount,
      p_topped: normalized.topped,
      p_zone: normalized.zone,
      p_attempts_to_top: normalized.attemptsToTop,
      p_attempts_to_zone: normalized.attemptsToZone,
      p_entered_by: "staff",
      p_client_event_id: payload.clientEventId,
      p_scored_at: payload.scoredAt,
      p_judge_device_id: payload.judgeDeviceId?.trim() || null,
      p_judge_session_id: payload.judgeSessionId?.trim() || null,
      p_replayed_from_offline: payload.replayedFromOffline ?? false,
    });

    if (attemptError) {
      throw new Error(attemptError.message);
    }

    const result = Array.isArray(data) ? data[0] : data;
    const attempt =
      result && typeof result === "object" && "attempt" in result
        ? (result as { attempt: unknown }).attempt
        : null;

    return NextResponse.json({
      attempt,
      status:
        result && typeof result === "object" && typeof (result as { status?: string }).status === "string"
          ? (result as { status: string }).status
          : "accepted",
      conflictReason:
        result &&
        typeof result === "object" &&
        typeof (result as { conflict_reason?: string }).conflict_reason === "string"
          ? (result as { conflict_reason: string }).conflict_reason
          : null,
      clientEventId:
        result &&
        typeof result === "object" &&
        typeof (result as { client_event_id?: string }).client_event_id === "string"
          ? (result as { client_event_id: string }).client_event_id
          : payload.clientEventId ?? null,
      scoredAt:
        result &&
        typeof result === "object" &&
        typeof (result as { scored_at?: string }).scored_at === "string"
          ? (result as { scored_at: string }).scored_at
          : payload.scoredAt ?? null,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unable to save the demo qualifier attempt.",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}


--- src\app\api\demo\reset\route.ts ---

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { createRouteSupabaseClient, createServiceRoleSupabaseClient } from "@/lib/server-supabase";

const RESET_SECRET = process.env["CRON_SECRET"] ?? process.env["DEMO_RESET_SECRET"] ?? null;
const PUBLIC_DEMO_PATH_PREFIXES = ["/demo", "/staff/demo"] as const;

type DemoResetRequest = {
  mode?: string;
  competitionId?: string | string[] | null;
};

async function isAuthorizedAdminRequest(request: NextRequest) {
  const authorization = request.headers.get("authorization");
  if (RESET_SECRET && authorization === `Bearer ${RESET_SECRET}`) {
    return true;
  }

  const supabase = createRouteSupabaseClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    return false;
  }

  const { data: profile } = await supabase.from("profiles").select("role").eq("id", user.id).maybeSingle();
  return profile?.role === "admin";
}

function isPublicDemoResetRequest(request: NextRequest, payload: DemoResetRequest | null) {
  if (request.method !== "POST" || payload?.mode !== "public_demo") {
    return false;
  }

  const origin = request.headers.get("origin");
  if (origin && origin !== request.nextUrl.origin) {
    return false;
  }

  const referer = request.headers.get("referer");
  if (!referer) {
    return false;
  }

  try {
    const refererUrl = new URL(referer);
    return (
      refererUrl.origin === request.nextUrl.origin &&
      PUBLIC_DEMO_PATH_PREFIXES.some((prefix) => refererUrl.pathname.startsWith(prefix))
    );
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function normalizeCompetitionIds(value: DemoResetRequest["competitionId"]) {
  if (typeof value === "string") {
    return value.trim() ? [value.trim()] : [];
  }

  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return value
      .filter((entry): entry is string => typeof entry === "string")
      .map((entry) => entry.trim())
      .filter(Boolean);
  }

  return [] as string[];
}

async function clearDemoCompetitions(competitionIds: string[]) {
  if (!competitionIds.length) {
    return [];
  }

  const supabase = createServiceRoleSupabaseClient();
  const { data: rows, error: loadError } = await supabase
    .from("competitions")
    .select("id")
    .in("id", competitionIds)
    .eq("is_demo", true);

  if (loadError) {
    throw new Error(loadError.message || "Unable to load demo competitions.");
  }

  const idsToDelete = (rows ?? []).map((row) => row.id as string);
  if (!idsToDelete.length) {
    return [];
  }

  const { error: deleteError } = await supabase.from("competitions").delete().in("id", idsToDelete);
  if (deleteError) {
    throw new Error(deleteError.message || "Unable to clear demo competitions.");
  }

  return idsToDelete;
}

async function handleReset(
  request: NextRequest,
  payload: DemoResetRequest | null,
  options?: { publicDemo?: boolean }
) {
  const authorized = options?.publicDemo ? true : await isAuthorizedAdminRequest(request);
  if (!authorized) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "This reset is only available from the live demo or an authorized staff session." },
      { status: 401 }
    );
  }

  try {
    const deletedCompetitionIds = await clearDemoCompetitions(normalizeCompetitionIds(payload?.competitionId));
    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      demo: {
        deletedCompetitionIds,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unable to reset the demo competition.",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  let payload: DemoResetRequest | null = null;

  try {
    payload = (await request.json()) as DemoResetRequest;
  } catch {
    payload = null;
  }

  return handleReset(request, payload, { publicDemo: isPublicDemoResetRequest(request, payload) });
}

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  return handleReset(request, null);
}


--- src\app\api\demo\scorecard-access\route.ts ---

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { DEMO_COMPETITION_SLUG } from "@/lib/demo";
import { createServiceRoleSupabaseClient } from "@/lib/server-supabase";

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const scenario = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("scenario");
  if (scenario !== "competitor") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unsupported demo scorecard scenario." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  try {
    const supabase = createServiceRoleSupabaseClient();
    const { data: competition, error: competitionError } = await supabase
      .from("competitions")
      .select("id, slug, is_demo")
      .eq("slug", DEMO_COMPETITION_SLUG)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (competitionError) {
      throw new Error(competitionError.message);
    }

    if (!competition?.is_demo) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Canonical demo competition not found." }, { status: 404 });
    }

    const { data: climbers, error: climbersError } = await supabase
      .from("climbers")
      .select("id, name, climber_number, access_token")
      .eq("competition_id", competition.id)
      .order("climber_number", { ascending: true });

    if (climbersError) {
      throw new Error(climbersError.message);
    }

    if (!climbers?.length) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "No seeded demo climbers are available yet." }, { status: 404 });
    }

    const { data: attempts, error: attemptsError } = await supabase
      .from("qualifier_attempts")
      .select("climber_id, attempt_count")
      .eq("competition_id", competition.id);

    if (attemptsError) {
      throw new Error(attemptsError.message);
    }

    const attemptTotals = new Map<string, number>();
    attempts?.forEach((attempt) => {
      attemptTotals.set(
        attempt.climber_id,
        (attemptTotals.get(attempt.climber_id) ?? 0) + (attempt.attempt_count ?? 0)
      );
    });

    const chosen = [...climbers].sort((left, right) => {
      const rightAttempts = attemptTotals.get(right.id) ?? 0;
      const leftAttempts = attemptTotals.get(left.id) ?? 0;
      if (rightAttempts !== leftAttempts) {
        return rightAttempts - leftAttempts;
      }
      return left.climber_number.localeCompare(right.climber_number, undefined, { numeric: true });
    })[0];

    return NextResponse.json({
      token: chosen.access_token,
      competitionSlug: competition.slug,
      climber: {
        id: chosen.id,
        name: chosen.name,
        climberNumber: chosen.climber_number,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unable to create the competitor demo session.",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}


--- src\app\api\demo\simulate\route.ts ---

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { normalizeQualifierAttemptInput } from "@/lib/attempts";
import { buildDisplayCategory } from "@/lib/scoring";
import { MOCK_ATHLETE_CURATED_FULL_NAMES } from "@/lib/mock-athlete-name-pool";
import { createServiceRoleSupabaseClient } from "@/lib/server-supabase";

type DemoSimulationMode =
  | "single_score"
  | "live_burst"
  | "hydrate_event"
  | "drama_tick"
  | "drama_reset";

type DemoSimulationRequest = {
  mode?: DemoSimulationMode;
  competitionId?: string;
};

type DramaMetadata = {
  drama_pair?: string[];
  drama_target_climber?: string;
  drama_target_climb_number?: number;
  drama_target_attempts_before?: number;
  drama_target_attempts_after?: number;
  drama_description?: string;
} | null;

type DramaContext = {
  athleteName: string;
  climberBName: string;
  climbLabel: string;
  beforeRank: number | null;
  afterRank: number | null;
  tiebreakExplanation: string;
  isRankSwap: boolean;
};

type QualifierAttemptRow = {
  climber_id: string;
  climb_number: number;
  attempt_count: number;
  topped: boolean;
  zone: boolean;
  attempts_to_top: number | null;
  attempts_to_zone: number | null;
};

type DemoCompetitionRecord = {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  is_demo: boolean;
  current_phase: string;
  total_climbs: number | null;
  max_climbers: number | null;
  demo_metadata: DramaMetadata;
};

type DemoCategoryRecord = {
  id: string;
  gender_division: string;
  age_group: string;
  sort_order: number;
};

type DemoRoundRecord = {
  id: string;
  problem_count: number | null;
};

type DemoScheduleBlockRecord = {
  id: string;
  eligible_category_ids: string[] | null;
};

type DemoClimberInsertRow = {
  id: string;
  competition_id: string;
  name: string;
  climber_number: string;
  province: string;
  category_id: string;
  gender_division: string;
  age_group: string;
  display_category: string;
  time_slot_id: string | null;
  access_token: string;
};

const PROVINCES = ["BC", "AB", "SK", "MB", "ON", "QC", "NB", "NS", "PE", "NL"] as const;
const DRAMA_PREFERRED_AGE_GROUPS = ["Youth B", "Youth A", "Junior", "Open"] as const;

function randomItem<T>(items: readonly T[]) {
  return items[Math.floor(Math.random() * items.length)];
}

function hashSeed(value: string) {
  let hash = 2166136261;

  for (let index = 0; index < value.length; index += 1) {
    hash ^= value.charCodeAt(index);
    hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619);
  }

  return hash >>> 0;
}

function seededUnit(seed: string) {
  return hashSeed(seed) / 4294967295;
}

function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number) {
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));
}

function createAccessToken(seed: string) {
  return `demo-${seed.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")}-${crypto.randomUUID().replace(/-/g, "").slice(0, 10)}`;
}

function getCategoryStrength(ageGroup: string) {
  switch (ageGroup) {
    case "Open":
      return 0.08;
    case "Junior":
      return 0.05;
    case "Youth A":
      return 0.04;
    case "Youth B":
      return 0.02;
    case "Youth C":
      return -0.02;
    case "Youth D":
      return -0.05;
    case "Masters":
      return -0.01;
    case "Rec":
      return -0.08;
    default:
      return 0;
  }
}

function buildRealisticAttempt(
  competitionId: string,
  category: DemoCategoryRecord,
  categoryIndex: number,
  climberSeed: string,
  fieldRank: number,
  fieldSize: number,
  climbNumber: number,
  problemCount: number
) {
  const normalizedRank = fieldSize <= 1 ? 0 : fieldRank / (fieldSize - 1);
  const baseSkill = 0.97 - normalizedRank * 0.72;
  const categoryBoost = getCategoryStrength(category.age_group);
  const consistency = seededUnit(`${climberSeed}:consistency`) * 0.14 - 0.07;
  const clutchBoost = seededUnit(`${climberSeed}:clutch:${climbNumber}`) * 0.14 - 0.07;
  const skill = clamp(baseSkill + categoryBoost + consistency + clutchBoost, 0.12, 1.05);

  const normalizedClimb = problemCount <= 1 ? 0 : (climbNumber - 1) / (problemCount - 1);
  const categoryDifficultyShift = (categoryIndex % 3) * 0.015;
  const routeDifficulty =
    0.22 +
    normalizedClimb * 0.5 +
    seededUnit(`${competitionId}:difficulty:${category.id}:${climbNumber}`) * 0.13 +
    categoryDifficultyShift;

  const attendancePenalty =
    normalizedClimb > 0.65 && skill < 0.45 && seededUnit(`${climberSeed}:attendance:${climbNumber}`) > 0.84
      ? 0.2
      : 0;
  const performance = skill - routeDifficulty - attendancePenalty;
  const volatility = seededUnit(`${climberSeed}:volatility:${climbNumber}`) * 0.12 - 0.06;
  const finalScore = performance + volatility;

  if (finalScore > 0.27) {
    const attemptsToTop = clamp(
      1 + Math.floor((0.46 - finalScore) * -4 + seededUnit(`${climberSeed}:top:${climbNumber}`) * 2),
      1,
      4
    );
    const flashBias = seededUnit(`${climberSeed}:flash:${climbNumber}`);
    const adjustedAttemptsToTop = finalScore > 0.44 && flashBias > 0.32 ? 1 : attemptsToTop;
    const attemptsToZone =
      adjustedAttemptsToTop === 1
        ? 1
        : clamp(adjustedAttemptsToTop - (flashBias > 0.66 ? 1 : 0), 1, adjustedAttemptsToTop);

    return {
      attempt_count: adjustedAttemptsToTop,
      zone: true,
      topped: true,
      attempts_to_top: adjustedAttemptsToTop,
      attempts_to_zone: attemptsToZone,
    };
  }

  if (finalScore > -0.03) {
    const attemptsToZone = clamp(
      1 + Math.floor((0.18 - finalScore) * 6 + seededUnit(`${climberSeed}:zone:${climbNumber}`) * 2),
      1,
      4
    );
    const extraBurns = seededUnit(`${climberSeed}:zone-burn:${climbNumber}`) > 0.58 ? 1 : 0;

    return {
      attempt_count: clamp(attemptsToZone + extraBurns, attemptsToZone, 5),
      zone: true,
      topped: false,
      attempts_to_top: null,
      attempts_to_zone: attemptsToZone,
    };
  }

  const workingAttempts = clamp(
    1 + Math.floor(Math.max(0, routeDifficulty - skill) * 5 + seededUnit(`${climberSeed}:miss:${climbNumber}`) * 2),
    1,
    5
  );

  return {
    attempt_count: workingAttempts,
    zone: false,
    topped: false,
    attempts_to_top: null,
    attempts_to_zone: null,
  };
}

async function requireCompetition(
  competitionId: string | undefined,
  supabase: ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleSupabaseClient>
) {
  if (!competitionId) {
    return {
      error: NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing demo competition id." }, { status: 400 }),
      competition: null,
    };
  }

  const { data: competition, error: competitionError } = await supabase
    .from("competitions")
    .select("id, slug, is_demo, current_phase, total_climbs, max_climbers, demo_metadata")
    .eq("id", competitionId)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (competitionError) {
    throw new Error(competitionError.message);
  }

  if (!competition?.is_demo) {
    return {
      error: NextResponse.json({ error: "Demo competition not found." }, { status: 404 }),
      competition: null,
    };
  }

  return {
    error: null,
    competition: competition as DemoCompetitionRecord,
  };
}

async function seedDramaScenario(
  supabase: ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleSupabaseClient>,
  competition: DemoCompetitionRecord,
  qualifierRound: DemoRoundRecord,
  categoryRows: DemoCategoryRecord[],
  climberRows: DemoClimberInsertRow[],
  problemCount: number
) {
  if (problemCount < 4) {
    throw new Error("This demo event needs at least four qualifier boulders to seed the cut-line drama scenario.");
  }

  const categoryCounts = new Map<string, number>();
  climberRows.forEach((climber) => {
    categoryCounts.set(climber.category_id, (categoryCounts.get(climber.category_id) ?? 0) + 1);
  });

  const targetCategory =
    [...categoryRows]
      .filter(
        (category) =>
          category.gender_division === "Men" &&
          DRAMA_PREFERRED_AGE_GROUPS.includes(
            category.age_group as (typeof DRAMA_PREFERRED_AGE_GROUPS)[number]
          )
      )
      .sort((left, right) => {
        const countDiff = (categoryCounts.get(right.id) ?? 0) - (categoryCounts.get(left.id) ?? 0);
        if (countDiff !== 0) {
          return countDiff;
        }

        return left.sort_order - right.sort_order;
      })[0] ?? null;

  if (!targetCategory) {
    throw new Error("Unable to find a category for the demo cut-line drama scenario.");
  }

  const trio = [...climberRows]
    .filter((climber) => climber.category_id === targetCategory.id)
    .sort((left, right) => Number(left.climber_number) - Number(right.climber_number))
    .slice(0, 3);

  if (trio.length < 3) {
    throw new Error("The demo cut-line drama scenario needs at least three climbers in one category.");
  }

  const [athleteA, athleteB, athleteC] = trio;

  const { error: deleteDramaAttemptsError } = await supabase
    .from("qualifier_attempts")
    .delete()
    .eq("competition_id", competition.id)
    .in(
      "climber_id",
      [athleteA.id, athleteB.id, athleteC.id]
    );

  if (deleteDramaAttemptsError) {
    throw new Error(deleteDramaAttemptsError.message);
  }

  const seededDramaAttempts = [
    [athleteA.id, 1, 1, true, true, 1, 1],
    [athleteA.id, 2, 1, true, true, 1, 1],
    [athleteA.id, 3, 1, true, true, 1, 1],
    [athleteA.id, 4, 2, true, false, null, 2],
    [athleteB.id, 1, 1, true, true, 1, 1],
    [athleteB.id, 2, 2, true, true, 2, 1],
    [athleteB.id, 3, 2, true, true, 2, 1],
    [athleteB.id, 4, 1, true, false, null, 1],
    [athleteC.id, 1, 1, true, true, 1, 1],
    [athleteC.id, 2, 2, true, true, 2, 1],
    [athleteC.id, 3, 3, true, true, 3, 2],
    [athleteC.id, 4, 1, true, false, null, 1],
  ].map(
    ([
      climberId,
      climbNumber,
      attemptCount,
      zone,
      topped,
      attemptsToTop,
      attemptsToZone,
    ]) => ({
      competition_id: competition.id,
      round_id: qualifierRound.id,
      climber_id: climberId,
      climb_number: climbNumber,
      attempt_count: attemptCount,
      zone,
      topped,
      attempts_to_top: attemptsToTop,
      attempts_to_zone: attemptsToZone,
      entered_by: "staff" as const,
    })
  );

  const { error: insertDramaAttemptsError } = await supabase
    .from("qualifier_attempts")
    .insert(seededDramaAttempts);

  if (insertDramaAttemptsError) {
    throw new Error(insertDramaAttemptsError.message);
  }

  const dramaMetadata: Exclude<DramaMetadata, null> = {
    drama_pair: [athleteB.id, athleteC.id],
    drama_target_climber: athleteC.id,
    drama_target_climb_number: 3,
    drama_target_attempts_before: 3,
    drama_target_attempts_after: 1,
    drama_description: `${athleteC.name} tops Boulder 3 in 1 attempt instead of 3 and jumps past ${athleteB.name} at the finals cut line on attempts.`,
  };

  const { error: updateCompetitionError } = await supabase
    .from("competitions")
    .update({ demo_metadata: dramaMetadata })
    .eq("id", competition.id);

  if (updateCompetitionError) {
    throw new Error(updateCompetitionError.message);
  }

  return dramaMetadata;
}

async function handleDramaTick(
  supabase: ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleSupabaseClient>,
  competition: DemoCompetitionRecord
) {
  const metadata = competition.demo_metadata;

  if (!metadata?.drama_target_climber || !metadata.drama_target_climb_number) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "No drama scenario is seeded for this competition yet." },
      { status: 409 }
    );
  }

  const targetClimberId = metadata.drama_target_climber;
  const targetClimbNumber = metadata.drama_target_climb_number;
  const attemptsAfter = metadata.drama_target_attempts_after ?? 1;
  const dramaPair = metadata.drama_pair ?? [];
  const climberBId = dramaPair.find((id) => id !== targetClimberId) ?? null;

  const { data: climbers, error: climbersError } = await supabase
    .from("climbers")
    .select("id, name")
    .in("id", climberBId ? [targetClimberId, climberBId] : [targetClimberId])
    .eq("competition_id", competition.id);

  if (climbersError) {
    throw new Error(climbersError.message);
  }

  const climberC = climbers?.find((climber) => climber.id === targetClimberId) ?? null;
  const climberB = climberBId ? climbers?.find((climber) => climber.id === climberBId) ?? null : null;

  const { data: round, error: roundError } = await supabase
    .from("competition_rounds")
    .select("id, problem_count")
    .eq("competition_id", competition.id)
    .eq("scoring_bucket", "qualifier")
    .eq("is_active", true)
    .order("sort_order", { ascending: true })
    .limit(1)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (roundError) {
    throw new Error(roundError.message);
  }

  if (!round) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "No active qualifier round found." }, { status: 409 });
  }

  const { data: currentAttempt, error: currentAttemptError } = await supabase
    .from("qualifier_attempts")
    .select("attempt_count, attempts_to_top, attempts_to_zone")
    .eq("competition_id", competition.id)
    .eq("climber_id", targetClimberId)
    .eq("round_id", round.id)
    .eq("climb_number", targetClimbNumber)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (currentAttemptError) {
    throw new Error(currentAttemptError.message);
  }

  const attemptsBefore = currentAttempt?.attempt_count ?? metadata.drama_target_attempts_before ?? 3;
  if (attemptsBefore <= attemptsAfter) {
    return NextResponse.json({
      mode: "drama_tick",
      alreadyFired: true,
      message: "The cut-line swap already fired. Reset the drama scenario to replay it cleanly.",
      dramaContext: null,
    });
  }

  const normalized = normalizeQualifierAttemptInput({
    attemptCount: attemptsAfter,
    topped: true,
    zone: true,
    attemptsToTop: attemptsAfter,
    attemptsToZone: attemptsAfter,
  });

  const { data, error: upsertError } = await supabase.rpc("append_qualifier_score_event", {
    p_competition_id: competition.id,
    p_round_id: round.id,
    p_climber_id: targetClimberId,
    p_climb_number: targetClimbNumber,
    p_attempt_count: normalized.attemptCount,
    p_topped: normalized.topped,
    p_zone: normalized.zone,
    p_attempts_to_top: normalized.attemptsToTop,
    p_attempts_to_zone: normalized.attemptsToZone,
    p_entered_by: "staff",
    p_client_event_id: `drama-tick-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
    p_scored_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    p_judge_device_id: "drama-simulator",
    p_judge_session_id: "drama_tick",
    p_replayed_from_offline: false,
  });

  if (upsertError) {
    throw new Error(upsertError.message);
  }

  const result = Array.isArray(data) ? data[0] : data;
  const attempt =
    result && typeof result === "object" && "attempt" in result
      ? (result as { attempt: unknown }).attempt
      : null;

  const dramaContext: DramaContext = {
    athleteName: climberC?.name ?? "Athlete C",
    climberBName: climberB?.name ?? "Athlete B",
    climbLabel: `Boulder ${String(targetClimbNumber).padStart(2, "0")}`,
    beforeRank: null,
    afterRank: null,
    tiebreakExplanation:
      `${climberC?.name ?? "Athlete C"} now tops Boulder ${targetClimbNumber} in ${attemptsAfter} attempt instead of ${attemptsBefore}. ` +
      `That drops their counting attempts and pushes them ahead of ${climberB?.name ?? "Athlete B"} at the finals cut line.`,
    isRankSwap: true,
  };

  return NextResponse.json({
    mode: "drama_tick",
    attempt,
    climberId: targetClimberId,
    climbNumber: targetClimbNumber,
    dramaContext,
  });
}

async function handleDramaReset(
  supabase: ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleSupabaseClient>,
  competition: DemoCompetitionRecord
) {
  const metadata = competition.demo_metadata;

  if (!metadata?.drama_target_climber || !metadata.drama_target_climb_number) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "No drama scenario is seeded for this competition." },
      { status: 409 }
    );
  }

  const { data: round, error: roundError } = await supabase
    .from("competition_rounds")
    .select("id")
    .eq("competition_id", competition.id)
    .eq("scoring_bucket", "qualifier")
    .eq("is_active", true)
    .order("sort_order", { ascending: true })
    .limit(1)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (roundError) {
    throw new Error(roundError.message);
  }

  if (!round) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "No active qualifier round found." }, { status: 409 });
  }

  const attemptsBefore = metadata.drama_target_attempts_before ?? 3;
  const normalized = normalizeQualifierAttemptInput({
    attemptCount: attemptsBefore,
    topped: true,
    zone: true,
    attemptsToTop: attemptsBefore,
    attemptsToZone: Math.max(1, attemptsBefore - 1),
  });

  const { error: upsertError } = await supabase.rpc("append_qualifier_score_event", {
    p_competition_id: competition.id,
    p_round_id: round.id,
    p_climber_id: metadata.drama_target_climber,
    p_climb_number: metadata.drama_target_climb_number,
    p_attempt_count: normalized.attemptCount,
    p_topped: normalized.topped,
    p_zone: normalized.zone,
    p_attempts_to_top: normalized.attemptsToTop,
    p_attempts_to_zone: normalized.attemptsToZone,
    p_entered_by: "staff",
    p_client_event_id: `drama-reset-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
    p_scored_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    p_judge_device_id: "drama-simulator",
    p_judge_session_id: "drama_reset",
    p_replayed_from_offline: false,
  });

  if (upsertError) {
    throw new Error(upsertError.message);
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ mode: "drama_reset", ok: true });
}

async function hydrateEventCompetition(
  supabase: ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleSupabaseClient>,
  competition: DemoCompetitionRecord
) {
  const { data: categories, error: categoriesError } = await supabase
    .from("competition_categories")
    .select("id, gender_division, age_group, sort_order")
    .eq("competition_id", competition.id)
    .order("sort_order", { ascending: true });

  if (categoriesError) {
    throw new Error(categoriesError.message);
  }

  const { data: qualifierRound, error: roundError } = await supabase
    .from("competition_rounds")
    .select("id, problem_count")
    .eq("competition_id", competition.id)
    .eq("scoring_bucket", "qualifier")
    .eq("is_active", true)
    .order("sort_order", { ascending: true })
    .limit(1)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (roundError) {
    throw new Error(roundError.message);
  }

  if (!qualifierRound) {
    throw new Error("No active qualifier round is available for this demo event.");
  }

  const { data: qualifierBlocks, error: blocksError } = await supabase
    .from("competition_schedule_blocks")
    .select("id, eligible_category_ids")
    .eq("competition_id", competition.id)
    .eq("phase_type", "qualifier_round")
    .order("sort_order", { ascending: true });

  if (blocksError) {
    throw new Error(blocksError.message);
  }

  const categoryRows = (categories ?? []) as DemoCategoryRecord[];
  if (!categoryRows.length) {
    throw new Error("This demo event needs at least one competition category before it can be simulated.");
  }

  const problemCount = Math.max(1, qualifierRound.problem_count ?? competition.total_climbs ?? 5);
  const qualifierBlockRows = (qualifierBlocks ?? []) as DemoScheduleBlockRecord[];
  const baseClimberTarget = Math.max(competition.max_climbers ?? 80, categoryRows.length * 18);
  const climberTarget = Math.min(240, baseClimberTarget + categoryRows.length * 6);
  const climbersPerCategory = Math.max(14, Math.floor(climberTarget / categoryRows.length));

  const slotByCategory = new Map<string, string | null>();
  categoryRows.forEach((category) => {
    const matchedBlock =
      qualifierBlockRows.find((block) => (block.eligible_category_ids ?? []).includes(category.id)) ??
      qualifierBlockRows[0] ??
      null;
    slotByCategory.set(category.id, matchedBlock?.id ?? null);
  });

  await supabase.from("qualifier_attempts").delete().eq("competition_id", competition.id);
  await supabase.from("climbers").delete().eq("competition_id", competition.id);

  const climberRows: DemoClimberInsertRow[] = categoryRows.flatMap((category, categoryIndex) =>
    Array.from({ length: climbersPerCategory }, (_, categoryClimberIndex) => {
      const globalIndex = categoryIndex * climbersPerCategory + categoryClimberIndex;
      const poolIndex =
        (categoryIndex * 29 + categoryClimberIndex * 7 + Math.floor(seededUnit(`${competition.id}:${category.id}`) * 11)) %
        MOCK_ATHLETE_CURATED_FULL_NAMES.length;
      const fullName = MOCK_ATHLETE_CURATED_FULL_NAMES[poolIndex] ?? `Demo Climber ${globalIndex + 1}`;
      const displayCategory = buildDisplayCategory(category.gender_division, category.age_group);
      const climberId = crypto.randomUUID();

      return {
        id: climberId,
        competition_id: competition.id,
        name: fullName,
        climber_number: String(101 + globalIndex),
        province: PROVINCES[(globalIndex + categoryIndex) % PROVINCES.length],
        category_id: category.id,
        gender_division: category.gender_division,
        age_group: category.age_group,
        display_category: displayCategory,
        time_slot_id: slotByCategory.get(category.id) ?? null,
        access_token: createAccessToken(`${competition.slug}-${fullName}-${globalIndex}`),
      };
    })
  );

  const { error: climberInsertError } = await supabase.from("climbers").insert(climberRows);
  if (climberInsertError) {
    throw new Error(climberInsertError.message);
  }

  const seededAttempts = climberRows.flatMap((climber, climberIndex) => {
    const category = categoryRows.find((row) => row.id === climber.category_id);
    if (!category) {
      return [];
    }

    const categoryIndex = categoryRows.findIndex((row) => row.id === category.id);
    const fieldRank = climberIndex % climbersPerCategory;
    const climberSeed = `${competition.id}:${category.id}:${climber.id}:${fieldRank}`;

    return Array.from({ length: problemCount }, (_, attemptIndex) => {
      const climbNumber = attemptIndex + 1;
      const skipProbability =
        climbNumber >= Math.max(3, problemCount - 1) && fieldRank > Math.floor(climbersPerCategory * 0.75)
          ? 0.24
          : climbNumber >= Math.max(4, problemCount)
            ? 0.08
            : 0;

      if (skipProbability > 0 && seededUnit(`${climberSeed}:skip:${climbNumber}`) < skipProbability) {
        return null;
      }

      const template = buildRealisticAttempt(
        competition.id,
        category,
        categoryIndex,
        climberSeed,
        fieldRank,
        climbersPerCategory,
        climbNumber,
        problemCount
      );

      return {
        competition_id: competition.id,
        round_id: qualifierRound.id,
        climber_id: climber.id,
        climb_number: climbNumber,
        attempt_count: template.attempt_count,
        topped: template.topped,
        zone: template.zone,
        attempts_to_top: template.attempts_to_top,
        attempts_to_zone: template.attempts_to_zone,
        entered_by: "staff",
      };
    }).filter(Boolean);
  });

  if (seededAttempts.length) {
    const { error: attemptsInsertError } = await supabase.from("qualifier_attempts").insert(seededAttempts);
    if (attemptsInsertError) {
      throw new Error(attemptsInsertError.message);
    }
  }

  const dramaMetadata = await seedDramaScenario(
    supabase,
    competition,
    qualifierRound as DemoRoundRecord,
    categoryRows,
    climberRows,
    problemCount
  );

  return {
    competitionId: competition.id,
    climberCount: climberRows.length,
    qualifierAttemptCount: seededAttempts.length,
    roundId: qualifierRound.id,
    dramaMetadata,
  };
}

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  let payload: DemoSimulationRequest;

  try {
    payload = (await request.json()) as DemoSimulationRequest;
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid request body." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const mode: DemoSimulationMode =
    payload.mode === "live_burst" ||
    payload.mode === "hydrate_event" ||
    payload.mode === "drama_tick" ||
    payload.mode === "drama_reset"
      ? payload.mode
      : "single_score";

  try {
    const supabase = createServiceRoleSupabaseClient();
    const { competition, error } = await requireCompetition(payload.competitionId, supabase);
    if (error || !competition) {
      return error;
    }

    if (mode === "drama_tick") {
      return await handleDramaTick(supabase, competition);
    }

    if (mode === "drama_reset") {
      return await handleDramaReset(supabase, competition);
    }

    if (mode === "hydrate_event") {
      const result = await hydrateEventCompetition(supabase, competition);
      return NextResponse.json({
        mode,
        ...result,
      });
    }

    if (competition.current_phase !== "qualifier_open") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Demo score simulation only runs while qualifiers are live." },
        { status: 409 }
      );
    }

    const { data: round, error: roundError } = await supabase
      .from("competition_rounds")
      .select("id, problem_count")
      .eq("competition_id", competition.id)
      .eq("scoring_bucket", "qualifier")
      .eq("is_active", true)
      .order("sort_order", { ascending: true })
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (roundError) {
      throw new Error(roundError.message);
    }

    if (!round) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "No active demo qualifier round is available." }, { status: 409 });
    }

    const { data: climbers, error: climbersError } = await supabase
      .from("climbers")
      .select("id, name, climber_number")
      .eq("competition_id", competition.id)
      .order("climber_number", { ascending: true });

    if (climbersError) {
      throw new Error(climbersError.message);
    }

    if (!climbers?.length) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "No simulated demo climbers are available yet." }, { status: 404 });
    }

    const { data: attempts, error: attemptsError } = await supabase
      .from("qualifier_attempts")
      .select(
        "competition_id, round_id, climber_id, climb_number, attempt_count, topped, zone, attempts_to_top, attempts_to_zone, entered_by, updated_at"
      )
      .eq("competition_id", competition.id)
      .eq("round_id", round.id);

    if (attemptsError) {
      throw new Error(attemptsError.message);
    }

    const problemCount = Math.max(1, round.problem_count ?? competition.total_climbs ?? 5);
    const attemptMap = new Map<string, QualifierAttemptRow>();
    (attempts ?? []).forEach((attempt) => {
      attemptMap.set(`${attempt.climber_id}:${attempt.climb_number}`, attempt as QualifierAttemptRow);
    });

    const candidateCells: Array<{ climberId: string; climbNumber: number; existing?: QualifierAttemptRow }> = [];
    climbers.forEach((climber) => {
      for (let climbNumber = 1; climbNumber <= problemCount; climbNumber += 1) {
        const existing = attemptMap.get(`${climber.id}:${climbNumber}`);
        if (!existing?.topped) {
          candidateCells.push({ climberId: climber.id, climbNumber, existing });
        }
      }
    });

    if (!candidateCells.length) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "The simulated event has already topped every available cell." }, { status: 409 });
    }

    const preferred = candidateCells.filter((cell) => !cell.existing?.zone);
    const candidate = randomItem(preferred.length ? preferred : candidateCells);
    const nextAttemptCount = Math.max(1, (candidate.existing?.attempt_count ?? 0) + 1);
    const zoneAlready = Boolean(candidate.existing?.zone);
    const topAlready = Boolean(candidate.existing?.topped);
    const shouldZone =
      zoneAlready ||
      nextAttemptCount >= 4 ||
      Math.random() < (mode === "live_burst" ? 0.62 : 0.54);
    const shouldTop =
      topAlready ||
      (shouldZone &&
        (nextAttemptCount >= 5 || Math.random() < (mode === "live_burst" ? 0.34 : 0.26)));

    const normalized = normalizeQualifierAttemptInput({
      attemptCount: nextAttemptCount,
      topped: shouldTop,
      zone: shouldZone,
      attemptsToTop: shouldTop ? candidate.existing?.attempts_to_top ?? nextAttemptCount : null,
      attemptsToZone: shouldZone ? candidate.existing?.attempts_to_zone ?? nextAttemptCount : null,
    });

    const { data, error: upsertError } = await supabase.rpc("append_qualifier_score_event", {
      p_competition_id: competition.id,
      p_round_id: round.id,
      p_climber_id: candidate.climberId,
      p_climb_number: candidate.climbNumber,
      p_attempt_count: normalized.attemptCount,
      p_topped: normalized.topped,
      p_zone: normalized.zone,
      p_attempts_to_top: normalized.attemptsToTop,
      p_attempts_to_zone: normalized.attemptsToZone,
      p_entered_by: "staff",
      p_client_event_id: `demo-sim-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
      p_scored_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      p_judge_device_id: "demo-simulator",
      p_judge_session_id: mode,
      p_replayed_from_offline: false,
    });

    if (upsertError) {
      throw new Error(upsertError.message);
    }

    const result = Array.isArray(data) ? data[0] : data;
    const attempt =
      result && typeof result === "object" && "attempt" in result
        ? (result as { attempt: unknown }).attempt
        : null;

    return NextResponse.json({
      mode,
      attempt,
      climberId: candidate.climberId,
      climbNumber: candidate.climbNumber,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unable to simulate the demo event.",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { fetchOfficialBoulderingEvents } from "@/lib/official-events";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const events = await fetchOfficialBoulderingEvents();
    return NextResponse.json({ events });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Unable to load official events.", error);
    return NextResponse.json(

--- src\app\api\qr\route.ts ---

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";

const DEFAULT_SIZE = 180;
const MIN_SIZE = 120;
const MAX_SIZE = 1024;

function normalizeSize(value: string | null) {
  const parsed = Number.parseInt(value ?? "", 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) {
    return DEFAULT_SIZE;
  }

  return Math.min(MAX_SIZE, Math.max(MIN_SIZE, parsed));
}

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const data = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("data")?.trim() ?? "";
  const size = normalizeSize(request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("size"));

  if (!data) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing QR data." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const upstreamUrl = `https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=${size}x${size}&data=${encodeURIComponent(data)}`;
  const response = await fetch(upstreamUrl, {
    headers: {
      Accept: "image/png",
    },
    next: {
      revalidate: 3600,
    },
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unable to generate QR code." }, { status: 502 });
  }

  const imageBuffer = await response.arrayBuffer();

  return new NextResponse(imageBuffer, {
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": response.headers.get("Content-Type") ?? "image/png",
      "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=3600, s-maxage=3600",
    },
  });
}

--- src\app\api\staff\competitions\actions\route.ts ---

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/server-auth";
import {
  getAdminCompetitionActionErrorStatus,
  handleAdminCompetitionAction,
  type AdminCompetitionActionRequest,
} from "@/lib/server-admin-competition-actions";

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  let payload: AdminCompetitionActionRequest;

  try {
    payload = (await request.json()) as AdminCompetitionActionRequest;
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid request body." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  try {
    const auth = await requireAdmin();
    if (!auth.ok) {
      return auth.response;
    }

    const result = await handleAdminCompetitionAction(payload);
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, ...result });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unable to complete admin action.";
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: getAdminCompetitionActionErrorStatus(message) });
  }
}


--- src\app\api\staff\scores\final\route.ts ---

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { normalizeFinalAttemptInput } from "@/lib/attempts";
import { getStaffScoreErrorStatus, normalizeStaffScoreRpcResult } from "@/lib/staff-score-api";
import { isPositiveInteger, readJsonBody, requireStaffScoreClient, trimOrNull } from "../_shared";

type FinalScoreRequest = {
  competitionId?: string;
  climberId?: string;
  climbNumber?: number;
  top?: boolean;
  zone?: boolean;
  attemptsToTop?: number | null;
  attemptsToZone?: number | null;
  clientEventId?: string;
  scoredAt?: string;
  judgeDeviceId?: string | null;
  judgeSessionId?: string | null;
  replayedFromOffline?: boolean;
};

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  const { payload, response: bodyError } = await readJsonBody<FinalScoreRequest>(request);
  if (bodyError) {
    return bodyError;
  }

  if (!payload?.competitionId || !payload.climberId || !isPositiveInteger(payload.climbNumber)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing competition, climber, or boulder details." }, { status: 400 });
  }
  const clientEventId = trimOrNull(payload.clientEventId);
  if (!clientEventId) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "clientEventId is required for idempotent staff scoring." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const normalized = normalizeFinalAttemptInput({
    top: payload.top ?? false,
    zone: payload.zone ?? false,
    attemptsToTop: payload.attemptsToTop,
    attemptsToZone: payload.attemptsToZone,
  });

  try {
    const { supabase, response: authError } = await requireStaffScoreClient();
    if (authError) {
      return authError;
    }

    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc("submit_staff_final_score_event", {
      p_competition_id: payload.competitionId,
      p_climber_id: payload.climberId,
      p_climb_number: payload.climbNumber,
      p_top: normalized.top,
      p_zone: normalized.zone,
      p_attempts_to_top: normalized.attemptsToTop,
      p_attempts_to_zone: normalized.attemptsToZone,
      p_client_event_id: clientEventId,
      p_scored_at: payload.scoredAt ?? null,
      p_judge_device_id: trimOrNull(payload.judgeDeviceId),
      p_judge_session_id: trimOrNull(payload.judgeSessionId),
      p_replayed_from_offline: payload.replayedFromOffline ?? false,
    });

    if (error) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: getStaffScoreErrorStatus(error.message) });
    }

    return NextResponse.json(
      normalizeStaffScoreRpcResult(data, {
        clientEventId,
        scoredAt: payload.scoredAt ?? null,
      })
    );
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unable to save the finals attempt.";
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: getStaffScoreErrorStatus(message) });
  }
}
