--- src\app\api\staff\scores\_shared.ts ---

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { requireStaff } from "@/lib/server-auth";
import { createRouteSupabaseClient } from "@/lib/server-supabase";

export type StaffScoreClientResult =
  | { supabase: ReturnType<typeof createRouteSupabaseClient>; response: null }
  | { supabase: null; response: NextResponse };

export async function requireStaffScoreClient(): Promise<StaffScoreClientResult> {
  const result = await requireStaff();
  if (!result.ok) {
    return {
      supabase: null,
      response: result.response,
    };
  }

  return { supabase: result.supabase, response: null };
}

export function trimOrNull(value: string | null | undefined) {
  const normalized = value?.trim();
  return normalized ? normalized : null;
}

export function isPositiveInteger(value: unknown): value is number {
  return Number.isInteger(value) && Number(value) > 0;
}

export async function readJsonBody<TPayload>(request: Request) {
  try {
    return { payload: (await request.json()) as TPayload, response: null };
  } catch {
    return {
      payload: null,
      response: NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid request body." }, { status: 400 }),
    };
  }
}


--- src\app\c\[slug]\display\page.tsx ---

"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useParams, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import DemoExperience from "@/components/demo-experience";
import FinalsResultsTable from "@/components/finals-results-table";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Surface } from "@/components/ui/surface";
import { getCompetitionSnapshot, type CompetitionSnapshot } from "@/lib/db";
import { getAuthState, isStaffRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { isDemoCompetitionRecord } from "@/lib/demo";
import { buildCompetitionPath, formatUsesSelfScoredQualifiers, getActiveQueueSessionBlock } from "@/lib/scoring";

export default function CompetitionDisplayPage() {
  const params = useParams<{ slug: string }>();
  const router = useRouter();
  const slug = typeof params?.slug === "string" ? params.slug : "";
  const [snapshot, setSnapshot] = useState<CompetitionSnapshot | null>(null);
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState("all");
  const [selectedFinalsCategory, setSelectedFinalsCategory] = useState("");
  const [authorized, setAuthorized] = useState(false);
  const [checkingAccess, setCheckingAccess] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!slug) {
      return;
    }

    const allowPublicDemoDisplay = isDemoCompetitionRecord({ slug, is_demo: false });
    void getAuthState()
      .then((authState) => {
        if (!isStaffRole(authState.profile?.role) && !allowPublicDemoDisplay) {
          router.replace(buildCompetitionPath(slug, "leaderboard"));
          return;
        }

        setAuthorized(true);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!allowPublicDemoDisplay) {
          router.replace(buildCompetitionPath(slug, "leaderboard"));
          return;
        }
        setAuthorized(true);
      })
      .finally(() => setCheckingAccess(false));
    }, [router, slug]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!authorized) {
      return;
    }

    const load = () => void getCompetitionSnapshot(slug).then((nextSnapshot) => setSnapshot(nextSnapshot));
    load();
    const interval = window.setInterval(load, 15000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(interval);
  }, [authorized, slug]);

  const qualifierCategories = useMemo(() => snapshot?.competition.categories ?? [], [snapshot]);
  const qualifierRows = useMemo(() => {
    if (!snapshot) {
      return [];
    }

    return snapshot.qualifierLeaderboard.filter((entry) => selectedCategory === "all" || entry.category_id === selectedCategory);
  }, [selectedCategory, snapshot]);

  const finalsGroups = useMemo(() => {
    const groups = new Map<string, CompetitionSnapshot["finalsLeaderboard"]>();
    snapshot?.finalsLeaderboard.forEach((entry) => {
      const next = groups.get(entry.display_category) ?? [];
      next.push(entry);
      groups.set(entry.display_category, next);
    });
    return groups;
  }, [snapshot]);
  const queueByClimb = useMemo(() => {
    const grouped = new Map<number, CompetitionSnapshot["boulderQueue"]>();
    snapshot?.boulderQueue.forEach((entry) => {
      const next = grouped.get(entry.climb_number) ?? [];
      next.push(entry);
      grouped.set(entry.climb_number, next);
    });
    return grouped;
  }, [snapshot]);

  const finalsCategories = useMemo(() => Array.from(finalsGroups.keys()).sort(), [finalsGroups]);
  const activeQualifierFormat = snapshot?.activeQualifierRound?.format ?? snapshot?.competition.format ?? "scramble";
  const scrambleFormat = snapshot ? formatUsesSelfScoredQualifiers(activeQualifierFormat) : false;
  const activeQualifierRoundName = snapshot?.activeQualifierRound?.name ?? "Qualifier";
  const activeQueueSession = useMemo(
    () => (snapshot ? getActiveQueueSessionBlock(snapshot.competition) : null),
    [snapshot]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedFinalsCategory && finalsCategories.length) {
      setSelectedFinalsCategory(finalsCategories[0]);
    }
  }, [finalsCategories, selectedFinalsCategory]);

  if (checkingAccess) {
    return (
      <main className="results-page min-h-screen">
        <div className="content-frame space-y-6">
          <Surface variant="card" className="text-slate-600">Checking display access...</Surface>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  if (!authorized) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <main className="results-page min-h-screen">
      <div className="content-frame space-y-6">
        {snapshot && isDemoCompetitionRecord(snapshot.competition) ? (
          <DemoExperience
            enabled
            routeId="display"
            competitionSlug={snapshot.competition.slug}
            bannerTitle="Spectator display demo"
            bannerDescription="This is the projector-friendly event screen for a TV, livestream, or wall display. It keeps the room updated without staff narrating every standings change."
            bannerTip="Use this as the final stop in the demo to show the polished public event-day experience."
          />
        ) : null}
        <section className="results-card" data-demo-anchor="display-overview">
          <div className="results-kicker">Big-screen display</div>
          <h1 className="mt-2 text-5xl font-semibold text-slate-950">{snapshot?.competition.name ?? "Loading competition..."}</h1>
          <p className="mt-3 text-lg text-slate-600">Projector view for live leaderboard updates, finals results, and wall traffic around the room.</p>
          {snapshot ? (
            <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              <Badge>{snapshot.competition.current_phase.replace(/_/g, " ")}</Badge>
              {snapshot.activeQualifierRound?.name ? <Badge>{snapshot.activeQualifierRound.name}</Badge> : null}
              {activeQueueSession ? <Badge>{activeQueueSession.label}</Badge> : null}
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </section>

        {snapshot?.competition.current_phase === "finals_open" || snapshot?.competition.current_phase === "finals_closed" || snapshot?.competition.current_phase === "results" ? (
          <>
            <Surface variant="card" data-demo-anchor="display-queue">
              <div className="finals-category-picker">
                {finalsCategories.map((category) => (
                  <button key={category} type="button" onClick={() => setSelectedFinalsCategory(category)} className={category === selectedFinalsCategory ? "finals-category-pill finals-category-pill-active" : "finals-category-pill"}>
                    {category}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </Surface>
            <FinalsResultsTable title={selectedFinalsCategory} rows={finalsGroups.get(selectedFinalsCategory) ?? []} />
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
          {scrambleFormat && activeQueueSession ? (
            <section className="results-card">
              <div className="results-kicker">Live crowd guide</div>
              <h2 className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold text-slate-950">{activeQueueSession.label}</h2>
              <p className="mt-3 text-lg text-slate-600">
                Shared scramble session check-ins. Use this as a live traffic guide for the wall, not a strict next-up list.
              </p>
              {queueByClimb.size ? (
                <div className="mt-6 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
                  {Array.from(queueByClimb.entries())
                    .sort(([left], [right]) => left - right)
                    .map(([climbNumber, entries]) => (
                      <Surface key={climbNumber} variant="meta">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                          <div className="text-xl font-semibold text-slate-950">Boulder {climbNumber}</div>
                          <Badge>{entries.length} checked in</Badge>
                        </div>
                        <div className="mt-3 text-sm text-slate-600">
                          {entries.length <= 1
                            ? "Open wall. Little to no wait right now."
                            : entries.length <= 3
                              ? "Light traffic. A short queue is forming."
                              : "Busy wall. Expect a bit of a wait."}
                        </div>
                        <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
                          {entries.slice(0, 5).map((entry) => (
                            <div key={entry.climber_id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-sm text-slate-700">
                              <span className="truncate">
                                {entry.climber_name}
                              </span>
                              <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-400">
                                #{entry.climber_number}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </Surface>
                    ))}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <Surface variant="meta" className="mt-6 text-slate-600">
                  No climbers are checked into a boulder yet for this live session.
                </Surface>
              )}
            </section>
          ) : null}
          <section className="results-card" data-demo-anchor="display-standings">
            <div className="results-kicker">{activeQualifierRoundName} standings</div>
            <div className="finals-category-picker">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setSelectedCategory("all")} className={selectedCategory === "all" ? "finals-category-pill finals-category-pill-active" : "finals-category-pill"}>
                All categories
              </button>
              {qualifierCategories.map((category) => (
                <button key={category.id} type="button" onClick={() => setSelectedCategory(category.id)} className={selectedCategory === category.id ? "finals-category-pill finals-category-pill-active" : "finals-category-pill"}>
                  {category.display_name}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div className="mt-6 space-y-4">
              {qualifierRows.map((entry) => (
                <div key={entry.climber_id} className="results-admin-list-item">
                  <div className="text-3xl font-semibold text-slate-950">{selectedCategory === "all" ? entry.overall_rank : entry.category_rank}</div>
                  <div className="flex-1">
                    <div className="text-2xl font-semibold text-slate-950">{entry.name}</div>
                    <div className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">{entry.display_category} · #{entry.climber_number}</div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-right">
                    <div className="text-2xl font-semibold text-slate-950">{entry.total_score}</div>
                    <div className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">{entry.topped_count} tops</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </section>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}


--- src\app\c\[slug]\leaderboard\page.tsx ---

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useParams, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import DemoExperience from "@/components/demo-experience";
import { LeaderboardPanel } from "@/components/demo/leaderboard-panel";
import SiteHeader from "@/components/site-header";
import { Alert } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Surface } from "@/components/ui/surface";
import { getCompetitionSnapshot, type CompetitionSnapshot } from "@/lib/db";
import { isDemoCompetitionRecord } from "@/lib/demo";

export default function CompetitionLeaderboardPage() {
  const params = useParams<{ slug: string }>();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const slug = typeof params?.slug === "string" ? params.slug : "";
  const presentationMode = searchParams?.get("presentation") === "1";
  const [snapshot, setSnapshot] = useState<CompetitionSnapshot | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    void getCompetitionSnapshot(slug)
      .then((nextSnapshot) => setSnapshot(nextSnapshot))
      .catch((nextError) =>
        setError(nextError instanceof Error ? nextError.message : "Unable to load rankings.")
      );
  }, [slug]);

  return (
    <main className="results-page">
      <div className="content-frame space-y-6">
        {!presentationMode ? <SiteHeader light competitionSlug={slug} /> : null}

        {error ? <Alert variant="error">{error}</Alert> : null}
        {snapshot && isDemoCompetitionRecord(snapshot.competition) ? (
          <DemoExperience
            enabled
            routeId="leaderboard"
            competitionSlug={snapshot.competition.slug}
            bannerTitle="Live leaderboard demo"
            bannerDescription="This is the page climbers, parents, and spectators can open during the event. It updates from the same competition model the judge panel writes to."
            bannerTip="Change categories or refresh after a saved score to show how public results stay in sync."
          />
        ) : null}

        {snapshot ? (
          <>
            {!presentationMode ? (
              <Surface variant="card">
                <div className="results-kicker">Live leaderboard</div>
                <h1 className="mt-2 text-4xl font-semibold text-slate-950 sm:text-5xl">
                  {snapshot.competition.name}
                </h1>
                <p className="mt-3 max-w-3xl text-base leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
                  This is the public-facing leaderboard for climbers, coaches, parents, and spectators. It stays in sync with the same event record the judge station writes to.
                </p>
              </Surface>
            ) : null}
            <LeaderboardPanel snapshot={snapshot} />
          </>
        ) : (
          <Surface variant="card" className="text-slate-600">
            Loading rankings...
          </Surface>
        )}
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}


--- src\app\c\[slug]\page.tsx ---

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useParams } from "next/navigation";
import SiteHeader from "@/components/site-header";
import CompetitionHero from "@/components/competition-hero";
import { DemoModeBanner } from "@/components/demo/demo-mode-banner";
import FinalsResultsTable from "@/components/finals-results-table";
import { Alert } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { buttonStyles } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { SectionHeader } from "@/components/ui/section-header";
import { Surface } from "@/components/ui/surface";
import { getCompetitionSnapshot, type CompetitionSnapshot } from "@/lib/db";
import { publicSupabase, supabaseConfigured } from "@/lib/supabase";
import { isDemoCompetitionRecord } from "@/lib/demo";
import {
  buildCompetitionPath,
  buildDisplayPath,
  formatCompetitionPhaseLabel,
  formatSchedulePhaseLabel,
  formatTimeRange,
  formatUsesSelfScoredQualifiers,
  getActiveQueueSessionBlock,
  getActiveScheduleBlock,
  getTimeSlotLabel,
  parseScheduleTimeToMinutes,
} from "@/lib/scoring";

export default function CompetitionOverviewPage() {
  const params = useParams<{ slug: string }>();
  const slug = typeof params?.slug === "string" ? params.slug : "";
  const [snapshot, setSnapshot] = useState<CompetitionSnapshot | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [selectedFinalsCategory, setSelectedFinalsCategory] = useState("");

  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!slug) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      const nextSnapshot = await getCompetitionSnapshot(slug);
      setSnapshot(nextSnapshot);
      setError("");
    } catch (nextError) {
      setError(nextError instanceof Error ? nextError.message : "Unable to load the competition.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [slug]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void refresh();
  }, [refresh]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!supabaseConfigured || !snapshot) {
      return;
    }

    const competitionId = snapshot.competition.id;
    const channel = publicSupabase
      .channel(`competition-${competitionId}`)
      .on("postgres_changes", { event: "*", schema: "public", table: "competitions", filter: `id=eq.${competitionId}` }, refresh)
      .on(
        "postgres_changes",
        { event: "*", schema: "public", table: "competition_schedule_blocks", filter: `competition_id=eq.${competitionId}` },
        refresh
      )
      .on("postgres_changes", { event: "*", schema: "public", table: "competition_boulder_queue", filter: `competition_id=eq.${competitionId}` }, refresh)
      .on("postgres_changes", { event: "*", schema: "public", table: "climbers", filter: `competition_id=eq.${competitionId}` }, refresh)
      .on("postgres_changes", { event: "*", schema: "public", table: "competition_finalists", filter: `competition_id=eq.${competitionId}` }, refresh)
      .subscribe();

    return () => {
      publicSupabase.removeChannel(channel);
    };
  }, [refresh, snapshot]);

  const activeBlock = useMemo(
    () => (snapshot ? getActiveScheduleBlock(snapshot.competition) : null),
    [snapshot]
  );
  const scrambleFormat = snapshot ? formatUsesSelfScoredQualifiers(snapshot.competition.format) : false;
  const activeScrambleSession = useMemo(
    () => (snapshot ? getActiveQueueSessionBlock(snapshot.competition) : null),
    [snapshot]
  );
  const orderedScheduleBlocks = useMemo(() => {
    if (!snapshot) {
      return [];
    }

    return [...snapshot.competition.schedule_blocks].sort((left, right) => {
      const startDiff = parseScheduleTimeToMinutes(left.start_time) - parseScheduleTimeToMinutes(right.start_time);
      if (startDiff !== 0) {
        return startDiff;
      }

      const endDiff = parseScheduleTimeToMinutes(left.end_time) - parseScheduleTimeToMinutes(right.end_time);
      if (endDiff !== 0) {
        return endDiff;
      }

      return left.label.localeCompare(right.label);
    });
  }, [snapshot]);
  const queueByClimb = useMemo(() => {
    const grouped = new Map<number, CompetitionSnapshot["boulderQueue"]>();
    snapshot?.boulderQueue.forEach((entry) => {
      const next = grouped.get(entry.climb_number) ?? [];
      next.push(entry);
      grouped.set(entry.climb_number, next);
    });
    return grouped;
  }, [snapshot]);
  const categoryById = useMemo(
    () => new Map(snapshot?.competition.categories.map((category) => [category.id, category]) ?? []),
    [snapshot]
  );
  const getBlockAgeGroups = useCallback(
    (blockIdList: string[]) => {
      const ageGroups = new Set<string>();
      blockIdList.forEach((categoryId) => {
        const category = categoryById.get(categoryId);
        if (category?.age_group) {
          ageGroups.add(category.age_group);
        }
      });
      return Array.from(ageGroups);
    },
    [categoryById]
  );
  const nextBlock = useMemo(() => {
    if (!activeBlock) {
      return null;
    }

    const activeIndex = orderedScheduleBlocks.findIndex((block) => block.id === activeBlock.id);
    if (activeIndex < 0) {
      return null;
    }

    return orderedScheduleBlocks[activeIndex + 1] ?? null;
  }, [activeBlock, orderedScheduleBlocks]);
  const activeBlockIndex = useMemo(
    () => (activeBlock ? orderedScheduleBlocks.findIndex((block) => block.id === activeBlock.id) : -1),
    [activeBlock, orderedScheduleBlocks]
  );
  const finalsGroups = useMemo(() => {
    const groups = new Map<string, CompetitionSnapshot["finalsLeaderboard"]>();
    snapshot?.finalsLeaderboard.forEach((entry) => {
      const next = groups.get(entry.display_category) ?? [];
      next.push(entry);
      groups.set(entry.display_category, next);
    });
    return groups;
  }, [snapshot]);
  const finalsCategories = useMemo(() => Array.from(finalsGroups.keys()).sort(), [finalsGroups]);
  const finalsRows = finalsGroups.get(selectedFinalsCategory) ?? [];
  const finalsActive =
    snapshot?.competition.current_phase === "finals_open" ||
    snapshot?.competition.current_phase === "finals_closed" ||
    snapshot?.competition.current_phase === "results";
  const liveCategoryCount = activeBlock ? getBlockAgeGroups(activeBlock.eligible_category_ids).length : 0;
  const overviewNavItems = useMemo(
    () => [
      { href: buildCompetitionPath(slug), label: "Overview" },
      { href: `${buildCompetitionPath(slug)}#start-list`, label: "Start list" },
      { href: buildCompetitionPath(slug, "register"), label: "Register" },
      { href: buildCompetitionPath(slug, "scorecard"), label: "Scorecard" },
      { href: buildCompetitionPath(slug, "leaderboard"), label: "Live leaderboard" },
    ],
    [slug]
  );
  const sortedStartList = useMemo(() => {
    if (!snapshot) {
      return [];
    }

    const scheduleIndex = new Map(
      snapshot.competition.schedule_blocks.map((block, index) => [block.id, index] as const)
    );

    return [...snapshot.climbers].sort((left, right) => {
      const leftSlotIndex =
        left.time_slot_id && scheduleIndex.has(left.time_slot_id)
          ? (scheduleIndex.get(left.time_slot_id) ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)
          : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
      const rightSlotIndex =
        right.time_slot_id && scheduleIndex.has(right.time_slot_id)
          ? (scheduleIndex.get(right.time_slot_id) ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)
          : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;

      if (leftSlotIndex !== rightSlotIndex) {
        return leftSlotIndex - rightSlotIndex;
      }

      const leftCategoryOrder = categoryById.get(left.category_id ?? "")?.sort_order ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
      const rightCategoryOrder = categoryById.get(right.category_id ?? "")?.sort_order ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;

      if (leftCategoryOrder !== rightCategoryOrder) {
        return leftCategoryOrder - rightCategoryOrder;
      }

      const leftNumber = Number.parseInt(left.climber_number, 10);
      const rightNumber = Number.parseInt(right.climber_number, 10);
      const leftNumberValid = Number.isFinite(leftNumber);
      const rightNumberValid = Number.isFinite(rightNumber);

      if (leftNumberValid && rightNumberValid && leftNumber !== rightNumber) {
        return leftNumber - rightNumber;
      }

      return left.name.localeCompare(right.name);
    });
  }, [categoryById, snapshot]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedFinalsCategory && finalsCategories.length) {
      setSelectedFinalsCategory(finalsCategories[0]);
      return;
    }

    if (selectedFinalsCategory && !finalsGroups.has(selectedFinalsCategory)) {
      setSelectedFinalsCategory(finalsCategories[0] ?? "");
    }
  }, [finalsCategories, finalsGroups, selectedFinalsCategory]);

  return (
    <main className="results-page">
      <div className="content-frame space-y-6">
        <SiteHeader light competitionSlug={slug} navItems={overviewNavItems} />

        {error ? <Alert variant="error">{error}</Alert> : null}

        {snapshot ? (
          <>
            {isDemoCompetitionRecord(snapshot.competition) ? <DemoModeBanner /> : null}
            <CompetitionHero competition={snapshot.competition} />

            <section className="results-editorial-panel">
              <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[1.1fr_0.9fr] lg:items-start">
                <SectionHeader
                  kicker="What should I do now?"
                  title={activeBlock ? `${activeBlock.label} is the current focus.` : "The event page is ready even before the first live block starts."}
                  description="Open the action you need first, then use the schedule and start list below for the deeper event details."
                />
                <div className="results-link-list">
                  <Link href={buildCompetitionPath(slug, "register")} className={buttonStyles({ variant: "primary", fullWidth: true })}>
                    Open registration
                  </Link>
                  <Link href={buildCompetitionPath(slug, "scorecard")} className={buttonStyles({ variant: "secondary", fullWidth: true })}>
                    Open scorecard
                  </Link>
                  <Link href={buildCompetitionPath(slug, "leaderboard")} className={buttonStyles({ variant: "secondary", fullWidth: true })}>
                    Open live leaderboard
                  </Link>
                  <Link href={buildDisplayPath(slug)} className={buttonStyles({ variant: "secondary", fullWidth: true })}>
                    Open big-screen display
                  </Link>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                <div className="rounded-[1rem] border border-slate-200 bg-white/85 px-4 py-3">
                  <div className="results-kicker">Current phase</div>
                  <div className="mt-2 text-base font-semibold text-slate-950">
                    {formatCompetitionPhaseLabel(snapshot.competition.current_phase)}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="rounded-[1rem] border border-slate-200 bg-white/85 px-4 py-3">
                  <div className="results-kicker">Field size</div>
                  <div className="mt-2 text-base font-semibold text-slate-950">
                    {snapshot.climbers.length} {snapshot.climbers.length === 1 ? "climber" : "climbers"}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="rounded-[1rem] border border-slate-200 bg-white/85 px-4 py-3">
                  <div className="results-kicker">Live block</div>
                  <div className="mt-2 text-base font-semibold text-slate-950">
                    {activeBlock ? formatTimeRange(activeBlock.start_time, activeBlock.end_time) : "Waiting"}
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                    {activeBlock ? `${liveCategoryCount} live ${liveCategoryCount === 1 ? "group" : "groups"}` : "No schedule block is live yet."}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="rounded-[1rem] border border-slate-200 bg-white/85 px-4 py-3">
                  <div className="results-kicker">Up next</div>
                  <div className="mt-2 text-base font-semibold text-slate-950">
                    {nextBlock ? nextBlock.label : "Nothing queued"}
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                    {nextBlock ? formatTimeRange(nextBlock.start_time, nextBlock.end_time) : "The current schedule has no later block."}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </section>

            {finalsActive ? (
              finalsRows.length ? (
                <>
                  <section className="results-card">
                    <div className="results-kicker">Finals results</div>
                    <h2 className="mt-2 break-words text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-950">Final standings</h2>
                    <div className="mt-3 text-sm text-slate-600">
                      Competition phase: {formatCompetitionPhaseLabel(snapshot.competition.current_phase)}
                    </div>
                    <div className="finals-category-picker mt-5">
                      {finalsCategories.map((category) => (
                        <button
                          key={category}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setSelectedFinalsCategory(category)}
                          className={
                            category === selectedFinalsCategory
                              ? "finals-category-pill finals-category-pill-active"
                              : "finals-category-pill"
                          }
                        >
                          {category}
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </section>
                  <FinalsResultsTable title={selectedFinalsCategory} rows={finalsRows} />
                </>
              ) : (
                <Surface variant="card" className="text-slate-600">
                  Finals are active, but no finals scores have been entered yet.
                </Surface>
              )
            ) : null}

            <section className="results-card">
              <div className="results-kicker">{activeScrambleSession ? "Active scramble session" : "Live schedule"}</div>
              <h2 className="mt-2 break-words text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-950 sm:text-3xl">
                {activeBlock ? activeBlock.label : "No block live"}
              </h2>
              <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
                The live block, the next block, and the public-facing schedule stay together here so athletes and spectators can orient themselves quickly.
              </p>

              {!activeBlock ? (
                <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
                  <p className="text-base text-slate-600">
                    {snapshot.competition.official_schedule_url
                      ? "No in-app schedule blocks are live yet. The official event schedule is available below."
                      : "Staff has not marked a live schedule block yet."}
                  </p>
                  {snapshot.competition.official_schedule_url ? (
                    <a
                      href={snapshot.competition.official_schedule_url}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noreferrer"
                      className="results-secondary-button inline-flex"
                    >
                      Open official schedule
                    </a>
                  ) : null}
                </div>
              ) : null}

              {orderedScheduleBlocks.length ? (
                <div className="results-schedule-list mt-4 grid gap-3">
                  {orderedScheduleBlocks.map((block, index) => {
                    const blockAgeGroups = getBlockAgeGroups(block.eligible_category_ids);
                    const isPastBlock = activeBlockIndex >= 0 && index < activeBlockIndex;
                    const isNextBlock = activeBlockIndex >= 0 && index === activeBlockIndex + 1;

                    if (block.is_active) {
                      return (
                        <div key={block.id} className="results-live-stage">
                          <div className="results-live-stage__grid">
                            <div className="min-w-0">
                              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                                <span className="results-chip results-chip-live">
                                  <span className="results-live-dot" aria-hidden="true" />
                                  Now live
                                </span>
                                <span className="results-chip">{formatSchedulePhaseLabel(block.phase_type)}</span>
                                {block.audience_label ? <span className="results-chip">{block.audience_label}</span> : null}
                              </div>

                              <div className="results-live-stage__headline">
                                <div className="results-kicker">Live Block</div>
                                <div className="results-live-stage__title">{block.label}</div>
                                <div className="results-live-stage__time">
                                  {formatTimeRange(block.start_time, block.end_time)}
                                </div>
                              </div>

                              {blockAgeGroups.length ? (
                                <div className="results-live-stage__categories">
                                  <div className="results-kicker">Live Categories</div>
                                  <div className="results-live-stage__category-row">
                                    {blockAgeGroups.map((ageGroup) => (
                                      <span key={`${block.id}-${ageGroup}`} className="results-live-stage__category-pill">
                                        {ageGroup}
                                      </span>
                                    ))}
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                              ) : null}
                            </div>

                            {nextBlock ? (
                              <div className="results-live-stage__next">
                                <div className="results-kicker">Up Next</div>
                                <div className="results-live-stage__next-label break-words">{nextBlock.label}</div>
                                <div className="results-live-stage__next-time break-words">
                                  {formatTimeRange(nextBlock.start_time, nextBlock.end_time)}
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            ) : null}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      );
                    }

                    return (
                      <div
                        key={block.id}
                        className={[
                          "results-meta-card",
                          isPastBlock ? "results-schedule-block-past" : "",
                          isNextBlock ? "results-schedule-block-next" : "",
                        ]
                          .filter(Boolean)
                          .join(" ")}
                      >
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <div className="break-words text-lg font-semibold text-slate-950">{block.label}</div>
                            <div className="mt-1 break-words text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
                              {formatTimeRange(block.start_time, block.end_time)}
                            </div>
                            {blockAgeGroups.length ? (
                              <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                                {blockAgeGroups.map((ageGroup) => (
                                  <span key={`${block.id}-${ageGroup}`} className="results-chip">
                                    {ageGroup}
                                  </span>
                                ))}
                              </div>
                            ) : null}
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                            {isNextBlock ? <span className="results-chip border-sky-200 bg-sky-50 text-sky-700">Up next</span> : null}
                            <span className="results-chip">{formatSchedulePhaseLabel(block.phase_type)}</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              ) : null}

              {activeScrambleSession ? (
                <div className="results-alert results-alert-success mt-4">
                  This is the live shared session window. Multiple climbers can score across the wall during this block.
                </div>
              ) : null}

              {activeScrambleSession && queueByClimb.size ? (
                <div className="mt-4 rounded-[1.35rem] border border-slate-200 bg-white/80 p-4">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <div className="results-kicker">Wall traffic</div>
                      <div className="mt-2 text-lg font-semibold text-slate-950">Live boulder check-ins</div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="results-chip">
                      {snapshot.boulderQueue.length} live {snapshot.boulderQueue.length === 1 ? "check-in" : "check-ins"}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                    {Array.from(queueByClimb.entries())
                      .sort(([left], [right]) => left - right)
                      .map(([climbNumber, entries]) => (
                        <div key={climbNumber} className="min-w-0 rounded-[1.2rem] border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/80 px-4 py-3">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                            <div className="font-semibold text-slate-950">Boulder {climbNumber}</div>
                            <div className="results-chip">{entries.length} checked in</div>
                          </div>
                          <div className="mt-3 break-words text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
                            {entries.length <= 1
                              ? "Open wall. Little to no wait right now."
                              : entries.length <= 3
                                ? "Light traffic. A short queue is forming."
                                : "Busy wall. Expect a bit of a wait."}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </section>

            <section id="start-list" className="results-card scroll-mt-24">
              <div>
                <div className="results-kicker">Start list</div>
                <h2 className="mt-2 break-words text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-950">Registered athletes</h2>
                <p className="mt-3 max-w-2xl text-base leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
                  See who is entered, which category they are in, and which session or wave they are assigned to.
                </p>
              </div>

              {!sortedStartList.length ? (
                <div className="results-meta-card mt-6 text-slate-600">
                  No athletes have registered yet.
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="results-data-scroll mt-6 hidden md:block">
                  <div className="min-w-[920px]">
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-[1.6fr_1fr_1.2fr_0.8fr] gap-4 border-b border-slate-200 px-5 py-3 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-500">
                      <div>Athlete</div>
                      <div>Category</div>
                      <div>Session</div>
                      <div>Province</div>
                    </div>
                    {sortedStartList.map((climber) => (
                      <div key={climber.id} className="grid grid-cols-[1.6fr_1fr_1.2fr_0.8fr] gap-4 border-b border-slate-100 px-5 py-4 text-sm text-slate-700">
                        <div className="min-w-0">
                          <div className="break-words text-lg font-semibold text-slate-950">{climber.name}</div>
                          <div className="mt-1 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-500">#{climber.climber_number}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div>{climber.display_category}</div>
                        <div>{getTimeSlotLabel(climber.time_slot_id, snapshot.competition)}</div>
                        <div>{climber.province}</div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {sortedStartList.length ? (
                <div className="mt-6 space-y-3 md:hidden">
                  {sortedStartList.map((climber) => (
                    <div key={climber.id} className="results-meta-card">
                      <div className="break-words text-lg font-semibold text-slate-950">{climber.name}</div>
                      <div className="mt-1 break-words text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
                        #{climber.climber_number} | {climber.province}
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                        <span className="results-chip">{climber.display_category}</span>
                        <span className="results-chip">{getTimeSlotLabel(climber.time_slot_id, snapshot.competition)}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </section>

            <section className="results-card">
              <div>
                <div className="results-kicker">Categories</div>
                <h2 className="mt-2 break-words text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-950">Competition categories</h2>
                <p className="mt-3 max-w-2xl text-base leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
                  Public standings stay separate by category. Open the rankings page for the current results.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                {snapshot.competition.categories.map((category) => (
                  <span key={category.id} className="results-chip">
                    {category.display_name}
                  </span>
                ))}
              </div>

              <div className="mt-6 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
                <div className="results-meta-card results-meta-card-compact">
                  <div className="results-kicker">Scorecards</div>
                  <div className="mt-2 text-lg font-semibold text-slate-950">
                    {scrambleFormat ? "Private scorecards" : "Private links"}
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">
                    {scrambleFormat ? "Each climber gets a live self-scoring link." : "Each climber gets a secure scoring link."}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="results-meta-card results-meta-card-compact">
                  <div className="results-kicker">Current phase</div>
                  <div className="mt-2 text-lg font-semibold text-slate-950">
                    {formatCompetitionPhaseLabel(snapshot.competition.current_phase)}
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">
                    Rankings and event status update here as the competition moves through the day.
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </section>
          </>
        ) : loading ? (
          <section className="results-card text-slate-600">Loading competition...</section>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useParams, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import SiteHeader from "@/components/site-header";
import { getCompetitionSnapshot, registerClimber, type CompetitionSnapshot } from "@/lib/db";
import { saveScorecardAccessToken } from "@/lib/scorecard-access";
import {
  canRegisterDuringCompetition,
  CLIMBER_NUMBER_PATTERN,
  formatCompetitionPhaseLabel,

export default function CompetitionRegisterPage() {
  const params = useParams<{ slug: string }>();
  const slug = typeof params?.slug === "string" ? params.slug : "";
  const router = useRouter();
  const errorRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const [snapshot, setSnapshot] = useState<CompetitionSnapshot | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [fieldError, setFieldError] = useState<{ field: string; message: string } | null>(null);
  const [successLink, setSuccessLink] = useState("");
  const [redirectingToScorecard, setRedirectingToScorecard] = useState(false);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [climberNumber, setClimberNumber] = useState("");
  const [province, setProvince] = useState("");
  const [categoryId, setCategoryId] = useState("");
  const [timeSlotId, setTimeSlotId] = useState("");
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);

  const loadSnapshot = useCallback(async () => {
    const nextSnapshot = await getCompetitionSnapshot(slug);
    setSnapshot(nextSnapshot);
    setCategoryId((current) => current || nextSnapshot.registrationChoices[0]?.category.id || "");
    return nextSnapshot;
  }, [slug]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadSnapshot()
      .catch((nextError) => {
        setError(nextError instanceof Error ? nextError.message : "Unable to load registration options.");
      })
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [loadSnapshot]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (error || fieldError) {
      errorRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
    }
  }, [error, fieldError]);

  const selectedChoice = useMemo(
    () => snapshot?.registrationChoices.find((choice) => choice.category.id === categoryId) ?? null,
    [categoryId, snapshot]
  );
  const availableSlots = useMemo(() => selectedChoice?.slots ?? [], [selectedChoice]);
  const selectedSlot = useMemo(
    () => availableSlots.find((slot) => slot.id === timeSlotId) ?? null,
    [availableSlots, timeSlotId]
  );
  const activeScheduleBlock = useMemo(() => (snapshot ? getActiveScheduleBlock(snapshot.competition) : null), [snapshot]);
  const registrationOpen = snapshot ? canRegisterDuringCompetition(snapshot.competition) : false;
  const registrationMessage = useMemo(() => {
    if (!snapshot || registrationOpen) {
      return "";
    }

    const now = new Date();
    const opensAt = snapshot.competition.registration_opens_at
      ? new Date(snapshot.competition.registration_opens_at)
      : null;
    const closesAt = snapshot.competition.registration_closes_at
      ? new Date(snapshot.competition.registration_closes_at)
      : null;

    if (opensAt && !Number.isNaN(opensAt.getTime()) && now < opensAt) {
      return `Registration opens on ${formatDateTimeLabel(snapshot.competition.registration_opens_at)}.`;
    }

    if (closesAt && !Number.isNaN(closesAt.getTime()) && now > closesAt) {
      return `Registration closed on ${formatDateTimeLabel(snapshot.competition.registration_closes_at)}.`;
    }

    if (["finals_open", "finals_closed", "results"].includes(snapshot.competition.current_phase)) {
      return "Registration is closed because this competition has already advanced beyond qualifier registration.";
    }

    return `Registration is currently closed during the ${formatCompetitionPhaseLabel(snapshot.competition.current_phase).toLowerCase()} phase.`;
  }, [registrationOpen, snapshot]);
  const assignmentLabel = snapshot ? getRegistrationAssignmentLabel(snapshot.competition) : "Assignment";
  const assignmentHelp = snapshot ? getRegistrationAssignmentHelpText(snapshot.competition) : "";
  const steps = useMemo(() => ["Details", "Category", assignmentLabel, "Confirm"] as const, [assignmentLabel]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!availableSlots.length) {
      setTimeSlotId("");
      return;
    }
    if (!availableSlots.some((slot) => slot.id === timeSlotId && slot.remaining_capacity > 0)) {
      setTimeSlotId(availableSlots.find((slot) => slot.remaining_capacity > 0)?.id ?? "");
    }
  }, [availableSlots, timeSlotId]);

  const validateCurrentStep = () => {
    setFieldError(null);
    if (step === 0) {
      if (!name.trim()) {
        setFieldError({ field: "name", message: "Enter the climber name." });
        return false;
      }
      if (!climberNumber.trim()) {
        setFieldError({ field: "climberNumber", message: "Enter the climber number." });
        return false;
      }
      if (!isValidClimberNumber(climberNumber)) {
        setFieldError({ field: "climberNumber", message: "Climber numbers must be 1 to 4 digits." });
        return false;
      }
      if (!province.trim()) {
        setFieldError({ field: "province", message: "Enter the province." });
        return false;
      }
    }
    if (step === 1 && !categoryId) {
      setFieldError({ field: "category", message: "Choose a category to continue." });
      return false;
    }
    if (step === 2 && availableSlots.length && !timeSlotId) {
      setFieldError({ field: "timeSlot", message: "Choose a time slot to continue." });
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (event: React.FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    setSuccessLink("");
    setRedirectingToScorecard(false);
    setFieldError(null);

    if (!snapshot) {
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const refreshedSnapshot = await loadSnapshot();
      const climber = await registerClimber({
        competitionId: refreshedSnapshot.competition.id,
        name,
        climberNumber,
        province,
        categoryId,
        timeSlotId: timeSlotId || null,
      });
      const link = climber.scorecard_path;
      saveScorecardAccessToken(climber.access_token, refreshedSnapshot.competition.slug);
      setSuccessLink(link);
      setRedirectingToScorecard(true);
      router.push(link);
    } catch (nextError) {
      setError(nextError instanceof Error ? nextError.message : "Registration failed.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <main className="results-page">
      <div className="content-frame space-y-6">
        <SiteHeader light competitionSlug={slug} />

        <section className="results-card">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div>
              <div className="results-kicker">Registration</div>
              <h1 className="mt-2 text-4xl font-semibold text-slate-950">
                {snapshot ? `Register for ${snapshot.competition.name}` : "Register for competition"}
              </h1>
            </div>
            <div className="results-chip">
              {snapshot ? formatCompetitionPhaseLabel(snapshot.competition.current_phase) : "Loading"}
            </div>
          </div>

            <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {steps.map((label, index) => (
              <div key={label} className={index === step ? "finals-category-pill finals-category-pill-active" : "finals-category-pill"}>
                {index + 1}. {label}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {activeScheduleBlock ? (
            <div className="results-meta-card mt-4">
              <div className="results-kicker">Live schedule context</div>
              <div className="mt-2 text-xl font-semibold text-slate-950">{activeScheduleBlock.label}</div>
            </div>
          ) : null}

          {!registrationOpen && snapshot ? (
            <div className="results-alert results-alert-error mt-4">
              {registrationMessage}
            </div>
          ) : null}

          {(error || fieldError || successLink) ? (
            <div ref={errorRef} aria-live="polite" className="mt-4 space-y-3">
              {error ? <div className="results-alert results-alert-error">{error}</div> : null}
              {fieldError ? <div className="results-alert results-alert-error">{fieldError.message}</div> : null}
              {successLink ? <div className="results-alert results-alert-success">{redirectingToScorecard ? "Registration complete. Opening your private scorecard..." : "Registration complete."}</div> : null}
            </div>
          ) : null}

          {loading ? (
            <div className="mt-6 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
              <div className="skeleton-block h-28 w-full" />
              <div className="skeleton-block h-28 w-full" />
            </div>
          ) : (
            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="mt-6 space-y-6">
              {step === 0 ? (
                <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
                  <label className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">Climber name</span>
                    <input value={name} onChange={(event) => setName(event.target.value)} className="results-input" placeholder="Jordan Chen" disabled={!registrationOpen || submitting} />
                  </label>
                  <label className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">Climber number</span>
                    <input
                      value={climberNumber}
                      onChange={(event) => setClimberNumber(normalizeClimberNumberInput(event.target.value))}
                      className="results-input"
                      placeholder="047"
                      inputMode="numeric"
                      pattern={CLIMBER_NUMBER_PATTERN.source}
                      maxLength={4}
                      disabled={!registrationOpen || submitting}
                    />
                  </label>
                  <label className="space-y-2 md:col-span-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">Province</span>
                    <input value={province} onChange={(event) => setProvince(event.target.value)} className="results-input" placeholder="Nova Scotia" disabled={!registrationOpen || submitting} />
                  </label>
                </div>

              {step === 1 ? (
                <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                  {snapshot?.registrationChoices.map((choice) => (

                      onClick={() => setCategoryId(choice.category.id)}
                      className={`results-admin-list-item ${categoryId === choice.category.id ? "results-admin-list-item-active" : ""}`}
                      disabled={!registrationOpen || submitting}
                    >
                      <div>
                        <div className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-950">{choice.category.display_name}</div>
                        <div className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">{choice.slots.length ? `${choice.slots.length} available slots` : "No time slot required"}</div>
                      </div>
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : null}

              {step === 2 ? (
                availableSlots.length ? (
                  <div className="grid gap-3">
                    <div className="results-meta-card text-slate-600">{assignmentHelp}</div>
                    {availableSlots.map((slot) => (
                      <button
                        key={slot.id}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setTimeSlotId(slot.id)}
                        disabled={!registrationOpen || submitting || slot.remaining_capacity <= 0}

                          {slot.start_time || slot.end_time ? (
                            <div className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">
                              {formatTimeRange(slot.start_time, slot.end_time)}
                            </div>
                          ) : null}
                          <div className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">{slot.remaining_capacity} spots left</div>
                        </div>
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="results-meta-card text-slate-600">
                    {snapshot?.competition.format === "scramble"
                      ? "This competition does not require a time-slot selection."
                      : "Staff can assign the official start group separately. No start-group selection is required here."}
                  </div>
                )
              ) : null}

              {step === 3 ? (
                <div className="results-meta-card space-y-3">
                  <div><span className="font-semibold text-slate-950">Name:</span> {name || "Not entered"}</div>
                  <div><span className="font-semibold text-slate-950">Number:</span> {climberNumber || "Not entered"}</div>
                  <div><span className="font-semibold text-slate-950">Province:</span> {province || "Not entered"}</div>
                  <div><span className="font-semibold text-slate-950">Category:</span> {selectedChoice?.category.display_name || "Not selected"}</div>

                      : availableSlots.length
                        ? "Not selected"
                        : "No assignment required"}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : null}

                ) : (

                  </button>
                )}

  );
