"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useEffect, useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button, buttonStyles } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Surface } from "@/components/ui/surface";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";
import { getCompetitionPreset } from "@/lib/competition-presets";
import { clearDemoSalesSession } from "@/lib/demo-sales-session";
import type { DemoStoryState, DemoStoryTargetAct } from "@/lib/demo-story";

type ActStatus = "locked" | "ready" | "in_progress" | "complete";

type StoryAct = {
  id: "create" | "judge" | "organizer" | "public";
  number: number;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  why: string;
  targetAct: DemoStoryTargetAct;
  hrefKey: keyof DemoStoryState["links"];
  primaryLabel: string;
};

const LOCAL_PROGRESS_KEY = "summit_demo_story_progress_v1";
const youthChampionshipPreset = getCompetitionPreset("youth_championship_finals");
const DEMO_STORY_COPY = {
  title: "Summit Series Demo",
} as const;

const storyActs: StoryAct[] = [
  {
    id: "create",
    number: 1,
    title: "Create Event",
    description:
      "Create the canonical youth championship demo with presets, categories, rounds, and schedule.",
    why: "The setup story shows how a real event gets configured before anyone scores a climb.",
    targetAct: "event_created",
    hrefKey: "setup",
    primaryLabel: "Review event setup",
  },
  {
    id: "judge",
    number: 2,
    title: "Correct Key Score",
    description:
      "Find Athlete C, select B3, change Top from attempt 3 to attempt 1, then save.",
    why: "A single judge correction can change the finalist cut line. The demo makes that visible.",
    targetAct: "score_corrected",
    hrefKey: "judge",
    primaryLabel: "Open judge station",
  },
  {
    id: "organizer",
    number: 3,
    title: "Advance Finalists / Start Finals",
    description:
      "Review the cut-line movement, lock qualifiers, advance finalists, and open finals.",
    why: "Complete the key score correction first, or prepare demo state and skip ahead.",
    targetAct: "finalists_started",
    hrefKey: "organizer",
    primaryLabel: "Open organizer view",
  },
  {
    id: "public",
    number: 4,
    title: "View Public Result",
    description:
      "See the competition as a climber, parent, coach, or spectator on the public event pages.",
    why: "The public view closes the loop: setup, scoring, organizer control, and results all line up.",
    targetAct: "public_ready",
    hrefKey: "publicEvent",
    primaryLabel: "View public event",
  },
];

function readLocalPublicViewed() {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") {
    return false;
  }

  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_PROGRESS_KEY) ?? "{}") as {
      publicViewed?: unknown;
    };
    return parsed.publicViewed === true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function writeLocalPublicViewed() {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") {
    return;
  }

  window.localStorage.setItem(LOCAL_PROGRESS_KEY, JSON.stringify({ publicViewed: true }));
}

function getActStatus(act: StoryAct, state: DemoStoryState, publicViewed: boolean): ActStatus {
  const progress = state.progress;

  if (act.id === "create") {
    return progress.eventCreated ? "complete" : "ready";
  }

  if (act.id === "judge") {
    if (progress.keyScoreCorrected) return "complete";
    return progress.eventCreated ? "ready" : "locked";
  }

  if (act.id === "organizer") {
    if (progress.finalistsAdvanced && progress.finalsStarted) return "complete";
    return progress.keyScoreCorrected ? "ready" : "locked";
  }

  if (publicViewed) {
    return "complete";
  }

  return progress.finalsStarted ? "ready" : "locked";
}

function getStatusLabel(status: ActStatus) {
  switch (status) {
    case "complete":
      return "Complete";
    case "ready":
      return "Ready";
    case "in_progress":
      return "In progress";
    default:
      return "Locked";
  }
}

function statusStyles(status: ActStatus) {
  switch (status) {
    case "complete":
      return "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800";
    case "ready":
      return "border-sky-200 bg-sky-50 text-sky-800";
    case "in_progress":
      return "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800";
    default:
      return "border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 text-slate-600";
  }
}

export function DemoCommandCenter({ initialState }: { initialState: DemoStoryState }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [state, setState] = useState(initialState);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(initialState.error);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [publicViewed, setPublicViewed] = useState(false);
  const [pendingLabel, setPendingLabel] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  useEffect(() => {
    setPublicViewed(readLocalPublicViewed());
    clearDemoSalesSession();
  }, []);

  async function prepareState(
    targetAct: DemoStoryTargetAct,
    options?: {
      reset?: boolean;
      redirectTo?: string | null;
      redirectKey?: keyof DemoStoryState["links"];
    }
  ) {
    setError(null);
    setNotice(null);
    setPendingLabel(options?.reset ? "Resetting demo..." : "Preparing demo...");
    clearDemoSalesSession();

    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/demo/prepare-state", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "content-type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ targetAct, reset: options?.reset === true }),
      });
      const payload = (await response.json()) as { ok?: boolean; state?: DemoStoryState; error?: string };

      if (!response.ok || !payload.ok || !payload.state) {
        throw new Error(payload.error ?? "Unable to prepare the demo story.");
      }

      setState(payload.state);
      if (targetAct === "public_ready") {
        writeLocalPublicViewed();
        setPublicViewed(true);
      }

      const redirectHref = options?.redirectTo ?? (options?.redirectKey ? payload.state.links[options.redirectKey] : null);
      if (redirectHref) {
        startTransition(() => {
          router.push(redirectHref);
        });
      }
    } catch (prepareError) {
      setError(prepareError instanceof Error ? prepareError.message : "Unable to prepare the demo story.");
    } finally {
      setPendingLabel(null);
    }
  }

  async function refreshStoryState(messageOnIncomplete?: string) {
    setError(null);
    setNotice(null);
    setPendingLabel("Checking demo progress...");

    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/demo/prepare-state", {
        method: "GET",
      });
      const payload = (await response.json()) as { ok?: boolean; state?: DemoStoryState; error?: string };

      if (!response.ok || !payload.ok || !payload.state) {
        throw new Error(payload.error ?? "Unable to refresh demo progress.");
      }

      setState(payload.state);
      if (messageOnIncomplete && !payload.state.progress.keyScoreCorrected) {
        setNotice(messageOnIncomplete);
      }
    } catch (refreshError) {
      setError(refreshError instanceof Error ? refreshError.message : "Unable to refresh demo progress.");
    } finally {
      setPendingLabel(null);
    }
  }

  function handleReset() {
    const shouldReset = window.confirm(
      "Reset the canonical demo event? This only affects demo-safe data and will recreate the guided story seed."
    );
    if (!shouldReset) {
      return;
    }

    void prepareState("event_created", { reset: true });
  }

  function handleActClick(act: StoryAct, status: ActStatus) {
    const href = state.links[act.hrefKey];

    if (act.id === "public") {
      writeLocalPublicViewed();
      setPublicViewed(true);
    }

    if (status === "locked" || !href) {
      const targetAct = act.id === "judge" ? "event_created" : act.targetAct;
      void prepareState(targetAct, { redirectTo: href, redirectKey: act.hrefKey });
      return;
    }

    router.push(href);
  }

  const currentAct =
    storyActs.find((act) => getActStatus(act, state, publicViewed) !== "complete") ??
    storyActs[storyActs.length - 1];
  const currentStatus = getActStatus(currentAct, state, publicViewed);
  const metadata = state.metadata;

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_top_left,rgba(14,165,233,0.18),transparent_34%),linear-gradient(135deg,#f8fafc,#eef6ff_46%,#fff7ed)] text-slate-950">
      <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-7xl flex-col gap-6 px-4 py-6 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div className="rounded-3xl border border-sky-200 bg-sky-50/90 px-5 py-4 shadow-[0_16px_38px_rgba(14,116,144,0.08)]">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between">
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.28em] text-sky-700">
                Demo Mode
              </p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">
                Changes are safe and resettable. This guide only prepares the canonical demo competition.
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              <Button size="compact" variant="secondary" onClick={() => router.push("/demo")}>
                View Guide
              </Button>
              <Button size="compact" variant="danger" onClick={handleReset} disabled={isPending || Boolean(pendingLabel)}>
                Reset Demo
              </Button>
              <Link href="/" className={buttonStyles({ variant: "ghost", size: "compact" })}>
                Exit Demo
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <Surface variant="card" density="public" className="relative overflow-hidden">
          <div className="absolute right-0 top-0 h-56 w-56 rounded-full bg-sky-200/40 blur-3xl" aria-hidden="true" />
          <div className="relative grid gap-8 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.08fr)_minmax(20rem,0.92fr)] xl:items-end">
            <div className="space-y-5">
              <Badge>Guided product story</Badge>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <h1 className="max-w-4xl text-4xl font-black tracking-[-0.04em] text-slate-950 sm:text-6xl">
                  {DEMO_STORY_COPY.title}
                </h1>
                <p className="max-w-3xl text-lg leading-8 text-slate-600">
                  Run a complete youth championship in five minutes. You’ll create the event,
                  correct a key score as a judge, advance finalists as the organizer, and view
                  the public result.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                <Button
                  variant="primary"
                  size="lg"
                  onClick={() => prepareState("event_created", { reset: true })}
                  disabled={isPending || Boolean(pendingLabel)}
                >
                  Start Full Story
                </Button>
                <Button
                  variant="secondary"
                  size="lg"
                  onClick={() => prepareState("event_created")}
                  disabled={isPending || Boolean(pendingLabel)}
                >
                  Use Ready-Made Demo Event
                </Button>
              <Button
                variant="danger"
                size="lg"
                onClick={handleReset}
                  disabled={isPending || Boolean(pendingLabel)}
                >
                Reset Demo
              </Button>
              {error ? (
                <Button
                  variant="secondary"
                  size="lg"
                  onClick={() => prepareState("event_created", { reset: true })}
                  disabled={isPending || Boolean(pendingLabel)}
                >
                  Repair demo state
                </Button>
              ) : null}
              </div>

              {(pendingLabel || error || notice) && (
                <div
                  className={cn(
                    "rounded-2xl border px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold",
                    error
                      ? "border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-700"
                      : notice
                        ? "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800"
                      : "border-sky-200 bg-sky-50 text-sky-800"
                  )}
                  role="status"
                >
                  {error ?? notice ?? pendingLabel}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="rounded-[2rem] border border-white/80 bg-white/80 p-5 shadow-[0_18px_50px_rgba(15,23,42,0.08)]">
              <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-slate-500">
                Current act
              </p>
              <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <h2 className="text-2xl font-black tracking-tight text-slate-950">
                    Act {currentAct.number}: {currentAct.title}
                  </h2>
                  <span className={cn("rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-xs font-black", statusStyles(currentStatus))}>
                    {getStatusLabel(currentStatus)}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">{currentAct.description}</p>
                <Button
                  variant="primary"
                  fullWidth
                  onClick={() => handleActClick(currentAct, currentStatus)}
                  disabled={isPending || Boolean(pendingLabel)}
                >
                  {currentStatus === "locked" ? "Prepare demo state and skip ahead" : currentAct.primaryLabel}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Surface>

        <section className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-4">
          {storyActs.map((act) => {
            const status = getActStatus(act, state, publicViewed);
            return (
              <Surface key={act.id} variant="row" density="organizer" className="flex h-full flex-col gap-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-slate-950 text-sm font-black text-white">
                    {status === "complete" ? "✓" : act.number}
                  </span>
                  <span className={cn("rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-xs font-black", statusStyles(status))}>
                    {getStatusLabel(status)}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <h3 className="text-lg font-black tracking-tight text-slate-950">{act.title}</h3>
                  <p className="text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">{act.description}</p>
                  <p className="text-xs font-semibold leading-5 text-slate-500">{act.why}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="mt-auto flex flex-col gap-2">
                  <Button
                    variant={status === "locked" ? "secondary" : "primary"}
                    size="compact"
                    onClick={() => handleActClick(act, status)}
                    disabled={isPending || Boolean(pendingLabel)}
                  >
                    {status === "locked" ? "Prepare demo state and skip ahead" : act.primaryLabel}
                  </Button>
                  {act.id === "judge" && state.progress.eventCreated && !state.progress.keyScoreCorrected ? (
                    <Button
                      variant="secondary"
                      size="compact"
                      onClick={() =>
                        void refreshStoryState(
                          "Not complete yet. Save Athlete C on B3 as Top on attempt 1, then check again."
                        )
                      }
                      disabled={isPending || Boolean(pendingLabel)}
                    >
                      I completed this
                    </Button>
                  ) : null}
                  {status === "locked" && (act.id === "organizer" || act.id === "public") ? (
                    <p className="text-xs font-semibold leading-5 text-amber-700">
                      This skips the hands-on task and prepares only canonical demo data.
                    </p>
                  ) : null}
                  {status !== "locked" && act.id === "public" && state.links.leaderboard && (
                    <Link
                      href={state.links.leaderboard}
                      onClick={() => {
                        writeLocalPublicViewed();
                        setPublicViewed(true);
                      }}
                      className={buttonStyles({ variant: "ghost", size: "compact" })}
                    >
                      Open leaderboard
                    </Link>
                  )}
                </div>
              </Surface>
            );
          })}
        </section>

        <section className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(20rem,0.72fr)]">
          <Surface variant="panel" density="public" className="space-y-5">
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-slate-500">
                Act 1 setup preview
              </p>
              <h2 className="mt-2 text-2xl font-black tracking-tight text-slate-950">
                Youth Championship with Finals
              </h2>
              <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">
                The preset creates youth categories, keeps Youth D and Youth C in qualifiers only,
                and makes Youth B, Youth A, and Junior finals-eligible.
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
              <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white/80 p-4">
                <h3 className="font-black text-slate-950">Generated categories</h3>
                <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {["Men", "Women"].flatMap((division) =>
                    youthChampionshipPreset.defaultCategories.map((ageGroup) => (
                      <span
                        key={`${division}-${ageGroup}`}
                        className="rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700"
                      >
                        {division} / {ageGroup}
                      </span>
                    ))
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white/80 p-4">
                <h3 className="font-black text-slate-950">Finals eligible</h3>
                <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {["Men", "Women"].flatMap((division) =>
                    youthChampionshipPreset.finalsEligibleCategories.map((ageGroup) => (
                      <span
                        key={`${division}-${ageGroup}`}
                        className="rounded-full border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-800"
                      >
                        {division} / {ageGroup}
                      </span>
                    ))
                  )}
                </div>
                <p className="mt-3 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">
                  Youth D and Youth C still compete, but they do not advance to finals by default.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </Surface>

          <Surface variant="meta" density="organizer" className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-slate-500">
                Cut-line drama
              </p>
              <h2 className="mt-2 text-xl font-black tracking-tight text-slate-950">
                {metadata?.drama_target_climber_name ?? "Athlete C"} on Boulder{" "}
                {metadata?.drama_target_climb_number ?? 3}
              </h2>
              <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">
                {metadata?.drama_description ??
                  "Athlete C tops B3 in 1 attempt instead of 3 and leapfrogs Athlete B at the finals cut line."}
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 p-4">
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">Before</p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xl font-black text-slate-950">
                  Top in {metadata?.drama_target_attempts_before ?? 3}
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50 p-4">
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700">After</p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xl font-black text-emerald-900">
                  Top in {metadata?.drama_target_attempts_after ?? 1}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            {state.links.scorecard && (
              <Link
                href={state.links.scorecard}
                onClick={() => {
                  writeLocalPublicViewed();
                  setPublicViewed(true);
                }}
                className={buttonStyles({ variant: "secondary", size: "compact", fullWidth: true })}
              >
                Open demo athlete scorecard
              </Link>
            )}
          </Surface>
        </section>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

--- src\components\demo\demo-sales-shell.tsx ---

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

type DemoSalesShellProps = {
  mode: "organizer" | "judge";
  stepLabel: string;
  title: string;
  body: string;
  autoplayRunning: boolean;
  audioEnabled: boolean;
  onReplay: () => void;
  onSkipToJudge: () => void;
  onBackToOrganizer: () => void;
  onToggleAudio: () => void;
};

export function DemoSalesShell({
  mode,
  stepLabel,
  title,
  body,
  autoplayRunning,
  audioEnabled,
  onReplay,
  onSkipToJudge,
  onBackToOrganizer,
  onToggleAudio,
}: DemoSalesShellProps) {
  return (
    <section className="demo-sales-shell">
      <div className="demo-sales-shell__main">
        <div className="demo-sales-shell__eyebrow">
          <span className="demo-live-badge">
            <span className="demo-live-dot" aria-hidden="true" />
            LIVE DEMO
          </span>
          <span className="demo-sales-shell__step">{stepLabel}</span>
          <span className="demo-sales-shell__mode">{mode === "organizer" ? "Organizer story" : "Judge story"}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-950">{title}</h2>
          <p className="max-w-4xl text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-600 sm:text-base">{body}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="demo-sales-shell__actions">
        <Button variant="secondary" className="min-h-11 rounded-full px-5" onClick={onReplay}>
          {autoplayRunning ? "Restart story" : "Replay demo"}
        </Button>
        {mode === "organizer" ? (
          <Button variant="secondary" className="min-h-11 rounded-full px-5" onClick={onSkipToJudge}>
            Skip to judge
          </Button>
        ) : (
          <Button variant="secondary" className="min-h-11 rounded-full px-5" onClick={onBackToOrganizer}>
            Back to organizer
          </Button>
        )}
        <button type="button" onClick={onToggleAudio} className="demo-sales-shell__audio">
          {audioEnabled ? "Audio on" : "Audio off"}
        </button>
      </div>
      {mode === "organizer" ? (
        <div className="demo-sales-shell__links">
          <Link href="/demo" className="results-secondary-button">
            All demo roles
          </Link>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </section>
  );
}


--- src\components\demo\demo-toolkit.tsx ---

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import type { DemoPlaybackStep, DemoToolkitState } from "@/components/demo/types";

type DemoToolkitProps = {
  state: DemoToolkitState;
  playbackStep: DemoPlaybackStep | null;
  onRunDemo: () => void;
  onToggleOffline: (nextValue: boolean) => void;
  onSimulateOneScore: () => void;
  onRunLiveBurst: () => void;
  onSyncNow: () => void;
  onRestoreDemo: () => void;
};

const playbackCopy: Record<DemoPlaybackStep, string> = {
  save: "Step 1 of 4: judge is logging the flash...",
  leaderboard: "Step 2 of 4: the finals bubble is flipping live...",
  offline: "Step 3 of 4: Wi-Fi is down, but scores are still saving...",
  sync: "Step 4 of 4: reconnecting and publishing queued scores...",
  complete: "Pitch flow complete. You can replay it or take over manually.",
};

export function DemoToolkit({
  state,
  playbackStep,
  onRunDemo,
  onToggleOffline,
  onSimulateOneScore,
  onRunLiveBurst,
  onSyncNow,
  onRestoreDemo,
}: DemoToolkitProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  const syncLabel =
    state.lastSyncStatus === "synced"
      ? "Saved live"
      : state.lastSyncStatus === "saving"
        ? "Saving live..."
        : state.lastSyncStatus === "syncing"
          ? "Publishing queue..."
          : state.lastSyncStatus === "failed"
            ? "Needs review"
            : state.pendingQueueCount > 0
              ? `On this device (${state.pendingQueueCount})`
              : "On this device";

  return (
    <div className="demo-toolkit fixed bottom-4 left-1/2 z-40 w-[min(34rem,calc(100vw-1.5rem))] -translate-x-1/2">
      <button
        type="button"
        className="demo-toolkit-summary w-full"
        onClick={() => setOpen((current) => !current)}
        aria-expanded={open}
      >
        <div className="demo-toolkit-pill">
          <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3">
            <div className="demo-toolkit-icon" aria-hidden="true">
              {open ? "-" : "+"}
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <div className="demo-toolkit-title">Demo tools</div>
              <div className="demo-toolkit-status">
                {state.scriptRunning && playbackStep
                  ? playbackCopy[playbackStep]
                  : state.simulateOffline
                    ? "Wi-Fi dropped. Scores are saving on this device."
                    : open
                      ? "Manual tools are open."
                      : "Open tools only when you want to steer the walkthrough."}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="demo-toolkit-chip">{syncLabel}</div>
        </div>
      </button>

      {open ? (
        <div className="demo-toolkit-panel">
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="results-kicker text-white/60">Walkthrough tools</div>
            <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-white">Run the 90-second comp-day story</h3>
            <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-300">
              Kick off one guided sequence that scores a flash, flips the finals bubble on a real
              tiebreak, drops Wi-Fi, queues a score, then reconnects and publishes everything live.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_auto]">
            <Button
              variant="linearPrimary"
              className="min-h-14 rounded-[1.15rem] text-base"
              onClick={onRunDemo}
              disabled={state.scriptRunning || state.simulationRunning}
              data-demo-anchor="interactive-run-demo"
            >
              {state.scriptRunning ? "Running guided demo..." : "Run guided demo"}
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="linearSecondary"
              className="min-h-14 rounded-[1.15rem] px-5"
              onClick={onRestoreDemo}
              disabled={state.scriptRunning}
            >
              Start over
            </Button>
          </div>

          <div className="demo-toolkit-divider" />

          <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <Button
              variant="linearSecondary"
              className="min-h-12 rounded-[1rem]"
              onClick={onSimulateOneScore}
              disabled={state.scriptRunning}
            >
              Trigger cut-line swap
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="linearSecondary"
              className="min-h-12 rounded-[1rem]"
              onClick={onRunLiveBurst}
              disabled={state.scriptRunning || state.simulationRunning}
            >
              {state.simulationRunning ? "Score burst running..." : "Run score burst"}
            </Button>
          </div>

          <label className="demo-toolkit-toggle">
            <div>
              <div className="font-semibold text-white">Simulate Wi-Fi drop</div>
              <div className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-300">
                Keep scoring locally while the public leaderboard pauses.
              </div>
            </div>
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={state.simulateOffline}
              onChange={(event) => onToggleOffline(event.target.checked)}
              className="h-5 w-5 rounded border-white/20 bg-transparent text-sky-400"
              disabled={state.scriptRunning && playbackStep !== "offline" && playbackStep !== "sync"}
              data-demo-anchor="interactive-offline-toggle"
            />
          </label>

          <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <Button
              variant="linearGhost"
              className="min-h-11 rounded-[1rem] border border-white/10 bg-white/[0.04]"
              onClick={onSyncNow}
              disabled={(state.pendingQueueCount === 0 && state.lastSyncStatus !== "failed") || state.scriptRunning}
              data-demo-anchor="interactive-sync-now"
            >
              Publish queued scores
            </Button>
            <div className="rounded-[1rem] border border-white/10 bg-white/[0.04] px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-300">
              {state.pendingQueueCount > 0
                ? `${state.pendingQueueCount} queued ${state.pendingQueueCount === 1 ? "score is" : "scores are"} waiting to publish`
                : "No queued scores waiting"}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

function buildLocalAttempt(
  snapshot: CompetitionSnapshot,
  input: JudgeQualifierSaveInput
): QualifierAttempt {
  return {
    competition_id: snapshot.competition.id,
    round_id: snapshot.activeQualifierRound?.id ?? null,
    climber_id: input.climberId,
    climb_number: input.climbNumber,
    attempt_count: input.attemptCount,
    topped: input.topped,
    zone: input.zone,
    attempts_to_top: input.attemptsToTop,
    attempts_to_zone: input.attemptsToZone,
    entered_by: "staff",
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

function mergeQualifierAttempt(attempts: QualifierAttempt[], nextAttempt: QualifierAttempt) {
  const remaining = attempts.filter(
    (attempt) =>
      !(
        attempt.round_id === nextAttempt.round_id &&
        attempt.climb_number === nextAttempt.climb_number
      )
  );

  return [...remaining, nextAttempt].sort((left, right) => left.climb_number - right.climb_number);
}

function applyQualifierAttemptToSnapshot(
  snapshot: CompetitionSnapshot,
  nextAttempt: QualifierAttempt
): CompetitionSnapshot {
  const nextClimbers = snapshot.climbers.map((climber) =>
    climber.id === nextAttempt.climber_id
      ? {
          ...climber,
          qualifier_attempts: mergeQualifierAttempt(climber.qualifier_attempts, nextAttempt),
        }
      : climber
  );

  return {
    ...snapshot,
    climbers: nextClimbers,
    qualifierLeaderboard: buildQualifierLeaderboard(
      nextClimbers,
      snapshot.competition,
      snapshot.activeQualifierRound ?? null
    ),
  };
}

type DemoQualifierSaveResponse = {
  attempt: QualifierAttempt;
  status: "accepted" | "projected" | "conflicted" | "ignored_as_stale";
  conflictReason: string | null;
  clientEventId: string | null;
  scoredAt: string | null;
};

async function getDemoQueueItems(competitionId: string) {
  return (await readOfflineQueue()).filter(
    (item): item is Extract<OfflineQueueItem, { type: "qualifier" }> =>
      item.type === "qualifier" && item.competitionId === competitionId
  );
}

async function postDemoQualifierAttempt(input: {
  competitionId: string;
  climberId: string;
  climbNumber: number;
  attemptCount: number;
  topped: boolean;
  zone: boolean;
  attemptsToTop: number | null;
  attemptsToZone: number | null;
  clientEventId: string;
  scoredAt: string;
  judgeDeviceId: string | null;
  judgeSessionId: string | null;
  replayedFromOffline?: boolean;
}) {
  const response = await fetch("/api/demo/qualifier-attempt", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(input),
  });
  const payload = (await response.json().catch(() => null)) as
    | { error?: string; attempt?: QualifierAttempt; status?: DemoQualifierSaveResponse["status"]; conflictReason?: string | null; clientEventId?: string | null; scoredAt?: string | null }
    | null;

  if (!response.ok || !payload?.attempt) {
    throw new Error(payload?.error || "Unable to save the demo qualifier score.");
  }

  return {
    attempt: payload.attempt,
    status: payload.status ?? "accepted",
    conflictReason: payload.conflictReason ?? null,
    clientEventId: payload.clientEventId ?? null,
    scoredAt: payload.scoredAt ?? null,
  } satisfies DemoQualifierSaveResponse;
}

function shouldQueueFailedSave(error: unknown) {
  if (typeof navigator !== "undefined" && !navigator.onLine) {
    return true;
  }

  const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error ?? "");
  return /failed to fetch|networkerror|network request failed|load failed|fetch/i.test(message);
}

function normalizeDemoErrorMessage(error: unknown, fallback: string) {
  const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message.trim() : String(error ?? "").trim();
  if (!message) {
    return fallback;
  }

  if (/unauthorized/i.test(message)) {
    return "This demo action needs a fresh authorized session before it can publish live again.";
  }

  return message;
}

function getQualifierRank(snapshot: CompetitionSnapshot, climberId: string) {
  return snapshot.qualifierLeaderboard.find((entry) => entry.climber_id === climberId)?.category_rank ?? null;
}

function getQualifierEntryByName(snapshot: CompetitionSnapshot, climberName: string) {
  return snapshot.qualifierLeaderboard.find((entry) => entry.name === climberName) ?? null;
}

function buildRankMessage(
  beforeSnapshot: CompetitionSnapshot,
  afterSnapshot: CompetitionSnapshot,
  athlete: DemoScenarioAthlete
) {
  const beforeRank = getQualifierRank(beforeSnapshot, athlete.id);
  const afterRank = getQualifierRank(afterSnapshot, athlete.id);

  if (beforeRank === null || afterRank === null) {
    return `Saved. ${athlete.name} is now visible on the public leaderboard.`;
  }

  if (afterRank < beforeRank) {
    return `Saved. ${athlete.name} moved from ${beforeRank}${ordinalSuffix(beforeRank)} to ${afterRank}${ordinalSuffix(afterRank)} in ${athlete.categoryLabel}.`;
  }

  if (afterRank > beforeRank) {
    return `Saved. ${athlete.name} now sits ${afterRank}${ordinalSuffix(afterRank)} in ${athlete.categoryLabel}.`;
  }

  return `Saved. ${athlete.name} stayed ${afterRank}${ordinalSuffix(afterRank)} in ${athlete.categoryLabel}, and the public leaderboard updated instantly.`;
}

function buildDramaSwapMessage(
  beforeSnapshot: CompetitionSnapshot,
  afterSnapshot: CompetitionSnapshot,
  dramaContext: DramaContext
) {
  const athleteBefore = getQualifierEntryByName(beforeSnapshot, dramaContext.athleteName);
  const athleteAfter = getQualifierEntryByName(afterSnapshot, dramaContext.athleteName);
  const bubbleBefore = getQualifierEntryByName(beforeSnapshot, dramaContext.climberBName);
  const bubbleAfter = getQualifierEntryByName(afterSnapshot, dramaContext.climberBName);
  const categoryLabel = athleteAfter?.display_category ?? athleteBefore?.display_category ?? "this category";

  if (
    athleteBefore?.category_rank &&
    athleteAfter?.category_rank &&
    bubbleBefore?.category_rank &&
    bubbleAfter?.category_rank
  ) {
    return `${dramaContext.athleteName} jumps from ${athleteBefore.category_rank}${ordinalSuffix(athleteBefore.category_rank)} to ${athleteAfter.category_rank}${ordinalSuffix(athleteAfter.category_rank)} in ${categoryLabel}. ${dramaContext.climberBName} slides from ${bubbleBefore.category_rank}${ordinalSuffix(bubbleBefore.category_rank)} to ${bubbleAfter.category_rank}${ordinalSuffix(bubbleAfter.category_rank)} on counting attempts. ${dramaContext.tiebreakExplanation}`;
  }

  return dramaContext.tiebreakExplanation;
}

function ordinalSuffix(value: number) {
  const mod10 = value % 10;
  const mod100 = value % 100;
  if (mod10 === 1 && mod100 !== 11) {
    return "st";
  }
  if (mod10 === 2 && mod100 !== 12) {
    return "nd";
  }
  if (mod10 === 3 && mod100 !== 13) {
    return "rd";
  }
  return "th";
}

function buildScoreResultLabel(attempt: Pick<QualifierAttempt, "topped" | "zone" | "attempt_count">) {
  if (attempt.topped) {
    return attempt.attempt_count === 1
      ? "FLASH TOP ✓"
      : `TOP on attempt ${attempt.attempt_count} ✓`;
  }
  if (attempt.zone) {
    return `ZONE on attempt ${attempt.attempt_count}`;
  }
  return `Attempt ${attempt.attempt_count} logged`;
}

function formatQueuedAtLabel(scoredAt: string) {
  const timestamp = new Date(scoredAt).getTime();
  if (Number.isNaN(timestamp)) {
    return "Queued just now";
  }

  const seconds = Math.max(0, Math.round((Date.now() - timestamp) / 1000));
  if (seconds < 5) {
    return "Queued just now";
  }
  if (seconds < 60) {
    return `Queued ${seconds}s ago`;
  }

  return `Queued ${Math.round(seconds / 60)}m ago`;
}

function buildQueuedScorePreviews(
  queue: Extract<OfflineQueueItem, { type: "qualifier" }>[],
  snapshot: CompetitionSnapshot | null
): DemoQueuedScorePreview[] {
  return queue.map((item) => {
    const climber = snapshot?.climbers.find((entry) => entry.id === item.climberId);
    return {
      id: item.id,
      climberName: climber?.name ?? "Queued climber",
      climbLabel: getDemoPitchClimb(item.climbNumber)?.label ?? `Boulder ${String(item.climbNumber).padStart(2, "0")}`,
      resultLabel: buildScoreResultLabel({
        topped: item.topped,
        zone: item.zone ?? false,
        attempt_count: item.attemptCount,
      }),
      queuedAtLabel: formatQueuedAtLabel(item.scoredAt),
      retryCount: item.retryCount,
    };
  });
}

function findClimber(snapshot: CompetitionSnapshot, climberId: string) {
  return snapshot.climbers.find((climber) => climber.id === climberId) ?? null;
}

function buildImpactReason(snapshot: CompetitionSnapshot, climberId: string) {
  const entry = snapshot.qualifierLeaderboard.find((row) => row.climber_id === climberId);
  if (!entry) {
    return null;
  }

  const sameCategory = snapshot.qualifierLeaderboard.filter(
    (row) => row.category_id === entry.category_id && row.climber_id !== climberId
  );

  const nearby = sameCategory.find(
    (row) =>
      row.category_rank === entry.category_rank + 1 ||
      row.category_rank === entry.category_rank - 1
  );

  if (!nearby) {
    return null;
  }

  if (
    entry.topped_count === nearby.topped_count &&
    entry.zone_count === nearby.zone_count &&
    entry.counting_attempt_total < nearby.counting_attempt_total
  ) {
    return "Fewer attempts wins";
  }

  if (entry.topped_count >= nearby.topped_count && entry.counting_attempt_total < nearby.counting_attempt_total) {
    return "Cleaner attempts edge it";
  }

  return null;
}

    clicking: false,
    label: null,
  });

    simulateOffline: false,
    pendingQueueCount: 0,
    simulationRunning: false,
    scriptRunning: false,
    lastSyncStatus: "synced",
  });
  const [queuedScorePreviews, setQueuedScorePreviews] = useState<DemoQueuedScorePreview[]>([]);
  const refreshTimerRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const leaderboardToastTimerRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const leaderboardBurstTriggeredRef = useRef(false);
  const snapshotRef = useRef<CompetitionSnapshot | null>(null);
  const confettiTimerRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const audioEngineRef = useRef<DemoAudioEngine | null>(null);
  const salesAutoplayStartedRef = useRef(false);
  const runDemoRef = useRef<((options?: { preserveSalesSession?: boolean }) => Promise<void>) | null>(null);
  runDemoRef.current = handleRunDemo;

  useEffect(() => {
    snapshotRef.current = snapshot;
  }, [snapshot]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const session = readDemoSalesSession();
    setSalesSession(session);
    setSalesAudioEnabled(session?.audioEnabled ?? false);
    setDemoCompetitionId(session?.competitionId ?? null);
  }, []);

  const syncSalesSessionState = useCallback((updater: (current: DemoSalesSession | null) => DemoSalesSession) => {
    setSalesSession((current) => {
      const next = updater(current);
      setDemoCompetitionId(next.competitionId ?? null);
      writeDemoSalesSession(next);
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (confettiTimerRef.current) {
        window.clearTimeout(confettiTimerRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, []);

  const getAudioEngine = useCallback(() => {
    if (audioEngineRef.current) {
      return audioEngineRef.current;
    }

    const AudioContextCtor =
      typeof window !== "undefined"
        ? (window.AudioContext ||
            // @ts-expect-error webkit fallback
            window.webkitAudioContext)
        : null;

    if (!AudioContextCtor) {
      return null;
    }

    const context = new AudioContextCtor();
    const playTone = (frequency: number, duration: number, gainValue: number) => {
      const oscillator = context.createOscillator();
      const gain = context.createGain();
      oscillator.type = "sine";
      oscillator.frequency.value = frequency;
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(gainValue, context.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, context.currentTime + duration);
      oscillator.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(context.destination);
      oscillator.start();
      oscillator.stop(context.currentTime + duration);
    };

    audioEngineRef.current = {
      click: () => playTone(560, 0.09, 0.03),
      flash: () => {
        playTone(780, 0.12, 0.045);
        playTone(1170, 0.2, 0.028);
      },
    };

    return audioEngineRef.current;
  }, []);

  const playDemoSound = useCallback(
    (tone: "click" | "flash") => {
      if (!salesAudioEnabled) {
        return;
      }

      const engine = getAudioEngine();
      if (!engine) {
        return;
      }

      engine[tone]();
    },
    [getAudioEngine, salesAudioEnabled]
  );

  const triggerConfetti = useCallback(() => {
    setShowConfetti(true);
    if (confettiTimerRef.current) {
      window.clearTimeout(confettiTimerRef.current);
    }
    confettiTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setShowConfetti(false);
    }, 1800);
  }, []);

  const refreshSnapshot = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!demoCompetitionId) {
      throw new Error("No organizer demo event is active yet. Create an event from the organizer flow first.");
    }

    const nextSnapshot = await getCompetitionSnapshot(demoCompetitionId);
    const pendingQueue = await getDemoQueueItems(nextSnapshot.competition.id);
    setSnapshot(nextSnapshot);
    setLeaderboardSnapshot(nextSnapshot);
    setLastUpdatedAt(new Date().toISOString());
    setQueuedScorePreviews(buildQueuedScorePreviews(pendingQueue, nextSnapshot));
    setToolkitState((current) => ({
      ...current,
      pendingQueueCount: pendingQueue.length,
    }));
    return nextSnapshot;
  }, [demoCompetitionId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setLoading(true);
    void refreshSnapshot()
      .then(() => {
        setError("");
      })
      .catch((nextError) => {
        setError(nextError instanceof Error ? nextError.message : "Unable to load the live demo.");
      })
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [refreshSnapshot]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!snapshot || toolkitState.simulateOffline) {
      return;
    }

    const tick = window.setInterval(() => {
      void refreshSnapshot().catch(() => {
        // Keep the local optimistic state if background refresh fails.
      });
    }, 8000);

    return () => window.clearInterval(tick);
  }, [refreshSnapshot, snapshot, toolkitState.simulateOffline]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (refreshTimerRef.current) {
        window.clearTimeout(refreshTimerRef.current);
      }
      if (leaderboardToastTimerRef.current) {
        window.clearTimeout(leaderboardToastTimerRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, []);

  const clearHighlightLater = () => {
    if (refreshTimerRef.current) {
      window.clearTimeout(refreshTimerRef.current);
    }

    refreshTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setHighlightedClimberId(null);
      setLeaderboardImpact(null);
    }, 2600);
  };

  const showLeaderboardToast = useCallback(
    (toast: LeaderboardToast) => {
      setLeaderboardToast(toast);
      setLastUpdatedAt(new Date().toISOString());
      if (leaderboardToastTimerRef.current) {
        window.clearTimeout(leaderboardToastTimerRef.current);
      }
      leaderboardToastTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
        setLeaderboardToast(null);
      }, 3200);
    },
    []
  );

  const scenarioAthlete = useMemo<DemoScenarioAthlete | null>(() => {
    if (!snapshot) {
      return null;
    }

    const activeRoundId = snapshot.activeQualifierRound?.id ?? null;
    const preferred =
      snapshot.climbers.find((climber) => {
        const boulderOneAttempt = filterAttemptsForRound(climber.qualifier_attempts, activeRoundId).find(
          (attempt) => attempt.climb_number === 1
        );

        return !boulderOneAttempt || !boulderOneAttempt.topped || (boulderOneAttempt.attempts_to_top ?? boulderOneAttempt.attempt_count) > 1;
      }) ??
      snapshot.climbers.find((climber) => climber.name.toLowerCase().includes("maya foster")) ??
      snapshot.climbers[0] ??
      null;

    if (!preferred) {
      return null;
    }

    return {
      id: preferred.id,
      name: preferred.name,
      climberNumber: preferred.climber_number,
      categoryLabel: preferred.display_category,
    };
  }, [snapshot]);

  const handleSaveQualifier = useCallback(
    async (input: JudgeQualifierSaveInput) => {
      const liveSnapshot = snapshotRef.current ?? snapshot;
      if (!liveSnapshot) {
        return;
      }

      const previousSnapshot = liveSnapshot;
      const optimisticAttempt = buildLocalAttempt(liveSnapshot, input);
      const optimisticSnapshot = applyQualifierAttemptToSnapshot(liveSnapshot, optimisticAttempt);
      setSaving(true);
      setError("");
      setMessage("");
      setToolkitState((current) => ({
        ...current,
        lastSyncStatus: toolkitState.simulateOffline ? "pending" : "saving",
      }));
      setHighlightedClimberId(input.climberId);
      const beforeRank = getQualifierRank(previousSnapshot, input.climberId);
      const optimisticAfterRank = getQualifierRank(optimisticSnapshot, input.climberId);
      setLeaderboardImpact({
        climberId: input.climberId,
        beforeRank,
        afterRank: optimisticAfterRank,
        delta: (beforeRank ?? 0) - (optimisticAfterRank ?? 0),
        reason: buildImpactReason(optimisticSnapshot, input.climberId),
      });
      setSnapshot(optimisticSnapshot);
      if (!toolkitState.simulateOffline) {
        setLeaderboardSnapshot(optimisticSnapshot);
      }
      clearHighlightLater();

      if (toolkitState.simulateOffline) {
        const metadata = await buildQueueMetadata();
        await enqueueOfflineItem({
          id: `demo-qualifier-${input.climberId}-${input.climbNumber}`,
          type: "qualifier",
          competitionId: liveSnapshot.competition.id,
          climberId: input.climberId,
          climbNumber: input.climbNumber,
          attemptCount: input.attemptCount,
          topped: input.topped,
          zone: input.zone,
          attemptsToTop: input.attemptsToTop,
          attemptsToZone: input.attemptsToZone,
          clientEventId: metadata.clientEventId,
          scoredAt: metadata.scoredAt,
          judgeDeviceId: metadata.judgeDeviceId,
          judgeSessionId: metadata.judgeSessionId,
          createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          retryCount: 0,
          lastTriedAt: null,
        });
        const queue = await getDemoQueueItems(liveSnapshot.competition.id);
        setQueuedScorePreviews(buildQueuedScorePreviews(queue, optimisticSnapshot));
        setToolkitState((current) => ({
          ...current,
          pendingQueueCount: queue.length,
          lastSyncStatus: "pending",
        }));
        if (scenarioAthlete && input.climberId === scenarioAthlete.id) {
          setOfflineQueuedSaveCompleted(true);
          setSyncRecovered(false);
        }
        setMessage(
          `Saved locally for ${scenarioAthlete?.name ?? "the demo athlete"}. The public leaderboard stays unchanged until you reconnect and sync.`
        );
        setSaving(false);
        return;
      }

      try {
        const metadata = await buildQueueMetadata();
        const savedResult = await postDemoQualifierAttempt({
          competitionId: liveSnapshot.competition.id,
          climberId: input.climberId,
          climbNumber: input.climbNumber,
          attemptCount: input.attemptCount,
          topped: input.topped,
          zone: input.zone,
          attemptsToTop: input.attemptsToTop,
          attemptsToZone: input.attemptsToZone,
          clientEventId: metadata.clientEventId,
          scoredAt: metadata.scoredAt,
          judgeDeviceId: metadata.judgeDeviceId,
          judgeSessionId: metadata.judgeSessionId,
        });

        const savedSnapshot = applyQualifierAttemptToSnapshot(liveSnapshot, savedResult.attempt);
        const savedAfterRank = getQualifierRank(savedSnapshot, input.climberId);
        const impactReason = buildImpactReason(savedSnapshot, input.climberId);
        const savedClimber = findClimber(savedSnapshot, input.climberId);
        const climbLabel =
          getDemoPitchClimb(input.climbNumber)?.label ??
          `Boulder ${String(input.climbNumber).padStart(2, "0")}`;
        setSnapshot(savedSnapshot);
        setLeaderboardSnapshot(savedSnapshot);
        setLeaderboardImpact({
          climberId: input.climberId,
          beforeRank,
          afterRank: savedAfterRank,
          delta: (beforeRank ?? 0) - (savedAfterRank ?? 0),
          reason: impactReason,
        });
        setToolkitState((current) => ({
          ...current,
          lastSyncStatus: "synced",
        }));
        if (scenarioAthlete && input.climberId === scenarioAthlete.id) {
          setLiveSaveCompleted(true);
        }
        setMessage(
          scenarioAthlete && input.climberId === scenarioAthlete.id
            ? buildRankMessage(previousSnapshot, savedSnapshot, scenarioAthlete)
            : "Score saved live. The leaderboard updated from the same event record."
        );
        if (savedClimber) {
          showLeaderboardToast({
            id: `${savedClimber.id}-${Date.now()}`,
            climberId: savedClimber.id,
            climberName: savedClimber.name,
            climbLabel,
            resultLabel: buildScoreResultLabel(savedResult.attempt),
            detail: impactReason,
          });
        }
        void refreshSnapshot().catch(() => {
          // The optimistic state already shows the result; silent failure is okay here.
        });
      } catch (nextError) {
        if (shouldQueueFailedSave(nextError)) {
          const metadata = await buildQueueMetadata();
          await enqueueOfflineItem({
            id: `demo-qualifier-${input.climberId}-${input.climbNumber}`,
            type: "qualifier",
          competitionId: liveSnapshot.competition.id,
            climberId: input.climberId,
            climbNumber: input.climbNumber,
            attemptCount: input.attemptCount,
            topped: input.topped,
            zone: input.zone,
            attemptsToTop: input.attemptsToTop,
            attemptsToZone: input.attemptsToZone,
            clientEventId: metadata.clientEventId,
            scoredAt: metadata.scoredAt,
            judgeDeviceId: metadata.judgeDeviceId,
            judgeSessionId: metadata.judgeSessionId,
            createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            retryCount: 0,
            lastTriedAt: null,
          });
          const queue = await getDemoQueueItems(liveSnapshot.competition.id);
          setQueuedScorePreviews(buildQueuedScorePreviews(queue, previousSnapshot));
          setToolkitState((current) => ({
            ...current,
            pendingQueueCount: queue.length,
            lastSyncStatus: "pending",
          }));
          if (scenarioAthlete && input.climberId === scenarioAthlete.id) {
            setOfflineQueuedSaveCompleted(true);
            setSyncRecovered(false);
          }
          setMessage("Network failed, so the score queued locally for retry. Reconnect to publish it.");
        } else {
          setSnapshot(previousSnapshot);
          setLeaderboardSnapshot(previousSnapshot);
          setToolkitState((current) => ({
            ...current,
            lastSyncStatus: "failed",
          }));
          setError(normalizeDemoErrorMessage(nextError, "Unable to save the score live right now."));
        }
      } finally {
        setSaving(false);
      }
    },
    [refreshSnapshot, scenarioAthlete, showLeaderboardToast, snapshot, toolkitState.simulateOffline]
  );

  const flushOfflineQueue = useCallback(async () => {
    const liveSnapshot = snapshotRef.current ?? snapshot;
    if (!liveSnapshot) {
      return;
    }

    const queue = await getDemoQueueItems(liveSnapshot.competition.id);
    if (!queue.length) {
      setQueuedScorePreviews([]);
      setToolkitState((current) => ({
        ...current,
        pendingQueueCount: 0,
        lastSyncStatus: "synced",
      }));
      return;
    }

    setToolkitState((current) => ({
      ...current,
      lastSyncStatus: "syncing",
    }));
    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    try {
      for (const item of queue) {
        await postDemoQualifierAttempt({
          competitionId: item.competitionId,
          climberId: item.climberId,
          climbNumber: item.climbNumber,
          attemptCount: item.attemptCount,
          topped: item.topped,
          zone: item.zone ?? false,
          attemptsToTop: item.attemptsToTop ?? null,
          attemptsToZone: item.attemptsToZone ?? null,
          clientEventId: item.clientEventId,
          scoredAt: item.scoredAt,
          judgeDeviceId: item.judgeDeviceId,
          judgeSessionId: item.judgeSessionId,
          replayedFromOffline: true,
        });
        await removeOfflineItem(item.id);
      }

      await refreshSnapshot();
      const remaining = await getDemoQueueItems(liveSnapshot.competition.id);
      const refreshedSnapshot = await getCompetitionSnapshot(liveSnapshot.competition.id);
      setQueuedScorePreviews(buildQueuedScorePreviews(remaining, refreshedSnapshot));
      setToolkitState((current) => ({
        ...current,
        pendingQueueCount: remaining.length,
        lastSyncStatus: "synced",
      }));
      if (queue.length > 0) {
        setSyncRecovered(true);
      }
      const lastQueuedItem = queue[queue.length - 1];
      if (lastQueuedItem) {
        const queuedClimber = findClimber(refreshedSnapshot, lastQueuedItem.climberId);
        if (queuedClimber) {
          showLeaderboardToast({
            id: `${queuedClimber.id}-${Date.now()}`,
            climberId: queuedClimber.id,
            climberName: queuedClimber.name,
            climbLabel:
              getDemoPitchClimb(lastQueuedItem.climbNumber)?.label ??
              `Boulder ${String(lastQueuedItem.climbNumber).padStart(2, "0")}`,
            resultLabel: buildScoreResultLabel({
              topped: lastQueuedItem.topped,
              zone: lastQueuedItem.zone ?? false,
              attempt_count: lastQueuedItem.attemptCount,
            }),
            detail: "Queued score just landed on the public leaderboard.",
          });
        }
      }
      setMessage("Queued score synced. Public leaderboard is live again.");
    } catch (nextError) {
      if (queue[0]) {
        await markOfflineItemRetried(queue[0].id);
      }
      const remaining = await getDemoQueueItems(liveSnapshot.competition.id);
      setQueuedScorePreviews(buildQueuedScorePreviews(remaining, liveSnapshot));
      setToolkitState((current) => ({
        ...current,
        pendingQueueCount: remaining.length,
        lastSyncStatus: "failed",
      }));
      setError(nextError instanceof Error ? nextError.message : "Unable to sync queued demo scores.");
    }
  }, [refreshSnapshot, showLeaderboardToast, snapshot]);

  const handleToggleOffline = (nextValue: boolean) => {
    setToolkitState((current) => ({
      ...current,
      simulateOffline: nextValue,
      lastSyncStatus: nextValue
        ? current.pendingQueueCount > 0
          ? "pending"
          : current.lastSyncStatus
        : current.lastSyncStatus,
    }));

    if (!nextValue) {
      void flushOfflineQueue();
    }
  };

  const runSimulationStep = useCallback(
    async (mode: DemoSimulationMode) => {
      const liveSnapshot = snapshotRef.current ?? snapshot;
      const response = await fetch("/api/demo/simulate", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ mode, competitionId: liveSnapshot?.competition.id }),
      });
      const payload = (await response.json().catch(() => null)) as
        | ({ error?: string } & Partial<DemoSimulationResponse>)
        | null;

      if (!response.ok || !liveSnapshot) {
        throw new Error(payload?.error || "Unable to run the demo simulation.");
      }

      if (payload?.alreadyFired) {
        if (payload.message) {
          setMessage(payload.message);
        }

        return {
          payload,
          simulatedSnapshot: liveSnapshot,
          beforeRank: null,
          afterRank: null,
        };
      }

      if (!payload?.attempt) {
        throw new Error(payload?.error || "Unable to run the demo simulation.");
      }

      const impactedClimberId = payload.climberId ?? payload.attempt.climber_id;
      const beforeRank = getQualifierRank(liveSnapshot, impactedClimberId);
      const simulatedSnapshot = applyQualifierAttemptToSnapshot(
        liveSnapshot,
        payload.attempt as QualifierAttempt
      );
      const impactReason = buildImpactReason(simulatedSnapshot, impactedClimberId);
      const impactedClimber = findClimber(simulatedSnapshot, impactedClimberId);
      const climbLabel =
        getDemoPitchClimb(payload.climbNumber ?? payload.attempt.climb_number)?.label ??
        `Boulder ${String(payload.climbNumber ?? payload.attempt.climb_number).padStart(2, "0")}`;
      setHighlightedClimberId(impactedClimberId);
      setSnapshot(simulatedSnapshot);
      setLeaderboardSnapshot(simulatedSnapshot);
      setLeaderboardImpact({
        climberId: impactedClimberId,
        beforeRank,
        afterRank: getQualifierRank(simulatedSnapshot, impactedClimberId),
        delta:
          (beforeRank ?? 0) -
          (getQualifierRank(simulatedSnapshot, impactedClimberId) ?? 0),
        reason: impactReason,
      });
      if (impactedClimber) {
        showLeaderboardToast({
          id: `${impactedClimber.id}-${Date.now()}`,
          climberId: impactedClimber.id,
          climberName: impactedClimber.name,
          climbLabel,
          resultLabel: buildScoreResultLabel(payload.attempt),
          detail: impactReason,
        });
      }
      clearHighlightLater();
      await refreshSnapshot();

      return {
        payload,
        simulatedSnapshot,
        beforeRank,
        afterRank: getQualifierRank(simulatedSnapshot, impactedClimberId),
      };
    },
    [refreshSnapshot, showLeaderboardToast, snapshot]
  );

  const resetDramaScenario = useCallback(
    async (suppressErrors = false) => {
      const liveSnapshot = snapshotRef.current ?? snapshot;
      if (!liveSnapshot) {
        return false;
      }

      try {
        const response = await fetch("/api/demo/simulate", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            mode: "drama_reset",
            competitionId: liveSnapshot.competition.id,
          }),
        });
        const payload = (await response.json().catch(() => null)) as
          | ({ error?: string } & Partial<DemoSimulationResponse>)
          | null;

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(payload?.error || "Unable to reset the drama scenario.");
        }

        await refreshSnapshot();
        setHighlightedClimberId(null);
        setLeaderboardImpact(null);
        setLeaderboardToast(null);
        return true;
      } catch (nextError) {
        if (!suppressErrors) {
          setError(nextError instanceof Error ? nextError.message : "Unable to reset the drama scenario.");
        }
        return false;
      }
    },
    [refreshSnapshot, snapshot]
  );

  const handleSimulateOneScore = async () => {
    setError("");
    setMessage("");
    try {
      const result = await runSimulationStep("drama_tick");
      if (result?.payload?.dramaContext) {
        setMessage(buildDramaSwapMessage(snapshotRef.current ?? snapshot ?? result.simulatedSnapshot, result.simulatedSnapshot, result.payload.dramaContext));
        setLeaderboardObserved(true);
      } else {
        setMessage(result?.payload?.message ?? "Triggered the cut-line swap.");
      }
    } catch (nextError) {
      setError(nextError instanceof Error ? nextError.message : "Unable to trigger the cut-line swap.");
    }
  };

  const handleRunLiveBurst = async () => {
    if (toolkitState.simulationRunning || toolkitState.scriptRunning) {
      return;
    }

    setToolkitState((current) => ({
      ...current,
      simulationRunning: true,
    }));
    setMessage("Live burst started. Watch the public rankings keep moving without leaving the page.");
      setError("");

      try {
        const burstCount = 5;
        for (let index = 0; index < burstCount; index += 1) {
          if (index > 0) {
            await new Promise((resolve) => window.setTimeout(resolve, 1300));
          }
          await runSimulationStep("live_burst");
        }
        setMessage("Live burst complete.");
    } catch (nextError) {
      setError(nextError instanceof Error ? nextError.message : "Unable to run the live burst.");
    } finally {
      setToolkitState((current) => ({
        ...current,
        simulationRunning: false,
      }));
      }
    };

  const wait = (ms: number) => new Promise((resolve) => window.setTimeout(resolve, ms));

  const moveDemoCursorTo = useCallback(
    async (
      anchor: string,
      options?: {
        click?: boolean;
        label?: string | null;
        settleMs?: number;
      }
    ) => {
      const element = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-demo-anchor="${anchor}"]`);
      if (!element) {
        return;
      }

      if (anchor.startsWith("interactive-offline") || anchor.startsWith("interactive-sync")) {
        element.closest("details")?.setAttribute("open", "open");
      }

      element.scrollIntoView({
        block: "center",
        inline: "center",
        behavior: "smooth",
      });

      await wait(options?.settleMs ?? 700);

      const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = rect.left + rect.width * 0.5;
      const y = rect.top + rect.height * 0.5;

      setDemoCursor({
        visible: true,
        x,
        y,
        clicking: false,
        label: options?.label ?? null,
      });

      await wait(420);

      if (options?.click) {
        setDemoCursor((current) => ({
          ...current,
          clicking: true,
        }));
        playDemoSound("click");
        await wait(260);
        setDemoCursor((current) => ({
          ...current,
          clicking: false,
        }));
      }
    },
    [playDemoSound]
  );

  const resetDemoDataInBackground = useCallback(async () => {
    if (snapshotRef.current) {
      const remaining = (await readOfflineQueue()).filter(
        (item) => item.competitionId !== snapshotRef.current?.competition.id
      );
      await writeOfflineQueue(remaining);
    }
  }, []);

  const replayFullSalesStory = async () => {
    setError("");
    setMessage("");
    const resetWorked = await resetDramaScenario(true);
    if (!resetWorked) {
      await handleRestoreDemo();
      return;
    }

    setLiveSaveCompleted(false);
    setLeaderboardObserved(false);
    setOfflineQueuedSaveCompleted(false);
    setSyncRecovered(false);
    setPlaybackStep(null);
    setPlaybackNarration(null);
    setPresentationFocus("judge");
    setMobileTab("judge");
    await handleRunDemo({ preserveSalesSession: salesSession?.organizerCompleted });
  };

  async function handleRunDemo(options?: { preserveSalesSession?: boolean }) {
    if (toolkitState.scriptRunning || toolkitState.simulationRunning) {
      return;
    }

    const freshSnapshot = snapshotRef.current ?? snapshot;
    if (!freshSnapshot) {
      setError("No simulated judge event is loaded yet.");
      return;
    }

    const athlete =
      freshSnapshot?.climbers.find((climber) => climber.name.toLowerCase().includes("maya foster")) ??
      freshSnapshot?.climbers[0] ??
      null;

    if (!athlete) {
      setError("Unable to find the scripted demo athlete.");
      return;
    }

    setToolkitState((current) => ({
      ...current,
      scriptRunning: true,
    }));
    setError("");
    setMessage("Guided demo started. Watch the same event you built move into one saved score, the finals bubble swap, the Wi-Fi drop, and the sync recovery.");
    syncSalesSessionState((current) =>
      createDemoSalesSession({
        mode: "judge",
        phase: "judge",
        storyStep: "judge-save",
        narratorTitle: options?.preserveSalesSession
          ? "The event you just configured is now powering live judging."
          : "Watch one saved score drive the whole comp-day story.",
        narratorBody: options?.preserveSalesSession
          ? "Stay with the same event as it moves into one judge save, a live leaderboard reaction, and an offline recovery moment."
          : "This guided demo shows the money moment: one clean save, live public movement, a Wi-Fi failure, and a resilient sync catch-up.",
        autoplay: true,
        organizerCompleted: options?.preserveSalesSession ?? false,
        judgePending: false,
        persistentCompletion: false,
        audioEnabled: current?.audioEnabled ?? salesAudioEnabled,
        competitionId: freshSnapshot.competition.id,
        competitionSlug: freshSnapshot.competition.slug,
      })
    );

    try {
      await resetDramaScenario(true);
      setPlaybackNarration({
        title: "Starting the guided demo",
        body: "You are still on the same event from organizer setup. Now one judge logs a score, the finals bubble flips live on tiebreaks, Wi-Fi drops, scores keep queueing, then everything syncs back in.",
      });
      await wait(2600);

      setPresentationFocus("judge");
      setPlaybackStep("save");
      setMobileTab("judge");
      setPlaybackNarration({
        title: "Step 1: Judge logs the deciding top",
        body: `Watch the left side. ${athlete.name} gets an official top on ${getDemoPitchClimb(1)?.label ?? "Boulder 1"} and that result becomes the public score everyone else reacts to.`,
      });
      syncSalesSessionState((current) => ({
        ...(current ??
          createDemoSalesSession({
            mode: "judge",
            phase: "judge",
            storyStep: "judge-save",
            narratorTitle: "",
            narratorBody: "",
          })),
        phase: "judge",
        storyStep: "judge-save",
        narratorTitle: "Step 1: Judge logs the deciding top",
        narratorBody: `Watch the left side. ${athlete.name} gets an official top on ${getDemoPitchClimb(1)?.label ?? "Boulder 1"} and that result becomes the public score everyone else reacts to.`,
      }));
      await moveDemoCursorTo("interactive-top-button", {
        click: true,
        label: "Top",
      });
      await wait(900);
      await moveDemoCursorTo("interactive-save-button", {
        click: true,
        label: "Save score",
      });
      await wait(1200);

      await handleSaveQualifier({
        climberId: athlete.id,
        climbNumber: 1,
        attemptCount: 1,
        topped: true,
        zone: true,
        attemptsToTop: 1,
        attemptsToZone: 1,
      });
      playDemoSound("flash");
      triggerConfetti();
      await wait(2200);

      setPresentationFocus("leaderboard");
      setPlaybackStep("leaderboard");
      setMobileTab("leaderboard");
      setPlaybackNarration({
        title: "Step 2: The finals bubble flips live",
        body: "Now watch the right side. One corrected attempt count changes the tie-break chain and flips the last finals spot in real time.",
      });
      syncSalesSessionState((current) => ({
        ...(current ??
          createDemoSalesSession({
            mode: "judge",
            phase: "judge",
            storyStep: "judge-leaderboard",
            narratorTitle: "",
            narratorBody: "",
          })),
        phase: "judge",
        storyStep: "judge-leaderboard",
        narratorTitle: "Step 2: The finals bubble flips live",
        narratorBody:
          "Now watch the right side. One corrected attempt count changes the tie-break chain and flips the last finals spot in real time.",
      }));
      setDemoCursor((current) => ({
        ...current,
        label: "Bubble spot changes live",
      }));
      await wait(2600);
      const dramaResult = await runSimulationStep("drama_tick");
      if (dramaResult?.payload?.dramaContext) {
        setMessage(
          buildDramaSwapMessage(
            snapshotRef.current ?? freshSnapshot,
            dramaResult.simulatedSnapshot,
            dramaResult.payload.dramaContext
          )
        );
      }
      setLeaderboardObserved(true);
      await wait(2200);
      await runSimulationStep("live_burst");
      await wait(1600);
      await runSimulationStep("live_burst");
      setMessage("The cut line just flipped on attempts, and the rest of the board keeps moving like a real comp floor.");
      await wait(2200);

      setPresentationFocus("offline");
      setPlaybackStep("offline");
      setMobileTab("judge");
      setPlaybackNarration({
        title: "Step 3: Wi-Fi drops, but judging keeps going",
        body: "The left side is now in offline mode. The public leaderboard pauses, but the judge can still save a score locally without losing the result.",
      });
      syncSalesSessionState((current) => ({
        ...(current ??
          createDemoSalesSession({
            mode: "judge",
            phase: "judge",
            storyStep: "judge-offline",
            narratorTitle: "",
            narratorBody: "",
          })),
        phase: "judge",
        storyStep: "judge-offline",
        narratorTitle: "Step 3: Wi-Fi drops, but judging keeps going",
        narratorBody:
          "The left side is now in offline mode. The public leaderboard pauses, but the judge can still save a score locally without losing the result.",
      }));
      setToolkitState((current) => ({
        ...current,
        simulateOffline: true,
        lastSyncStatus: current.pendingQueueCount > 0 ? "pending" : current.lastSyncStatus,
      }));
      await moveDemoCursorTo("interactive-offline-toggle", {
        click: true,
        label: "Simulate Wi-Fi drop",
      });
      await wait(1800);
      await moveDemoCursorTo("interactive-zone-button", {
        click: true,
        label: "Zone",
      });
      await wait(700);
      await moveDemoCursorTo("interactive-save-button", {
        click: true,
        label: "Save locally",
      });
      await wait(1200);
      await handleSaveQualifier({
        climberId: athlete.id,
        climbNumber: 2,
        attemptCount: 2,
        topped: false,
        zone: true,
        attemptsToTop: null,
        attemptsToZone: 2,
      });
      await wait(2400);

      setPresentationFocus("sync");
      setPlaybackStep("sync");
      setPlaybackNarration({
        title: "Step 4: Reconnect and publish the queue",
        body: "Wi-Fi comes back, the queued score flushes, and the public side catches up without the judge having to re-enter anything.",
      });
      syncSalesSessionState((current) => ({
        ...(current ??
          createDemoSalesSession({
            mode: "judge",
            phase: "judge",
            storyStep: "judge-sync",
            narratorTitle: "",
            narratorBody: "",
          })),
        phase: "judge",
        storyStep: "judge-sync",
        narratorTitle: "Step 4: Reconnect and publish the queue",
        narratorBody:
          "Wi-Fi comes back, the queued score flushes, and the public side catches up without the judge having to re-enter anything.",
      }));
      setToolkitState((current) => ({
        ...current,
        simulateOffline: false,
      }));
      await moveDemoCursorTo("interactive-offline-toggle", {
        click: true,
        label: "Reconnect Wi-Fi",
      });
      await wait(1100);
      await moveDemoCursorTo("interactive-sync-now", {
        click: true,
        label: "Reconnect and sync",
      });
      await wait(1100);
      await flushOfflineQueue();
      setMobileTab("leaderboard");
      await wait(2600);

      setPlaybackStep("complete");
      setPresentationFocus("leaderboard");
      setPlaybackNarration({
        title: "Demo complete",
        body: "In under a minute, the same event moved from organizer setup into live judging, a real leaderboard swing, and a clean recovery from bad Wi-Fi.",
      });
      await resetDemoDataInBackground();
      syncSalesSessionState((current) => ({
        ...(current ??
          createDemoSalesSession({
            mode: "judge",
            phase: "complete",
            storyStep: "complete",
            narratorTitle: "",
            narratorBody: "",
          })),
        mode: "judge",
        phase: "complete",
        storyStep: "complete",
        narratorTitle: "Demo complete",
        narratorBody:
          "The same event was created from scratch, judged live, and recovered cleanly. Use Start over whenever you want to return to the organizer flow and build the next event.",
        autoplay: false,
        organizerCompleted: true,
        judgePending: false,
        persistentCompletion: true,
        audioEnabled: salesAudioEnabled,
      }));
      salesAutoplayStartedRef.current = false;
      setMessage("Guided demo complete. Use Start over to jump back to the organizer flow and rebuild the event from scratch.");

    } catch (nextError) {
      setError(normalizeDemoErrorMessage(nextError, "Unable to run the guided demo."));
    } finally {
      setDemoCursor((current) => ({
        ...current,
        visible: false,
        clicking: false,
        label: null,
      }));
      setToolkitState((current) => ({
        ...current,
        scriptRunning: false,
      }));
    }
  }

  const handleGuidedLeaderboardBurst = useCallback(async () => {
    if (toolkitState.simulationRunning || toolkitState.simulateOffline) {
      return;
    }

    setLeaderboardObserved(false);
    setToolkitState((current) => ({
      ...current,
      simulationRunning: true,
    }));
    setMessage("Watch the finals bubble flip first, then the rest of the field keeps moving around it.");
    setError("");

    try {
      const dramaResult = await runSimulationStep("drama_tick");
      if (dramaResult?.payload?.dramaContext) {
        setMessage(
          buildDramaSwapMessage(
            snapshotRef.current ?? snapshot ?? dramaResult.simulatedSnapshot,
            dramaResult.simulatedSnapshot,
            dramaResult.payload.dramaContext
          )
        );
        setLeaderboardObserved(true);
      }

      const burstCount = 2;
      for (let index = 0; index < burstCount; index += 1) {
        await new Promise((resolve) => window.setTimeout(resolve, 1200));
        await runSimulationStep("live_burst");
      }
      setMessage("The cut line moved on attempts, then the board kept breathing with live ambient scores.");
    } catch (nextError) {
      setError(nextError instanceof Error ? nextError.message : "Unable to run the guided live event burst.");
    } finally {
      setToolkitState((current) => ({
        ...current,
        simulationRunning: false,
      }));
    }
  }, [runSimulationStep, snapshot, toolkitState.simulateOffline, toolkitState.simulationRunning]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeTourStep !== "leaderboard") {
      leaderboardBurstTriggeredRef.current = false;
      return;
    }

    if (!leaderboardBurstTriggeredRef.current) {
      setLeaderboardObserved(false);
    }

    if (!liveSaveCompleted || toolkitState.simulateOffline || toolkitState.scriptRunning) {
      return;
    }

    if (leaderboardBurstTriggeredRef.current) {
      return;
    }

    leaderboardBurstTriggeredRef.current = true;
    void handleGuidedLeaderboardBurst();
  }, [
    activeTourStep,
    handleGuidedLeaderboardBurst,
      leaderboardObserved,
      liveSaveCompleted,
      toolkitState.scriptRunning,
      toolkitState.simulateOffline,
    ]);

  async function handleRestoreDemo() {
    setError("");
    setMessage("");
    try {
      const activeCompetitionId = snapshot?.competition.id ?? demoCompetitionId;
      if (activeCompetitionId) {
        const remaining = (await readOfflineQueue()).filter((item) => item.competitionId !== activeCompetitionId);
        await writeOfflineQueue(remaining);
      }

      const response = await fetch("/api/demo/reset", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          mode: "public_demo",
          competitionId: activeCompetitionId,
        }),
      });
      const payload = (await response.json().catch(() => null)) as { error?: string } | null;
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(payload?.error || "Unable to reset the demo event.");
      }

      clearDemoSalesSession();
      setDemoCompetitionId(null);
      setSalesSession(null);
      salesAutoplayStartedRef.current = false;
      router.push("/staff/demo");
    } catch (nextError) {
      setError(normalizeDemoErrorMessage(nextError, "Unable to reset the demo."));
    }
  }

  const statusLabel = useMemo(() => {
    const status = toolkitState.lastSyncStatus;
    if (status === "synced") {
      return "Saved live";
    }
    if (status === "saving") {
      return "Saving live...";
    }
    if (status === "syncing") {
      return "Publishing queued scores...";
