    }
    if (status === "failed") {
      return "Sync needs review";
    }
    return toolkitState.pendingQueueCount > 0 ? `Saved on this device (${toolkitState.pendingQueueCount})` : "Saved on this device";
  }, [toolkitState.lastSyncStatus, toolkitState.pendingQueueCount]);
  const showPersistentCompletion = playbackStep === "complete" || salesSession?.persistentCompletion === true;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!snapshot || !salesSession || salesAutoplayStartedRef.current) {
      return;
    }

    if (salesSession.mode === "judge" && salesSession.autoplay) {
      salesAutoplayStartedRef.current = true;
      void runDemoRef.current?.({ preserveSalesSession: salesSession.organizerCompleted });
    }
  }, [salesSession, snapshot]);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <main className="results-page">
        <div className={shellClassName}>
          <SiteHeader
            light
            status={
              <Link href="/demo" className="results-secondary-button">
                Back to demo roles
              </Link>
            }
          />
          <Surface variant="card" className="text-slate-600">
            Loading the live scoring demo...
          </Surface>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  if (!snapshot || !leaderboardSnapshot) {
    return (
      <main className="results-page">
        <div className={shellClassName}>
          <SiteHeader light />
          <Alert variant="error">
            {error || "Unable to load the live scoring demo."}
            {!demoCompetitionId ? (
              <>
                {" "}
                <Link href="/staff/demo" className="underline underline-offset-2">
                  Go back to the organizer demo
                </Link>
                {" "}to create and launch an event first.
              </>
            ) : null}
          </Alert>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className={`results-page ${toolkitState.simulateOffline ? "demo-pitch-offline-page" : ""}`}>
      <div className={shellClassName}>
        <SiteHeader
          light
          status={
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <Link href="/demo" className="results-secondary-button">
                Demo roles
              </Link>
              <Link href={buildDisplayPath(snapshot.competition.slug)} className="results-secondary-button">
                Public display
              </Link>
              <div className="results-chip">{statusLabel}</div>
            </div>
          }
        />

        <DemoSalesShell
          mode="judge"
          stepLabel={JUDGE_STEP_LABELS[playbackStep ?? "save"]}
          title={playbackNarration?.title ?? salesSession?.narratorTitle ?? "Watch the finals bubble flip live on one corrected score."}
          body={
            playbackNarration?.body ??
            salesSession?.narratorBody ??
            "This pitch path shows a clean save, a cut-line tiebreak swap, a Wi-Fi drop, and a resilient sync recovery."
          }
          autoplayRunning={toolkitState.scriptRunning}
          audioEnabled={salesAudioEnabled}
          onReplay={() => void replayFullSalesStory()}
          onSkipToJudge={() => void handleRunDemo({ preserveSalesSession: salesSession?.organizerCompleted })}
          onBackToOrganizer={() => {
            writeDemoSalesSession(
              createDemoSalesSession({
                mode: "organizer",
                phase: "organizer",
                storyStep: "organizer-intro",
                narratorTitle: "Back to the organizer side of the story.",
                narratorBody:
                  "Return to the organizer setup flow to show how the event gets built before comp day starts.",
                autoplay: false,
                organizerCompleted: false,
                judgePending: false,
                persistentCompletion: false,
                audioEnabled: salesAudioEnabled,
                competitionId: snapshot.competition.id,
                competitionSlug: snapshot.competition.slug,
              })
            );
            router.push("/staff/demo");
          }}
          onToggleAudio={() => {
            const nextValue = !salesAudioEnabled;
            setSalesAudioEnabled(nextValue);
            const existing = readDemoSalesSession();
            if (existing) {
              setSalesSession({
                ...existing,
                audioEnabled: nextValue,
              });
              patchDemoSalesSession({ audioEnabled: nextValue });
            } else {
              writeDemoSalesSession(
                createDemoSalesSession({
                  mode: "judge",
                  phase: "judge",
                  storyStep: "judge-save",
                  narratorTitle: "Watch the finals bubble flip live on one corrected score.",
                  narratorBody:
                    "This pitch path shows a clean save, a cut-line tiebreak swap, a Wi-Fi drop, and a resilient sync recovery.",
                  autoplay: false,
                  organizerCompleted: false,
                  judgePending: false,
                  persistentCompletion: false,
                  audioEnabled: nextValue,
                  competitionId: snapshot.competition.id,
                  competitionSlug: snapshot.competition.slug,
                })
              );
            }
          }}
        />

        {showPersistentCompletion ? (
          <Surface variant="card" className="overflow-hidden border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50/70">
            <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[1.05fr_0.95fr] lg:items-center">
              <div className="space-y-3">
                  <div className="results-kicker text-emerald-700">Guided story complete</div>
                <h2 className="text-3xl font-semibold text-slate-950 sm:text-4xl">
                  The event was built, judged live, and safely recovered from bad Wi‑Fi.
                </h2>
                <p className="max-w-3xl text-base leading-7 text-slate-600">
                  This ending stays visible for the presenter, even though the underlying demo event has already been reset behind the scenes and is ready for the next replay.
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                {[
                  "Organizer created the event structure",
                  "Judge station saved a live score",
                  "Leaderboard reacted instantly",
                  "Offline queue recovered cleanly",
                ].map((item) => (
                  <div
                    key={item}
                    className="rounded-[1.4rem] border border-emerald-200 bg-white/90 px-4 py-4 text-sm font-medium text-emerald-900 shadow-[0_16px_45px_-30px_rgba(16,185,129,0.5)]"
                  >
                    <span className="mr-2 inline-flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-emerald-500 text-xs font-bold text-white">
                      ✓
                    </span>
                    {item}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </Surface>
        ) : null}

        <Surface variant="card" className="overflow-hidden">
          <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[1.1fr_0.9fr] lg:items-end">
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div className="results-kicker">Experience as a judge</div>
              <h1 className="results-editorial-title text-4xl font-semibold text-slate-950 sm:text-5xl">
                Save one score. Watch the finals bubble flip live.
              </h1>
              <p className="max-w-3xl text-base leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
                You are judging {scenarioAthlete?.categoryLabel ?? "the featured qualifier field"}. Start with{" "}
                {scenarioAthlete?.name ?? "the highlighted athlete"} on Boulder 1. Then the right side shows the exact cut-line tiebreak swing that climbers, coaches, and spectators would see live.
              </p>
              {scenarioAthlete ? (
                <div className="inline-flex max-w-3xl flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-sky-200 bg-sky-50/90 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-sky-800">
                  <span>You are judging {scenarioAthlete.categoryLabel} qualifiers.</span>
                  <span className="hidden sm:inline">·</span>
                  <span>Save {scenarioAthlete.name} on Boulder 1 first.</span>
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-start gap-3 lg:justify-end">
              <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setMobileTab("judge")} className="xl:hidden">
                Judge
              </Button>
              <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setMobileTab("leaderboard")} className="xl:hidden">
                Leaderboard
              </Button>
              <Link href="/staff/demo" className="results-secondary-button">
                Organizer workflow
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Surface>

        {playbackNarration ? (
          <Surface variant="row" className="border-sky-200/80 bg-[linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(240,249,255,0.98),rgba(255,255,255,0.94))]">
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:flex-row lg:items-start lg:justify-between">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="results-kicker text-sky-700">
                  {toolkitState.scriptRunning ? "Autoplay walkthrough" : "Walkthrough summary"}
                </div>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-950">
                  {playbackNarration.title}
                </h2>
                <p className="max-w-4xl text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-600 sm:text-base">
                  {playbackNarration.body}
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-sky-200 bg-white/90 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-sky-800 shadow-[0_10px_24px_rgba(14,116,215,0.08)]">
                <span className="demo-live-dot" aria-hidden="true" />
                <span>{toolkitState.scriptRunning ? "Watch this step before the next one starts" : "Ready to replay"}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </Surface>
        ) : null}

        <div className="grid gap-6 2xl:[grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.18fr)_minmax(34rem,0.82fr)]">
          <div className={`min-w-0 ${mobileTab === "leaderboard" ? "hidden 2xl:block" : ""}`}>
            <JudgeWorkspace
              snapshot={snapshot}
              embedded
              saving={saving}
              queuedCount={toolkitState.pendingQueueCount}
              queuedItems={queuedScorePreviews}
              message={message}
              error={error}
              syncStatus={statusLabel}
              syncState={toolkitState.lastSyncStatus}
              initialClimberId={scenarioAthlete?.id ?? snapshot.climbers[0]?.id ?? null}
              targetClimberId={scenarioAthlete?.id ?? null}
              targetClimberName={scenarioAthlete?.name ?? null}
              offlineMode={toolkitState.simulateOffline}
              interactionLocked={toolkitState.scriptRunning}
              pitchClimbLabels={[...DEMO_PITCH_CLIMBS]}
              presentationFocus={presentationFocus}
              onSaveQualifier={handleSaveQualifier}
            />
          </div>
          <div className={`min-w-0 ${mobileTab === "judge" ? "hidden 2xl:block" : ""}`}>
            <LeaderboardPanel
              snapshot={leaderboardSnapshot}
              embedded
              highlightedClimberId={highlightedClimberId}
              targetClimberId={scenarioAthlete?.id ?? null}
              impact={leaderboardImpact}
              lastUpdatedAt={lastUpdatedAt}
              toast={leaderboardToast}
              presentationFocus={presentationFocus}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <DemoToolkit
        state={toolkitState}
        playbackStep={playbackStep}
        onRunDemo={() => void handleRunDemo()}
        onToggleOffline={handleToggleOffline}
        onSimulateOneScore={() => void handleSimulateOneScore()}
        onRunLiveBurst={() => void handleRunLiveBurst()}
        onSyncNow={() => void flushOfflineQueue()}
        onRestoreDemo={() => void handleRestoreDemo()}
      />
      {showConfetti ? (
        <div className="demo-confetti" aria-hidden="true">
          {Array.from({ length: 18 }).map((_, index) => (
            <span
              key={`confetti-${index}`}
              className="demo-confetti-piece"
              style={{
                left: `${8 + index * 5}%`,
                animationDelay: `${index * 60}ms`,
              }}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {demoCursor.visible ? (
        <div
          className={`demo-pointer ${demoCursor.clicking ? "demo-pointer-clicking" : ""}`}
          style={{
            left: demoCursor.x,
            top: demoCursor.y,
          }}
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          <div className="demo-pointer-dot" />
          {demoCursor.label ? <div className="demo-pointer-label">{demoCursor.label}</div> : null}
        </div>
      ) : null}
      <InteractiveDemoTour
        pendingQueueCount={toolkitState.pendingQueueCount}
        climberName={scenarioAthlete?.name ?? "the demo athlete"}
        liveSaveCompleted={liveSaveCompleted}
        leaderboardObserved={leaderboardObserved}
        offlineMode={toolkitState.simulateOffline}
        offlineQueuedSaveCompleted={offlineQueuedSaveCompleted}
        syncRecovered={syncRecovered}
        syncStatus={toolkitState.lastSyncStatus}
        suppressed={toolkitState.scriptRunning || playbackStep !== null}
        onActiveStepChange={setActiveTourStep}
        onRestart={() => void handleRestoreDemo()}
      />
    </main>
  );
}


--- src\components\demo\interactive-demo-tour.tsx ---

"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { motion, AnimatePresence, useReducedMotion } from "framer-motion";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Surface } from "@/components/ui/surface";
import type { DemoSyncStatus } from "@/components/demo/types";

const TOUR_STATE_KEY = "interactive_demo_tour_state_v2";

type InteractiveDemoTourProps = {
  pendingQueueCount: number;
  climberName: string;
  liveSaveCompleted: boolean;
  leaderboardObserved: boolean;
  offlineMode: boolean;
  offlineQueuedSaveCompleted: boolean;
  syncRecovered: boolean;
  syncStatus: DemoSyncStatus;
  suppressed?: boolean;
  onActiveStepChange?: (stepId: "judge" | "save" | "leaderboard" | "offline" | "sync") => void;
  onRestart?: () => void;
};

const baseSteps = [
  {
    id: "judge",
    title: "Find the demo athlete",
    body: "__ATHLETE__ is highlighted as the first scoring example. This is the one row to act on first.",
  },
  {
    id: "save",
    title: "Save one score",
    body: "For __ATHLETE__ on Boulder 1, tap Zone or Top, then press Save score. Continue unlocks after that score is officially saved.",
  },
  {
    id: "leaderboard",
    title: "Watch the ranking react",
    body: "As soon as your save lands, the finals bubble flips on a tie-break. Watch the leaderboard on the right show the cut-line swap first, then keep moving like a real comp floor.",
  },
  {
    id: "offline",
    title: "Simulate a Wi-Fi drop",
    body: "Turn on Simulate Wi-Fi drop, save the demo athlete again, and leave the score queued locally.",
  },
  {
    id: "sync",
    title: "Reconnect and sync",
    body: "Turn Wi-Fi back on or hit Reconnect and sync. Continue unlocks once the queued score publishes.",
  },
] as const;

export function InteractiveDemoTour({
  pendingQueueCount,
  climberName,
  liveSaveCompleted,
  leaderboardObserved,
  offlineMode,
  offlineQueuedSaveCompleted,
  syncRecovered,
  syncStatus,
  suppressed = false,
  onActiveStepChange,
  onRestart,
}: InteractiveDemoTourProps) {
  const reduceMotion = useReducedMotion();
  const [hidden, setHidden] = useState(false);
  const [stepIndex, setStepIndex] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(TOUR_STATE_KEY);
      if (!raw) {
        return;
      }

      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as { hidden?: boolean; stepIndex?: number };
      setHidden(Boolean(parsed.hidden));
      if (typeof parsed.stepIndex === "number" && parsed.stepIndex >= 0 && parsed.stepIndex < baseSteps.length) {
        setStepIndex(parsed.stepIndex);
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore bad local tour state.
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    window.localStorage.setItem(
      TOUR_STATE_KEY,
      JSON.stringify({
        hidden,
        stepIndex,
      })
    );
  }, [hidden, stepIndex]);

  const steps = useMemo(
    () =>
      baseSteps.map((step) =>
        step.id === "sync" && pendingQueueCount > 0
          ? {
              ...step,
              body: `${pendingQueueCount} queued ${
                pendingQueueCount === 1 ? "score is" : "scores are"
              } waiting right now. Reconnect and publish them to finish the resilience story.`,
            }
          : {
              ...step,
              body: step.body.replace("__ATHLETE__", climberName),
            }
      ),
    [climberName, pendingQueueCount]
  );

  const activeStep = steps[stepIndex];

  useEffect(() => {
    if (suppressed) {
      return;
    }

    onActiveStepChange?.(activeStep.id);
  }, [activeStep.id, onActiveStepChange, suppressed]);
  const stepRequirement = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeStep.id === "judge") {
      return {
        complete: true,
        label: "The demo athlete is already highlighted.",
      };
    }

    if (activeStep.id === "save") {
      return {
        complete: liveSaveCompleted,
        label: liveSaveCompleted
          ? "Live score saved."
          : `Tap Zone or Top for ${climberName} on Boulder 1, then press Save score.`,
      };
    }

    if (activeStep.id === "leaderboard") {
      return {
        complete: leaderboardObserved,
        label: leaderboardObserved
          ? "Leaderboard impact confirmed."
          : "Watch the cut line flip, then let the ambient scores keep moving around it.",
      };
    }

    if (activeStep.id === "offline") {
      return {
        complete: offlineQueuedSaveCompleted,
        label: offlineQueuedSaveCompleted
          ? "Offline queue created."
          : offlineMode
            ? `Save ${climberName} again while Wi-Fi is dropped so it queues locally.`
            : "Turn on Simulate Wi-Fi drop, then save the demo athlete again.",
      };
    }

    return {
      complete: syncRecovered,
      label: syncRecovered
        ? "Queued score synced back to the public leaderboard."
        : syncStatus === "syncing"
          ? "Sync is running now. Wait for it to finish."
          : "Reconnect and sync the queued score to finish the walkthrough.",
    };
  }, [
    activeStep.id,
    climberName,
    leaderboardObserved,
    liveSaveCompleted,
    offlineMode,
    offlineQueuedSaveCompleted,
    syncRecovered,
    syncStatus,
  ]);

  if (suppressed) {
    return null;
  }

  if (hidden) {
    return (
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setHidden(false)}
        className="fixed bottom-4 left-4 z-40 rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-white/92 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 shadow-[0_12px_30px_rgba(15,23,42,0.12)] backdrop-blur-xl"
      >
        Resume demo tour
      </button>
    );
  }

  return (
    <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
      <motion.div
        key={activeStep.id}
        initial={reduceMotion ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 16 }}
        animate={reduceMotion ? { opacity: 1 } : { opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        exit={reduceMotion ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
        transition={{ duration: reduceMotion ? 0.18 : 0.32, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
        className="fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-40 w-[min(28rem,calc(100vw-2rem))]"
      >
        <Surface variant="card" className="space-y-4 rounded-[1.8rem] p-5 shadow-[0_24px_60px_rgba(15,23,42,0.18)]">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="results-kicker">
              Step {stepIndex + 1} of {steps.length}
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setHidden(true)}
              className="rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-500"
            >
              Hide
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <h3 className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-950">{activeStep.title}</h3>
            <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-600">{activeStep.body}</p>
          </div>
          <div
            className={`rounded-[1rem] border px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium ${
              stepRequirement.complete
                ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800"
                : "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800"
            }`}
          >
            {stepRequirement.complete ? "Ready to continue: " : "Do this next: "}
            {stepRequirement.label}
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            {steps.map((step, index) => (
              <div
                key={step.id}
                className={`h-2 flex-1 rounded-full ${index === stepIndex ? "bg-sky-500" : index < stepIndex ? "bg-slate-400" : "bg-slate-200"}`}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              onClick={() => setStepIndex((current) => Math.max(0, current - 1))}
              disabled={stepIndex === 0}
            >
              Back
            </Button>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Button
                variant="ghost"
                onClick={() => {
                  setStepIndex(0);
                  setHidden(false);
                  onRestart?.();
                }}
              >
                Restart
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="primary"
                disabled={!stepRequirement.complete}
                onClick={() => {
                  if (stepIndex === steps.length - 1) {
                    setHidden(true);
                    return;
                  }
                  setStepIndex((current) => Math.min(steps.length - 1, current + 1));
                }}
              >
                {stepIndex === steps.length - 1 ? "Finish" : "Continue"}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Surface>
      </motion.div>
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}


--- src\components\demo\judge-workspace.tsx ---

﻿"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Alert } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Surface } from "@/components/ui/surface";
import type { CompetitionSnapshot } from "@/lib/db";
import { normalizeQualifierAttemptInput } from "@/lib/attempts";
import {
  canStaffScoreQualifier,
  filterAttemptsForRound,
  formatCompetitionPhaseLabel,
  getActiveQualifierStyleRound,
  getClimbs,
  type QualifierAttempt,
} from "@/lib/scoring";
import type { DemoQueuedScorePreview, DemoSyncStatus, JudgeQualifierSaveInput } from "@/components/demo/types";

type QualifierDraft = { attemptCount: number; topped: boolean; zone: boolean };
type QualifierDraftState = Record<string, QualifierDraft>;
type ConfirmationTone = "pending" | "confirmed" | "dirty";

const EMPTY_QUALIFIER_DRAFT: QualifierDraft = { attemptCount: 0, topped: false, zone: false };

function getQualifierDraftFromAttempt(
  attempt?: { attempt_count: number; topped: boolean; zone?: boolean | null } | null
): QualifierDraft {
  const normalized = normalizeQualifierAttemptInput({
    attemptCount: attempt?.attempt_count ?? 0,
    topped: Boolean(attempt?.topped),
    zone: Boolean(attempt?.zone ?? attempt?.topped),
    attemptsToTop: attempt?.attempt_count ?? 0,
    attemptsToZone: attempt?.attempt_count ?? 0,
  });

  return {
    attemptCount: normalized.attemptCount,
    topped: normalized.topped,
    zone: normalized.zone,
  };
}

function qualifierDraftMatchesSaved(
  draft: QualifierDraft,
  attempt?: { attempt_count: number; topped: boolean; zone?: boolean | null } | null
) {
  const normalized = normalizeQualifierAttemptInput(draft);
  const saved = getQualifierDraftFromAttempt(attempt);
  return (
    normalized.attemptCount === saved.attemptCount &&
    normalized.topped === saved.topped &&
    normalized.zone === saved.zone
  );
}

function formatQualifierSavedState(
  attempt?: { attempt_count: number; topped: boolean; zone?: boolean | null } | null
) {
  if (!attempt) {
    return "No official entry yet";
  }

  const countLabel = `${attempt.attempt_count} ${
    attempt.attempt_count === 1 ? "attempt" : "attempts"
  }`;
  if (attempt.topped) {
    return `${countLabel}, zone + top`;
  }
  if (attempt.zone) {
    return `${countLabel}, zone`;
  }
  return `${countLabel}, no hold`;
}

function getQualifierPresentation(
  draft: QualifierDraft,
  attempt?: { attempt_count: number; topped: boolean; zone?: boolean | null } | null
): {
  normalized: ReturnType<typeof normalizeQualifierAttemptInput>;
  dirty: boolean;
  liveLabel: string;
  liveDetail: string;
  confirmationLabel: string;
  confirmationTone: ConfirmationTone;
  savedSummary: string;
} {
  const normalized = normalizeQualifierAttemptInput(draft);
  const dirty = !qualifierDraftMatchesSaved(draft, attempt);
  const hasSavedAttempt = Boolean(attempt);
  const hasSavedResult = Boolean(attempt?.topped || attempt?.zone);

  let liveLabel = "Waiting for first attempt";
  let liveDetail = "Count the first attempt, then mark zone or top once control is clear.";

  if (normalized.topped) {
    liveLabel = `Top called on attempt ${normalized.attemptsToTop ?? normalized.attemptCount}`;
    liveDetail = "Zone stays on automatically. This will save as the official result for this boulder.";
  } else if (normalized.zone) {
    liveLabel = `Zone called on attempt ${normalized.attemptsToZone ?? normalized.attemptCount}`;
    liveDetail = "Zone is marked. Add top later only if the climber finishes.";
  } else if (normalized.attemptCount > 0) {
    liveLabel = `Attempt ${normalized.attemptCount} - no hold called`;
    liveDetail = "No scoring hold is marked yet.";
  }

  return {
    normalized,
    dirty,
    liveLabel,
    liveDetail,
    confirmationLabel: dirty
      ? "Unsaved judge edits"
      : hasSavedAttempt
        ? hasSavedResult
          ? "Score confirmed"
          : "Draft saved"
        : "No saved score yet",
    confirmationTone: dirty ? "dirty" : hasSavedResult ? "confirmed" : "pending",
    savedSummary: formatQualifierSavedState(attempt),
  };
}

type JudgeWorkspaceProps = {
  snapshot: CompetitionSnapshot;
  embedded?: boolean;
  saving?: boolean;
  queuedCount?: number;
  queuedItems?: DemoQueuedScorePreview[];
  message?: string;
  error?: string;
  syncStatus?: string;
  syncState?: DemoSyncStatus;
  initialClimberId?: string | null;
  targetClimberId?: string | null;
  targetClimberName?: string | null;
  offlineMode?: boolean;
  interactionLocked?: boolean;
  pitchClimbLabels?: Array<{ number: number; shortLabel: string; label: string }>;
  presentationFocus?: "judge" | "save" | "leaderboard" | "offline" | "sync" | "complete" | null;
  onSaveQualifier: (input: JudgeQualifierSaveInput) => Promise<void>;
};

export function JudgeWorkspace({
  snapshot,
  embedded = false,
  saving = false,
  queuedCount = 0,
  queuedItems = [],
  message = "",
  error = "",
  syncStatus = "Saved live",
  syncState = "synced",
  initialClimberId = null,
  targetClimberId = null,
  targetClimberName = null,
  offlineMode = false,
  interactionLocked = false,
  pitchClimbLabels = [],
  presentationFocus = null,
  onSaveQualifier,
}: JudgeWorkspaceProps) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [selectedBoulder, setSelectedBoulder] = useState(1);
  const [qualifierDrafts, setQualifierDrafts] = useState<QualifierDraftState>({});
  const activeQualifierRoundId =
    snapshot.activeQualifierRound?.id ??
    getActiveQualifierStyleRound(snapshot.competition)?.id ??
    null;
  const activeQualifierRoundName =
    snapshot.activeQualifierRound?.name ??
    getActiveQualifierStyleRound(snapshot.competition)?.name ??
    "Qualifier";
  const activeQualifierProblemCount =
    snapshot.activeQualifierRound?.problem_count ?? snapshot.competition.total_climbs ?? 0;
  const qualifierScoringOpen = canStaffScoreQualifier(snapshot.competition);
  const syncToneClass =
    syncState === "failed"
      ? "demo-judge-sync-row-failed"
      : syncState === "syncing" || syncState === "saving"
        ? "demo-judge-sync-row-syncing"
        : syncState === "pending" || offlineMode
          ? "demo-judge-sync-row-pending"
          : "demo-judge-sync-row-synced";
  const syncHelperCopy = offlineMode
    ? "New scores stay on this judge station until you reconnect."
    : syncState === "saving"
      ? "Saving this result live to the public leaderboard now."
    : syncState === "pending"
      ? `${queuedCount} ${queuedCount === 1 ? "score is" : "scores are"} waiting to publish.`
      : syncState === "syncing"
        ? "Queued scores are syncing back to the public leaderboard."
        : syncState === "failed"
          ? "Sync needs attention before the public view catches up."
          : "Every save is publishing live to the public leaderboard.";
  const selectedPitchClimb =
    pitchClimbLabels.find((climb) => climb.number === selectedBoulder) ??
    pitchClimbLabels[selectedBoulder - 1] ??
    null;

  useEffect(() => {
    const nextDrafts: QualifierDraftState = {};
    snapshot.climbers.forEach((climber) => {
      filterAttemptsForRound(climber.qualifier_attempts, activeQualifierRoundId).forEach((attempt) => {
        nextDrafts[`${climber.id}:${attempt.climb_number}`] = getQualifierDraftFromAttempt(attempt);
      });
    });
    setQualifierDrafts(nextDrafts);
  }, [activeQualifierRoundId, snapshot]);

  const qualifierClimbers = useMemo(() => {
    const normalized = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    const filtered = snapshot.climbers.filter((climber) => {
      if (!normalized) {
        return true;
      }

      return (
        climber.name.toLowerCase().includes(normalized) ||
        climber.climber_number.toLowerCase().includes(normalized) ||
        climber.display_category.toLowerCase().includes(normalized)
      );
    });

    if (!initialClimberId) {
      return filtered;
    }

    return [...filtered].sort((left, right) => {
      if (left.id === initialClimberId) {
        return -1;
      }
      if (right.id === initialClimberId) {
        return 1;
      }
      return left.name.localeCompare(right.name);
    });
  }, [initialClimberId, query, snapshot.climbers]);

  const qualifierSavedCount = useMemo(
    () =>
      snapshot.climbers.filter((climber) =>
        filterAttemptsForRound(climber.qualifier_attempts, activeQualifierRoundId).some(
          (attempt) => attempt.climb_number === selectedBoulder
        )
      ).length,
    [activeQualifierRoundId, selectedBoulder, snapshot.climbers]
  );

  const setQualifierDraft = (key: string, updater: (draft: QualifierDraft) => QualifierDraft) => {
    setQualifierDrafts((current) => {
      const nextDraft = updater(current[key] ?? EMPTY_QUALIFIER_DRAFT);
      return {
        ...current,
        [key]: nextDraft,
      };
    });
  };

  const handleSave = async (climberId: string, climbNumber: number) => {
    const key = `${climberId}:${climbNumber}`;
    const draft = qualifierDrafts[key] ?? EMPTY_QUALIFIER_DRAFT;
    const normalized = normalizeQualifierAttemptInput(draft);
    setQualifierDrafts((current) => ({
      ...current,
      [key]: {
        attemptCount: normalized.attemptCount,
        topped: normalized.topped,
        zone: normalized.zone,
      },
    }));
    await onSaveQualifier({
      climberId,
      climbNumber,
      attemptCount: normalized.attemptCount,
      topped: normalized.topped,
      zone: normalized.zone,
      attemptsToTop: normalized.attemptsToTop,
      attemptsToZone: normalized.attemptsToZone,
    });
  };

  return (
    <Surface
      variant="card"
      className={`${embedded ? "flex h-full min-h-0 min-w-0 flex-col" : ""} ${
        offlineMode ? "demo-judge-offline-surface" : ""
      } ${presentationFocus === "judge" || presentationFocus === "offline" || presentationFocus === "sync" ? "demo-pitch-focus-surface" : ""}`}
    >
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4" data-demo-anchor="interactive-judge">
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <div className="results-kicker">{activeQualifierRoundName} scoring workspace</div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-950 sm:text-3xl">
            Boulder-by-boulder judging
          </h2>
          <p className="max-w-2xl text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
            You are judging {targetClimberId ? qualifierClimbers.find((climber) => climber.id === targetClimberId)?.display_category ?? "the live qualifier field" : "the live qualifier field"}. Save one score on Boulder 1, then watch the public leaderboard react on the right.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <Badge>{formatCompetitionPhaseLabel(snapshot.competition.current_phase)}</Badge>
          <Badge variant={queuedCount > 0 ? "live" : "default"} data-demo-anchor="interactive-sync">
            {syncStatus}
          </Badge>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
        <div className="rounded-[1rem] border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/80 px-4 py-3">
          <div className="results-kicker">Current boulder</div>
          <div className="mt-2 text-base font-semibold text-slate-950">
            B{String(selectedBoulder).padStart(2, "0")}
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
            {qualifierSavedCount} of {snapshot.climbers.length} entries saved
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-[1rem] border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/80 px-4 py-3">
          <div className="results-kicker">Field</div>
          <div className="mt-2 text-base font-semibold text-slate-950">
            {qualifierClimbers.length} visible {qualifierClimbers.length === 1 ? "climber" : "climbers"}
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
            {activeQualifierProblemCount} qualifier {activeQualifierProblemCount === 1 ? "boulder" : "boulders"}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-[1rem] border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/80 px-4 py-3">
          <div className="results-kicker">Sync state</div>
          <div className="mt-2 text-base font-semibold text-slate-950">{syncStatus}</div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">{syncHelperCopy}</div>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-[1rem] border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/80 px-4 py-3">
          <div className="results-kicker">Queue</div>
          <div className="mt-2 text-base font-semibold text-slate-950">
            {queuedCount > 0 ? `${queuedCount} waiting` : "Clear"}
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
            {offlineMode ? "Device-first saves are enabled." : "No delayed judge saves right now."}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className={`mt-4 grid gap-4 ${embedded ? "demo-judge-shell-embedded" : "xl:grid-cols-[20rem_minmax(0,1fr)]"}`}>
        <div className="results-control-stack space-y-3">
          <div>
            <div className="results-kicker">{activeQualifierRoundName} controls</div>
            <div className="mt-1 text-xl font-semibold text-slate-950">
              Boulder {String(selectedBoulder).padStart(2, "0")}
            </div>
            {selectedPitchClimb ? (
              <div className="mt-2 inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-white/85 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 shadow-[0_8px_20px_rgba(15,23,42,0.04)]">
                {selectedPitchClimb.label}
              </div>
            ) : null}
            <div className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">
              {qualifierSavedCount} of {snapshot.climbers.length} climbers already have an entry on this
              boulder.
            </div>
            {targetClimberName ? (
              <div className="mt-3 rounded-[1rem] border border-sky-200 bg-sky-50/80 px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-sky-800">
                Demo target: save {targetClimberName} on Boulder 1, then watch the leaderboard jump.
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </div>
          <input
            value={query}
            onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value)}
            className="results-input"
            placeholder="Filter by name, number, or category"
            disabled={interactionLocked}
          />
          <div className="flex max-h-[16rem] flex-wrap gap-2 overflow-y-auto">
            {getClimbs(activeQualifierProblemCount).map((climb) => (
              <button
                key={climb.number}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelectedBoulder(climb.number)}
                className={`results-secondary-button px-4 ${
                  selectedBoulder === climb.number ? "results-secondary-button-active" : ""
                }`}
                disabled={interactionLocked}
              >
                <span className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1 text-center">
                  <span>B{String(climb.number).padStart(2, "0")}</span>
                  {pitchClimbLabels[climb.number - 1] ? (
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-medium normal-case tracking-normal text-slate-500">
                      {pitchClimbLabels[climb.number - 1]?.shortLabel}
                    </span>
                  ) : null}
                </span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="rounded-[1.1rem] border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/80 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-600">
            {qualifierScoringOpen
              ? "Large touch targets are enabled here on purpose so a judge can save a score fast, even under gym pressure."
              : "Qualifier scoring is currently locked, so the workspace is in read-only mode."}
          </div>
          {offlineMode || queuedItems.length || syncState === "syncing" || syncState === "failed" ? (
            <div className="rounded-[1.2rem] border border-slate-200 bg-white/90 px-4 py-4 shadow-[0_10px_24px_rgba(15,23,42,0.05)]">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="results-kicker">Offline queue</div>
                <div className="rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-500">
                  Queue proof
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-2 text-base font-semibold text-slate-950">
                {queuedCount > 0
                  ? `${queuedCount} ${queuedCount === 1 ? "score is" : "scores are"} waiting to publish`
                  : syncState === "syncing"
                    ? "Queued scores are publishing now"
                    : offlineMode
                      ? "New scores will stay on this device until you reconnect"
                      : "No queued scores right now"}
              </div>
              <div className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-600">
                {offlineMode
                  ? "Every save is preserved on this judge station first, then replayed to the public leaderboard after reconnection."
                  : syncState === "failed"
                    ? "Publishing needs attention. The queued scores below are still preserved on this device."
                    : "This queue is the proof that no judge save disappears during a Wi-Fi drop."}
              </div>
              {queuedItems.length ? (
                <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
                  {queuedItems.map((item) => (
                    <div
                      key={item.id}
                      className="rounded-[1rem] border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/85 px-3 py-3 text-sm text-slate-700"
                    >
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                        <div className="font-semibold text-slate-950">{item.climberName}</div>
                        <div className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-500">{item.queuedAtLabel}</div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-1">
                        {item.climbLabel} · {item.resultLabel}
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-500">
                        {item.retryCount > 0
                          ? `Retry attempts: ${item.retryCount}`
                          : "Waiting for the next publish opportunity."}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        <div className="min-h-0 min-w-0 space-y-2.5 overflow-y-auto pr-1" data-demo-anchor="interactive-judge-card">
          {qualifierClimbers.map((climber, climberIndex) => {
            const key = `${climber.id}:${selectedBoulder}`;
            const existingAttempt = filterAttemptsForRound(
              climber.qualifier_attempts,
              activeQualifierRoundId
            ).find((attempt) => attempt.climb_number === selectedBoulder);
            const draft = qualifierDrafts[key] ?? getQualifierDraftFromAttempt(existingAttempt);
            const presentation = getQualifierPresentation(draft, existingAttempt);
            return (
              <div
                key={climber.id}
                className={`results-workspace-card route-judge-card ${
                  embedded ? "demo-judge-card-embedded" : ""
                } ${
                  targetClimberId === climber.id ? "demo-judge-card-target ring-2 ring-sky-300/80 shadow-[0_18px_42px_rgba(14,116,215,0.12)]" : ""
                }`}
                data-demo-anchor={climberIndex === 0 ? "interactive-first-athlete" : undefined}
              >
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-950">{climber.name}</div>
                    <div className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">
                      #{climber.climber_number} | {climber.display_category}
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                      <div className={`judge-status-chip judge-status-chip-${presentation.confirmationTone}`}>
                        {presentation.confirmationLabel}
                      </div>
                      {targetClimberId === climber.id ? (
                        <Badge className="demo-judge-target-badge">Demo target</Badge>
                      ) : null}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-500">
                    Boulder {String(selectedBoulder).padStart(2, "0")}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {targetClimberId === climber.id ? (
                  <div className="demo-judge-target-callout">
                    Save this climber first so the rank jump is obvious on the leaderboard.
                  </div>
                ) : null}

                <div className={`demo-judge-live-stack ${embedded ? "demo-judge-live-stack-embedded" : "route-judge-live-row"}`}>
                  <div className="route-judge-counter-card">
                    <div className="results-kicker">Live attempt counter</div>
                    <div className={`route-judge-counter-row ${embedded ? "demo-judge-counter-row-embedded" : ""}`}>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() =>
                          setQualifierDraft(key, (current) => {
                            const nextAttemptCount = Math.max(0, current.attemptCount - 1);
                            return {
                              attemptCount: nextAttemptCount,
                              topped: nextAttemptCount > 0 ? current.topped : false,
                              zone: nextAttemptCount > 0 ? current.zone : false,
                            };
                          })
                        }
                        className="route-judge-counter-button"
                        aria-label={`Decrease live attempts for ${climber.name}`}
                        disabled={interactionLocked}
                      >
                        -
                      </button>
                      <div className="route-judge-counter-value">{presentation.normalized.attemptCount}</div>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() =>
                          setQualifierDraft(key, (current) => ({
                            ...current,
                            attemptCount: current.attemptCount + 1,
                          }))
                        }
                        className="route-judge-counter-button route-judge-counter-button-accent"
                        aria-label={`Add an attempt for ${climber.name}`}
                        disabled={interactionLocked}
                      >
                        Add attempt
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className={`judge-live-summary min-w-0 ${embedded ? "demo-judge-live-summary-embedded" : ""}`}>
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      <div className="results-kicker">Score status</div>
                      <div className="mt-2 text-xl font-semibold text-slate-950">{presentation.liveLabel}</div>
                      <div className={`demo-judge-sync-row ${syncToneClass}`} data-demo-anchor={climberIndex === 0 ? "interactive-offline-banner" : undefined}>
                        <span className="demo-judge-sync-dot" />
                        <span>{syncStatus}</span>
                        <span className="hidden text-slate-400 sm:inline">·</span>
                        <span className="demo-judge-sync-helper">{syncHelperCopy}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-sm text-slate-600">{presentation.liveDetail}</div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className={`route-judge-action-grid route-judge-action-grid-qualifier ${embedded ? "demo-judge-action-grid-embedded" : ""}`}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setQualifierDraft(key, (current) => ({
                        ...current,
                        attemptCount: current.attemptCount + 1,
                      }))
                    }
                    className="route-judge-action route-judge-action-neutral"
                    disabled={interactionLocked}
                  >
                    <span className="route-judge-action-label">Add attempt</span>
                    <span className="route-judge-action-detail">Count another live start</span>
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setQualifierDraft(key, (current) => ({
                        attemptCount: Math.max(1, current.attemptCount),
                        topped: false,
                        zone: !current.zone,
                      }))
                    }
                    className={`route-judge-action route-judge-action-zone ${
                      presentation.normalized.zone && !presentation.normalized.topped
                        ? "route-judge-action-active"
                        : ""
                    }`}
                    data-demo-anchor={climberIndex === 0 ? "interactive-zone-button" : undefined}
                    disabled={interactionLocked}
                  >
                    <span className="route-judge-action-label">Zone</span>
                    <span className="route-judge-action-detail">
                      {presentation.normalized.zone && !presentation.normalized.topped
                        ? "Zone ON"
                        : "Zone OFF"}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setQualifierDraft(key, (current) => ({
                        attemptCount: Math.max(1, current.attemptCount),
                        topped: !current.topped,
                        zone: !current.topped ? true : current.zone,
                      }))
                    }
                    className={`route-judge-action route-judge-action-top ${
                      presentation.normalized.topped ? "route-judge-action-active" : ""
                    }`}
                    data-demo-anchor={climberIndex === 0 ? "interactive-top-button" : undefined}
                    disabled={interactionLocked}
                  >
                    <span className="route-judge-action-label">Top</span>
                    <span className="route-judge-action-detail">
                      {presentation.normalized.topped ? "Top ON" : "Top OFF"}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className={`route-judge-footer ${embedded ? "demo-judge-footer-embedded" : ""}`}>
                  <div className="space-y-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
                    <div>Last saved: {presentation.savedSummary}</div>
                    {message && targetClimberId === climber.id ? (
                      <div className="text-sm font-medium text-emerald-700">{message}</div>
                    ) : null}
                    {error && targetClimberId === climber.id ? (
                      <div className="text-sm font-medium text-red-700">{error}</div>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                  <div
                    className={`flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 ${embedded ? "w-full sm:w-auto" : ""}`}
                    data-demo-anchor={climberIndex === 0 ? "interactive-save" : undefined}
                  >
                    <Button
                      variant="ghost"
                      className={`text-slate-500 ${embedded ? "min-h-12 px-5 text-sm" : "min-h-11 rounded-full px-4"}`}
                      onClick={() => setQualifierDraft(key, () => EMPTY_QUALIFIER_DRAFT)}
                      disabled={saving || interactionLocked}
                    >
                      Clear
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      variant="primary"
                      className={`${embedded ? "min-h-14 min-w-[13rem] flex-1 rounded-[1.1rem] px-6 text-base sm:flex-none" : "min-h-11 rounded-full px-5"}`}
                      onClick={() => void handleSave(climber.id, selectedBoulder)}
                      disabled={saving || !qualifierScoringOpen || interactionLocked}
                      data-demo-anchor={climberIndex === 0 ? "interactive-save-button" : undefined}
                    >
                      Save score
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </Surface>
  );
}


--- src\components\demo\leaderboard-panel.tsx ---

"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "framer-motion";
import FinalsResultsTable from "@/components/finals-results-table";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Surface } from "@/components/ui/surface";
import type { LeaderboardImpact, LeaderboardToast } from "@/components/demo/types";
import type { CompetitionSnapshot } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  compareQualifierEntries,
  formatCompetitionPhaseLabel,
  formatFinalPoints,
  formatUsesSelfScoredQualifiers,
  getFormatCapabilities,
  pickPreferredQualifierCategory,
} from "@/lib/scoring";

type LeaderboardPanelProps = {
  snapshot: CompetitionSnapshot;
  embedded?: boolean;
  highlightedClimberId?: string | null;
  targetClimberId?: string | null;
  impact?: LeaderboardImpact | null;
  lastUpdatedAt?: string | null;
  toast?: LeaderboardToast | null;
  presentationFocus?: "judge" | "save" | "leaderboard" | "offline" | "sync" | "complete" | null;
};

export function LeaderboardPanel({
  snapshot,
  embedded = false,
  highlightedClimberId = null,
  targetClimberId = null,
  impact = null,
  lastUpdatedAt = null,
  toast = null,
  presentationFocus = null,
}: LeaderboardPanelProps) {
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState("");
  const [selectedFinalsCategory, setSelectedFinalsCategory] = useState("");
  const [relativeNow, setRelativeNow] = useState(() => Date.now());
  const reduceMotion = useReducedMotion();

  const categories = useMemo(() => {
    const offeredCategories = snapshot.registrationChoices.map((choice) => choice.category);
    const sourceCategories = offeredCategories.length ? offeredCategories : snapshot.competition.categories;
    return [...sourceCategories].sort((left, right) => {
      const sortDiff = left.sort_order - right.sort_order;
      if (sortDiff !== 0) {
        return sortDiff;
      }

      return left.display_name.localeCompare(right.display_name);
    });
  }, [snapshot]);

  const preferredCategoryId = useMemo(
    () => pickPreferredQualifierCategory(categories, snapshot.qualifierLeaderboard),
    [categories, snapshot.qualifierLeaderboard]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!categories.length) {
      return;
    }

    if (!selectedCategory || !categories.some((category) => category.id === selectedCategory)) {
      setSelectedCategory(preferredCategoryId || categories[0].id);
    }
  }, [categories, preferredCategoryId, selectedCategory]);

  const qualifierRows = useMemo(() => {
    return snapshot.qualifierLeaderboard
      .filter((entry) => !selectedCategory || entry.category_id === selectedCategory)
      .sort((left, right) => {
        const rankDiff = left.category_rank - right.category_rank;
        if (rankDiff !== 0) {
          return rankDiff;
        }

        return compareQualifierEntries(left, right);
      });
  }, [selectedCategory, snapshot.qualifierLeaderboard]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!impact?.climberId) {
      return;
    }

    const impactedEntry = snapshot.qualifierLeaderboard.find((entry) => entry.climber_id === impact.climberId);
    if (impactedEntry?.category_id && impactedEntry.category_id !== selectedCategory) {
      setSelectedCategory(impactedEntry.category_id);
    }
  }, [impact?.climberId, selectedCategory, snapshot.qualifierLeaderboard]);

  const finalsGroups = useMemo(() => {
    const groups = new Map<string, CompetitionSnapshot["finalsLeaderboard"]>();
    snapshot.finalsLeaderboard.forEach((entry) => {
      const next = groups.get(entry.display_category) ?? [];
      next.push(entry);
      groups.set(entry.display_category, next);
    });
    return groups;
  }, [snapshot.finalsLeaderboard]);

  const finalsCategories = useMemo(() => Array.from(finalsGroups.keys()).sort(), [finalsGroups]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedFinalsCategory && finalsCategories.length) {
      setSelectedFinalsCategory(finalsCategories[0]);
    }
  }, [finalsCategories, selectedFinalsCategory]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => setRelativeNow(Date.now()), 1000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  const finalsRows = finalsGroups.get(selectedFinalsCategory) ?? [];
  const finalsActive =
    snapshot.competition.current_phase === "finals_open" ||
    snapshot.competition.current_phase === "finals_closed" ||
    snapshot.competition.current_phase === "results";
  const activeQualifierFormat =
    snapshot.activeQualifierRound?.format ?? snapshot.competition.format ?? "scramble";
  const scrambleFormat = formatUsesSelfScoredQualifiers(activeQualifierFormat);
  const activeQualifierRoundName = snapshot.activeQualifierRound?.name ?? "Qualifier";
  const qualifierScoreContextLabel =
    getFormatCapabilities(activeQualifierFormat).qualifierScoringUnit === "climb_points"
      ? "Score column shows climb points."
      : "Score column shows official qualifier points.";

  const wrapperClass = embedded ? "h-full space-y-3" : "space-y-5";

  const lastUpdatedLabel = useMemo(() => {
    if (!lastUpdatedAt) {
      return "Updated just now";
    }

    const timestamp = new Date(lastUpdatedAt).getTime();
    if (Number.isNaN(timestamp)) {
      return "Updated live";
    }

    const seconds = Math.max(0, Math.round((relativeNow - timestamp) / 1000));
    if (seconds <= 1) {
      return "Updated just now";
    }
    if (seconds < 60) {
      return `Updated ${seconds}s ago`;
    }

    const minutes = Math.round(seconds / 60);
    return `Updated ${minutes}m ago`;
  }, [lastUpdatedAt, relativeNow]);

  const impactHeadline = useMemo(() => {
    if (!impact?.climberId) {
      return null;
    }

    const impactedEntry = snapshot.qualifierLeaderboard.find((entry) => entry.climber_id === impact.climberId);
    if (!impactedEntry) {
      return null;
    }

    const beforeLabel = impact.beforeRank ? `#${impact.beforeRank}` : "Unranked";
    const afterLabel = impact.afterRank ? `#${impact.afterRank}` : `#${impactedEntry.category_rank}`;
    const movementLabel =
      impact.delta > 0
        ? `${impactedEntry.name} moved ${beforeLabel} -> ${afterLabel}`
        : impact.delta < 0
          ? `${impactedEntry.name} moved ${beforeLabel} -> ${afterLabel}`
          : `${impactedEntry.name} is now ${afterLabel}`;

    return {
      entry: impactedEntry,
      movementLabel,
      scoreLabel: Number.isInteger(impactedEntry.total_score)
        ? impactedEntry.total_score.toLocaleString()
        : formatFinalPoints(impactedEntry.total_score),
    };
  }, [impact, snapshot.qualifierLeaderboard]);

  const getImpactLabel = (climberId: string) => {
    if (!impact || impact.climberId !== climberId) {
      return null;
    }

    if (impact.beforeRank !== null && impact.afterRank !== null && impact.delta > 0) {
      return `Moved up ${impact.delta}`;
    }

    if (impact.beforeRank !== null && impact.afterRank !== null && impact.delta < 0) {
      return `Dropped ${Math.abs(impact.delta)}`;
    }

    if (impact.beforeRank !== null && impact.afterRank !== null) {
      return "Rank updated";
    }

    return "New score";
  };

  return (
    <div className={wrapperClass}>
      {finalsActive ? (
        finalsRows.length ? (
          <>
            <Surface
              variant="card"
              className={embedded ? "h-full min-h-0" : undefined}
              data-demo-anchor={embedded ? "interactive-leaderboard" : "leaderboard-overview"}
            >
              <div className="results-kicker">Finals</div>
              <h2 className="mt-2 break-words text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-950">
                Finals standings
              </h2>
              <div className="mt-3 text-sm text-slate-600">
                Competition phase: {formatCompetitionPhaseLabel(snapshot.competition.current_phase)}
              </div>
              <div className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-600">Score column shows finals points.</div>
              <div className="finals-category-picker mt-5">
                {finalsCategories.map((category) => (
                  <button
                    key={category}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setSelectedFinalsCategory(category)}
                    className={
                      category === selectedFinalsCategory
                        ? "finals-category-pill finals-category-pill-active"
                        : "finals-category-pill"
                    }
                  >
                    {category}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </Surface>
            <FinalsResultsTable title={selectedFinalsCategory} rows={finalsRows} />
          </>
        ) : (
          <Surface
            variant="card"
            className="text-slate-600"
            data-demo-anchor={embedded ? "interactive-leaderboard" : "leaderboard-overview"}
          >
            Finals are active, but no finals scores have been entered yet.
          </Surface>
        )
      ) : (
        <Surface
          variant="card"
          className={`${embedded ? "flex h-full min-h-0 min-w-0 flex-col" : ""} ${
            presentationFocus === "leaderboard" || presentationFocus === "sync"
              ? "demo-pitch-focus-surface"
              : ""
          }`}
          data-demo-anchor={embedded ? "interactive-leaderboard" : "leaderboard-overview"}
        >
          <div className="results-kicker">{activeQualifierRoundName} standings</div>
          <h2 className="mt-2 break-words text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-950 sm:text-3xl">
            {scrambleFormat ? "Live scramble standings" : `Live ${activeQualifierRoundName.toLowerCase()} rankings`}
          </h2>
          <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-sm text-slate-600">
            <div className="demo-live-badge">
              <span className="demo-live-dot" aria-hidden="true" />
              <span>LIVE</span>
            </div>
            <div>{lastUpdatedLabel}</div>
            <div>{qualifierScoreContextLabel}</div>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
            <div className="rounded-[1rem] border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/80 px-4 py-3">
              <div className="results-kicker">Visible field</div>
              <div className="mt-2 text-base font-semibold text-slate-950">
                {qualifierRows.length} {qualifierRows.length === 1 ? "climber" : "climbers"}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="rounded-[1rem] border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/80 px-4 py-3">
              <div className="results-kicker">Category</div>
              <div className="mt-2 text-base font-semibold text-slate-950">
                {categories.find((category) => category.id === selectedCategory)?.display_name ?? "All categories"}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="rounded-[1rem] border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/80 px-4 py-3">
              <div className="results-kicker">Round</div>
              <div className="mt-2 text-base font-semibold text-slate-950">{activeQualifierRoundName}</div>
            </div>
            <div className="rounded-[1rem] border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/80 px-4 py-3">
              <div className="results-kicker">Status</div>
              <div className="mt-2 text-base font-semibold text-slate-950">
                {toast ? `Score saved for ${toast.climberName}` : impactHeadline ? "Rank movement detected" : "Steady live feed"}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {impactHeadline ? (
            <motion.div
              layout
              initial={reduceMotion ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 12 }}
              animate={reduceMotion ? { opacity: 1 } : { opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              transition={{ duration: reduceMotion ? 0.18 : 0.35, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
              className="mt-4 rounded-[1.2rem] border border-emerald-200 bg-[linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(236,253,245,0.98),rgba(240,249,255,0.96))] px-4 py-3.5 shadow-[0_16px_40px_-28px_rgba(16,185,129,0.5)]"
            >
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div>
                  <div className="results-kicker text-emerald-700">Rank change live</div>
                  <div className="mt-1.5 text-xl font-semibold text-slate-950 sm:text-2xl">{impactHeadline.movementLabel}</div>
                  <div className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-600">
                    {impactHeadline.entry.display_category} · Score {impactHeadline.scoreLabel} · {impactHeadline.entry.topped_count} tops / {impactHeadline.entry.zone_count} zones
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {impact?.delta ? <Badge variant="live">{impact.delta > 0 ? `Up ${impact.delta}` : `Down ${Math.abs(impact.delta)}`}</Badge> : null}
                  {impact?.reason ? <Badge variant="live">{impact.reason}</Badge> : null}
                </div>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          ) : null}

          <div
            className={`mt-4 w-full overflow-x-auto rounded-[1.1rem] border border-slate-200/80 bg-white/72 px-2 py-2 shadow-[0_8px_24px_rgba(15,23,42,0.04)] backdrop-blur-xl ${embedded ? "" : "sticky top-20 z-20 sm:top-24"}`}
            data-demo-anchor={embedded ? undefined : "leaderboard-categories"}
          >
            <div className="flex min-w-max gap-2">
              {categories.map((category) => (
                <button
                  key={category.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedCategory(category.id)}
                  className={
                    selectedCategory === category.id
                      ? "finals-category-pill finals-category-pill-active"
                      : "finals-category-pill"
                  }
                >
                  {category.display_name}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {!qualifierRows.length ? (
            <Surface variant="meta" className="mt-5 text-slate-600">
              {scrambleFormat
                ? "This session has not recorded any scores yet. Check back once climbers start logging attempts."
                : `Scoring has not started yet. Check back during the ${activeQualifierRoundName.toLowerCase()} round.`}
            </Surface>
          ) : (
            <>
              <motion.div layout className="mt-5 space-y-2.5 md:hidden">
                {qualifierRows.map((entry) => {
                  const impactLabel = getImpactLabel(entry.climber_id);
                  const impacted = Boolean(impactLabel);
                  return (
                    <motion.div
                      key={entry.climber_id}
                      layout
                      transition={{ duration: reduceMotion ? 0.18 : 0.55, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
                    >
                      <Surface
                        variant="meta"
                        className={`min-w-0 ${highlightedClimberId === entry.climber_id ? "ring-2 ring-sky-400/50" : ""} ${impacted ? "demo-rank-impact-card" : ""}`}
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <div className="results-kicker">Rank #{entry.category_rank}</div>
                            <div className="mt-2 break-words text-lg font-semibold text-slate-950">{entry.name}</div>
                            <div className="mt-1 break-words text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
                              #{entry.climber_number} | {entry.province}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-right">
                            <div className="results-kicker">Score</div>
                            <div className="font-semibold text-slate-950">
                              {Number.isInteger(entry.total_score)
                                ? entry.total_score.toLocaleString()
                                : formatFinalPoints(entry.total_score)}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                          <Badge>{entry.display_category}</Badge>
                          {targetClimberId === entry.climber_id ? <Badge>Demo target</Badge> : null}
                          {impactLabel ? <Badge variant="live">{impactLabel}</Badge> : null}
                          {impact?.climberId === entry.climber_id && impact.reason ? (
                            <Badge variant="live">{impact.reason}</Badge>
                          ) : null}
                          <Badge>{entry.topped_count} tops</Badge>
                          <Badge>{entry.zone_count} zones</Badge>
                        </div>
                      </Surface>
                    </motion.div>
                  );
                })}
              </motion.div>

              <div
                className={`results-data-scroll mt-5 hidden md:block ${embedded ? "relative min-w-0 flex-1 overflow-x-auto overflow-y-hidden" : ""}`}
                data-demo-anchor={embedded ? "interactive-leaderboard-table" : "leaderboard-table"}
              >
                <div className="results-table-scroll-hint">
                  <span>{qualifierScoreContextLabel}</span>
                  <span>Scroll sideways for the full standings table.</span>
                </div>
                <motion.div layout className="min-w-[920px]">
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-[0.7fr_1.6fr_1fr_1fr_1fr_1.2fr] gap-4 border-b border-slate-200 px-4 py-2.5 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-500">
                    <div>Rank</div>
                    <div>Name</div>
                    <div>Province</div>
                    <div>Category</div>
                    <div>Score</div>
                    <div>Summary</div>
                  </div>
                  {qualifierRows.map((entry) => {
                    const impactLabel = getImpactLabel(entry.climber_id);
                    const impacted = Boolean(impactLabel);
                    return (
                      <motion.div
                        key={entry.climber_id}
                        layout
                        transition={{ duration: reduceMotion ? 0.18 : 0.55, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
                        className={`grid grid-cols-[0.7fr_1.6fr_1fr_1fr_1fr_1.2fr] gap-4 border-b border-slate-100 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-700 transition-colors ${
                          highlightedClimberId === entry.climber_id ? "bg-sky-50/80" : ""
                        } ${impacted ? "demo-rank-impact-row" : ""}`}
                      >
                        <div className="demo-rank-number text-slate-950">{entry.category_rank}</div>
                        <div className="min-w-0">
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                            <div className="break-words text-lg font-semibold text-slate-950">{entry.name}</div>
                            {targetClimberId === entry.climber_id ? <Badge>Demo target</Badge> : null}
                            {impactLabel ? <Badge variant="live">{impactLabel}</Badge> : null}
                            {impact?.climberId === entry.climber_id && impact.reason ? (
                              <Badge variant="live">{impact.reason}</Badge>
                            ) : null}
                          </div>
                          <div className="mt-1 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-500">#{entry.climber_number}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div>{entry.province}</div>
                        <div>{entry.display_category}</div>
                        <div className="font-semibold text-slate-950">
                          {Number.isInteger(entry.total_score)
                            ? entry.total_score.toLocaleString()
                            : formatFinalPoints(entry.total_score)}
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          {entry.topped_count} tops / {entry.zone_count} zones
                        </div>
                      </motion.div>
                    );
                  })}
                </motion.div>
                <AnimatePresence>
                  {toast ? (
                    <motion.div
                      key={toast.id}
                      initial={reduceMotion ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 16, scale: 0.98 }}
                      animate={reduceMotion ? { opacity: 1 } : { opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
                      exit={reduceMotion ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 12, scale: 0.98 }}
                      transition={{ duration: reduceMotion ? 0.18 : 0.3, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
                      className="demo-leaderboard-toast"
                    >
                      <div className="results-kicker text-emerald-200">Last score logged</div>
                      <div className="mt-2 text-base font-semibold text-white">
                        {toast.climberName} - {toast.climbLabel}
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-1 text-sm text-emerald-100">{toast.resultLabel}</div>
                      {toast.detail ? <div className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-300">{toast.detail}</div> : null}
                    </motion.div>
                  ) : null}
                </AnimatePresence>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </Surface>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


--- src\components\demo\organizer-demo-tour.tsx ---

"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "framer-motion";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Surface } from "@/components/ui/surface";

const TOUR_STATE_KEY = "organizer_demo_tour_state_v3";

export type OrganizerDemoStepId =
  | "overview"
  | "basics_name"
  | "basics_format"
  | "basics_registration"
  | "categories"
  | "preset"
  | "schedule"
  | "stages"
  | "create_event"
  | "event_details"
  | "save_event"
  | "handoff";

export type OrganizerDemoHandoffTarget = "judge" | "leaderboard" | "display";

type OrganizerDemoTourProps = {
  hasCreatedCompetition: boolean;
  competitionName: string;
  eventDetailsComplete: boolean;
  eventSaved: boolean;
  judgeReady: boolean;
  suppressed?: boolean;
  onActiveStepChange: (stepId: OrganizerDemoStepId) => void;
  onRestart: () => void;
  onJumpToCreate: () => void;
  onFocusAnchor: (anchor: string) => void;
  onLaunchJudge: () => void;
};

const baseSteps: Array<{
  id: OrganizerDemoStepId;
  title: string;
  body: string;
}> = [
  {
    id: "create_event",
    title: "Create the event for real",
    body: "Start from the empty organizer state and create the competition yourself. This is the first proof point in the story.",
  },
  {
    id: "event_details",
    title: "Review the generated event",
    body: "Check the preset, categories, finals eligibility, schedule, and stages so the setup feels like a real comp day.",
  },
  {
    id: "save_event",
    title: "Save the event",
    body: "Lock in the organizer setup with the real save button before you move into the judge experience.",
  },
  {
    id: "handoff",
    title: "Open the judge panel",
    body: "Once the saved event is ready, launch the judge panel and let the simulation bring the comp to life.",
  },
];

export function OrganizerDemoTour({
  hasCreatedCompetition,
  competitionName,
  eventDetailsComplete,
  eventSaved,
  judgeReady,
  suppressed = false,
  onActiveStepChange,
  onRestart,
  onJumpToCreate,
  onFocusAnchor,
  onLaunchJudge,
}: OrganizerDemoTourProps) {
  const reduceMotion = useReducedMotion();
  const [hidden, setHidden] = useState(false);
  const [stepIndex, setStepIndex] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(TOUR_STATE_KEY);
      if (!raw) {
        return;
      }

      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as { hidden?: boolean; stepIndex?: number };
      setHidden(Boolean(parsed.hidden));
      if (typeof parsed.stepIndex === "number" && parsed.stepIndex >= 0 && parsed.stepIndex < baseSteps.length) {
        setStepIndex(parsed.stepIndex);
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore bad saved organizer tour state.
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    window.localStorage.setItem(
      TOUR_STATE_KEY,
      JSON.stringify({
        hidden,
        stepIndex,
      })
    );
  }, [hidden, stepIndex]);

  const activeStep = baseSteps[stepIndex];

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!suppressed) {
      onActiveStepChange(activeStep.id);
    }
  }, [activeStep.id, onActiveStepChange, suppressed]);

  const stepRequirement = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeStep.id === "create_event") {
      return {
        complete: hasCreatedCompetition,
        label: hasCreatedCompetition
          ? `${competitionName || "Your event"} has been created.`
          : "Click Create event to generate the event record and unlock the organizer setup panel.",
      };
    }

    if (activeStep.id === "event_details") {
      return {
        complete: eventDetailsComplete,
        label: eventDetailsComplete
          ? "Categories, structure, schedule, and stages are configured."
          : "Review the setup cards until the meaningful setup areas show ready.",
      };
    }

    if (activeStep.id === "save_event") {
      return {
        complete: eventSaved,
        label: eventSaved
          ? "The current organizer setup is saved."
          : "Click Save competition after you finish the setup cards.",
      };
    }

    return {
      complete: judgeReady,
      label: judgeReady
        ? "The judge panel is unlocked and ready to simulate registrations."
        : "The judge panel unlocks after the event is fully configured and saved.",
    };
  }, [activeStep.id, competitionName, eventDetailsComplete, eventSaved, hasCreatedCompetition, judgeReady]);

  if (suppressed) {
    return null;
  }

  if (hidden) {
    return (
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setHidden(false)}
        className="fixed bottom-4 left-4 z-40 rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-white/92 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 shadow-[0_12px_30px_rgba(15,23,42,0.12)] backdrop-blur-xl"
      >
        Resume organizer tour
      </button>
    );
  }

  return (
    <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
      <motion.div
        key={activeStep.id}
        initial={reduceMotion ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 16 }}
        animate={reduceMotion ? { opacity: 1 } : { opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        exit={reduceMotion ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
        transition={{ duration: reduceMotion ? 0.18 : 0.32, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
        className="fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-40 w-[min(30rem,calc(100vw-2rem))]"
      >
