        <Surface variant="card" className="space-y-4 rounded-[1.8rem] p-5 shadow-[0_24px_60px_rgba(15,23,42,0.18)]">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="results-kicker">
              Step {stepIndex + 1} of {baseSteps.length} - Organizer walkthrough
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setHidden(true)}
              className="rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-500"
            >
              Hide
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <h3 className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-950">{activeStep.title}</h3>
            <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-600">{activeStep.body}</p>
          </div>
          <div
            className={`rounded-[1rem] border px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium ${
              stepRequirement.complete
                ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800"
                : "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800"
            }`}
          >
            {stepRequirement.complete ? "Ready to continue: " : "Do this next: "}
            {stepRequirement.label}
          </div>
          {activeStep.id === "create_event" ? (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              <button type="button" onClick={onJumpToCreate} className="results-primary-button">
                Open create form
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : null}
          {activeStep.id === "event_details" ? (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onFocusAnchor("organizer-progress")}
                className="results-primary-button"
              >
                Open setup cards
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : null}
          {activeStep.id === "save_event" ? (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onFocusAnchor("organizer-save-event")}
                className="results-primary-button"
              >
                Focus save button
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : null}
          {activeStep.id === "handoff" ? (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onLaunchJudge}
                disabled={!judgeReady}
                className={judgeReady ? "results-primary-button" : "results-secondary-button opacity-60"}
              >
                Go to judge panel
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : null}
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            {baseSteps.map((step, index) => (
              <div
                key={step.id}
                className={`h-2 flex-1 rounded-full ${index === stepIndex ? "bg-sky-500" : index < stepIndex ? "bg-slate-400" : "bg-slate-200"}`}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              onClick={() => setStepIndex((current) => Math.max(0, current - 1))}
              disabled={stepIndex === 0}
            >
              Back
            </Button>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Button
                variant="ghost"
                onClick={() => {
                  onRestart();
                  setStepIndex(0);
                  setHidden(false);
                }}
              >
                Restart
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="primary"
                disabled={!stepRequirement.complete}
                onClick={() => {
                  if (stepIndex === baseSteps.length - 1) {
                    setHidden(true);
                    return;
                  }
                  setStepIndex((current) => Math.min(baseSteps.length - 1, current + 1));
                }}
              >
                {stepIndex === baseSteps.length - 1 ? "Finish" : "Continue"}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Surface>
      </motion.div>
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}

"use client";

import { AnimatePresence, motion } from "framer-motion";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties } from "react";
import { buttonStyles } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

export type DemoTourRouteId = "organizer" | "judge" | "leaderboard" | "display";

type CalloutMode = "floating" | "sheet";
type CalloutSide = "left" | "right" | "bottom";

type DemoTourStep = {
  routeId: DemoTourRouteId;
  href: string;
  selector: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  action: string;
  continueLabel?: string;
  preferredSide?: Exclude<CalloutSide, "bottom">;
  verticalBias?: "top" | "center" | "bottom";
  calloutWidth?: number;
  allowInteraction?: boolean;
};

type DemoExperienceProps = {
  enabled: boolean;
  routeId: DemoTourRouteId;
  competitionSlug: string;
  bannerTitle: string;
  bannerDescription: string;
  bannerTip: string;
};

type SpotlightBox = {
  top: number;
  left: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  radius: number;
};

const STORAGE_STEP_KEY = "scorecard_demo_tour_step";
const STORAGE_DISMISSED_KEY = "scorecard_demo_tour_dismissed";
const TRANSITION_MIN_MS = 600;
const FALLBACK_CALLOUT_STYLE: CSSProperties = {
  left: 16,
  bottom: 16,
  width: 344,
};

function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number) {
  return Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max);
}

function getRouteLabel(routeId: DemoTourRouteId) {
  if (routeId === "organizer") return "Organizer demo";
  if (routeId === "judge") return "Judge station";
  if (routeId === "leaderboard") return "Live leaderboard";
  return "Big-screen display";
}

function buildInteractionPanels(spotlight: SpotlightBox): CSSProperties[] {
  return [
    { left: 0, top: 0, width: "100%", height: spotlight.top },
    { left: 0, top: spotlight.top, width: spotlight.left, height: spotlight.height },
    { left: spotlight.left + spotlight.width, top: spotlight.top, right: 0, height: spotlight.height },
    { left: 0, top: spotlight.top + spotlight.height, width: "100%", bottom: 0 },
  ];
}

function resolvePreferredTop(rect: DOMRect, calloutHeight: number, bias: DemoTourStep["verticalBias"]) {
  if (bias === "top") {
    return rect.top - 12;
  }
  if (bias === "bottom") {
    return rect.bottom - calloutHeight + 12;
  }
  return rect.top + rect.height / 2 - calloutHeight / 2;
}

function resolveFloatingSide(
  rect: DOMRect,
  calloutWidth: number,
  preferredSide: DemoTourStep["preferredSide"]
): Exclude<CalloutSide, "bottom"> | null {
  const isRightHalf = rect.left + rect.width / 2 > window.innerWidth / 2;
  const rightFits = rect.right + 24 + calloutWidth <= window.innerWidth - 16;
  const leftFits = rect.left - 24 - calloutWidth >= 16;

  const fallbackSides: Array<Exclude<CalloutSide, "bottom">> = isRightHalf ? ["left", "right"] : ["right", "left"];
  const sidesToTry = preferredSide ? [preferredSide, ...fallbackSides.filter((side) => side !== preferredSide)] : fallbackSides;

  for (const side of sidesToTry) {
    if (side === "left" && leftFits) {
      return "left";
    }
    if (side === "right" && rightFits) {
      return "right";
    }
  }

  return null;
}

export default function DemoExperience({
  enabled,
  routeId,
  competitionSlug,
  bannerTitle,
  bannerDescription,
  bannerTip,
}: DemoExperienceProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const steps = useMemo(() => buildDemoTourSteps(competitionSlug), [competitionSlug]);
  const routeStepIndexes = useMemo(
    () =>
      steps
        .map((step, index) => ({ step, index }))
        .filter((entry) => entry.step.routeId === routeId)
        .map((entry) => entry.index),
    [routeId, steps]
  );

  const firstRouteStepIndex = routeStepIndexes[0] ?? 0;
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(firstRouteStepIndex);
  const [dismissed, setDismissed] = useState(true);
  const [complete, setComplete] = useState(false);
  const [spotlight, setSpotlight] = useState<SpotlightBox | null>(null);
  const [calloutStyle, setCalloutStyle] = useState<CSSProperties | null>(null);
  const [calloutMode, setCalloutMode] = useState<CalloutMode>("floating");
  const [calloutSide, setCalloutSide] = useState<CalloutSide>("right");
  const [prefersReducedMotion, setPrefersReducedMotion] = useState(false);
  const [transitioning, setTransitioning] = useState(false);

  const transitionStartedAtRef = useRef(0);
  const transitionTimerRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  const activeStep = steps[activeIndex] ?? null;
  const previousStep = activeIndex > 0 ? steps[activeIndex - 1] : null;
  const nextStep = activeIndex < steps.length - 1 ? steps[activeIndex + 1] : null;
  const routeCurrentStepPosition = routeStepIndexes.findIndex((index) => index === activeIndex);
  const routeNextStep =
    routeCurrentStepPosition >= 0 && routeCurrentStepPosition < routeStepIndexes.length - 1
      ? steps[routeStepIndexes[routeCurrentStepPosition + 1]]
      : null;

  const finishTransition = () => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") {
      setTransitioning(false);
      return;
    }

    if (transitionTimerRef.current) {
      window.clearTimeout(transitionTimerRef.current);
      transitionTimerRef.current = null;
    }

    const elapsed = Date.now() - transitionStartedAtRef.current;
    const remaining = Math.max(0, TRANSITION_MIN_MS - elapsed);
    transitionTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setTransitioning(false);
      transitionTimerRef.current = null;
    }, remaining);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") {
      return;
    }

    const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
    const applyPreference = () => setPrefersReducedMotion(mediaQuery.matches);
    applyPreference();
    mediaQuery.addEventListener("change", applyPreference);

    return () => mediaQuery.removeEventListener("change", applyPreference);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled || typeof window === "undefined") {
      return;
    }

    const storedDismissed = window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_DISMISSED_KEY) === "true";
    const parsedIndex = Number(window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_STEP_KEY));
    const storedIndex =
      Number.isInteger(parsedIndex) && parsedIndex >= 0 && parsedIndex < steps.length ? parsedIndex : firstRouteStepIndex;
    const resolvedIndex =
      steps[storedIndex]?.routeId === routeId ? storedIndex : firstRouteStepIndex;

    setDismissed(storedDismissed);
    setComplete(false);
    setActiveIndex(resolvedIndex);

    setTransitioning(false);
  }, [enabled, firstRouteStepIndex, routeId, steps]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled || dismissed || complete || !activeStep || activeStep.routeId !== routeId || typeof window === "undefined") {
      setSpotlight(null);
      setCalloutStyle(null);
      setCalloutMode("floating");
      setCalloutSide("right");
      return;
    }

    let frame = 0;
    let settleTimer = 0;
    let resizeObserver: ResizeObserver | null = null;

    const updatePosition = (scrollTarget: boolean) => {
      const target = document.querySelector(activeStep.selector);
      if (!(target instanceof HTMLElement)) {
        setTransitioning(true);
        setSpotlight(null);
        setCalloutMode("sheet");
        setCalloutSide("bottom");
        const fallbackWidth = Math.min(360, window.innerWidth - 24);
        setCalloutStyle({
          left: Math.max(12, (window.innerWidth - fallbackWidth) / 2),
          bottom: 16,
          width: fallbackWidth,
        });
        return;
      }

      finishTransition();

      if (scrollTarget) {
        target.scrollIntoView({
          behavior: prefersReducedMotion ? "auto" : "smooth",
          block: activeStep.verticalBias === "top" ? "start" : activeStep.verticalBias === "bottom" ? "end" : "center",
          inline: "nearest",
        });
      }

      window.clearTimeout(settleTimer);
      settleTimer = window.setTimeout(
        () =>
          (frame = window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
            const padding = window.innerWidth < 768 ? 12 : 18;
            const requestedWidth = activeStep.calloutWidth ?? 344;
            const calloutWidth = Math.min(requestedWidth, window.innerWidth - 24);
            const preferredSide = resolveFloatingSide(rect, calloutWidth, activeStep.preferredSide);
            const useFloating = window.innerWidth >= 980 && rect.width < window.innerWidth * 0.68 && preferredSide !== null;
            const verticalPadding = useFloating ? padding + 12 : padding + 44;

            const nextSpotlight: SpotlightBox = {
              top: clamp(rect.top - padding, 12, Math.max(12, window.innerHeight - rect.height - verticalPadding * 2 - 12)),
              left: clamp(rect.left - padding, 12, Math.max(12, window.innerWidth - rect.width - padding * 2 - 12)),
              width: Math.max(rect.width + padding * 2, 240),
              height: Math.max(rect.height + padding * 2, 120),
              radius: window.innerWidth < 768 ? 24 : 30,
            };

            setSpotlight(nextSpotlight);

            if (!useFloating || !preferredSide) {
              const sheetWidth = Math.min(window.innerWidth >= 1024 ? 320 : 360, window.innerWidth - 24);
              setCalloutMode("sheet");
              setCalloutSide("bottom");
              setCalloutStyle({
                left: Math.max(12, (window.innerWidth - sheetWidth) / 2),
                bottom: 16,
                width: sheetWidth,
              });
              return;
            }

            const resolvedLeft =
              preferredSide === "right" ? rect.right + 24 : rect.left - calloutWidth - 24;
            const estimatedHeight = 308;
            const smartBias =
              activeStep.verticalBias === "center" && rect.top > window.innerHeight / 2
                ? "bottom"
                : activeStep.verticalBias === "center"
                  ? "top"
                  : activeStep.verticalBias;
            const preferredTop = resolvePreferredTop(rect, estimatedHeight, smartBias);
            const resolvedTop = clamp(preferredTop, 16, Math.max(16, window.innerHeight - estimatedHeight - 16));

            setCalloutMode("floating");
            setCalloutSide(preferredSide);
            setCalloutStyle({
              top: resolvedTop,
              left: clamp(resolvedLeft, 12, Math.max(12, window.innerWidth - calloutWidth - 12)),
              width: calloutWidth,
            });
          })),
        scrollTarget && !prefersReducedMotion ? 220 : 70
      );
    };

    const targetElement = document.querySelector(activeStep.selector);
    if (typeof ResizeObserver !== "undefined") {
      resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => updatePosition(false));
      if (targetElement instanceof HTMLElement) {
        resizeObserver.observe(targetElement);
      }
      resizeObserver.observe(document.body);
    }

    const handleResize = () => updatePosition(false);
    const handleScroll = () => updatePosition(false);

    updatePosition(true);
    const settleTimeout = window.setTimeout(() => updatePosition(false), prefersReducedMotion ? 90 : 280);
    window.addEventListener("resize", handleResize);
    window.addEventListener("scroll", handleScroll, true);

    return () => {
      window.clearTimeout(settleTimer);
      window.clearTimeout(settleTimeout);
      window.cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      resizeObserver?.disconnect();
      window.removeEventListener("resize", handleResize);
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", handleScroll, true);
    };
  }, [activeStep, complete, dismissed, enabled, prefersReducedMotion, routeId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (typeof window !== "undefined" && transitionTimerRef.current) {
        window.clearTimeout(transitionTimerRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof document === "undefined") {
      return;
    }

    const isActive = enabled && !dismissed && !complete && activeStep?.routeId === routeId;
    document.body.dataset.demoTourActive = isActive ? "true" : "false";

    return () => {
      delete document.body.dataset.demoTourActive;
    };
  }, [activeStep, complete, dismissed, enabled, routeId]);

  if (!enabled || !activeStep) {
    return null;
  }

  const goToStep = (targetIndex: number) => {
    const targetStep = steps[targetIndex];
    if (!targetStep || typeof window === "undefined") {
      return;
    }

    setComplete(false);
    window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_STEP_KEY, String(targetIndex));
    window.localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_DISMISSED_KEY);
    setDismissed(false);

    if (targetStep.routeId !== routeId) {
      transitionStartedAtRef.current = Date.now();
      setTransitioning(true);
      router.push(targetStep.href);
      return;
    }

    setTransitioning(false);
    setActiveIndex(targetIndex);
  };

  const restartTour = () => {
    setComplete(false);
    goToStep(0);
  };

  const dismissTour = () => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_DISMISSED_KEY, "true");
      window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_STEP_KEY, String(activeIndex));
    }
    setDismissed(true);
  };

  const maskId = `demo-tour-mask-${activeIndex}`;
  const showTransitionOverlay = !dismissed && !complete && (transitioning || activeStep.routeId !== routeId);
  const showTourOverlay = !dismissed && !complete && activeStep.routeId === routeId;
  const animatedCalloutStyle = calloutStyle ?? FALLBACK_CALLOUT_STYLE;
  const animatedCalloutTarget = {
    top: typeof animatedCalloutStyle.top === "number" ? animatedCalloutStyle.top : undefined,
    left: typeof animatedCalloutStyle.left === "number" ? animatedCalloutStyle.left : undefined,
    right: typeof animatedCalloutStyle.right === "number" ? animatedCalloutStyle.right : undefined,
    bottom: typeof animatedCalloutStyle.bottom === "number" ? animatedCalloutStyle.bottom : undefined,
    width:
      typeof animatedCalloutStyle.width === "number" || typeof animatedCalloutStyle.width === "string"
        ? animatedCalloutStyle.width
        : undefined,
    opacity: 1,
    scale: 1,
    y: 0,
  };
  const spotlightTransition = prefersReducedMotion
    ? { duration: 0 }
    : { type: "spring" as const, stiffness: 62, damping: 28, mass: 1.3 };
  const calloutTransition = prefersReducedMotion
    ? { duration: 0 }
    : { type: "spring" as const, stiffness: 72, damping: 26, mass: 1.18 };
  const fadeTransition = prefersReducedMotion
    ? { duration: 0 }
    : { duration: 0.72, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] as const };

  return (
    <>
      <section className="results-alert border border-sky-200/70 bg-[linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(240,249,255,0.98),rgba(239,246,255,0.88))] text-sky-900 shadow-[0_16px_44px_rgba(14,116,144,0.1)]">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-start lg:justify-between">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 self-start rounded-full border border-sky-200 bg-white/80 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-sky-700 shadow-[0_10px_24px_rgba(14,116,144,0.08)]">
              <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-sky-500 shadow-[0_0_0_6px_rgba(14,165,233,0.12)]" />
              {`Step ${activeIndex + 1} of ${steps.length} - Demo mode`}
            </div>
            <div className="text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-950">{bannerTitle}</div>
            <p className="max-w-3xl text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-700">{bannerDescription}</p>
            <p className="max-w-3xl text-sm leading-relaxed text-sky-800">{bannerTip}</p>
            {routeNextStep ? (
              <p className="max-w-3xl text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
                On this page next: <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{routeNextStep.title}</span>
              </p>
            ) : null}
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <button type="button" onClick={restartTour} className={buttonStyles({ variant: "secondary" })}>
              Restart tour
            </button>
            {nextStep ? (
              <button type="button" onClick={() => goToStep(activeIndex + 1)} className={buttonStyles({ variant: "primary" })}>
                Next: {nextStep.title}
              </button>
            ) : (
              <button type="button" onClick={restartTour} className={buttonStyles({ variant: "primary" })}>
                Back to organizer demo
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
        {showTransitionOverlay ? (
          <motion.div
            key="demo-tour-transition"
            className="pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-50"
            initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
            transition={fadeTransition}
          >
            <motion.div className="demo-tour-transition-shell absolute inset-0" initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }} transition={fadeTransition} />
            <motion.div
              className="demo-tour-transition-card absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 w-[min(24rem,calc(100vw-2rem))] rounded-[1.4rem] border border-white/75 bg-white/92 px-6 py-6 text-center shadow-[0_30px_80px_rgba(15,23,42,0.18)] backdrop-blur-xl"
              initial={{ x: "-50%", y: "-46%", opacity: 0, scale: 0.97 }}
              animate={{ x: "-50%", y: "-50%", opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
              exit={{ x: "-50%", y: "-48%", opacity: 0, scale: 0.98 }}
              transition={calloutTransition}
            >
              <div className="mx-auto h-2 w-16 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-slate-200/90">
                <div className="demo-tour-transition-bar h-full w-1/2 rounded-full bg-[linear-gradient(90deg,#185fa5,#0c447c)]" />
              </div>
              <div className="mt-5 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-500">
                Guided handoff
              </div>
              <div className="mt-3 text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-950">
                {`Traveling to ${getRouteLabel(activeStep.routeId)}...`}
              </div>
              <p className="mt-3 text-sm leading-7 text-slate-600">Bringing the next tour step into view.</p>
            </motion.div>
          </motion.div>
        ) : null}
      </AnimatePresence>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {showTourOverlay ? (
          <motion.div
            key={`demo-tour-overlay-${activeIndex}-${routeId}`}
            className="fixed inset-0 z-50 pointer-events-none"
            initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
            transition={fadeTransition}
          >
            {spotlight ? (
              <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none">
                <svg className="demo-tour-overlay-svg absolute inset-0 h-full w-full" aria-hidden="true">
                  <defs>
                    <mask id={maskId}>
                      <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="white" />
                      <motion.rect
                        initial={false}
                        animate={{
                          x: spotlight.left,
                          y: spotlight.top,
                          width: spotlight.width,
                          height: spotlight.height,
                          rx: spotlight.radius,
                          ry: spotlight.radius,
                        }}
                        transition={spotlightTransition}
                        fill="black"
                      />
                    </mask>
                    <radialGradient id={`${maskId}-gradient`} cx="50%" cy="45%" r="82%">
                      <stop offset="0%" stopColor="rgba(15,23,42,0.18)" />
                      <stop offset="55%" stopColor="rgba(15,23,42,0.28)" />
                      <stop offset="100%" stopColor="rgba(15,23,42,0.4)" />
                    </radialGradient>
                  </defs>
                  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill={`url(#${maskId}-gradient)`} mask={`url(#${maskId})`} />
                </svg>

                <motion.div
                  className="demo-tour-spotlight absolute pointer-events-none"
                  initial={false}
                  animate={{
                    top: spotlight.top,
                    left: spotlight.left,
                    width: spotlight.width,
                    height: spotlight.height,
                    borderRadius: spotlight.radius,
                  }}
                  transition={spotlightTransition}
                >
                  <div className="demo-tour-spotlight__glow absolute -inset-6 rounded-[calc(inherit+1.5rem)]" />
                  <div className="demo-tour-spotlight__wash absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit]" />
                  <div className="demo-tour-spotlight__edge absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit]" />
                </motion.div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <motion.div className="demo-tour-backdrop absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none" initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }} transition={fadeTransition} />
            )}

            {spotlight
              ? buildInteractionPanels(spotlight).map((panelStyle, index) => (
                  <div key={`demo-tour-blocker-${index}`} className="absolute pointer-events-auto" style={panelStyle} />
                ))
              : null}

            {spotlight && !activeStep.allowInteraction ? (
              <motion.div
                className="absolute pointer-events-auto"
                initial={false}
                animate={{
                  top: spotlight.top,
                  left: spotlight.left,
                  width: spotlight.width,
                  height: spotlight.height,
                  borderRadius: spotlight.radius,
                }}
                transition={spotlightTransition}
              />
            ) : null}

            <motion.aside
              layout
              className={`demo-tour-callout pointer-events-auto absolute ${calloutMode === "sheet" ? "demo-tour-callout-sheet" : "demo-tour-callout-floating"}`}
              initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96, y: 16 }}
              animate={animatedCalloutTarget}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.98, y: 12 }}
              transition={calloutTransition}
            >
            {calloutMode === "floating" && !complete ? (
              <div className={`demo-tour-callout__arrow demo-tour-callout__arrow-${calloutSide}`} aria-hidden="true" />
            ) : null}

            {complete ? (
              <div className="text-center">
                <div className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-emerald-100 text-xl text-emerald-700 shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.95)]">
                  {"\u2713"}
                </div>
                <h2 className="mt-4 text-[1.7rem] font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-950">Tour complete</h2>
                <p className="mt-3 text-[15px] leading-7 text-slate-700">
                  You&apos;ve seen the full event workflow. The demo is still live, so you can keep exploring freely.
                </p>
                <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2">
                  <button type="button" onClick={restartTour} className={buttonStyles({ variant: "primary" })}>
                    Restart tour
                  </button>
                  <button type="button" onClick={dismissTour} className={buttonStyles({ variant: "secondary" })}>
                    Explore on my own
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <>
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
                  <div>
                    <div className="demo-tour-callout__badge">{`Stop ${activeIndex + 1} of ${steps.length}`}</div>
                    <h2 className="mt-3 text-[1.55rem] font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-950 sm:text-[1.75rem]">{activeStep.title}</h2>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={dismissTour}
                    className="rounded-full border border-slate-200/90 bg-white/75 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-500 transition-all duration-300 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1)] hover:border-slate-300 hover:bg-white hover:text-slate-700"
                  >
                    Hide
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-5">
                  <div className="flex gap-2">
                    {steps.map((step, index) => (
                      <div
                        key={`${step.routeId}-${step.selector}`}
                        className={
                          index === activeIndex
                            ? "demo-tour-progress demo-tour-progress-active"
                            : index < activeIndex
                              ? "demo-tour-progress demo-tour-progress-done"
                              : "demo-tour-progress"
                        }
                      />
                    ))}
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-3 h-[2px] overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-slate-200/90">
                    <div className="demo-tour-progress-bar" style={{ width: `${((activeIndex + 1) / steps.length) * 100}%` }} />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <p className="mt-4 text-[14px] leading-7 text-slate-600">{activeStep.description}</p>
                <div className="mt-4 rounded-[1.15rem] border border-sky-200/90 bg-sky-50/95 px-4 py-4 text-sm leading-7 text-sky-900 shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.92)]">
                  {activeStep.action}
                </div>

                <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <div className="text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-slate-500">
                    {activeIndex + 1} / {steps.length}
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    {previousStep ? (
                      <button type="button" onClick={() => goToStep(activeIndex - 1)} className={buttonStyles({ variant: "secondary" })}>
                        Back
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        disabled
                        aria-hidden="true"
                        className={cn(buttonStyles({ variant: "secondary" }), "pointer-events-none opacity-0")}
                      >
                        Back
                      </button>
                    )}
                    {nextStep ? (
                      <button type="button" onClick={() => goToStep(activeIndex + 1)} className={buttonStyles({ variant: "primary" })}>
                        {activeStep.continueLabel ?? "Continue ->"}
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setComplete(true)}
                        className={cn(
                          buttonStyles({ variant: "primary" }),
                          "bg-[linear-gradient(135deg,#15966d,#13845f)] hover:shadow-[0_18px_36px_rgba(21,150,109,0.22)]"
                        )}
                      >
                        {activeStep.continueLabel ?? "Finish tour"}
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </>
            )}
            </motion.aside>
          </motion.div>
        ) : null}
      </AnimatePresence>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {enabled && dismissed ? (
          <motion.button
            key="demo-tour-resume"
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
                window.localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_DISMISSED_KEY);
              }
              setDismissed(false);
              setComplete(false);
            }}
            className="fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-50 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-slate-200/90 bg-white/92 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 shadow-[0_12px_28px_rgba(15,23,42,0.12)] backdrop-blur-md transition-all duration-300 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1)] hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:bg-white"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 14, scale: 0.96 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 10, scale: 0.98 }}
            transition={calloutTransition}
          >
            <span aria-hidden="true">{"\u25B6"}</span>
            Resume tour
          </motion.button>
        ) : null}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </>
  );
}


--- src\components\finals-results-table.tsx ---

"use client";

import type { CSSProperties } from "react";
import { formatFinalPoints, type FinalsLeaderboardEntry } from "@/lib/scoring";

function FinalsResultCell({
  top,
  zone,
  attemptsToTop,
  attemptsToZone,
}: {
  top: boolean;
  zone: boolean;
  attemptsToTop: number | null;
  attemptsToZone: number | null;
}) {
  if (!top && !zone) {
    return <div className="finals-problem-box finals-problem-box-empty">-</div>;
  }

  if (top) {
    return (
      <div className="finals-problem-box finals-problem-box-top">
        <div className="finals-problem-box__top-attempt">{attemptsToTop ?? 1}</div>
        <div className="finals-problem-box__zone-attempt">{attemptsToZone ?? attemptsToTop ?? 1}</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="finals-problem-box finals-problem-box-zone-only">
      <div className="finals-problem-box__zone-band">
        <div className="finals-problem-box__zone-attempt">{attemptsToZone ?? 1}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function metricClassName(value: number) {
  return value === 0 ? "finals-metric finals-metric-dim" : "finals-metric finals-metric-strong";
}

export default function FinalsResultsTable({
  title,
  rows,
}: {
  title: string;
  rows: FinalsLeaderboardEntry[];
}) {
  const problemCount = Math.max(1, ...rows.map((entry) => entry.problem_results.length), 4);
  const mobileProblemGridStyle: CSSProperties = {
    gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${problemCount}, minmax(0, 1fr))`,
  };
  const desktopGridStyle: CSSProperties = {
    gridTemplateColumns: `0.7fr 2.3fr 1fr repeat(${problemCount}, 0.8fr) 1fr 0.7fr 0.7fr 0.8fr 0.8fr`,
  };
  const desktopTableMinWidth = `${760 + problemCount * 76}px`;

  return (
    <section className="results-card">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="results-kicker">Finals rankings</div>
          <h2 className="results-editorial-title mt-2 break-words text-3xl font-semibold text-slate-950 sm:text-4xl">{title}</h2>
        </div>
        <div className="results-chip">2025 IFSC points</div>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-5 space-y-3 md:hidden">
        {rows.map((entry) => (
          <div key={entry.climber_id} className="results-meta-card min-w-0">
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <div className="results-kicker">Rank #{entry.category_rank}</div>
                <div className="mt-2 break-words text-xl font-semibold text-slate-950">{entry.name}</div>
                <div className="mt-1 break-words text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
                  {entry.province} | Qualifier #{entry.previous_round_rank}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-right">
                <div className="results-kicker">Points</div>
                <div className={metricClassName(entry.total_points)}>{formatFinalPoints(entry.total_points)}</div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-4 grid gap-2" style={mobileProblemGridStyle}>
              {entry.problem_results.map((problem) => (
                <div key={problem.climb_number} className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="text-center text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-500">
                    B{problem.climb_number}
                  </div>
                  <FinalsResultCell
                    top={problem.top}
                    zone={problem.zone}
                    attemptsToTop={problem.attempts_to_top}
                    attemptsToZone={problem.attempts_to_zone}
                  />
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-sm text-slate-600">
              <div><span className="font-semibold text-slate-950">{entry.tops}</span> tops</div>
              <div><span className="font-semibold text-slate-950">{entry.zones}</span> zones</div>
              <div><span className="font-semibold text-slate-950">{entry.attempts_to_top}</span> attempts to top</div>
              <div><span className="font-semibold text-slate-950">{entry.attempts_to_zone}</span> attempts to zone</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="results-data-scroll mt-5 hidden md:block">
        <div className="results-table-scroll-hint">
          <span>Score column shows finals points.</span>
          <span>Scroll sideways for the full finals table.</span>
        </div>
        <div className="finals-table-shell" style={{ minWidth: desktopTableMinWidth }}>
          <div className="grid finals-table-header" style={desktopGridStyle}>
            <div>#</div>
            <div>Athlete</div>
            <div>Prov</div>
            {Array.from({ length: problemCount }, (_, index) => (
              <div key={`header-problem-${index + 1}`}>{index + 1}</div>
            ))}
            <div>Points</div>
            <div>T</div>
            <div>Z</div>
            <div>A.T</div>
            <div>A.Z</div>
          </div>

          <div className="divide-y divide-black/10">
            {rows.map((entry) => (
              <div key={entry.climber_id} className="grid finals-table-row items-center" style={desktopGridStyle}>
                <div className="finals-rank">{entry.category_rank}</div>
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <div className="finals-athlete-name break-words">{entry.name}</div>
                  <div className="finals-athlete-subline">
                    Qualifier #{entry.previous_round_rank}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="finals-province">{entry.province}</div>
                {entry.problem_results.map((problem) => (
                  <FinalsResultCell
                    key={problem.climb_number}
                    top={problem.top}
                    zone={problem.zone}
                    attemptsToTop={problem.attempts_to_top}
                    attemptsToZone={problem.attempts_to_zone}
                  />
                ))}
                <div className={metricClassName(entry.total_points)}>{formatFinalPoints(entry.total_points)}</div>
                <div className={metricClassName(entry.tops)}>{entry.tops}</div>
                <div className={metricClassName(entry.zones)}>{entry.zones}</div>
                <div className={metricClassName(entry.attempts_to_top)}>{entry.attempts_to_top}</div>
                <div className={metricClassName(entry.attempts_to_zone)}>{entry.attempts_to_zone}</div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}


--- src\components\judge\athlete-picker.tsx ---

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/empty-state";
import { Surface } from "@/components/ui/surface";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

export type AthletePickerStatusTone = "pending" | "dirty" | "zone" | "top" | "saved";

export type AthletePickerEntry = {
  id: string;
  climberNumber: string;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  statusLabel: string;
  resultLabel: string;
  statusTone: AthletePickerStatusTone;
};

type AthletePickerProps = {
  activeRoundName: string;
  athletes: AthletePickerEntry[];
  problemCount: number;
  query: string;
  savedCount: number;
  selectedAthleteId: string | null;
  selectedBoulder: number;
  totalCount: number;
  onQueryChange: (value: string) => void;
  onSelectAthlete: (athleteId: string) => void;
  onSelectBoulder: (boulder: number) => void;
};

const statusStyles: Record<AthletePickerStatusTone, string> = {
  pending: "border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-slate-600",
  dirty: "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-700",
  zone: "border-amber-300 bg-amber-100 text-amber-900",
  top: "border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-900",
  saved: "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700",
};

export function AthletePicker({
  activeRoundName,
  athletes,
  problemCount,
  query,
  savedCount,
  selectedAthleteId,
  selectedBoulder,
  totalCount,
  onQueryChange,
  onSelectAthlete,
  onSelectBoulder,
}: AthletePickerProps) {
  return (
    <Surface density="judge" variant="panel" className="space-y-4">
      <div>
        <div className="results-kicker">{activeRoundName} controls</div>
        <div className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold text-slate-950">
          Boulder {String(selectedBoulder).padStart(2, "0")}
        </div>
        <div className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">
          {savedCount} of {totalCount} climbers have an entry here.
        </div>
      </div>

      <label className="block">
        <span className="sr-only">Search athletes</span>
        <input
          value={query}
          onChange={(event) => onQueryChange(event.target.value)}
          className="results-input min-h-14 text-base"
          placeholder="Search number, name, category"
          inputMode="search"
        />
      </label>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-4" aria-label="Select boulder">
        {Array.from({ length: problemCount }, (_, index) => index + 1).map((climbNumber) => (
          <Button
            key={climbNumber}
            size="touch"
            variant={selectedBoulder === climbNumber ? "primary" : "secondary"}
            className="min-w-0 px-3 text-base"
            aria-pressed={selectedBoulder === climbNumber}
            onClick={() => onSelectBoulder(climbNumber)}
          >
            B{String(climbNumber).padStart(2, "0")}
          </Button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-2">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="results-kicker">Athlete picker</div>
          <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500">{athletes.length} shown</div>
        </div>
        <div className="max-h-[36rem] space-y-2 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
          {athletes.map((athlete) => {
            const selected = athlete.id === selectedAthleteId;
            return (
              <button
                key={athlete.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onSelectAthlete(athlete.id)}
                className={cn(
                  "w-full rounded-[1.2rem] border px-4 py-3 text-left transition focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-sky-500/40 focus-visible:ring-offset-2",
                  selected
                    ? "border-sky-300 bg-sky-50 shadow-[0_12px_28px_rgba(14,116,215,0.12)]"
                    : "border-slate-200 bg-white/85 hover:border-slate-300 hover:bg-white"
                )}
                aria-pressed={selected}
              >
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <div className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-500">
                      #{athlete.climberNumber}
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-1 truncate text-lg font-bold text-slate-950">{athlete.name}</div>
                    <div className="mt-1 truncate text-sm text-slate-600">{athlete.category}</div>
                  </div>
                  <div className={cn("shrink-0 rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold", statusStyles[athlete.statusTone])}>
                    {athlete.statusLabel}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="mt-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-600">{athlete.resultLabel}</div>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        {!athletes.length ? (
          <EmptyState
            eyebrow="No match"
            title="No athletes match that search"
            description="Try a climber number, first name, last name, or category."
            className="bg-white/80"
          />
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </Surface>
  );
}

--- src\components\pwa-provider.tsx ---

"use client";

import Image from "next/image";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

type BeforeInstallPromptEvent = Event & {
  prompt: () => Promise<void>;
  userChoice: Promise<{ outcome: "accepted" | "dismissed"; platform: string }>;
};

const INSTALL_DISMISSED_KEY = "summit-series-install-dismissed";

export default function PwaProvider() {
  const [deferredPrompt, setDeferredPrompt] = useState<BeforeInstallPromptEvent | null>(null);
  const [installed, setInstalled] = useState(false);
  const [dismissed, setDismissed] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!("serviceWorker" in navigator)) {
      return;
    }

    const hostname = window.location.hostname;
    if (
      process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production" ||
      hostname === "localhost" ||
      hostname === "127.0.0.1" ||
      hostname === "::1"
    ) {
      return;
    }

    navigator.serviceWorker.register("/sw.js").catch((error) => {
      console.error("Service worker registration failed:", error);
    });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
    setDismissed(window.localStorage.getItem(INSTALL_DISMISSED_KEY) === "true");
    setInstalled(window.matchMedia("(display-mode: standalone)").matches);

    const onBeforeInstallPrompt = (event: Event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      setDeferredPrompt(event as BeforeInstallPromptEvent);
    };

    const onInstalled = () => {
      setInstalled(true);
      setDeferredPrompt(null);
      setDismissed(false);
      window.localStorage.removeItem(INSTALL_DISMISSED_KEY);
    };

    window.addEventListener("beforeinstallprompt", onBeforeInstallPrompt);
    window.addEventListener("appinstalled", onInstalled);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("beforeinstallprompt", onBeforeInstallPrompt);
      window.removeEventListener("appinstalled", onInstalled);
    };
  }, []);

  const dismissBanner = () => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      window.localStorage.setItem(INSTALL_DISMISSED_KEY, "true");
    }
    setDismissed(true);
  };

  const installApp = async () => {
    if (!deferredPrompt) return;
    await deferredPrompt.prompt();
    const outcome = await deferredPrompt.userChoice;
    if (outcome.outcome === "accepted") {
      setInstalled(true);
    }
    setDeferredPrompt(null);
  };

  if (!deferredPrompt || installed || dismissed) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div className="install-banner">
      <div className="install-banner__backdrop" onClick={dismissBanner} aria-hidden="true" />
      <div className="install-banner__content" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="install-banner-title">
        <div className="install-banner__lead">
          <div className="install-banner__badge" aria-hidden="true">
            <Image src="/brand-logo.png" alt="" width={72} height={72} className="install-banner__badge-image" />
          </div>
          <div className="flex-1">
            <div className="meta-label text-fbc-yellow">Install Summit Series</div>
            <h2 id="install-banner-title" className="install-banner__title">Launch it like a real gym tool</h2>
            <p className="install-banner__copy">
              Add Summit Series to your home screen for faster judge access, cleaner full-screen use,
              and better reliability in spotty reception.
            </p>
            <div className="install-banner__benefits">
              <span className="install-banner__benefit">Full screen</span>
              <span className="install-banner__benefit">Faster launch</span>
              <span className="install-banner__benefit">Better offline feel</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="install-banner__actions">
          <button onClick={dismissBanner} className="btn-ghost install-banner__dismiss">
            Not now
          </button>
          <button onClick={() => void installApp()} className="btn-primary install-banner__install">
            Install
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


--- src\components\site-header.tsx ---

"use client";

import Image from "next/image";
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { buildCompetitionPath, buildDisplayPath } from "@/lib/scoring";
import { readScorecardAccess } from "@/lib/scorecard-access";
import { buttonStyles } from "@/components/ui/button";

interface NavItem {
  href: string;
  label: string;
}

export default function SiteHeader({
  status,
  competitionSlug,
  light = false,
  navItems,
}: {
  status?: ReactNode;
  competitionSlug?: string;
  light?: boolean;
  navItems?: NavItem[];
}) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [scorecardHref, setScorecardHref] = useState(
    competitionSlug ? buildCompetitionPath(competitionSlug, "scorecard") : "/"
  );
  const [hasSavedScorecard, setHasSavedScorecard] = useState(false);

  const resolvedNavItems = useMemo(() => {
    if (navItems) {
      return navItems;
    }

    if (!competitionSlug) {
      return [];
    }

    return [
      { href: buildCompetitionPath(competitionSlug), label: "Overview" },
      { href: buildCompetitionPath(competitionSlug, "register"), label: "Register" },
      { href: buildCompetitionPath(competitionSlug, "scorecard"), label: "Scorecard" },
      { href: buildCompetitionPath(competitionSlug, "leaderboard"), label: "Rankings" },
      { href: buildDisplayPath(competitionSlug), label: "Display" },
    ];
  }, [competitionSlug, navItems]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const access = readScorecardAccess(competitionSlug);
    if (competitionSlug && access?.competitionSlug === competitionSlug) {
      setScorecardHref(buildCompetitionPath(competitionSlug, "scorecard"));
      setHasSavedScorecard(true);
      return;
    }

    if (competitionSlug) {
      setScorecardHref(buildCompetitionPath(competitionSlug, "scorecard"));
      setHasSavedScorecard(false);
      return;
    }

    setScorecardHref("/");
    setHasSavedScorecard(false);
  }, [competitionSlug, pathname]);

  const normalizedScorecardPath = scorecardHref.split("#")[0]?.split("?")[0] || "/";
  const showMobileScorecardTray =
    Boolean(competitionSlug) && hasSavedScorecard && pathname !== normalizedScorecardPath;

  return (
    <>
      <header className={`app-header ${light ? "app-header-light" : ""}`}>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 text-left lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
          <Link href="/" className="results-brand-lockup max-w-full">
            <div className={`results-brand-mark ${light ? "" : "border-white/20"}`}>
              <Image src="/brand-logo.png" alt="Summit Series logo" width={72} height={72} className="results-brand-logo" />
            </div>
            <div className="results-brand-wordmark">
              <div className={`results-brand-title ${light ? "text-slate-500" : "text-slate-200"}`}>Summit Series</div>
              <div className={`results-brand-subtitle ${light ? "text-slate-900" : "text-chalk"}`}>Competition Results</div>
            </div>
          </Link>

          <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-3 lg:items-end">
            {resolvedNavItems.length ? (
              <nav className={`nav-scroll ${competitionSlug || navItems ? "lg:justify-end" : "sm:justify-start lg:justify-end"}`}>
                {resolvedNavItems.map((item) => {
                  const href = item.label === "Scorecard" ? scorecardHref : item.href;
                  const activeHref = (item.label === "Scorecard" ? scorecardHref : item.href).split("#")[0] || "/";
                  const isActive =
                    activeHref === "/"
                      ? pathname === "/"
                      : pathname === activeHref || pathname?.startsWith(`${activeHref}/`);

                  return (
                    <Link
                      key={item.href}
                      href={href}
                      className={`nav-pill shrink-0 ${isActive ? "nav-pill-active" : ""} ${light ? "nav-pill-light" : ""}`}
                    >
                      {item.label === "Scorecard" && hasSavedScorecard ? "My Scorecard" : item.label}
                    </Link>
                  );
                })}
              </nav>
            ) : null}

            {status ? <div className="flex w-full flex-wrap items-center justify-start gap-2 lg:justify-end">{status}</div> : null}
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      {showMobileScorecardTray ? (
        <div className="sticky-active-bar md:hidden">
          <div className="sticky-active-bar__content">
            <div className="text-center">
              <div className="meta-label text-slate-300">Quick Access</div>
              <div className="mt-2 text-lg font-semibold text-white">My Scorecard</div>
              <div className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-300">
                Jump back into your saved scorecard for this event.
              </div>
            </div>
            <Link href={scorecardHref} className={buttonStyles({ variant: "primary", fullWidth: true })}>
              Open My Scorecard
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}

  buildCompetitionPath,
  buildDisplayPath,
  buildStaffCompetitionPath,
} from "@/lib/scoring";

export default function StaffCompetitionSubnav({ competitionSlug }: { competitionSlug: string }) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const items = [
    { href: buildStaffCompetitionPath(competitionSlug), label: "Admin" },
    { href: buildStaffCompetitionPath(competitionSlug, "judge"), label: "Judge" },
    { href: buildStaffCompetitionPath(competitionSlug, "preflight"), label: "Preflight" },
    { href: buildCompetitionPath(competitionSlug), label: "Public" },
    { href: buildDisplayPath(competitionSlug), label: "Display" },
  ];

  return (
    <nav className="results-workspace-card py-3">
      <div className="nav-scroll">
        {items.map((item) => {
          const isActive =
            pathname === item.href || pathname?.startsWith(`${item.href}/`);

          return (
            <Link
              key={item.href}
              href={item.href}
              className={`nav-pill nav-pill-light ${isActive ? "nav-pill-active" : ""}`}
            >
              {item.label}
            </Link>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </nav>
  );
}

function cloneCompetition(competition: Competition): Competition {
  return {
    ...competition,
    categories: competition.categories.map((category) => ({ ...category })),
    schedule_blocks: competition.schedule_blocks.map((block) => ({
      ...block,
      eligible_category_ids: [...block.eligible_category_ids],
    })),
    rounds: (competition.rounds ?? []).map((round) => ({
      ...round,
      eligible_category_ids: [...round.eligible_category_ids],
      scoring_config: { ...round.scoring_config },
    })),
  };
}

function toggleAgeGroup(current: string[], ageGroup: string) {
  if (current.includes(ageGroup)) {
    return current.filter((entry) => entry !== ageGroup);
  }

  return [...current, ageGroup];
}

function createScheduleBlockId() {
  if (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && typeof crypto.randomUUID === "function") {
    return crypto.randomUUID();
  }

  return `schedule-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
}

function createRoundTemplate(
  competition: Pick<Competition, "id" | "format" | "total_climbs" | "qualifier_counting_climbs" | "finals_cutoff" | "finals_problem_count">,
  roundType: CompetitionRoundType,
  sortOrder: number
): CompetitionRound {
  const scoringBucket = getRoundDefaultScoringBucket(roundType);
  return {
    id: createCompetitionRoundId(),
    competition_id: competition.id,
    round_number: sortOrder,
    sort_order: sortOrder,
    name: getRoundLabel(roundType, sortOrder - 1),
    round_type: roundType,
    format: roundType === "finals" ? "ifsc_finals_format" : competition.format,
    status: "pending",
    runtime_phase: getRoundRuntimePhase(roundType),
    is_enabled: true,
    is_active: scoringBucket === "qualifier",
    activated_at: null,
    problem_count: roundType === "finals" ? competition.finals_problem_count : competition.total_climbs,
    counting_climbs: roundType === "finals" ? null : competition.qualifier_counting_climbs,
    finals_cutoff: roundType === "semifinal" ? null : competition.finals_cutoff,
    eligible_category_ids: [],
    advancement_source_round_id: null,
    advancement_cutoff: roundType === "finals" ? competition.finals_cutoff : null,
    scoring_bucket: scoringBucket,
    scoring_config: {},
    started_at: null,
    closed_at: null,
  };
}

function buildRoundPlanTemplate(competition: Pick<Competition, "id" | "format" | "has_finals" | "total_climbs" | "qualifier_counting_climbs" | "finals_cutoff" | "finals_problem_count">) {
  const rounds = [createRoundTemplate(competition, "qualifier", 1)];
  if (competitionHasFinals(competition)) {
    const finalsRound = createRoundTemplate(competition, "finals", rounds.length + 1);
    finalsRound.advancement_source_round_id = rounds[0].id;
    rounds.push(finalsRound);
  }

  return rounds;
}

function summarizeRoundPlan(rounds: CompetitionRound[]) {
  return rounds.map((round) => `${round.round_type}:${round.scoring_bucket}:${round.problem_count}:${round.format}`).join("|");
}

function sanitizeDraftText(value: string | null | undefined) {
  const trimmed = value?.trim() ?? "";
  if (!trimmed || trimmed === "undefined" || trimmed === "null") {
    return "";
  }

  return trimmed;
}

function sanitizeDraftNullable(value: string | null | undefined) {
  const trimmed = sanitizeDraftText(value);
  return trimmed || null;
}

function formatDateTimeLocalInput(value: string | null | undefined) {
  const trimmed = sanitizeDraftText(value);
  if (!trimmed) {
    return "";
  }

  const date = new Date(trimmed);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    return "";
  }

  const localDate = new Date(date.getTime() - date.getTimezoneOffset() * 60_000);
  return localDate.toISOString().slice(0, 16);
}

function parseDateTimeLocalInput(value: string) {
  const trimmed = value.trim();
  if (!trimmed) {
    return null;
  }

  const date = new Date(trimmed);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    return null;
  }

  return date.toISOString();
}

function formatAgeGroupBandLabel(ageGroups: readonly string[]) {
  return ageGroups.join(" / ");
}

function sortAgeGroups(ageGroups: readonly string[]) {
  const ageGroupOrder = CATEGORY_AGE_GROUPS as readonly string[];
  return [...ageGroups].sort((left, right) => ageGroupOrder.indexOf(left) - ageGroupOrder.indexOf(right));
}

function getWaveLabel(ageGroups: readonly string[], competition: Competition) {
  return `${formatAgeGroupBandLabel(sortAgeGroups(ageGroups))} ${getRegistrationAssignmentLabel(competition)}`;
}

function getWaveAudienceLabel(ageGroups: readonly string[]) {
  return formatAgeGroupBandLabel(sortAgeGroups(ageGroups));
}

function getCompactWaveLabel(ageGroups: readonly string[], competition: Competition) {
  const sortedAgeGroups = sortAgeGroups(ageGroups);
  const assignmentLabel = getRegistrationAssignmentLabel(competition);
  const eligibleAgeGroups = sortAgeGroups(
    QUALIFIER_TEMPLATE_AGE_GROUPS.filter((ageGroup) => competition.qualifier_eligible_age_groups.includes(ageGroup))
  );

  if (
    eligibleAgeGroups.length > 0 &&
    sortedAgeGroups.length === eligibleAgeGroups.length &&
    sortedAgeGroups.every((ageGroup, index) => ageGroup === eligibleAgeGroups[index])
  ) {
    return `All Categories ${assignmentLabel}`;
  }

  if (sortedAgeGroups.length <= 2) {
    return getWaveLabel(sortedAgeGroups, competition);
  }

  return `${sortedAgeGroups[0]} + ${sortedAgeGroups.length - 1} more ${assignmentLabel}`;
}

function reindexScheduleBlocks(blocks: CompetitionScheduleBlock[]) {
  return blocks.map((block, index) => ({
    ...block,
    sort_order: index,
  }));
}

function getWaveAgeGroupsFromCategoryIds(
  categoryIds: readonly string[],
  qualifierCategories: Competition["categories"]
) {
  return sortAgeGroups(
    qualifierCategories
      .filter((category) => categoryIds.includes(category.id))
      .map((category) => category.age_group)
      .filter((ageGroup, index, current) => current.indexOf(ageGroup) === index)
  );
}

  return [
    { label: "Check-in", phase_type: "check_in", audience_label: "All athletes", capacity: competition.max_climbers },

function getDefaultRoundIdForSchedulePhase(
  competition: Pick<Competition, "rounds">,
  phaseType: SchedulePhaseType,
  roundType?: CompetitionRoundType
) {
  if (roundType) {
    const exactRound = competition.rounds?.find((round) => round.round_type === roundType);
    if (exactRound) {
      return exactRound.id;
    }
  }

  if (phaseType === "qualifier_round") {
    return competition.rounds?.find((round) => round.scoring_bucket === "qualifier")?.id ?? null;
  }

  if (phaseType === "finals_round" || phaseType === "isolation" || phaseType === "observation") {
    return competition.rounds?.find((round) => round.scoring_bucket === "finals")?.id ?? null;
  }

  return null;
}

function createScheduleBlockFromTemplate(
  competition: Competition,
  template: ScheduleBlockTemplate,
  qualifierCategories: Competition["categories"],
  index: number
): CompetitionScheduleBlock {
  const linkedRoundId = getDefaultRoundIdForSchedulePhase(competition, template.phase_type, template.round_type);
  const eligibleCategoryIds =
    template.phase_type === "qualifier_round" || template.phase_type === "custom"
      ? template.eligible_age_groups?.length
        ? qualifierCategories
            .filter((category) => template.eligible_age_groups?.includes(category.age_group))
            .map((category) => category.id)
        : qualifierCategories.map((category) => category.id)
      : [];

  return {
    id: createScheduleBlockId(),
    competition_id: competition.id,
    round_id: linkedRoundId,
    sort_order: index,
    label: template.label,
    phase_type: template.phase_type,
    audience_label: template.audience_label,
    is_active: index === 0,
    start_time: "",
    end_time: "",
    capacity: template.capacity ?? competition.max_climbers,
    eligible_category_ids: eligibleCategoryIds,
  };
}

function buildGuidedQualifierSessionTemplates(competition: Competition): ScheduleBlockTemplate[] {
  const eligibleAgeGroups = QUALIFIER_TEMPLATE_AGE_GROUPS.filter((ageGroup) =>
    competition.qualifier_eligible_age_groups.includes(ageGroup)
  );

  if (eligibleAgeGroups.length) {
    return eligibleAgeGroups.map((ageGroup) => ({
      label: `${ageGroup} ${getRegistrationAssignmentLabel(competition)}`,
      phase_type: "qualifier_round" as const,
      round_type: "qualifier" as const,
      audience_label: ageGroup,
      capacity: competition.max_climbers,
      eligible_age_groups: [ageGroup],
    }));
  }

  const assignmentLabel = getRegistrationAssignmentLabel(competition);
  return formatUsesSelfScoredQualifiers(competition.format)
    ? [
        {
          label: `${assignmentLabel} 1`,
          phase_type: "qualifier_round" as const,
          round_type: "qualifier" as const,
          audience_label: "Scramble window",
          capacity: competition.max_climbers,
        },
        {
          label: `${assignmentLabel} 2`,
          phase_type: "qualifier_round" as const,
          round_type: "qualifier" as const,
          audience_label: "Scramble window",
          capacity: competition.max_climbers,
        },
      ]
    : [
        {
          label: `${assignmentLabel} A`,
          phase_type: "qualifier_round" as const,
          round_type: "qualifier" as const,
          audience_label: "Qualifier wave",
          capacity: competition.max_climbers,
        },
        {
          label: `${assignmentLabel} B`,
          phase_type: "qualifier_round" as const,
          round_type: "qualifier" as const,
          audience_label: "Qualifier wave",
          capacity: competition.max_climbers,
        },
      ];
}

        const preferredDemoSummary =
          demoMode && demoSessionCompetitionId
            ? summaries.find((entry) => entry.competition.id === demoSessionCompetitionId) ?? null
            : null;
        if (demoMode) {
          return initialMatch?.competition.id ?? preferredDemoSummary?.competition.id ?? "";
        }

        return initialMatch?.competition.id ?? summaries[0]?.competition.id ?? "";
      });
      setError("");
    } catch (nextError) {
      setError(nextError instanceof Error ? nextError.message : "Unable to load the staff dashboard.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [demoMode, demoSessionCompetitionId, initialCompetitionSlug]);

    const importedOfficialRegistrationUrl = sanitizeExternalUrl(initialCreateDraft?.officialRegistrationUrl);
    const importedOfficialScheduleUrl = sanitizeExternalUrl(initialCreateDraft?.officialScheduleUrl);
    const importedHeroImageUrl = sanitizeExternalUrl(initialCreateDraft?.heroImageUrl);
    const importedDisciplineLabel = sanitizeDraftText(initialCreateDraft?.disciplineLabel);
    const importedFormat = sanitizeDraftText(initialCreateDraft?.format);

      !importedName &&
      !importedLocation &&
      !importedStartDate &&
      !importedEndDate &&
      !importedDescription &&
      !importedOfficialEventUrl &&
      !importedOfficialRegistrationUrl &&
      !importedOfficialScheduleUrl &&
      !importedHeroImageUrl &&
      !importedDisciplineLabel &&

    setCreateRegistrationClosesAt(importedRegistrationClosesAt);

    setCreateOfficialRegistrationUrl(importedOfficialRegistrationUrl);

  }, [initialCreateDraft]);

  const selectedSummary = useMemo(
    () => visibleSummaries.find((entry) => entry.competition.id === selectedCompetitionId) ?? null,

  );
  const selectedGuidedSetupPreset =
    GUIDED_SETUP_PRESETS.find((preset) => preset.id === selectedGuidedSetupPresetId) ?? null;
  const orderedDraftScheduleBlocks = useMemo(
    () => (draft ? [...draft.schedule_blocks].sort(compareScheduleBlocks) : []),
    [draft]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
