function createId() {
  return crypto.randomUUID();
}

function createAccessToken(seed: string) {
  return `demo-${seed.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")}-${crypto.randomUUID().replace(/-/g, "").slice(0, 10)}`;
}

function formatDate(value: Date) {
  return value.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

function minutesToLabel(totalMinutes: number) {
  const hours = Math.floor(totalMinutes / 60);
  const minutes = totalMinutes % 60;
  const suffix = hours >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM";
  const twelveHour = ((hours + 11) % 12) + 1;
  return `${twelveHour}:${minutes.toString().padStart(2, "0")} ${suffix}`;
}

function buildAttemptTemplate(seedIndex: number, climbNumber: number) {
  const variant = (seedIndex + climbNumber) % 5;

  switch (variant) {
    case 0:
      return { attempt_count: 1, zone: true, topped: true, attempts_to_top: 1, attempts_to_zone: 1 };
    case 1:
      return { attempt_count: 2, zone: true, topped: true, attempts_to_top: 2, attempts_to_zone: 2 };
    case 2:
      return { attempt_count: 2, zone: true, topped: false, attempts_to_top: null, attempts_to_zone: 2 };
    case 3:
      return { attempt_count: 3, zone: true, topped: false, attempts_to_top: null, attempts_to_zone: 3 };
    default:
      return { attempt_count: 4, zone: false, topped: false, attempts_to_top: null, attempts_to_zone: null };
  }
}

async function requireNoSupabaseError<T extends { error: { message: string } | null }>(result: T, fallback: string) {
  if (result.error) {
    throw new Error(result.error.message || fallback);
  }
}

function stripOptionalCompetitionLinkColumns<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(payload: T) {
  const next = { ...payload };
  OPTIONAL_COMPETITION_LINK_COLUMNS.forEach((column) => {
    delete next[column];
  });
  return next;
}

function isMissingCompetitionLinkColumnError(error: { message?: string } | null | undefined) {
  const message = error?.message?.toLowerCase() ?? "";
  return OPTIONAL_COMPETITION_LINK_COLUMNS.some((column) => message.includes(column));
}

function stripOptionalQueueColumns<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(payload: T) {
  const next = { ...payload };
  OPTIONAL_QUEUE_COLUMNS.forEach((column) => {
    delete next[column];
  });
  return next;
}

function isMissingQueueColumnError(error: { message?: string } | null | undefined) {
  const message = error?.message?.toLowerCase() ?? "";
  return OPTIONAL_QUEUE_COLUMNS.some((column) => message.includes(column));
}

export async function resetDemoCompetition() {
  const supabase = createServiceRoleSupabaseClient();
  const now = new Date();
  const startDate = formatDate(now);
  const registrationOpensAt = new Date(now.getTime() - 14 * DAY_MS).toISOString();
  const registrationClosesAt = new Date(now.getTime() + DAY_MS).toISOString();
  const competitionId = createId();
  const qualifierRoundId = createId();
  const finalsRoundId = createId();

  const existingDemoRows = await supabase
    .from("competitions")
    .select("id, is_demo, slug")
    .eq("slug", DEMO_COMPETITION_SLUG);
  await requireNoSupabaseError(existingDemoRows, "Unable to load the existing demo competition.");

  const existingRows = existingDemoRows.data ?? [];
  const nonDemoConflict = existingRows.find((row) => row.slug === DEMO_COMPETITION_SLUG && row.is_demo !== true);
  if (nonDemoConflict) {
    throw new Error("A real competition already uses the canonical demo slug. Refusing to overwrite it.");
  }

  const existingDemoIds = existingRows.filter((row) => row.is_demo === true).map((row) => row.id as string);
  if (existingDemoIds.length) {
    const deleteResult = await supabase.from("competitions").delete().in("id", existingDemoIds);
    await requireNoSupabaseError(deleteResult, "Unable to clear the existing demo competition.");
  }

  const initialDemoMetadata = {
    scenario_version: "demo-story-v1",
    preset_id: YOUTH_CHAMPIONSHIP_PRESET.id,
    preset_name: YOUTH_CHAMPIONSHIP_PRESET.name,
    story_step: "event_created",
    finals_ineligible_age_groups: ["Youth D", "Youth C"],
  };

  const competitionPayload = {
    id: competitionId,
    slug: DEMO_COMPETITION_SLUG,
    name: DEMO_COMPETITION_NAME,
    is_demo: true,
    status: "active",
    format: YOUTH_CHAMPIONSHIP_PRESET.format,
    current_phase: "qualifier_open",
    discipline_label: "Boulder",
    stage_mode: "qualifier",
    location_name: DEMO_LOCATION,
    start_date: startDate,
    end_date: startDate,
    registration_opens_at: registrationOpensAt,
    registration_closes_at: registrationClosesAt,
    description:
      "Run a complete youth championship story: create the event, correct a key judge score, advance finalists, and view public results.",
    hero_image_url: "",
    official_event_url: "",
    official_registration_url: "",
    official_schedule_url: "",
    total_climbs: YOUTH_CHAMPIONSHIP_PRESET.qualifierProblemCount,
    max_climbers: DEMO_CATEGORY_SEEDS.reduce((total, entry) => total + entry.climbers.length, 0),
    qualifier_counting_climbs: YOUTH_CHAMPIONSHIP_PRESET.countingClimbs,
    has_finals: YOUTH_CHAMPIONSHIP_PRESET.finalsEnabled,
    finals_cutoff: YOUTH_CHAMPIONSHIP_PRESET.finalsCutoff,
    finals_tie_advances: YOUTH_CHAMPIONSHIP_PRESET.tiesAdvanceDefault,
    qualifier_eligible_age_groups: YOUTH_CHAMPIONSHIP_PRESET.defaultCategories,
    finals_eligible_age_groups: YOUTH_CHAMPIONSHIP_PRESET.finalsEligibleCategories,
    qualifier_locked_at: null,
    finals_started_at: null,
    finals_problem_count: YOUTH_CHAMPIONSHIP_PRESET.finalsProblemCount,
    demo_metadata: initialDemoMetadata,
  };
  let competitionInsert = await supabase.from("competitions").insert(competitionPayload);
  if (competitionInsert.error && isMissingCompetitionLinkColumnError(competitionInsert.error)) {
    competitionInsert = await supabase.from("competitions").insert(stripOptionalCompetitionLinkColumns(competitionPayload));
  }
  await requireNoSupabaseError(competitionInsert, "Unable to create the demo competition.");

  const categories = DEMO_CATEGORY_SEEDS.map((entry, index) => ({
    id: createCategoryKey(entry.division, entry.ageGroup),

  }));
  const categoryInsert = await supabase.from("competition_categories").insert(categories);
  await requireNoSupabaseError(categoryInsert, "Unable to create demo categories.");

  const rounds = [
    {
      id: qualifierRoundId,
      competition_id: competitionId,
      round_number: 1,
      sort_order: 1,
      name: "Qualifier",
      round_type: "qualifier",
      format: "five_on_five_off",
      status: "active",
      runtime_phase: "qualifier_open",
      is_enabled: true,
      is_active: true,
      activated_at: now.toISOString(),
      problem_count: YOUTH_CHAMPIONSHIP_PRESET.qualifierProblemCount,
      counting_climbs: YOUTH_CHAMPIONSHIP_PRESET.countingClimbs,
      finals_cutoff: YOUTH_CHAMPIONSHIP_PRESET.finalsCutoff,
      eligible_category_ids: categories.map((entry) => entry.id),
      advancement_source_round_id: null,
      advancement_cutoff: null,
      scoring_bucket: "qualifier",
      scoring_config: { demo: true, mode: "judge" },
      started_at: now.toISOString(),
      closed_at: null,

    {

  await requireNoSupabaseError(roundInsert, "Unable to create demo rounds.");

  const allCategoryIds = categories.map((category) => category.id);

  const qualifierWaves = [

  const scheduleBlocks: DemoScheduleBlockRow[] = [

  const qualifierBlocksByCategoryId = new Map(

      .filter((entry) => entry.phase_type === "qualifier_round")
      .map((entry) => [entry.eligible_category_ids?.[0] as string, entry.id as string])

  const climbers: DemoClimberRow[] = DEMO_CATEGORY_SEEDS.flatMap((entry) => {

        supersedes_event_id: null,

  }

  const dramaTrio = climbers
    .filter((climber) => climber.age_group === "Youth B" && climber.gender_division === "Men")
    .sort((left, right) => Number(left.climber_number) - Number(right.climber_number))
    .slice(0, 3);

  if (dramaTrio.length === 3) {
    const [athleteA, athleteB, athleteC] = dramaTrio;
    const dramaClimberIds = dramaTrio.map((climber) => climber.id);
    const deleteDramaAttempts = await supabase
      .from("qualifier_attempts")
      .delete()
      .eq("competition_id", competitionId)
      .in("climber_id", dramaClimberIds);
    await requireNoSupabaseError(deleteDramaAttempts, "Unable to reset the demo cut-line score cells.");

    const dramaAttemptRows: Array<[string, number, number, boolean, boolean, number | null, number | null]> = [
      [athleteA.id, 1, 1, true, true, 1, 1],
      [athleteA.id, 2, 1, true, true, 1, 1],

      [athleteB.id, 4, 1, true, false, null, 1],
      [athleteC.id, 1, 1, true, true, 1, 1],

      [athleteC.id, 3, 3, true, true, 3, 2],
      [athleteC.id, 4, 1, true, false, null, 1],
    ];
    const seededDramaAttempts = dramaAttemptRows.map(
      ([
        climberId,
        climbNumber,
        attemptCount,
        zone,
        topped,
        attemptsToTop,
        attemptsToZone,
      ]) => ({

      })
    );

    const dramaAttemptInsert = await supabase.from("qualifier_attempts").insert(seededDramaAttempts);
    await requireNoSupabaseError(dramaAttemptInsert, "Unable to create the demo cut-line scenario.");

    const dramaEventInsert = await supabase.from("qualifier_score_events").insert(
      seededDramaAttempts.map((attempt, index) => ({
        id: createId(),
        competition_id: attempt.competition_id,
        round_id: attempt.round_id,
        climber_id: attempt.climber_id,
        climb_number: attempt.climb_number,
        attempt_count: attempt.attempt_count,
        zone: attempt.zone,
        topped: attempt.topped,
        attempts_to_top: attempt.attempts_to_top,
        attempts_to_zone: attempt.attempts_to_zone,
        entered_by: attempt.entered_by,
        judge_device_id: "demo-story-seed",
        judge_session_id: "cut-line-scenario",
        scored_at: new Date(now.getTime() - (seededDramaAttempts.length - index) * 30_000).toISOString(),
        received_at: new Date(now.getTime() - (seededDramaAttempts.length - index) * 30_000).toISOString(),
        client_event_id: `demo-drama-seed-${attempt.climber_id}-${attempt.climb_number}`,
        replayed_from_offline: false,
        conflict_flag: false,
        conflict_reason: null,
        supersedes_event_id: null,
      }))
    );
    await requireNoSupabaseError(dramaEventInsert, "Unable to create the demo cut-line score events.");

    const dramaMetadata = buildDemoStoryMetadataForClimbers({
      baseMetadata: initialDemoMetadata,
      targetClimber: athleteC,
      affectedClimber: athleteB,
    });

    const metadataUpdate = await supabase
      .from("competitions")
      .update({ demo_metadata: dramaMetadata })
      .eq("id", competitionId)
      .eq("is_demo", true);
    await requireNoSupabaseError(metadataUpdate, "Unable to save demo story metadata.");
  }

  const activeDemoBlockId =
    scheduleBlocks.find((entry) => entry.label === DEMO_ACTIVE_BLOCK_LABEL)?.id ?? null;
  const demoQueueClimbers = climbers
    .filter((entry) => entry.age_group === "Youth B" && entry.gender_division === "Men")
    .slice(0, 3);
  if (activeDemoBlockId && demoQueueClimbers.length) {
    const queuePayload = demoQueueClimbers.map((climber, index) => ({
      id: createId(),
      competition_id: competitionId,
      climber_id: climber.id,
      schedule_block_id: activeDemoBlockId,
      climb_number: index + 2,
      checked_in_at: new Date(now.getTime() - (index + 1) * 45 * 1000).toISOString(),
      climber_name: climber.name,
      climber_number: climber.climber_number,
      display_category: climber.display_category,
      province: climber.province,
      time_slot_id: climber.time_slot_id,
    }));
    let queueInsert = await supabase.from("competition_boulder_queue").insert(queuePayload);
    if (queueInsert.error && isMissingQueueColumnError(queueInsert.error)) {
      queueInsert = await supabase
        .from("competition_boulder_queue")
        .insert(queuePayload.map((entry) => stripOptionalQueueColumns(entry)));
    }
    await requireNoSupabaseError(queueInsert, "Unable to create the demo boulder queue.");
  }

  return {
    competitionId,
    slug: DEMO_COMPETITION_SLUG,
    name: DEMO_COMPETITION_NAME,
  };
}


--- src\lib\demo-sales-session.ts ---

export type DemoSalesMode = "organizer" | "judge";

export type DemoSalesStoryStep =
  | "organizer-intro"
  | "organizer-categories"
  | "organizer-preset"
  | "organizer-schedule"
  | "organizer-stages"
  | "organizer-handoff"
  | "organizer-build"
  | "judge-save"
  | "judge-leaderboard"
  | "judge-offline"
  | "judge-sync"
  | "complete";

export type DemoSalesPhase = "organizer" | "build" | "judge" | "complete";

export type DemoSalesSession = {
  mode: DemoSalesMode;
  phase: DemoSalesPhase;
  storyStep: DemoSalesStoryStep;
  narratorTitle: string;
  narratorBody: string;
  autoplay: boolean;
  organizerCompleted: boolean;
  judgePending: boolean;
  persistentCompletion: boolean;
  audioEnabled: boolean;
  competitionId?: string | null;
  competitionSlug?: string | null;
};

const DEMO_SALES_SESSION_KEY = "demo_sales_session_v1";

function canUseSessionStorage() {
  return typeof window !== "undefined" && typeof window.sessionStorage !== "undefined";
}

export function readDemoSalesSession() {
  if (!canUseSessionStorage()) {
    return null as DemoSalesSession | null;
  }

  try {
    const raw = window.sessionStorage.getItem(DEMO_SALES_SESSION_KEY);
    if (!raw) {
      return null;
    }

    return JSON.parse(raw) as DemoSalesSession;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function writeDemoSalesSession(session: DemoSalesSession) {
  if (!canUseSessionStorage()) {
    return;
  }

  window.sessionStorage.setItem(DEMO_SALES_SESSION_KEY, JSON.stringify(session));
}

export function patchDemoSalesSession(patch: Partial<DemoSalesSession>) {
  const current = readDemoSalesSession();
  if (!current) {
    return;
  }

  writeDemoSalesSession({
    ...current,
    ...patch,
  });
}

export function clearDemoSalesSession() {
  if (!canUseSessionStorage()) {
    return;
  }

  window.sessionStorage.removeItem(DEMO_SALES_SESSION_KEY);
}

export function createDemoSalesSession(
  partial: Partial<DemoSalesSession> & Pick<DemoSalesSession, "mode" | "storyStep" | "narratorTitle" | "narratorBody">
) {
  return {
    phase: partial.mode,
    autoplay: true,
    organizerCompleted: false,
    judgePending: false,
    persistentCompletion: false,
    audioEnabled: false,
    ...partial,
  } satisfies DemoSalesSession;
}


--- src\lib\demo-story-target.ts ---

export const DEMO_STORY_TARGET_ROLE_KEY = "athlete_c";
export const DEMO_STORY_AFFECTED_ROLE_KEY = "athlete_b";
export const DEMO_STORY_TARGET_CATEGORY = {
  genderDivision: "Men",
  ageGroup: "Youth B",
  displayCategory: "Men / Youth B",
} as const;

export type DemoStoryClimberIdentity = {
  id: string;
  competition_id?: string;
  name: string;
  climber_number: string;
  gender_division?: string | null;
  age_group?: string | null;
  display_category?: string | null;
};

export type DemoStoryTargetMetadata = {
  scenario_version?: string;
  preset_id?: string;
  preset_name?: string;
  story_step?: string;
  finals_ineligible_age_groups?: string[];
  drama_pair?: string[];
  drama_target_climber?: string;
  target_climber_id?: string;
  drama_target_climber_name?: string;
  target_climber_name?: string;
  drama_target_climber_number?: string;
  target_climber_number?: string;
  drama_target_role?: string;
  target_role?: string;
  drama_target_category?: string;
  target_category?: string;
  drama_target_climb_number?: number;
  target_climb_number?: number;
  drama_target_attempts_before?: number;
  target_attempts_before?: number;
  drama_target_attempts_after?: number;
  target_attempts_after?: number;
  drama_description?: string;
  drama_affected_climber?: string;
  affected_climber_id?: string;
  drama_affected_climber_name?: string;
  affected_climber_name?: string;
  drama_affected_climber_number?: string;
  affected_climber_number?: string;
  drama_affected_role?: string;
  affected_role?: string;
  [key: string]: unknown;
};

function normalizeText(value: string | null | undefined) {
  return value?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? "";
}

function matchesTargetCategory(climber: DemoStoryClimberIdentity) {
  return (
    normalizeText(climber.gender_division) === normalizeText(DEMO_STORY_TARGET_CATEGORY.genderDivision) &&
    normalizeText(climber.age_group) === normalizeText(DEMO_STORY_TARGET_CATEGORY.ageGroup)
  );
}

export function findDemoStoryClimberFromMetadata(
  climbers: readonly DemoStoryClimberIdentity[],
  metadata: DemoStoryTargetMetadata | null | undefined,
  role: "target" | "affected" = "target"
) {
  const source = metadata ?? {};

  const id =
    role === "target"
      ? source.target_climber_id ?? source.drama_target_climber
      : source.affected_climber_id ?? source.drama_affected_climber;
  const byId = id ? climbers.find((climber) => climber.id === id) ?? null : null;
  if (byId) {
    return byId;
  }

  const number =
    role === "target"
      ? source.target_climber_number ?? source.drama_target_climber_number
      : source.affected_climber_number ?? source.drama_affected_climber_number;
  const name =
    role === "target"
      ? source.target_climber_name ?? source.drama_target_climber_name
      : source.affected_climber_name ?? source.drama_affected_climber_name;
  const roleKey =
    role === "target"
      ? source.target_role ?? source.drama_target_role ?? DEMO_STORY_TARGET_ROLE_KEY
      : source.affected_role ?? source.drama_affected_role ?? DEMO_STORY_AFFECTED_ROLE_KEY;

  const categoryMatches = climbers.filter(matchesTargetCategory);
  const scopedClimbers = categoryMatches.length ? categoryMatches : climbers;

  if (number) {
    const byNumber = scopedClimbers.find((climber) => climber.climber_number === number) ?? null;
    if (byNumber) {
      return byNumber;
    }
  }

  if (name) {
    const normalizedName = normalizeText(name);
    const byName = scopedClimbers.find((climber) => normalizeText(climber.name) === normalizedName) ?? null;
    if (byName) {
      return byName;
    }
  }

  if (roleKey === DEMO_STORY_TARGET_ROLE_KEY) {
    return [...scopedClimbers].sort((left, right) =>
      left.climber_number.localeCompare(right.climber_number, undefined, { numeric: true })
    )[2] ?? null;
  }

  if (roleKey === DEMO_STORY_AFFECTED_ROLE_KEY) {
    return [...scopedClimbers].sort((left, right) =>
      left.climber_number.localeCompare(right.climber_number, undefined, { numeric: true })
    )[1] ?? null;
  }

  return null;
}

export function buildDemoStoryMetadataForClimbers(input: {
  baseMetadata: DemoStoryTargetMetadata;
  targetClimber: DemoStoryClimberIdentity;
  affectedClimber: DemoStoryClimberIdentity;
}) {
  const { baseMetadata, targetClimber, affectedClimber } = input;

  return {
    ...baseMetadata,
    drama_pair: [affectedClimber.id, targetClimber.id],
    drama_target_climber: targetClimber.id,
    target_climber_id: targetClimber.id,
    drama_target_climber_name: targetClimber.name,
    target_climber_name: targetClimber.name,
    drama_target_climber_number: targetClimber.climber_number,
    target_climber_number: targetClimber.climber_number,
    drama_target_role: DEMO_STORY_TARGET_ROLE_KEY,
    target_role: DEMO_STORY_TARGET_ROLE_KEY,
    drama_target_category: DEMO_STORY_TARGET_CATEGORY.displayCategory,
    target_category: DEMO_STORY_TARGET_CATEGORY.displayCategory,
    drama_target_climb_number: 3,
    target_climb_number: 3,
    drama_target_attempts_before: 3,
    target_attempts_before: 3,
    drama_target_attempts_after: 1,
    target_attempts_after: 1,
    drama_description: `${targetClimber.name} tops Boulder 3 in 1 attempt instead of 3 and jumps past ${affectedClimber.name} at the finals cut line on attempts.`,
    drama_affected_climber: affectedClimber.id,
    affected_climber_id: affectedClimber.id,
    drama_affected_climber_name: affectedClimber.name,
    affected_climber_name: affectedClimber.name,
    drama_affected_climber_number: affectedClimber.climber_number,
    affected_climber_number: affectedClimber.climber_number,
    drama_affected_role: DEMO_STORY_AFFECTED_ROLE_KEY,
    affected_role: DEMO_STORY_AFFECTED_ROLE_KEY,
  } satisfies DemoStoryTargetMetadata;
}

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

function demoCompetition(
  overrides: Partial<DemoStoryCompetitionSummary> = {}
): DemoStoryCompetitionSummary {
  return {
    id: "demo-competition",
    slug: DEMO_COMPETITION_SLUG,
    name: "Demo",

    current_phase: "qualifier_open",
    qualifier_locked_at: null,

    demo_metadata: {
      scenario_version: "demo-story-v1",
      drama_target_climber: "climber-c",
      drama_target_climb_number: 3,
      drama_target_attempts_after: 1,
    },
    ...overrides,
  };
}

describe("demo story progress", () => {
  it("only treats the canonical is_demo competition as mutable", () => {
    expect(isCanonicalDemoMutableCompetition(demoCompetition())).toBe(true);
    expect(
      isCanonicalDemoMutableCompetition({
        slug: DEMO_COMPETITION_SLUG,
        is_demo: false,
      })
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(
      isCanonicalDemoMutableCompetition({
        slug: "real-youth-championship",
        is_demo: true,
      })
    ).toBe(false);
  });

  it("detects the key score correction from the normalized qualifier attempt", () => {
    const progress = deriveDemoStoryProgress({
      competition: demoCompetition(),
      targetAttempt: {
        attempt_count: 1,
        topped: true,
        zone: true,
        attempts_to_top: 1,
        attempts_to_zone: 1,
      },
      finalistCount: 0,
    });

    expect(progress.eventCreated).toBe(true);
    expect(progress.keyScoreCorrected).toBe(true);
    expect(progress.finalistsAdvanced).toBe(false);
  });

  it("does not mark the judge act complete while the seeded before-state is still present", () => {
    const progress = deriveDemoStoryProgress({
      competition: demoCompetition(),
      targetAttempt: {
        attempt_count: 3,
        topped: true,
        zone: true,
        attempts_to_top: 3,
        attempts_to_zone: 2,
      },
      finalistCount: 0,
    });

    expect(progress.eventCreated).toBe(true);
    expect(progress.keyScoreCorrected).toBe(false);
  });

  it("does not mark act 2 complete when the target climber is stale or outside the canonical demo", () => {
    const progress = deriveDemoStoryProgress({
      competition: demoCompetition(),
      targetAttempt: {
        attempt_count: 1,
        topped: true,
        zone: true,
        attempts_to_top: 1,
        attempts_to_zone: 1,
      },
      finalistCount: 0,
      targetClimberBelongsToCompetition: false,
    });

    expect(progress.eventCreated).toBe(false);
    expect(progress.keyScoreCorrected).toBe(false);
  });

  it("detects organizer/public readiness from finalists and finals phase", () => {
    const progress = deriveDemoStoryProgress({
      competition: demoCompetition({
        current_phase: "finals_open",
        finals_started_at: "2026-05-01T12:00:00.000Z",
      }),
      targetAttempt: {
        attempt_count: 1,
        topped: true,
        zone: true,
        attempts_to_top: 1,
        attempts_to_zone: 1,
      },
      finalistCount: 6,
      publicViewed: true,
    });

    expect(progress.finalistsAdvanced).toBe(true);
    expect(progress.finalsStarted).toBe(true);
    expect(progress.publicViewed).toBe(true);
  });

  it("preserves existing demo metadata when story state updates are merged", () => {
    expect(
      mergeDemoStoryMetadata(
        {
          scenario_version: "demo-story-v1",
          drama_target_climber: "climber-c",
          custom_note: "do not erase me",
        },
        {
          story_step: "score_corrected",
          key_score_corrected_at: "2026-05-01T12:00:00.000Z",
        }
      )
    ).toEqual({
      scenario_version: "demo-story-v1",
      drama_target_climber: "climber-c",
      custom_note: "do not erase me",
      story_step: "score_corrected",
      key_score_corrected_at: "2026-05-01T12:00:00.000Z",
    });
  });

  it("repairs stale target metadata from stable climber number and category fields", () => {
    const climbers = [
      {
        id: "fresh-a",
        competition_id: "new-demo",
        name: "Noah Patel",
        climber_number: "102",
        gender_division: "Men",
        age_group: "Youth B",
        display_category: "Men / Youth B",
      },
      {
        id: "fresh-b",
        competition_id: "new-demo",
        name: "Milo Fraser",
        climber_number: "103",
        gender_division: "Men",
        age_group: "Youth B",
        display_category: "Men / Youth B",
      },
      {
        id: "fresh-c",
        competition_id: "new-demo",
        name: "Maya Chen",
        climber_number: "104",
        gender_division: "Men",
        age_group: "Youth B",
        display_category: "Men / Youth B",
      },
    ];

    const repaired = findDemoStoryClimberFromMetadata(climbers, {
      drama_target_climber: "stale-climber-id",
      drama_target_climber_number: "104",
      drama_target_climber_name: "Maya Chen",
      drama_target_category: "Men / Youth B",
    });

    expect(repaired?.id).toBe("fresh-c");
  });

  it("builds reset metadata with a target climber id from the newly-created demo field", () => {
    const targetClimber = {
      id: "new-target-id",
      competition_id: "new-demo",
      name: "Maya Chen",
      climber_number: "104",
      gender_division: "Men",
      age_group: "Youth B",
      display_category: "Men / Youth B",
    };
    const affectedClimber = {
      id: "new-affected-id",
      competition_id: "new-demo",
      name: "Milo Fraser",
      climber_number: "103",
      gender_division: "Men",
      age_group: "Youth B",
      display_category: "Men / Youth B",
    };

    const metadata = buildDemoStoryMetadataForClimbers({
      baseMetadata: { scenario_version: "demo-story-v1" },
      targetClimber,
      affectedClimber,
    });

    expect(metadata.target_climber_id).toBe(targetClimber.id);
    expect(metadata.drama_target_climber).toBe(targetClimber.id);
    expect(metadata.target_climber_number).toBe("104");
    expect(metadata.drama_pair).toEqual([affectedClimber.id, targetClimber.id]);
  });
});


--- src\lib\demo-story.ts ---

import { normalizeQualifierAttemptInput } from "./attempts";
import { DEMO_COMPETITION_NAME, DEMO_COMPETITION_SLUG, isCanonicalDemoCompetitionSlug } from "./demo";
import { resetDemoCompetition } from "./demo-reset";
import {
  buildDemoStoryMetadataForClimbers,
  findDemoStoryClimberFromMetadata,
  type DemoStoryClimberIdentity,
  type DemoStoryTargetMetadata,
} from "./demo-story-target";
import { handleAdminCompetitionAction } from "./server-admin-competition-actions";
import { createServiceRoleSupabaseClient } from "./server-supabase";

export type DemoStoryTargetAct =
  | "event_created"
  | "score_corrected"
  | "finalists_started"
  | "public_ready";

export type DemoStoryProgress = {
  eventCreated: boolean;
  keyScoreCorrected: boolean;
  finalistsAdvanced: boolean;
  finalsStarted: boolean;
  publicViewed: boolean;
};

export type DemoStoryMetadata = DemoStoryTargetMetadata & {
  story_step?: DemoStoryTargetAct | string;
  key_score_corrected_at?: string;
  finalists_started_at?: string;
  public_ready_at?: string;
};

export type DemoStoryCompetitionSummary = {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  name: string;
  is_demo: boolean;
  current_phase: string;
  qualifier_locked_at: string | null;
  finals_started_at: string | null;
  demo_metadata: DemoStoryMetadata | null;
};

type DemoStoryAttemptSummary = {
  attempt_count: number;
  topped: boolean;
  zone: boolean;
  attempts_to_top: number | null;
  attempts_to_zone: number | null;
};

export type DemoStoryProgressSnapshot = {
  competition: DemoStoryCompetitionSummary | null;
  targetAttempt?: DemoStoryAttemptSummary | null;
  finalistCount?: number | null;
  publicViewed?: boolean;
  targetClimberBelongsToCompetition?: boolean;
};

export type DemoStoryState = {
  available: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  competition: DemoStoryCompetitionSummary | null;
  metadata: DemoStoryMetadata | null;
  targetAttempt: DemoStoryAttemptSummary | null;
  finalistCount: number;
  progress: DemoStoryProgress;
  links: {
    setup: string;
    judge: string | null;
    organizer: string | null;
    publicEvent: string | null;
    leaderboard: string | null;
    scorecard: string | null;
  };
};

const FINAL_PHASES = new Set(["finals_open", "finals_closed", "results"]);
const ACT_ORDER: DemoStoryTargetAct[] = [
  "event_created",
  "score_corrected",
  "finalists_started",
  "public_ready",
];

export function isCanonicalDemoMutableCompetition(
  competition: Pick<DemoStoryCompetitionSummary, "slug" | "is_demo"> | null | undefined
) {
  return Boolean(competition?.is_demo && isCanonicalDemoCompetitionSlug(competition.slug));
}

export function mergeDemoStoryMetadata(
  existing: DemoStoryMetadata | null | undefined,
  updates: DemoStoryMetadata
): DemoStoryMetadata {
  return {
    ...(existing ?? {}),
    ...updates,
  };
}

export function deriveDemoStoryProgress(snapshot: DemoStoryProgressSnapshot): DemoStoryProgress {
  const metadata = snapshot.competition?.demo_metadata ?? null;
  const expectedAttempts = metadata?.drama_target_attempts_after ?? 1;
  const attempt = snapshot.targetAttempt ?? null;
  const completedTopAttempt = attempt?.attempts_to_top ?? attempt?.attempt_count ?? null;
  const targetBelongs = snapshot.targetClimberBelongsToCompetition !== false;
  const eventCreated =
    isCanonicalDemoMutableCompetition(snapshot.competition) &&
    Boolean(metadata?.scenario_version) &&
    targetBelongs;
  const keyScoreCorrected =
    eventCreated &&
    Boolean(attempt?.topped) &&
    Boolean(attempt?.zone) &&
    completedTopAttempt === expectedAttempts;
  const finalistsAdvanced = eventCreated && (snapshot.finalistCount ?? 0) > 0;
  const finalsStarted =
    eventCreated &&
    (Boolean(snapshot.competition?.finals_started_at) ||
      FINAL_PHASES.has(snapshot.competition?.current_phase ?? ""));

  return {
    eventCreated,
    keyScoreCorrected,
    finalistsAdvanced,
    finalsStarted,
    publicViewed: Boolean(snapshot.publicViewed),
  };
}

function emptyDemoStoryState(error: string | null = null): DemoStoryState {
  return {
    available: false,
    error,
    competition: null,
    metadata: null,
    targetAttempt: null,
    finalistCount: 0,
    progress: {
      eventCreated: false,
      keyScoreCorrected: false,
      finalistsAdvanced: false,
      finalsStarted: false,
      publicViewed: false,
    },
    links: {
      setup: "/staff/demo",
      judge: null,
      organizer: null,
      publicEvent: null,
      leaderboard: null,
      scorecard: null,
    },
  };
}

function getActIndex(targetAct: DemoStoryTargetAct) {
  return ACT_ORDER.indexOf(targetAct);
}

async function loadCanonicalDemoCompetition(supabase: ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleSupabaseClient>) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("competitions")
    .select("id, slug, name, is_demo, current_phase, qualifier_locked_at, finals_started_at, demo_metadata")
    .eq("slug", DEMO_COMPETITION_SLUG)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (error) {
    throw new Error(error.message);
  }

  if (!data) {
    return null;
  }

  const competition = data as DemoStoryCompetitionSummary;
  if (!isCanonicalDemoMutableCompetition(competition)) {
    throw new Error("The canonical demo slug belongs to a real competition. Refusing to prepare demo state.");
  }

  return competition;
}

async function loadDemoTargetAttempt(
  supabase: ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleSupabaseClient>,
  competition: DemoStoryCompetitionSummary | null
) {
  const metadata = competition?.demo_metadata ?? null;
  if (!competition?.id || !metadata?.drama_target_climber || !metadata.drama_target_climb_number) {
    return null;
  }

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("qualifier_attempts")
    .select("attempt_count, topped, zone, attempts_to_top, attempts_to_zone")
    .eq("competition_id", competition.id)
    .eq("climber_id", metadata.drama_target_climber)
    .eq("climb_number", metadata.drama_target_climb_number)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (error) {
    throw new Error(error.message);
  }

  return (data ?? null) as DemoStoryAttemptSummary | null;
}

async function loadDemoStoryClimbers(
  supabase: ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleSupabaseClient>,
  competitionId: string
) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("climbers")
    .select("id, competition_id, name, climber_number, gender_division, age_group, display_category")
    .eq("competition_id", competitionId);

  if (error) {
    throw new Error(error.message);
  }

  return (data ?? []) as DemoStoryClimberIdentity[];
}

async function repairDemoStoryMetadata(
  supabase: ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleSupabaseClient>,
  competition: DemoStoryCompetitionSummary,
  options: { resetIfUnrepairable?: boolean } = {}
) {
  const metadata = competition.demo_metadata ?? null;
  const climbers = await loadDemoStoryClimbers(supabase, competition.id);
  const targetClimber = findDemoStoryClimberFromMetadata(climbers, metadata, "target");
  const affectedClimber = findDemoStoryClimberFromMetadata(climbers, metadata, "affected");

  if (!targetClimber || !affectedClimber) {
    if (options.resetIfUnrepairable) {
      await resetDemoCompetition();
      const resetCompetition = await loadCanonicalDemoCompetition(supabase);
      if (!resetCompetition) {
        throw new Error("Unable to repair the demo state.");
      }
      return repairDemoStoryMetadata(supabase, resetCompetition, { resetIfUnrepairable: false });
    }

    return {
      competition,
      targetClimber: null,
      repaired: false,
    };
  }

  const nextMetadata = buildDemoStoryMetadataForClimbers({
    baseMetadata: {
      scenario_version: "demo-story-v1",
      story_step: "event_created",
      finals_ineligible_age_groups: ["Youth D", "Youth C"],
      ...(metadata ?? {}),
    },
    targetClimber,
    affectedClimber,
  });
  const alreadyFresh =
    metadata?.drama_target_climber === targetClimber.id &&
    metadata?.target_climber_id === targetClimber.id &&
    metadata?.drama_affected_climber === affectedClimber.id &&
    metadata?.affected_climber_id === affectedClimber.id;

  if (!alreadyFresh) {
    const update = await supabase
      .from("competitions")
      .update({ demo_metadata: nextMetadata })
      .eq("id", competition.id)
      .eq("is_demo", true);

    if (update.error) {
      throw new Error(update.error.message);
    }
  }

  return {
    competition: {
      ...competition,
      demo_metadata: nextMetadata,
    },
    targetClimber,
    repaired: !alreadyFresh,
  };
}

async function loadDemoFinalistCount(
  supabase: ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleSupabaseClient>,
  competition: DemoStoryCompetitionSummary | null
) {
  if (!competition?.id) {
    return 0;
  }

  const { count, error } = await supabase
    .from("competition_finalists")
    .select("id", { count: "exact", head: true })
    .eq("competition_id", competition.id);

  if (error) {
    throw new Error(error.message);
  }

  return count ?? 0;
}

async function loadDemoScorecardLink(
  supabase: ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleSupabaseClient>,
  competition: DemoStoryCompetitionSummary | null
) {
  const metadata = competition?.demo_metadata ?? null;
  if (!competition?.id || !metadata?.drama_target_climber) {
    return null;
  }

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("climbers")
    .select("access_token")
    .eq("competition_id", competition.id)
    .eq("id", metadata.drama_target_climber)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (error) {
    throw new Error(error.message);
  }

  const token = typeof data?.access_token === "string" ? data.access_token : null;
  return token ? `/c/${competition.slug}/scorecard?token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}&demoStory=public` : null;
}

export async function getDemoStoryState(publicViewed = false): Promise<DemoStoryState> {
  let supabase: ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleSupabaseClient>;

  try {
    supabase = createServiceRoleSupabaseClient();
  } catch (error) {
    return emptyDemoStoryState(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Demo services are not configured.");
  }

  try {
    const loadedCompetition = await loadCanonicalDemoCompetition(supabase);
    if (!loadedCompetition) {
      return emptyDemoStoryState(null);
    }

    const repairResult = await repairDemoStoryMetadata(supabase, loadedCompetition);
    if (!repairResult.targetClimber) {
      return {
        ...emptyDemoStoryState("Demo target climber is missing. Repair the demo state to regenerate canonical demo metadata."),
        available: true,
        competition: loadedCompetition,
        metadata: loadedCompetition.demo_metadata,
        links: {
          setup: "/staff/demo",
          judge: `/staff/c/${loadedCompetition.slug}/judge?demoStory=act2`,
          organizer: `/staff/c/${loadedCompetition.slug}?demoStory=act3`,
          publicEvent: `/c/${loadedCompetition.slug}?demoStory=public`,
          leaderboard: `/c/${loadedCompetition.slug}/leaderboard?demoStory=public`,
          scorecard: null,
        },
      };
    }

    const competition = repairResult.competition;
    const [targetAttempt, finalistCount, scorecard] = await Promise.all([
      loadDemoTargetAttempt(supabase, competition),
      loadDemoFinalistCount(supabase, competition),
      loadDemoScorecardLink(supabase, competition),
    ]);
    const progress = deriveDemoStoryProgress({
      competition,
      targetAttempt,
      finalistCount,
      publicViewed,
      targetClimberBelongsToCompetition: true,
    });
    const judgeParams = new URLSearchParams({ demoStory: "act2" });
    if (competition.demo_metadata?.drama_target_climber) {
      judgeParams.set("climberId", competition.demo_metadata.drama_target_climber);
    }
    if (competition.demo_metadata?.drama_target_climb_number) {
      judgeParams.set("boulder", String(competition.demo_metadata.drama_target_climb_number));
    }

    return {
      available: true,
      error: null,
      competition,
      metadata: competition.demo_metadata,
      targetAttempt,
      finalistCount,
      progress,
      links: {
        setup: "/staff/demo",
        judge: `/staff/c/${competition.slug}/judge?${judgeParams.toString()}`,
        organizer: `/staff/c/${competition.slug}?demoStory=act3`,
        publicEvent: `/c/${competition.slug}?demoStory=public`,
        leaderboard: `/c/${competition.slug}/leaderboard?demoStory=public`,
        scorecard,
      },
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return emptyDemoStoryState(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unable to load the demo story state.");
  }
}

async function ensureDemoCompetition(
  supabase: ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleSupabaseClient>,
  options: { reset?: boolean }
) {
  let competition = await loadCanonicalDemoCompetition(supabase);

  if (options.reset || !competition) {
    await resetDemoCompetition();
    competition = await loadCanonicalDemoCompetition(supabase);
  }

  if (!competition) {
    throw new Error("Unable to create the canonical demo competition.");
  }

  return competition;
}

async function ensureStoryMetadata(supabase: ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleSupabaseClient>) {
  let competition = await loadCanonicalDemoCompetition(supabase);
  const metadata = competition?.demo_metadata ?? null;

  if (
    !competition ||
    !metadata?.scenario_version ||
    !metadata.drama_target_climber ||
    !metadata.drama_target_climb_number
  ) {
    await resetDemoCompetition();
    competition = await loadCanonicalDemoCompetition(supabase);
  }

  if (!competition?.demo_metadata?.drama_target_climber || !competition.demo_metadata.drama_target_climb_number) {
    throw new Error("Unable to prepare the demo story metadata.");
  }

  const repairResult = await repairDemoStoryMetadata(supabase, competition, { resetIfUnrepairable: true });
  if (!repairResult.targetClimber) {
    throw new Error("Unable to repair the demo target climber.");
  }

  return repairResult.competition;
}

async function applyDemoKeyScoreCorrection(supabase: ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleSupabaseClient>) {
  const competition = await ensureStoryMetadata(supabase);
  const metadata = competition.demo_metadata!;
  const targetClimberId = metadata.drama_target_climber!;
  const targetClimbNumber = metadata.drama_target_climb_number!;
  const attemptsAfter = metadata.drama_target_attempts_after ?? 1;
  const normalized = normalizeQualifierAttemptInput({
    attemptCount: attemptsAfter,
    topped: true,
    zone: true,
    attemptsToTop: attemptsAfter,
    attemptsToZone: 1,
  });

  const { data: round, error: roundError } = await supabase
    .from("competition_rounds")
    .select("id")
    .eq("competition_id", competition.id)
    .eq("scoring_bucket", "qualifier")
    .order("sort_order", { ascending: true })
    .limit(1)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (roundError) {
    throw new Error(roundError.message);
  }

  if (!round?.id) {
    throw new Error("No qualifier round is available for the demo story.");
  }

  const { error } = await supabase.rpc("append_qualifier_score_event", {
    p_competition_id: competition.id,
    p_round_id: round.id,
    p_climber_id: targetClimberId,
    p_climb_number: targetClimbNumber,
    p_attempt_count: normalized.attemptCount,
    p_topped: normalized.topped,
    p_zone: normalized.zone,
    p_attempts_to_top: normalized.attemptsToTop,
    p_attempts_to_zone: normalized.attemptsToZone,
    p_entered_by: "staff",
    p_client_event_id: `demo-story-key-score-${competition.id}-${targetClimberId}-${targetClimbNumber}`,
    p_scored_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    p_judge_device_id: "demo-command-center",
    p_judge_session_id: "guided-story",
    p_replayed_from_offline: false,
  });

  if (error) {
    throw new Error(error.message);
  }

  const nextMetadata = mergeDemoStoryMetadata(metadata, {
    story_step: "score_corrected",
    key_score_corrected_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  });
  const update = await supabase
    .from("competitions")
    .update({ demo_metadata: nextMetadata })
    .eq("id", competition.id)
    .eq("is_demo", true);

  if (update.error) {
    throw new Error(update.error.message);
  }
}

async function ensureFinalistsStarted(supabase: ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleSupabaseClient>) {
  const competition = await ensureStoryMetadata(supabase);
  const existingFinalistCount = await loadDemoFinalistCount(supabase, competition);
  const alreadyStarted =
    existingFinalistCount > 0 &&
    (Boolean(competition.finals_started_at) || FINAL_PHASES.has(competition.current_phase));

  if (!alreadyStarted) {
    await handleAdminCompetitionAction({
      action: "set_phase",
      competitionId: competition.id,
      nextPhase: "qualifier_closed",
      note: "Demo story: organizer reviewed the corrected cut line.",
    });
    await handleAdminCompetitionAction({
      action: "advance_to_finals",
      competitionId: competition.id,
    });
    await handleAdminCompetitionAction({
      action: "set_phase",
      competitionId: competition.id,
      nextPhase: "finals_open",
      note: "Demo story: finals are open for the public demo.",
    });
  }

  const latest = await loadCanonicalDemoCompetition(supabase);
  if (!latest) {
    throw new Error("Unable to reload the demo competition after starting finals.");
  }

  const nextMetadata = mergeDemoStoryMetadata(latest.demo_metadata, {
    story_step: "finalists_started",
    finalists_started_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  });
  const update = await supabase
    .from("competitions")
    .update({ demo_metadata: nextMetadata })
    .eq("id", latest.id)
    .eq("is_demo", true);

  if (update.error) {
    throw new Error(update.error.message);
  }
}

export async function prepareDemoStoryState(
  targetAct: DemoStoryTargetAct,
  options: { reset?: boolean } = {}
): Promise<DemoStoryState> {
  if (!ACT_ORDER.includes(targetAct)) {
    throw new Error("Invalid demo story target.");
  }

  const supabase = createServiceRoleSupabaseClient();
  await ensureDemoCompetition(supabase, options);

  if (getActIndex(targetAct) >= getActIndex("score_corrected")) {
    await applyDemoKeyScoreCorrection(supabase);
  }

  if (getActIndex(targetAct) >= getActIndex("finalists_started")) {
    await ensureFinalistsStarted(supabase);
  }

  if (targetAct === "public_ready") {
    const competition = await loadCanonicalDemoCompetition(supabase);
    if (!competition) {
      throw new Error("Unable to load the demo competition.");
    }

    const nextMetadata = mergeDemoStoryMetadata(competition.demo_metadata, {
      story_step: "public_ready",
      public_ready_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    });
    const update = await supabase
      .from("competitions")
      .update({ demo_metadata: nextMetadata })
      .eq("id", competition.id)
      .eq("is_demo", true);

    if (update.error) {
      throw new Error(update.error.message);
    }
  }

  return getDemoStoryState();
}

export const DEMO_STORY_COPY = {
  title: "Summit Series Demo",

--- src\lib\demo.ts ---

import type { Competition } from "./scoring";

export const DEMO_COMPETITION_SLUG = "spring-open-2026-demo";
export const DEMO_COMPETITION_NAME = "Summit Series Youth Championship - Demo";
export const LEGACY_DEMO_SLUG_PREFIXES = ["mock-", "spring-send-"] as const;
export const DEMO_PITCH_CLIMBS = [
  { number: 1, shortLabel: "Blue V6", label: "Blue V6 · JS" },
  { number: 2, shortLabel: "Red V5", label: "Red V5 · ML" },
  { number: 3, shortLabel: "White V4", label: "White V4 · AB" },
  { number: 4, shortLabel: "Black V7", label: "Black V7 · CR" },
] as const;

export function getDemoPitchClimb(climbNumber: number) {
  return DEMO_PITCH_CLIMBS.find((climb) => climb.number === climbNumber) ?? null;
}

export function isLegacyDemoCompetitionSlug(slug: string | null | undefined) {
  const normalized = slug?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? "";
  return LEGACY_DEMO_SLUG_PREFIXES.some((prefix) => normalized.startsWith(prefix));
}

export function isCanonicalDemoCompetitionSlug(slug: string | null | undefined) {
  return (slug?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? "") === DEMO_COMPETITION_SLUG;
}

export function isDemoCompetitionRecord(
  competition:
    | Pick<Competition, "slug"> & {
        is_demo?: boolean | null;
      }
    | null
    | undefined
) {
  if (!competition) {
    return false;
  }

  if (typeof competition.is_demo === "boolean") {
    return competition.is_demo || isCanonicalDemoCompetitionSlug(competition.slug);
  }

  return isCanonicalDemoCompetitionSlug(competition.slug) || isLegacyDemoCompetitionSlug(competition.slug);
}

export function isProtectedDemoCompetitionRecord(
  competition:
    | Pick<Competition, "slug"> & {
        is_demo?: boolean | null;
      }
    | null
    | undefined
) {
  if (!competition) {
    return false;
  }

  return isCanonicalDemoCompetitionSlug(competition.slug) || isLegacyDemoCompetitionSlug(competition.slug);
}


--- src\lib\export.ts ---

import type { CompetitionSnapshot } from "./db";

function escapeCsv(value: string | number | null | undefined) {
  const text = value == null ? "" : String(value);
  if (text.includes(",") || text.includes('"') || text.includes("\n")) {
    return `"${text.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
  }
  return text;
}

export function buildQualifierCsv(snapshot: CompetitionSnapshot) {
  const rows = [
    ["Rank", "Name", "Number", "Province", "Category", "Score", "Tops", "Zones", "Attempts"],
    ...snapshot.qualifierLeaderboard.map((entry) => [
      entry.overall_rank,
      entry.name,
      entry.climber_number,
      entry.province,
      entry.display_category,
      entry.total_score,
      entry.topped_count,
      entry.zone_count,
      entry.counting_attempt_total,
    ]),
  ];

  return rows.map((row) => row.map(escapeCsv).join(",")).join("\n");
}

export function buildFinalsCsv(snapshot: CompetitionSnapshot) {
  const problemHeaders = Array.from({ length: snapshot.competition.finals_problem_count }, (_, index) => `B${index + 1}`);
  const rows = [
    ["Rank", "Name", "Number", "Province", "Category", ...problemHeaders, "Points", "Tops", "Zones", "Attempts To Top", "Attempts To Zone"],
    ...snapshot.finalsLeaderboard.map((entry) => [
      entry.overall_rank,
      entry.name,
      entry.climber_number,
      entry.province,
      entry.display_category,
      ...entry.problem_results.map((problem) => (problem.top ? `T${problem.attempts_to_top ?? 1}` : problem.zone ? `Z${problem.attempts_to_zone ?? 1}` : "")),
      entry.total_points,
      entry.tops,
      entry.zones,
      entry.attempts_to_top,
      entry.attempts_to_zone,
    ]),
  ];

  return rows.map((row) => row.map(escapeCsv).join(",")).join("\n");
}

export function downloadCsv(filename: string, csv: string) {
  const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const anchor = document.createElement("a");
  anchor.href = url;
  anchor.download = filename;
  anchor.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

--- src\lib\mock-athlete-seeds.test.ts ---

import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import {
  MOCK_ATHLETE_CURATED_FULL_NAMES,
  MOCK_ATHLETE_FIRST_NAMES,
  MOCK_ATHLETE_FULL_NAME_POOL,
  MOCK_ATHLETE_LAST_NAMES,
} from "./mock-athlete-name-pool";

const repoRoot = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..", "..");

describe("mock athlete name pool", () => {
  it("ships a large deterministic pool with low repetition risk", () => {
    expect(MOCK_ATHLETE_CURATED_FULL_NAMES.length).toBeGreaterThan(200);
    expect(MOCK_ATHLETE_FIRST_NAMES.length).toBeGreaterThan(200);
    expect(MOCK_ATHLETE_LAST_NAMES.length).toBeGreaterThan(200);
    expect(MOCK_ATHLETE_FULL_NAME_POOL.length).toBeGreaterThan(800);

    const normalized = new Set(MOCK_ATHLETE_FULL_NAME_POOL.map((name) => name.toLowerCase()));
    expect(normalized.size).toBe(MOCK_ATHLETE_FULL_NAME_POOL.length);
    expect(MOCK_ATHLETE_FULL_NAME_POOL.some((name) => name.includes("'"))).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe("mock seed sql", () => {
  it("uses the expanded name pool instead of the old tiny inline rotations", () => {
    const mockEventsSql = readFileSync(path.join(repoRoot, "sql", "mock-events-seed.sql"), "utf8");
    const springSendRegistrationSql = readFileSync(
      path.join(repoRoot, "sql", "spring-send", "02-seed-registrations.sql"),
      "utf8"
    );

    expect(mockEventsSql).not.toContain("'Avery','Jordan','Parker'");
    expect(mockEventsSql).toContain(`% ${MOCK_ATHLETE_FULL_NAME_POOL.length})] as name`);

    expect(springSendRegistrationSql).not.toContain("case ((series.n * 17) % 24)");
    expect(springSendRegistrationSql).toContain(`% ${MOCK_ATHLETE_FULL_NAME_POOL.length})] as athlete_name`);
  });

  it("keeps the richer multi-factor scoring model in both mock pipelines", () => {
    const mockEventsSql = readFileSync(path.join(repoRoot, "sql", "mock-events-seed.sql"), "utf8");
    const springSendAttemptsSql = readFileSync(
      path.join(repoRoot, "sql", "spring-send", "03-seed-qualifier-attempts.sql"),
      "utf8"
    );

    expect(mockEventsSql).toContain("athlete_profiles as");
    expect(mockEventsSql).toContain("base_strength");
    expect(mockEventsSql).toContain("consistency_band");
    expect(mockEventsSql).toContain("performance_rating");
    expect(mockEventsSql).toContain("finalist_profiles as");

    expect(springSendAttemptsSql).toContain("base_strength");
    expect(springSendAttemptsSql).toContain("consistency_band");
    expect(springSendAttemptsSql).toContain("performance_score");
    expect(springSendAttemptsSql).not.toContain("strength_band");
  });
});


--- src\lib\official-events.test.ts ---

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import { parseUsaClimbingEvents, parseWorldClimbingEvents } from "./official-events";

describe("parseWorldClimbingEvents", () => {
  it("reads current world climbing series cards from the live calendar format", () => {
    const html = `
      <div>Season 2026</div>
      <div class="card__event-horizontal">
        <div class="card__container">
          <span class="d3-ty-caption-large font-semibold">01-03</span>
          <span class="d3-ty-caption font-semibold">May 2026</span>
          <div class="uppercase d3-ty-tag-large text-purple">boulder</div>
          <a aria-label="World Climbing Series Keqiao 2026" href="https://www.ifsc-climbing.org/events/world-climbing-series-keqiao-2026/">
            <h4>World Climbing Series Keqiao 2026</h4>
          </a>
          <span class="d3-ty-body-small text-navy-dark"><svg></svg>Keqiao, China</span>
          <div class="flex flex-row gap-6">
            <a title="Info sheet" href="https://ifsc.results.info/events/1524/infosheet">Info sheet</a>
            <a title="Registrations" href="https://ifsc.results.info/event/1524/registrations">Registrations</a>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="card__event-horizontal">
        <div class="card__container">
          <span class="d3-ty-caption-large font-semibold">08-10</span>
          <span class="d3-ty-caption font-semibold">May 2026</span>
          <div class="uppercase d3-ty-tag-large text-purple">lead speed</div>
          <a aria-label="World Climbing Series Wujiang 2026" href="https://www.ifsc-climbing.org/events/world-climbing-series-wujiang-2026/">
            <h4>World Climbing Series Wujiang 2026</h4>
          </a>
          <span class="d3-ty-body-small text-navy-dark"><svg></svg>Wujiang, China</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    expect(parseWorldClimbingEvents(html)).toEqual([
      expect.objectContaining({
        title: "World Climbing Series Keqiao 2026",
        location: "Keqiao, China",
        start_date: "2026-05-01",
        end_date: "2026-05-03",
        official_schedule_url: "https://ifsc.results.info/events/1524/infosheet",
        official_registration_url: "https://ifsc.results.info/event/1524/registrations",
      }),
    ]);
  });
});

    const html = `

--- src\lib\official-events.ts ---

export interface OfficialEvent {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  series: string;
  location: string;
  disciplines: string;
  start_date: string;
  end_date: string;
  description: string;
  source_name: string;
  source_url: string;
  official_event_url: string;
  official_registration_url: string;
  official_schedule_url: string;
  registration_opens_at: string | null;
  registration_closes_at: string | null;
  hero_image_url: string;
}

const WORLD_CLIMBING_SOURCE_URL = "https://www.worldclimbing.com/calendar/index";
const USA_CLIMBING_NACS_URL = "https://usaclimbing.org/compete/north-american-cup-series/";

function decodeHtmlEntities(value: string) {
  return value
    .replace(/&#(\d+);/g, (_, code) => String.fromCodePoint(Number(code)))
    .replace(/&#x([0-9a-f]+);/gi, (_, code) => String.fromCodePoint(parseInt(code, 16)))
    .replace(/&nbsp;/g, " ")
    .replace(/&amp;/g, "&")
    .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
    .replace(/&apos;/g, "'")
    .replace(/&#8211;|&#x2013;|&ndash;/gi, "\u2013")
    .replace(/&#8212;|&#x2014;|&mdash;/gi, "\u2014")
    .replace(/&lt;/g, "<")
    .replace(/&gt;/g, ">");
}

function repairMojibake(value: string) {
  if (!/Ã|Â|â/.test(value)) {
    return value;
  }

  try {
    return Buffer.from(value, "latin1").toString("utf8");
  } catch {
    return value;
  }
}

function stripTags(value: string) {
  return decodeHtmlEntities(value.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " "));
}

function normalizeWhitespace(value: string) {
  return repairMojibake(value).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}

function slugify(value: string) {
  return value
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");
}

function monthNumber(month: string) {
  const months = [
    "january",
    "february",
    "march",
    "april",
    "may",
    "june",
    "july",
    "august",
    "september",
    "october",
    "november",
    "december",
  ];

  return months.indexOf(month.toLowerCase()) + 1;
}

function formatIsoDate(year: number, month: number, day: number) {
  return `${year.toString().padStart(4, "0")}-${month.toString().padStart(2, "0")}-${day
    .toString()
    .padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

function parseNamedDateRange(range: string) {
  const normalized = normalizeWhitespace(range.replace(/[\u2013\u2014-]/g, "\u2013"));
  const match = normalized.match(/^([A-Za-z]+) (\d{1,2})\u2013(\d{1,2}), (\d{4})$/);
  if (!match) {
    return null;
  }

  const [, monthRaw, startDayRaw, endDayRaw, yearRaw] = match;
  const month = monthNumber(monthRaw);
  if (!month) {
    return null;
  }

  const year = Number(yearRaw);
  return {
    start_date: formatIsoDate(year, month, Number(startDayRaw)),
    end_date: formatIsoDate(year, month, Number(endDayRaw)),
  };
}

function absolutizeUrl(baseUrl: string, href: string) {
  if (!href) {
    return "";
  }

  try {
    return new URL(decodeHtmlEntities(href), baseUrl).toString();
  } catch {
    return decodeHtmlEntities(href);
  }
}

async function fetchSourceHtml(url: string) {
  const response = await fetch(url, {
    headers: {
      "user-agent": "ScorecardOfficialEvents/1.0",
    },
    next: { revalidate: 21600 },
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Unable to load official events from ${url}.`);
  }

  return response.text();
}

function extractWorldClimbingSeasonYear(html: string) {
  const seasonMatch = html.match(/Season (\d{4})/i);
  if (seasonMatch) {
    return Number(seasonMatch[1]);
  }

  const datedMonthMatch = html.match(
    /<span class="d3-ty-caption[^"]*">([A-Za-z]+)\s+(\d{4})<\/span>/i
  );
  if (datedMonthMatch) {
    return Number(datedMonthMatch[2]);
  }

  return new Date().getFullYear();
}

function parseCalendarCardDateRange(dayLabel: string, monthLabel: string, fallbackYear: number) {
  const normalizedDay = normalizeWhitespace(dayLabel);
  const normalizedMonth = normalizeWhitespace(monthLabel);
  const monthMatch = normalizedMonth.match(/^([A-Za-z]+)(?:\s+(\d{4}))?$/);
  const dayMatch = normalizedDay.match(/^(\d{1,2})(?:-(\d{1,2}))?$/);
  if (!monthMatch || !dayMatch) {
    return null;
  }

  const [, monthRaw, yearRaw] = monthMatch;
  const [, startDayRaw, endDayRaw] = dayMatch;
  const month = monthNumber(monthRaw);
  if (!month) {
    return null;
  }

  const year = yearRaw ? Number(yearRaw) : fallbackYear;
  const startDay = Number(startDayRaw);
  const endDay = endDayRaw ? Number(endDayRaw) : startDay;

  return {
    start_date: formatIsoDate(year, month, startDay),
    end_date: formatIsoDate(year, month, endDay),
  };
}

export function parseWorldClimbingEvents(html: string): OfficialEvent[] {
  const fallbackYear = extractWorldClimbingSeasonYear(html);
  const cards = html.split('<div class="card__event-horizontal">').slice(1);

  const events: OfficialEvent[] = [];
  cards.forEach((card) => {
    const titleMatch = card.match(
      /<a aria-label="([^"]+)" href="([^"]+)">\s*<h4[^>]*>([^<]+)<\/h4>\s*<\/a>/i
    );
    const dateMatch = card.match(
      /<span class="d3-ty-caption-large[^>]*">([^<]+)<\/span>\s*<span class="d3-ty-caption[^>]*">([^<]+)<\/span>/i
    );
    const disciplineMatch = card.match(/<div class="uppercase[^>]*">([^<]+)<\/div>/i);
    const locationMatch = card.match(/<span class="d3-ty-body-small[^>]*">[\s\S]*?<\/svg>([^<]+)<\/span>/i);
    if (!titleMatch || !dateMatch || !disciplineMatch || !locationMatch) {
      return;
    }

    const [, , href, rawTitle] = titleMatch;
    const [, rawDayLabel, rawMonthLabel] = dateMatch;
    const [, rawDisciplines] = disciplineMatch;
    const [, rawLocation] = locationMatch;

    const title = normalizeWhitespace(stripTags(rawTitle));
    const disciplines = normalizeWhitespace(stripTags(rawDisciplines));
    const location = normalizeWhitespace(stripTags(rawLocation));
    if (!/^World Climbing Series\b/i.test(title) || !disciplines.toLowerCase().includes("boulder")) {
      return;
    }

    const parsedRange = parseCalendarCardDateRange(rawDayLabel, rawMonthLabel, fallbackYear);
    if (!parsedRange) {
      return;
    }

    const infoSheetUrl = absolutizeUrl(
      WORLD_CLIMBING_SOURCE_URL,
      card.match(/<a title="Info sheet"[^>]*href="([^"]+)"/i)?.[1] ?? ""
    );
    const registrationUrl = absolutizeUrl(
      WORLD_CLIMBING_SOURCE_URL,
      card.match(/<a title="Registrations"[^>]*href="([^"]+)"/i)?.[1] ?? ""
    );
    const officialEventUrl = absolutizeUrl(WORLD_CLIMBING_SOURCE_URL, href);

    events.push({
      id: `world-climbing-${slugify(location)}-${parsedRange.start_date}`,
      title,
      series: "World Climbing",
      location,
      disciplines,
      description: `${title} in ${location} featuring ${disciplines.toLowerCase()}, as listed on the live World Climbing calendar.`,
      source_name: "World Climbing live calendar",
      source_url: WORLD_CLIMBING_SOURCE_URL,
      official_event_url: officialEventUrl,
      official_registration_url: registrationUrl,
      official_schedule_url: infoSheetUrl || officialEventUrl,
      registration_opens_at: null,
      registration_closes_at: null,
      hero_image_url: "",
      ...parsedRange,
    });
  });

  return events;
}

function extractAnchorHrefs(segment: string) {
  const anchors = new Map<string, string>();
  const anchorPattern =
    /<a[^>]*class="[^"]*icon-tile[^"]*"[^>]*href="([^"]+)"[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<h4[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/h4>/gi;
  let match: RegExpExecArray | null;

  while ((match = anchorPattern.exec(segment)) !== null) {
    const [, href, labelHtml] = match;
    const label = normalizeWhitespace(stripTags(labelHtml));
    if (!label) {
      continue;
    }

    anchors.set(label, absolutizeUrl(USA_CLIMBING_NACS_URL, href));
  }

  return anchors;
}

function extractUsaClimbingHeroImage(segment: string) {
  const heroMatch =
    segment.match(/data-src="([^"]+\.(?:jpg|jpeg|png|webp))"/i) ??
    segment.match(/src="([^"]+\.(?:jpg|jpeg|png|webp))"/i);
  return heroMatch?.[1] ?? "";
}

function findUsaClimbingLocationUrl(anchors: Map<string, string>) {
  for (const [label, href] of Array.from(anchors.entries())) {
    if (label.toLowerCase().startsWith("location:")) {
      return href;
    }
  }

  return "";
}

export function parseUsaClimbingEvents(html: string): OfficialEvent[] {
  const sectionPattern = /<li>\s*<a class="uk-accordion-title uk-accordion-title--event"[\s\S]*?<\/li>/gi;

  const events: OfficialEvent[] = [];
  let match: RegExpExecArray | null;

  while ((match = sectionPattern.exec(html)) !== null) {
    const segment = match[0];
    const title = normalizeWhitespace(stripTags(segment.match(/<h3>([^<]+)<\/h3>/i)?.[1] ?? ""));
    const dateAndLocation = normalizeWhitespace(
      stripTags(segment.match(/<h3 class="uk-text-light">([^<]+)<\/h3>/i)?.[1] ?? "").replace(
        /[\u2013\u2014-]/g,
        "\u2013"
      )
    );
    const dateMatch = dateAndLocation.match(/^([A-Za-z]+ \d{1,2}\u2013\d{1,2}, \d{4}) in (.+)$/);
    const disciplineMatch = title.match(/\(([^)]+)\)/);
    const disciplines = disciplineMatch?.[1]?.trim() ?? "";
    if (!disciplines.toLowerCase().includes("boulder")) {
      continue;
    }

    if (!dateMatch) {
      continue;
    }

    const parsedRange = parseNamedDateRange(dateMatch[1]);
    if (!parsedRange) {
      continue;
    }

    const location = dateMatch[2].trim();
    const anchors = extractAnchorHrefs(segment);
    const heroImageUrl = extractUsaClimbingHeroImage(segment);
    const locationUrl = findUsaClimbingLocationUrl(anchors);
    const infoSheetUrl = anchors.get("Info Sheet") ?? "";
    const registrationUrl = anchors.get("Athlete Registration") ?? "";
    const scheduleUrl = anchors.get("Schedule") ?? "";
    const resultsUrl = anchors.get("Registered Athletes/Results") ?? "";
    const officialEventUrl = infoSheetUrl || locationUrl || resultsUrl || scheduleUrl || USA_CLIMBING_NACS_URL;

    events.push({
      id: `nacs-${slugify(location)}-${parsedRange.start_date}`,
      title,
      series: "North American Cup Series",
      location,
      disciplines,
      description:
        "Part of the official North American Cup Series calendar. This event is published by USA Climbing and may include separate registration and schedule resources on the official event page.",
      source_name: "USA Climbing North American Cup Series",
      source_url: USA_CLIMBING_NACS_URL,
      official_event_url: officialEventUrl,
      official_registration_url: registrationUrl,
      official_schedule_url: scheduleUrl || infoSheetUrl || officialEventUrl,
      registration_opens_at: null,
      registration_closes_at: null,
      hero_image_url: heroImageUrl,
      ...parsedRange,
    });
  }

  return events;
}

function mergeOfficialEvents(primary: OfficialEvent[], secondary: OfficialEvent[]) {
  const merged = new Map<string, OfficialEvent>();

  [...primary, ...secondary].forEach((event) => {
    const key = `${event.start_date}:${slugify(event.location)}:${slugify(event.disciplines)}`;
    const existing = merged.get(key);
    if (!existing) {
      merged.set(key, event);
      return;
    }

    merged.set(key, {
      ...existing,
      description: existing.description || event.description,
      source_name: existing.source_name || event.source_name,
      source_url: existing.source_url || event.source_url,
      official_event_url: existing.official_event_url || event.official_event_url,
      official_registration_url: existing.official_registration_url || event.official_registration_url,
      official_schedule_url: existing.official_schedule_url || event.official_schedule_url,
      registration_opens_at: existing.registration_opens_at ?? event.registration_opens_at,
      registration_closes_at: existing.registration_closes_at ?? event.registration_closes_at,
      hero_image_url: existing.hero_image_url || event.hero_image_url,
    });
  });

  return Array.from(merged.values());
}

export async function fetchOfficialBoulderingEvents() {
  const [worldClimbingHtml, usaClimbingHtml] = await Promise.all([
    fetchSourceHtml(WORLD_CLIMBING_SOURCE_URL),
    fetchSourceHtml(USA_CLIMBING_NACS_URL),
  ]);

  return mergeOfficialEvents(parseWorldClimbingEvents(worldClimbingHtml), parseUsaClimbingEvents(usaClimbingHtml)).sort(
    (left, right) => left.start_date.localeCompare(right.start_date)
  );
}


--- src\lib\scorecard-access.test.ts ---

import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY,
  clearScorecardAccessToken,
  readScorecardAccess,
  saveScorecardAccessToken,
} from "./scorecard-access";

class MemoryStorage {
  private values = new Map<string, string>();

  get length() {
    return this.values.size;
  }

  clear() {
    this.values.clear();
  }

  getItem(key: string) {
    return this.values.get(key) ?? null;
  }

  key(index: number) {
    return Array.from(this.values.keys())[index] ?? null;
  }

  removeItem(key: string) {
    this.values.delete(key);
  }

  setItem(key: string, value: string) {
    this.values.set(key, value);
  }
}

describe("scorecard access storage", () => {
  const originalWindow = (globalThis as { window?: Window & typeof globalThis }).window;

  beforeEach(() => {
    (globalThis as { window?: Window & typeof globalThis }).window = {
      sessionStorage: new MemoryStorage() as unknown as Storage,
      localStorage: new MemoryStorage() as unknown as Storage,
    } as Window & typeof globalThis;
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    if (originalWindow) {
      (globalThis as { window?: Window & typeof globalThis }).window = originalWindow;
      return;
    }

    delete (globalThis as { window?: Window & typeof globalThis }).window;
  });

  it("stores scorecard access per competition slug", () => {
    saveScorecardAccessToken("token-one", "spring-send");
    saveScorecardAccessToken("token-two", "granite-open");

    expect(readScorecardAccess("spring-send")).toEqual({
      token: "token-one",
      competitionSlug: "spring-send",
    });
    expect(window.sessionStorage.getItem("scorecard_access_spring-send")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(readScorecardAccess("granite-open")).toEqual({
      token: "token-two",
      competitionSlug: "granite-open",
    });
  });

  it("migrates the legacy scorecard key when the slug matches", () => {
    window.localStorage.setItem(
      SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY,
      JSON.stringify({
        token: "legacy-token",
        competitionSlug: "spring-send",
      })
    );

    expect(readScorecardAccess("spring-send")).toEqual({
      token: "legacy-token",
      competitionSlug: "spring-send",
    });
    expect(window.localStorage.getItem(SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY)).toBeNull();
    expect(window.sessionStorage.getItem("scorecard_access_spring-send")).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it("clears all scoped scorecard access tokens when requested", () => {
    saveScorecardAccessToken("token-one", "spring-send");
    saveScorecardAccessToken("token-two", "granite-open");

    clearScorecardAccessToken();

    expect(readScorecardAccess("spring-send")).toBeNull();
    expect(readScorecardAccess("granite-open")).toBeNull();
    expect(window.sessionStorage.length).toBe(0);
  });
});


--- src\lib\scorecard-access.ts ---

"use client";

export const SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY = "scorecard_access_token";
export const SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_PREFIX = "scorecard_access_";

export interface SavedScorecardAccess {
  token: string;
  competitionSlug: string;
}

function getSessionStorage() {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") {
    return null;
  }

  return window.sessionStorage;
}

function getLegacyStorage() {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") {
    return null;
  }

  return window.localStorage;
}

function buildScorecardAccessKey(competitionSlug: string) {
  return `${SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_PREFIX}${competitionSlug}`;
}

function parseSavedScorecardAccess(raw: string | null) {
  if (!raw) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<SavedScorecardAccess>;
    if (typeof parsed.token !== "string" || typeof parsed.competitionSlug !== "string") {
      return null;
    }

    return {
      token: parsed.token,
      competitionSlug: parsed.competitionSlug,
    };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function saveScorecardAccessToken(token: string, competitionSlug?: string) {
  const normalizedToken = token.trim();
  const normalizedSlug = competitionSlug?.trim() ?? "";
  const storage = getSessionStorage();
  if (!storage || !normalizedToken || !normalizedSlug) {
    return;
  }

  const payload: SavedScorecardAccess = {
    token: normalizedToken,
    competitionSlug: normalizedSlug,
  };

  storage.setItem(buildScorecardAccessKey(normalizedSlug), JSON.stringify(payload));
  getLegacyStorage()?.removeItem(SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY);
}

export function readScorecardAccess(competitionSlug?: string) {
  const storage = getSessionStorage();
  if (!storage) {
    return null;
  }

  const normalizedSlug = competitionSlug?.trim() ?? "";
  if (normalizedSlug) {
    const scoped = parseSavedScorecardAccess(storage.getItem(buildScorecardAccessKey(normalizedSlug)));
    if (scoped) {
      return scoped;
    }
  }

  const legacyStorage = getLegacyStorage();
  const legacy = parseSavedScorecardAccess(legacyStorage?.getItem(SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY) ?? null);
  if (legacy && (!normalizedSlug || legacy.competitionSlug === normalizedSlug)) {
    storage.setItem(buildScorecardAccessKey(legacy.competitionSlug), JSON.stringify(legacy));
    legacyStorage?.removeItem(SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY);
    return legacy;
  }

  if (!normalizedSlug) {
    for (let index = 0; index < storage.length; index += 1) {
      const key = storage.key(index);
      if (!key?.startsWith(SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_PREFIX)) {
        continue;
      }

      const scoped = parseSavedScorecardAccess(storage.getItem(key));
      if (scoped) {
        return scoped;
      }
    }

    return null;
  }

  return null;
}

export function readScorecardAccessToken(competitionSlug?: string) {
  return readScorecardAccess(competitionSlug)?.token ?? "";
}

export function clearScorecardAccessToken(competitionSlug?: string) {
  const storage = getSessionStorage();
  const legacyStorage = getLegacyStorage();
  if (!storage) {
    return;
  }

  const normalizedSlug = competitionSlug?.trim() ?? "";
  if (normalizedSlug) {
    storage.removeItem(buildScorecardAccessKey(normalizedSlug));
    const legacy = parseSavedScorecardAccess(legacyStorage?.getItem(SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY) ?? null);
    if (legacy?.competitionSlug === normalizedSlug) {
      legacyStorage?.removeItem(SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY);
    }
    return;
  }

  const keysToRemove: string[] = [];
  for (let index = 0; index < storage.length; index += 1) {
    const key = storage.key(index);
    if (key?.startsWith(SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_PREFIX)) {
      keysToRemove.push(key);
    }
  }
  keysToRemove.forEach((key) => storage.removeItem(key));
  legacyStorage?.removeItem(SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY);
}

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  buildQualifierLeaderboard,
  buildRegistrationChoices,
  canRegisterForScheduleBlock,
  canClimberSelfScoreQualifier,
  canRegisterDuringCompetition,
  canUseLiveBoulderQueue,
  DEFAULT_COMPETITION,
  getActiveQueueSessionBlock,
  getCompetitionPhaseSequenceFromScheduleBlocks,
  getCompetitionPhaseForSchedulePhase,
  getFormatCapabilities,
  isRoundActiveForCompetitionPhase,
  normalizeCompetition,
  phaseToStageMode,
  pickPreferredQualifierCategory,
} from "./scoring";

describe("format capabilities", () => {
  it("marks scramble as self-scored and not official points", () => {
    expect(getFormatCapabilities("scramble")).toMatchObject({
      selfScoredQualifier: true,
      officialPointsQualifier: false,
      supportsFinals: false,
    });
  });

  it("marks flash as official points with fixed counting climbs", () => {
    expect(getFormatCapabilities("flash_format")).toMatchObject({
      selfScoredQualifier: false,
      officialPointsQualifier: true,
      countingClimbsFixed: true,
      supportsFinals: true,
    });
  });
});

describe("competition phases", () => {
  it("derives finals stage from observation and results phases", () => {
    expect(phaseToStageMode("observation")).toBe("finals");
    expect(phaseToStageMode("results")).toBe("finals");
    expect(phaseToStageMode("wall_reset")).toBe("qualifier");
  });

  it("defaults registration and self scoring to closed unless qualifier_open", () => {
    expect(canRegisterDuringCompetition({ current_phase: "qualifier_open" })).toBe(true);
    expect(canRegisterDuringCompetition({ current_phase: "qualifier_closed" })).toBe(false);
    expect(canClimberSelfScoreQualifier({ current_phase: "qualifier_open", format: "scramble" })).toBe(true);
    expect(canClimberSelfScoreQualifier({ current_phase: "qualifier_closed", format: "scramble" })).toBe(false);
  });

  it("allows future registration windows during qualifier_closed when explicit dates are still open", () => {
    const opensAt = new Date(Date.now() - 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();
    const closesAt = new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();

    expect(
      canRegisterDuringCompetition({
        current_phase: "qualifier_closed",
        status: "active",
        registration_opens_at: opensAt,
        registration_closes_at: closesAt,
      })
    ).toBe(true);
  });

  it("closes registration outside the configured registration window", () => {
    const opensAt = new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();
    const closesAt = new Date(Date.now() + 48 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();

    expect(
      canRegisterDuringCompetition({
        current_phase: "qualifier_open",
        status: "active",
        registration_opens_at: opensAt,
        registration_closes_at: closesAt,
      })
    ).toBe(false);
  });

  it("maps live schedule blocks to the scoring phase they imply", () => {
    expect(getCompetitionPhaseForSchedulePhase("qualifier_round")).toBe("qualifier_open");
    expect(getCompetitionPhaseForSchedulePhase("isolation")).toBe("observation");
    expect(getCompetitionPhaseForSchedulePhase("finals_round")).toBe("finals_open");
    expect(getCompetitionPhaseForSchedulePhase("custom")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("builds a phase sequence from schedule blocks without duplicate qualifier phases", () => {
    expect(
      getCompetitionPhaseSequenceFromScheduleBlocks([
        { label: "Youth B", phase_type: "qualifier_round", start_time: "9:00 AM" },
        { label: "Youth A", phase_type: "qualifier_round", start_time: "10:00 AM" },
        { label: "Reset", phase_type: "wall_reset", start_time: "11:00 AM" },
        { label: "Observe", phase_type: "observation", start_time: "12:00 PM" },
        { label: "Finals", phase_type: "finals_round", start_time: "1:00 PM" },
        { label: "Awards", phase_type: "results", start_time: "2:00 PM" },
      ])
    ).toEqual(["qualifier_open", "wall_reset", "observation", "finals_open", "results"]);
  });

  it("only opens the live boulder queue during a live self-scored qualifier block", () => {
    const scrambleCompetition = normalizeCompetition({
      id: "comp-queue",
      name: "Queue Test",
      slug: "queue-test",
      format: "scramble",
      current_phase: "qualifier_open",
    });

    scrambleCompetition.schedule_blocks = [
      {
        id: "block-1",
        competition_id: scrambleCompetition.id,
        label: "Morning Session",
        phase_type: "qualifier_round",
        audience_label: "Open Session",
        is_active: true,
        start_time: "9:00 AM",
        end_time: "12:00 PM",
        capacity: 50,
        eligible_category_ids: [],
      },
    ];

    expect(canUseLiveBoulderQueue(scrambleCompetition)).toBe(true);
    expect(getActiveQueueSessionBlock(scrambleCompetition)?.label).toBe("Morning Session");

    expect(
      canUseLiveBoulderQueue({
        ...scrambleCompetition,
        current_phase: "qualifier_closed",
      })
    ).toBe(false);

    expect(
      canUseLiveBoulderQueue({
        ...scrambleCompetition,
        format: "flash_format",
      })
    ).toBe(false);
  });
});
