const SAFE_EXTERNAL_PROTOCOLS = new Set(["http:", "https:"]);

export function sanitizeExternalUrl(
  value: string | null | undefined,
  options?: {
    allowDataImage?: boolean;
  }
) {
  const trimmed = value?.trim() ?? "";
  if (!trimmed || trimmed === "undefined" || trimmed === "null") {
    return "";
  }

  if (options?.allowDataImage && /^data:image\/[a-z0-9.+-]+;base64,[a-z0-9+/=\s]+$/i.test(trimmed)) {
    return trimmed;
  }

  try {
    const url = new URL(trimmed);
    if (!SAFE_EXTERNAL_PROTOCOLS.has(url.protocol)) {
      return "";
    }

    return url.toString();
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
}

export function sanitizeInternalRedirectPath(
  value: string | null | undefined,
  fallback = "/staff/dashboard"
) {
  const trimmed = value?.trim() ?? "";
  if (!trimmed) {
    return fallback;
  }

  if (!trimmed.startsWith("/") || trimmed.startsWith("//") || /[\r\n\\]/.test(trimmed)) {
    return fallback;
  }

  try {
    const url = new URL(trimmed, "https://scorecard.local");
    return `${url.pathname}${url.search}${url.hash}`;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}


--- src\lib\server-admin-competition-actions.ts ---

import { createServiceRoleSupabaseClient } from "./server-supabase";
import { sanitizeExternalUrl } from "./security";
import {
  DEFAULT_COMPETITION,
  buildDisplayCategory,
  createCategoryKey,
  createCompetitionId,
  createCompetitionRoundId,
  getDefaultCompetitionCategories,
  getFinalsStyleRounds,
  getQualifierStyleRounds,
  getRecommendedFinalsCutoff,
  getRecommendedQualifierClimbCount,
  getRecommendedQualifierCountingClimbs,
  normalizeCompetition,
  normalizeCompetitionRounds,
  slugifyCompetitionName,
  type Competition,
  type CompetitionCategory,
  type CompetitionPhase,
  type CompetitionRound,
  type CompetitionScheduleBlock,
  type CompetitionStatus,
  type FinalistSelection,
} from "./scoring";

type CompetitionFormat = Competition["format"];
type ServiceRoleSupabaseClient = ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleSupabaseClient>;

export type AdminCompetitionActionRequest = {
  action?: string;
  competitionId?: string;
  input?: Record<string, unknown>;
  blockId?: string;
  status?: CompetitionStatus;
  nextPhase?: CompetitionPhase;
  note?: string;
  orderedClimberIds?: string[];
  orderedFinalists?: FinalistSelection[];
};

const OPTIONAL_COMPETITION_LINK_COLUMNS = [
  "official_event_url",
  "official_registration_url",
  "official_schedule_url",
] as const;

const COMPETITION_PHASES: CompetitionPhase[] = [
  "qualifier_open",
  "qualifier_closed",
  "wall_reset",
  "observation",
  "finals_open",
  "finals_closed",
  "results",
];

const COMPETITION_STATUSES: CompetitionStatus[] = ["active", "archived"];
const COMPETITION_FORMATS: CompetitionFormat[] = [
  "scramble",
  "five_on_five_off",
  "flash_format",
  "ifsc_finals_format",
];

function cleanString(value: unknown) {
  return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}

function cleanOptionalExternalUrl(value: unknown) {
  return sanitizeExternalUrl(typeof value === "string" ? value : null) || "";
}

function arrayifyIds(value: unknown) {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
    return [] as string[];
  }

  return value.filter((entry): entry is string => typeof entry === "string");
}

function isMissingCompetitionLinkColumnError(error: { message?: string } | null | undefined) {
  const message = error?.message?.toLowerCase() ?? "";
  return OPTIONAL_COMPETITION_LINK_COLUMNS.some((column) => message.includes(column));
}

function stripOptionalCompetitionLinkColumns<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(payload: T) {
  const next = { ...payload };
  OPTIONAL_COMPETITION_LINK_COLUMNS.forEach((column) => {
    delete next[column];
  });
  return next;
}

function createId() {
  if (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && typeof crypto.randomUUID === "function") {
    return crypto.randomUUID();
  }

  return `id-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`;
}

function requireString(value: unknown, label: string) {
  const normalized = cleanString(value);
  if (!normalized) {
    throw new Error(`${label} is required.`);
  }

  return normalized;
}

function getScoreBearingRounds(rounds: CompetitionRound[]) {
  return {
    qualifierRound: getQualifierStyleRounds(rounds)[0] ?? null,
    finalsRound: getFinalsStyleRounds(rounds)[0] ?? null,
  };
}

function assertValidCompetitionRounds(rounds: CompetitionRound[]) {
  const finalsScoreRounds = getFinalsStyleRounds(rounds);
  const activeRounds = rounds.filter((round) => round.is_active);

  if (finalsScoreRounds.length > 1) {
    throw new Error("Only one round can use the finals scoring bucket.");
  }

  if (rounds.some((round) => round.round_type === "finals" && round.scoring_bucket === "qualifier")) {
    throw new Error("Finals rounds must use the finals scoring bucket or remain planning-only.");
  }

  if (rounds.some((round) => round.round_type !== "finals" && round.scoring_bucket === "finals")) {
    throw new Error("Only finals rounds can use the finals scoring bucket.");
  }

  if (activeRounds.length > 1) {
    throw new Error("Only one round can be active at a time.");
  }
}

function projectLegacyCompetitionFields(competition: Competition, rounds: CompetitionRound[]) {
  const { qualifierRound, finalsRound } = getScoreBearingRounds(rounds);

  return {
    format: qualifierRound?.format ?? competition.format,
    total_climbs: qualifierRound?.problem_count ?? competition.total_climbs,
    qualifier_counting_climbs: qualifierRound?.counting_climbs ?? competition.qualifier_counting_climbs,
    finals_cutoff: finalsRound?.finals_cutoff ?? qualifierRound?.finals_cutoff ?? competition.finals_cutoff,
    finals_problem_count: finalsRound?.problem_count ?? competition.finals_problem_count,
    has_finals: finalsRound !== null ? true : competition.has_finals,
  };
}

function mapCategoryRows(rows: any[]) {
  return rows.map((row) => ({
    id: row.id ?? createCategoryKey(row.gender_division ?? "Open", row.age_group ?? "Open"),
    competition_id: row.competition_id,
    gender_division: row.gender_division ?? "Open",
    age_group: row.age_group ?? "Open",
    display_name: row.display_name ?? buildDisplayCategory(row.gender_division ?? "Open", row.age_group ?? "Open"),
    sort_order: row.sort_order ?? 0,
    created_at: row.created_at ?? undefined,
  })) satisfies CompetitionCategory[];
}

function mapScheduleBlockRows(rows: any[]) {
  return rows.map((row) => ({
    id: row.id ?? createId(),
    competition_id: row.competition_id,
    round_id: row.round_id ?? null,
    sort_order: row.sort_order ?? 0,
    label: row.label ?? "Open block",
    phase_type: row.phase_type ?? "custom",
    audience_label: row.audience_label ?? "",
    is_active: row.is_active ?? false,
    start_time: row.start_time ?? null,
    end_time: row.end_time ?? null,
    capacity: row.capacity ?? DEFAULT_COMPETITION.max_climbers,
    eligible_category_ids: arrayifyIds(row.eligible_category_ids),
    created_at: row.created_at ?? undefined,
  })) satisfies CompetitionScheduleBlock[];
}

function mapRoundRows(rows: any[]) {
  return rows.map((row) => ({
    id: row.id ?? createCompetitionRoundId(),
    competition_id: row.competition_id,
    round_number: row.round_number ?? 1,
    sort_order: row.sort_order ?? row.round_number ?? 1,
    name: row.name ?? "Round",
    round_type: row.round_type ?? "qualifier",
    format: row.format ?? "scramble",
    status: row.status ?? "pending",
    runtime_phase: row.runtime_phase ?? "qualifier_open",
    is_enabled: row.is_enabled ?? true,
    is_active: row.is_active ?? false,
    activated_at: row.activated_at ?? null,
    problem_count: row.problem_count ?? 4,
    counting_climbs: row.counting_climbs ?? null,
    finals_cutoff: row.finals_cutoff ?? null,
    eligible_category_ids: arrayifyIds(row.eligible_category_ids),
    advancement_source_round_id: row.advancement_source_round_id ?? null,
    advancement_cutoff: row.advancement_cutoff ?? null,
    scoring_bucket: row.scoring_bucket ?? "none",
    scoring_config:
      row.scoring_config && typeof row.scoring_config === "object" && !Array.isArray(row.scoring_config)
        ? row.scoring_config
        : {},
    started_at: row.started_at ?? null,
    closed_at: row.closed_at ?? null,
    created_at: row.created_at ?? undefined,
  })) satisfies CompetitionRound[];
}

function hydrateCompetitions(
  rows: any[],
  categories: CompetitionCategory[],
  scheduleBlocks: CompetitionScheduleBlock[],
  rounds: CompetitionRound[]
) {
  return rows.map((row) => {
    const competitionId = row.id;
    return normalizeCompetition(
      row,
      categories.filter((category) => category.competition_id === competitionId),
      scheduleBlocks.filter((block) => block.competition_id === competitionId),
      rounds.filter((round) => round.competition_id === competitionId)
    );
  });
}

function normalizeScheduleBlocks(input: unknown) {
  if (!Array.isArray(input)) {
    return [] as CompetitionScheduleBlock[];
  }

  return input.map((block, index) => {
    const row = block as Partial<CompetitionScheduleBlock>;
    return {
      id: row.id || createId(),
      competition_id: row.competition_id ?? "",
      round_id: row.round_id ?? null,
      sort_order: row.sort_order ?? index,
      label: cleanString(row.label) || "Open block",
      phase_type: row.phase_type ?? "custom",
      audience_label: cleanString(row.audience_label),
      is_active: Boolean(row.is_active),
      start_time: row.start_time ? cleanString(row.start_time) : null,
      end_time: row.end_time ? cleanString(row.end_time) : null,
      capacity: Number.isFinite(row.capacity) ? Number(row.capacity) : 0,
      eligible_category_ids: Array.isArray(row.eligible_category_ids) ? row.eligible_category_ids : [],
      created_at: row.created_at,
    } satisfies CompetitionScheduleBlock;
  });
}

function normalizeInputRounds(input: unknown, competition: Competition) {
  return normalizeCompetitionRounds(Array.isArray(input) ? (input as CompetitionRound[]) : [], competition);
}

async function fetchAdminCompetitionRows(
  supabase: ServiceRoleSupabaseClient,
  includeArchived: boolean
) {
  let query = supabase.from("competitions").select("*").order("start_date", { ascending: false }).order("name");
  if (!includeArchived) {
    query = query.eq("status", "active");
  }

  const { data, error } = await query;
  if (error) {
    throw new Error(error.message);
  }

  return data ?? [];
}

async function fetchAdminCompetitionCategories(
  supabase: ServiceRoleSupabaseClient,
  competitionIds: string[]
) {
  if (!competitionIds.length) {
    return [] as CompetitionCategory[];
  }

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("competition_categories")
    .select("*")
    .in("competition_id", competitionIds)
    .order("sort_order", { ascending: true });

  if (error) {
    throw new Error(error.message);
  }

  return mapCategoryRows(data ?? []);
}

async function fetchAdminCompetitionScheduleBlocks(
  supabase: ServiceRoleSupabaseClient,
  competitionIds: string[]
) {
  if (!competitionIds.length) {
    return [] as CompetitionScheduleBlock[];
  }

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("competition_schedule_blocks")
    .select("*")
    .in("competition_id", competitionIds)
    .order("sort_order", { ascending: true })
    .order("start_time", { ascending: true });

  if (error) {
    throw new Error(error.message);
  }

  return mapScheduleBlockRows(data ?? []);
}

async function fetchAdminCompetitionRounds(
  supabase: ServiceRoleSupabaseClient,
  competitionIds: string[]
) {
  if (!competitionIds.length) {
    return [] as CompetitionRound[];
  }

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("competition_rounds")
    .select("*")
    .in("competition_id", competitionIds)
    .order("round_number", { ascending: true });

  if (error) {
    throw new Error(error.message);
  }

  return mapRoundRows(data ?? []);
}

export async function listAdminCompetitions(includeArchived = true) {
  const supabase = createServiceRoleSupabaseClient();
  const rows = await fetchAdminCompetitionRows(supabase, includeArchived);
  const competitionIds = rows.map((row) => row.id as string);
  const [categories, scheduleBlocks, rounds] = await Promise.all([
    fetchAdminCompetitionCategories(supabase, competitionIds),
    fetchAdminCompetitionScheduleBlocks(supabase, competitionIds),
    fetchAdminCompetitionRounds(supabase, competitionIds),
  ]);

  return hydrateCompetitions(rows, categories, scheduleBlocks, rounds);
}

async function loadCompetitionRecord(supabase: ServiceRoleSupabaseClient, competitionId: string) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("competitions")
    .select("*")
    .eq("id", competitionId)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (error) {
    throw new Error(error.message);
  }

  if (!data) {
    throw new Error("Competition not found.");
  }

  return data;
}

async function loadCompetitionRounds(supabase: ServiceRoleSupabaseClient, competitionId: string) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("competition_rounds")
    .select("*")
    .eq("competition_id", competitionId)
    .order("round_number", { ascending: true });

  if (error) {
    throw new Error(error.message);
  }

  return mapRoundRows(data ?? []);
}

async function assertStructuralEditsAllowed(
  supabase: ServiceRoleSupabaseClient,
  previous: Competition,
  next: Competition
) {
  const previousRounds = normalizeCompetitionRounds(previous.rounds ?? [], previous);
  const nextRounds = normalizeCompetitionRounds(next.rounds ?? [], next);
  const structureChanged =
    JSON.stringify(
      previousRounds.map((round) => ({
        id: round.id,
        round_type: round.round_type,
        scoring_bucket: round.scoring_bucket,
        format: round.format,
        problem_count: round.problem_count,
        counting_climbs: round.counting_climbs,
        finals_cutoff: round.finals_cutoff,
        advancement_source_round_id: round.advancement_source_round_id,
        advancement_cutoff: round.advancement_cutoff,
      }))
    ) !==
    JSON.stringify(
      nextRounds.map((round) => ({
        id: round.id,
        round_type: round.round_type,
        scoring_bucket: round.scoring_bucket,
        format: round.format,
        problem_count: round.problem_count,
        counting_climbs: round.counting_climbs,
        finals_cutoff: round.finals_cutoff,
        advancement_source_round_id: round.advancement_source_round_id,
        advancement_cutoff: round.advancement_cutoff,
      }))
    );

  if (!structureChanged) {
    return;
  }

  const [registrations, qualifierAttempts, finalAttempts, finalists] = await Promise.all([
    supabase.from("climbers").select("id", { count: "exact", head: true }).eq("competition_id", previous.id),
    supabase.from("qualifier_attempts").select("id", { count: "exact", head: true }).eq("competition_id", previous.id),
    supabase.from("final_attempts").select("id", { count: "exact", head: true }).eq("competition_id", previous.id),
    supabase.from("competition_finalists").select("climber_id", { count: "exact", head: true }).eq("competition_id", previous.id),
  ]);

  for (const result of [registrations, qualifierAttempts, finalAttempts, finalists]) {
    if (result.error) {
      throw new Error(result.error.message);
    }
  }

  if ((qualifierAttempts.count ?? 0) > 0 || (finalAttempts.count ?? 0) > 0 || (finalists.count ?? 0) > 0) {
    throw new Error("Round structure is locked after scoring or finalist creation begins.");
  }

  if ((registrations.count ?? 0) > 0) {
    throw new Error("Round structure is locked after registrations begin. You can still adjust schedule details.");
  }

  if (previous.current_phase === "results" || previous.current_phase === "finals_closed") {
    throw new Error("Historical competitions cannot change round structure.");
  }
}

async function persistCompetitionRounds(
  supabase: ServiceRoleSupabaseClient,
  competition: Competition,
  rounds: CompetitionRound[]
) {
  const normalizedRounds = normalizeCompetitionRounds(rounds, competition);
  assertValidCompetitionRounds(normalizedRounds);
  const { error } = await supabase.rpc("save_competition_rounds", {
    p_competition_id: competition.id,
    p_rounds: normalizedRounds.map((round, index) => ({
      id: round.id || createCompetitionRoundId(),
      competition_id: competition.id,
      round_number: round.round_number ?? index + 1,
      sort_order: round.sort_order ?? round.round_number ?? index + 1,
      name: cleanString(round.name),
      round_type: round.round_type,
      format: round.format,
      status: round.status,
      runtime_phase: round.runtime_phase,
      is_enabled: round.is_enabled,
      is_active: round.is_active,
      activated_at: round.activated_at,
      problem_count: round.problem_count,
      counting_climbs: round.counting_climbs,
      finals_cutoff: round.finals_cutoff,
      eligible_category_ids: round.eligible_category_ids,
      advancement_source_round_id: round.advancement_source_round_id,
      advancement_cutoff: round.advancement_cutoff,
      scoring_bucket: round.scoring_bucket,
      scoring_config: round.scoring_config,
      started_at: round.started_at,
      closed_at: round.closed_at,
    })),
  });

  if (error) {
    throw new Error(error.message);
  }
}

async function syncCompetitionRoundRuntimeState(
  supabase: ServiceRoleSupabaseClient,
  competitionId: string
) {
  const { error } = await supabase.rpc("sync_competition_round_runtime_state", {
    p_competition_id: competitionId,
  });

  if (error) {
    throw new Error(error.message);
  }
}

async function createCompetition(
  supabase: ServiceRoleSupabaseClient,
  input: Record<string, unknown>
) {
  const format = input.format;
  if (!COMPETITION_FORMATS.includes(format as CompetitionFormat)) {
    throw new Error("A valid competition format is required.");
  }

  const name = requireString(input.name, "Competition name");
  const slugBase = slugifyCompetitionName(name);
  const { data: existingRows, error: existingError } = await supabase
    .from("competitions")
    .select("slug");

  if (existingError) {
    throw new Error(existingError.message);
  }

  const existingSlugs = new Set((existingRows ?? []).map((row) => row.slug as string));
  let slug = slugBase;
  let suffix = 2;
  while (existingSlugs.has(slug)) {
    slug = `${slugBase}-${suffix}`;
    suffix += 1;
  }

  const competition = normalizeCompetition({
    id: createCompetitionId(),
    slug,
    name,
    is_demo: Boolean(input.is_demo),
    format: format as CompetitionFormat,
    has_finals: typeof input.has_finals === "boolean" ? input.has_finals : undefined,
    current_phase: "qualifier_open",
    discipline_label: cleanString(input.discipline_label) || "Boulder",
    location_name: cleanString(input.location_name),
    start_date: typeof input.start_date === "string" ? input.start_date : null,
    end_date: typeof input.end_date === "string" ? input.end_date : null,
    registration_opens_at: typeof input.registration_opens_at === "string" ? input.registration_opens_at : null,
    registration_closes_at: typeof input.registration_closes_at === "string" ? input.registration_closes_at : null,
    description: cleanString(input.description),
    hero_image_url: cleanOptionalExternalUrl(input.hero_image_url),
    official_event_url: cleanOptionalExternalUrl(input.official_event_url),
    official_registration_url: cleanOptionalExternalUrl(input.official_registration_url),
    official_schedule_url: cleanOptionalExternalUrl(input.official_schedule_url),
    status: "active",
    stage_mode: "qualifier",
    total_climbs: getRecommendedQualifierClimbCount(format as CompetitionFormat),
    qualifier_counting_climbs: getRecommendedQualifierCountingClimbs(format as CompetitionFormat),
    finals_cutoff: getRecommendedFinalsCutoff(format as CompetitionFormat),
  });
  const legacyProjection = projectLegacyCompetitionFields(competition, competition.rounds ?? []);
  const insertPayload = {
    id: competition.id,
    slug: competition.slug,
    name: competition.name,
    is_demo: competition.is_demo,
    status: competition.status,
    format: legacyProjection.format,
    current_phase: competition.current_phase,
    discipline_label: competition.discipline_label,
    stage_mode: competition.stage_mode,
    location_name: competition.location_name,
    start_date: competition.start_date,
    end_date: competition.end_date,
    registration_opens_at: competition.registration_opens_at,
    registration_closes_at: competition.registration_closes_at,
    description: competition.description,
    hero_image_url: competition.hero_image_url,
    official_event_url: competition.official_event_url,
    official_registration_url: competition.official_registration_url,
    official_schedule_url: competition.official_schedule_url,
    total_climbs: legacyProjection.total_climbs,
    max_climbers: competition.max_climbers,
    qualifier_counting_climbs: legacyProjection.qualifier_counting_climbs,
    has_finals: legacyProjection.has_finals,
    finals_cutoff: legacyProjection.finals_cutoff,
    finals_tie_advances: competition.finals_tie_advances,
    qualifier_eligible_age_groups: competition.qualifier_eligible_age_groups,
    finals_eligible_age_groups: competition.finals_eligible_age_groups,
    qualifier_locked_at: null,
    finals_started_at: null,
    finals_problem_count: legacyProjection.finals_problem_count,
  };

  let { error } = await supabase.from("competitions").insert(insertPayload);
  if (error && isMissingCompetitionLinkColumnError(error)) {
    ({ error } = await supabase.from("competitions").insert(stripOptionalCompetitionLinkColumns(insertPayload)));
  }
  if (error) {
    throw new Error(error.message);
  }

  const categories = getDefaultCompetitionCategories(competition.id);
  const { error: categoryError } = await supabase.from("competition_categories").insert(
    categories.map((category) => ({
      id: category.id,
      competition_id: competition.id,
      gender_division: category.gender_division,
      age_group: category.age_group,
      display_name: category.display_name,
      sort_order: category.sort_order,
    }))
  );
  if (categoryError) {
    throw new Error(categoryError.message);
  }

  await persistCompetitionRounds(supabase, competition, competition.rounds ?? []);
  return { competitionId: competition.id };
}

async function saveCompetitionConfig(
  supabase: ServiceRoleSupabaseClient,
  competitionId: string,
  input: Record<string, unknown>
) {
  const current = await loadCompetitionRecord(supabase, competitionId);
  const existingRounds = await loadCompetitionRounds(supabase, competitionId);
  const previous = normalizeCompetition({ ...current, id: competitionId }, [], [], existingRounds);
  const scheduleBlocks = normalizeScheduleBlocks(input.schedule_blocks).map((block) => ({
    ...block,
    competition_id: competitionId,
  }));
  const draft = normalizeCompetition(
    {
      ...input,
      id: competitionId,
      slug: cleanString(input.slug) || current.slug,
      name: cleanString(input.name) || current.name,
      hero_image_url: cleanOptionalExternalUrl(input.hero_image_url),
      official_event_url: cleanOptionalExternalUrl(input.official_event_url),
      official_registration_url: cleanOptionalExternalUrl(input.official_registration_url),
      official_schedule_url: cleanOptionalExternalUrl(input.official_schedule_url),
    },
    getDefaultCompetitionCategories(competitionId),
    scheduleBlocks,
    []
  );
  const nextRounds = normalizeInputRounds(input.rounds, draft);
  const payload = { ...draft, rounds: nextRounds };

  await assertStructuralEditsAllowed(supabase, previous, payload);
  const legacyProjection = projectLegacyCompetitionFields(payload, payload.rounds ?? []);
  const upsertPayload = {
    id: payload.id,
    slug: payload.slug,
    name: payload.name,
    is_demo: payload.is_demo,
    status: payload.status,
    format: legacyProjection.format,
    current_phase: payload.current_phase,
    discipline_label: payload.discipline_label,
    stage_mode: payload.stage_mode,
    location_name: payload.location_name,
    start_date: payload.start_date,
    end_date: payload.end_date,
    registration_opens_at: payload.registration_opens_at,
    registration_closes_at: payload.registration_closes_at,
    description: payload.description,
    hero_image_url: payload.hero_image_url,
    official_event_url: payload.official_event_url,
    official_registration_url: payload.official_registration_url,
    official_schedule_url: payload.official_schedule_url,
    total_climbs: legacyProjection.total_climbs,
    max_climbers: payload.max_climbers,
    qualifier_counting_climbs: legacyProjection.qualifier_counting_climbs,
    has_finals: legacyProjection.has_finals,
    finals_cutoff: legacyProjection.finals_cutoff,
    finals_tie_advances: payload.finals_tie_advances,
    qualifier_eligible_age_groups: payload.qualifier_eligible_age_groups,
    finals_eligible_age_groups: payload.finals_eligible_age_groups,
    qualifier_locked_at: payload.qualifier_locked_at,
    finals_started_at: payload.finals_started_at,
    finals_problem_count: legacyProjection.finals_problem_count,
  };

  let { error } = await supabase.from("competitions").upsert(upsertPayload);
  if (error && isMissingCompetitionLinkColumnError(error)) {
    ({ error } = await supabase.from("competitions").upsert(stripOptionalCompetitionLinkColumns(upsertPayload)));
  }
  if (error) {
    throw new Error(error.message);
  }

  const { error: deleteScheduleError } = await supabase
    .from("competition_schedule_blocks")
    .delete()
    .eq("competition_id", competitionId);
  if (deleteScheduleError) {
    throw new Error(deleteScheduleError.message);
  }

  await persistCompetitionRounds(supabase, payload, payload.rounds ?? []);

  if (scheduleBlocks.length) {
    const { error: scheduleError } = await supabase.from("competition_schedule_blocks").insert(
      scheduleBlocks.map((block, index) => ({
        id: block.id || createId(),
        competition_id: competitionId,
        sort_order: block.sort_order ?? index,
        label: cleanString(block.label),
        phase_type: block.phase_type,
        audience_label: cleanString(block.audience_label),
        is_active: block.is_active,
        start_time: block.start_time ? cleanString(block.start_time) : null,
        end_time: block.end_time ? cleanString(block.end_time) : null,
        capacity: block.capacity,
        eligible_category_ids: block.eligible_category_ids,
        round_id: block.round_id ?? null,
      }))
    );

    if (scheduleError) {
      throw new Error(scheduleError.message);
    }
  }

  return { competitionId };
}

export async function handleAdminCompetitionAction(payload: AdminCompetitionActionRequest) {
  const supabase = createServiceRoleSupabaseClient();
  const competitionId = payload.competitionId ? cleanString(payload.competitionId) : "";

  switch (payload.action) {
    case "create":
      return createCompetition(supabase, payload.input ?? {});
    case "save_config":
      return saveCompetitionConfig(supabase, requireString(competitionId, "Competition id"), payload.input ?? {});
    case "set_live_schedule_block": {
      const id = requireString(competitionId, "Competition id");
      const blockId = requireString(payload.blockId, "Schedule block id");
      await loadCompetitionRecord(supabase, id);
      const { error: clearError } = await supabase
        .from("competition_schedule_blocks")
        .update({ is_active: false })
        .eq("competition_id", id);
      if (clearError) throw new Error(clearError.message);
      const { error: setError } = await supabase
        .from("competition_schedule_blocks")
        .update({ is_active: true })
        .eq("competition_id", id)
        .eq("id", blockId);
      if (setError) throw new Error(setError.message);
      await syncCompetitionRoundRuntimeState(supabase, id);
      return { competitionId: id };
    }
    case "set_status": {
      const id = requireString(competitionId, "Competition id");
      if (!COMPETITION_STATUSES.includes(payload.status as CompetitionStatus)) {
        throw new Error("Invalid competition status.");
      }
      await loadCompetitionRecord(supabase, id);
      const { error } = await supabase.from("competitions").update({ status: payload.status }).eq("id", id);
      if (error) throw new Error(error.message);
      return { competitionId: id };
    }
    case "set_phase": {
      const id = requireString(competitionId, "Competition id");
      if (!COMPETITION_PHASES.includes(payload.nextPhase as CompetitionPhase)) {
        throw new Error("Invalid competition phase.");
      }
      await loadCompetitionRecord(supabase, id);
      const rpcPayload: Record<string, unknown> = {
        p_competition_id: id,
        p_next_phase: payload.nextPhase,
      };
      if (payload.note?.trim()) {
        rpcPayload.p_note = payload.note.trim();
      }
      const { error } = await supabase.rpc("set_competition_phase", rpcPayload);
      if (error) throw new Error(error.message);
      await syncCompetitionRoundRuntimeState(supabase, id);
      return { competitionId: id };
    }
    case "undo": {
      const id = requireString(competitionId, "Competition id");
      await loadCompetitionRecord(supabase, id);
      const { error } = await supabase.rpc("undo_last_competition_operation", { p_competition_id: id });
      if (error) throw new Error(error.message);
      await syncCompetitionRoundRuntimeState(supabase, id);
      return { competitionId: id };
    }
    case "delete": {
      const id = requireString(competitionId, "Competition id");
      await loadCompetitionRecord(supabase, id);
      const { error } = await supabase.from("competitions").delete().eq("id", id);
      if (error) throw new Error(error.message);
      return { competitionId: id, deleted: true };
    }
    case "advance_to_finals": {
      const id = requireString(competitionId, "Competition id");
      await loadCompetitionRecord(supabase, id);
      const { error } = await supabase.rpc("advance_competition_to_finals", { p_competition_id: id });
      if (error) throw new Error(error.message);
      await syncCompetitionRoundRuntimeState(supabase, id);
      return { competitionId: id };
    }
    case "reset": {
      const id = requireString(competitionId, "Competition id");
      await loadCompetitionRecord(supabase, id);
      const { error } = await supabase.rpc("reset_competition", { p_competition_id: id });
      if (error) throw new Error(error.message);
      await syncCompetitionRoundRuntimeState(supabase, id);
      return { competitionId: id };
    }
    case "update_finalist_order": {
      const id = requireString(competitionId, "Competition id");
      if (!Array.isArray(payload.orderedClimberIds)) {
        throw new Error("Finalist order is required.");
      }
      await loadCompetitionRecord(supabase, id);
      const { count, error: countError } = await supabase
        .from("competition_finalists")
        .select("climber_id", { count: "exact", head: true })
        .eq("competition_id", id);
      if (countError) throw new Error(countError.message);
      if (!count) throw new Error("Advance the competition to finals before changing the finals climbing order.");
      for (let index = 0; index < payload.orderedClimberIds.length; index += 1) {
        const climberId = requireString(payload.orderedClimberIds[index], "Climber id");
        const { error } = await supabase
          .from("competition_finalists")
          .update({ climbing_order: index + 1 })
          .eq("competition_id", id)
          .eq("climber_id", climberId);
        if (error) throw new Error(error.message);
      }
      return { competitionId: id };
    }
    case "save_finalist_field": {
      const id = requireString(competitionId, "Competition id");
      const finalists = Array.isArray(payload.orderedFinalists) ? payload.orderedFinalists : [];
      await loadCompetitionRecord(supabase, id);
      const { error: deleteError } = await supabase.from("competition_finalists").delete().eq("competition_id", id);
      if (deleteError) throw new Error(deleteError.message);
      if (finalists.length) {
        const { error: insertError } = await supabase.from("competition_finalists").insert(
          finalists.map((finalist, index) => ({
            competition_id: id,
            climber_id: requireString(finalist.climber_id, "Finalist climber id"),
            name: cleanString(finalist.name),
            category_id: finalist.category_id,
            display_category: finalist.display_category,
            gender_division: finalist.gender_division,
            age_group: finalist.age_group,
            qualifier_rank: finalist.qualifier_rank,
            advanced_with_tie: finalist.advanced_with_tie,
            climbing_order: index + 1,
          }))
        );
        if (insertError) throw new Error(insertError.message);
      }
      return { competitionId: id };
    }
    default:
      throw new Error("Unsupported admin competition action.");
  }
}

export function getAdminCompetitionActionErrorStatus(message: string) {
  const normalized = message.toLowerCase();
  if (normalized.includes("required") || normalized.includes("invalid") || normalized.includes("unsupported")) {
    return 400;
  }
  if (normalized.includes("not found")) {
    return 404;
  }
  if (normalized.includes("locked") || normalized.includes("advance")) {
    return 409;
  }
  return 500;
}


--- src\lib\server-auth.ts ---

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createRouteSupabaseClient } from "./server-supabase";
import { isStaffRole } from "./staff-score-api";

type RouteSupabaseClient = ReturnType<typeof createRouteSupabaseClient>;

type ProfileRole = "admin" | "judge" | string;

type AuthenticatedProfile = {
  id: string;
  role: ProfileRole | null;
};

type AuthGuardResult =
  | { ok: true; supabase: RouteSupabaseClient; profile: AuthenticatedProfile }
  | { ok: false; response: NextResponse };

export async function getAuthenticatedProfile(
  supabase: RouteSupabaseClient = createRouteSupabaseClient()
): Promise<AuthGuardResult> {
  const {
    data: { user },
    error: userError,
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (userError || !user) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      response: NextResponse.json({ error: "Authentication required." }, { status: 401 }),
    };
  }

  const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("role")
    .eq("id", user.id)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (profileError) {
    throw new Error(profileError.message);
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    supabase,
    profile: {
      id: user.id,
      role: typeof profile?.role === "string" ? profile.role : null,
    },
  };
}

export async function requireStaff(): Promise<AuthGuardResult> {
  const result = await getAuthenticatedProfile();
  if (!result.ok) {
    return result;
  }

  if (!isStaffRole(result.profile.role)) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      response: NextResponse.json({ error: "Staff role required." }, { status: 403 }),
    };
  }

  return result;
}

export async function requireAdmin(): Promise<AuthGuardResult> {
  const result = await getAuthenticatedProfile();
  if (!result.ok) {
    return result;
  }

  if (result.profile.role !== "admin") {
    return {
      ok: false,
      response: NextResponse.json({ error: "Admin role required." }, { status: 403 }),
    };
  }

  return result;
}

import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { createServerClient } from "@supabase/ssr";
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import { SUPABASE_ENV_ERROR, SUPABASE_BROWSER_KEY_ERROR } from "./supabase";

const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const supabaseBrowserKey =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY ??
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;
const supabaseServiceRoleKey = process.env["SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY"];

export const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_ERROR =
  "Missing Supabase service role credentials. Set SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY alongside NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL.";

export function assertSupabaseRouteClientConfigured() {
  if (!supabaseUrl || !supabaseBrowserKey) {
    throw new Error(SUPABASE_ENV_ERROR);
  }

  if (supabaseBrowserKey.startsWith("sb_secret_")) {
    throw new Error(SUPABASE_BROWSER_KEY_ERROR);
  }
}

export function assertSupabaseServiceRoleConfigured() {
  if (!supabaseUrl || !supabaseServiceRoleKey) {
    throw new Error(SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_ERROR);
  }
}

export function createRouteSupabaseClient() {
  assertSupabaseRouteClientConfigured();
  const cookieStore = cookies();

  return createServerClient(supabaseUrl!, supabaseBrowserKey!, {
    cookies: {
      get(name: string) {
        return cookieStore.get(name)?.value;
      },
      set(name: string, value: string, options: Record<string, unknown>) {
        cookieStore.set({ name, value, ...options });
      },
      remove(name: string, options: Record<string, unknown>) {
        cookieStore.set({ name, value: "", ...options });
      },
    },
  });
}

export function createServiceRoleSupabaseClient() {
  assertSupabaseServiceRoleConfigured();

  return createClient(supabaseUrl!, supabaseServiceRoleKey!, {
    auth: {
      persistSession: false,
      autoRefreshToken: false,
      detectSessionInUrl: false,
    },
  });
}


--- src\lib\staff-offline-queue.ts ---

"use client";

import localforage from "localforage";

type OfflineQueueBase = {
  id: string;
  clientEventId: string;
  scoredAt: string;
  judgeDeviceId: string | null;
  judgeSessionId: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
  retryCount: number;
  lastTriedAt: string | null;
};

export type OfflineQueueItem =
  | (OfflineQueueBase & {
      type: "qualifier";
      competitionId: string;
      climberId: string;
      climbNumber: number;
      attemptCount: number;
      topped: boolean;
      zone?: boolean;
      attemptsToTop?: number | null;
      attemptsToZone?: number | null;
    })
  | (OfflineQueueBase & {
      type: "finals";
      competitionId: string;
      climberId: string;
      climbNumber: number;
      top: boolean;
      zone: boolean;
      attemptsToTop: number | null;
      attemptsToZone: number | null;
    });

const STORAGE_KEY = "staff_offline_queue";
const DEVICE_ID_KEY = "staff_offline_queue_device_id";
const SESSION_ID_KEY = "staff_offline_queue_session_id";

const queueStore = localforage.createInstance({
  name: "scorecard",
  storeName: "staff_offline_queue",
});

function generateId() {
  if (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && typeof crypto.randomUUID === "function") {
    return crypto.randomUUID();
  }

  return `generated-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`;
}

async function readStoredString(key: string) {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    const value = await queueStore.getItem<string>(key);
    return typeof value === "string" && value.trim() ? value : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

async function writeStoredString(key: string, value: string) {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") {
    return;
  }

  await queueStore.setItem(key, value);
}

export async function getJudgeDeviceId() {
  const existing = await readStoredString(DEVICE_ID_KEY);
  if (existing) {
    return existing;
  }

  const next = generateId();
  await writeStoredString(DEVICE_ID_KEY, next);
  return next;
}

export async function getJudgeSessionId() {
  const existing = await readStoredString(SESSION_ID_KEY);
  if (existing) {
    return existing;
  }

  const next = generateId();
  await writeStoredString(SESSION_ID_KEY, next);
  return next;
}

export function createClientEventId() {
  return generateId();
}

export async function buildQueueMetadata() {
  const [judgeDeviceId, judgeSessionId] = await Promise.all([getJudgeDeviceId(), getJudgeSessionId()]);
  return {
    clientEventId: createClientEventId(),
    scoredAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    judgeDeviceId,
    judgeSessionId,
  };
}

export async function readOfflineQueue(): Promise<OfflineQueueItem[]> {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") {
    return [];
  }

  try {
    const raw = await queueStore.getItem<unknown>(STORAGE_KEY);
    return Array.isArray(raw) ? (raw as OfflineQueueItem[]) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export async function writeOfflineQueue(items: OfflineQueueItem[]) {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") {
    return;
  }

  await queueStore.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, items);
}

export async function enqueueOfflineItem(item: OfflineQueueItem) {
  const queue = await readOfflineQueue();
  const deduped = queue.filter(
    (entry) =>
      !(
        entry.type === item.type &&
        entry.competitionId === item.competitionId &&
        entry.climberId === item.climberId &&
        entry.climbNumber === item.climbNumber
      )
  );
  deduped.push(item);
  deduped.sort((left, right) => left.scoredAt.localeCompare(right.scoredAt));
  await writeOfflineQueue(deduped);
}

export async function removeOfflineItem(id: string) {
  await writeOfflineQueue((await readOfflineQueue()).filter((entry) => entry.id !== id));
}

export async function markOfflineItemRetried(id: string) {
  const queue = await readOfflineQueue();
  await writeOfflineQueue(
    queue.map((entry) =>
      entry.id === id
        ? {
            ...entry,
            retryCount: entry.retryCount + 1,
            lastTriedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          }
        : entry
    )
  );
}


--- src\lib\staff-score-api.test.ts ---

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  getStaffScoreErrorStatus,
  isStaffRole,
  normalizeStaffScoreRpcResult,
} from "./staff-score-api";

describe("staff score API helpers", () => {
  it("recognizes the current global staff roles", () => {
    expect(isStaffRole("admin")).toBe(true);
    expect(isStaffRole("judge")).toBe(true);
    expect(isStaffRole("organizer")).toBe(false);
    expect(isStaffRole(null)).toBe(false);
  });

  it("normalizes snake_case RPC score metadata into the route response shape", () => {
    expect(
      normalizeStaffScoreRpcResult({
        attempt: { id: "attempt-1" },
        status: "conflicted",
        conflict_reason: "replaced_existing_score",
        client_event_id: "event-1",
        scored_at: "2026-05-01T12:00:00.000Z",
      })
    ).toEqual({
      attempt: { id: "attempt-1" },
      status: "conflicted",
      conflictReason: "replaced_existing_score",
      clientEventId: "event-1",
      scoredAt: "2026-05-01T12:00:00.000Z",
    });
  });

  it("falls back to safe metadata for empty RPC responses", () => {
    expect(
      normalizeStaffScoreRpcResult(null, {
        clientEventId: "client-event",
        scoredAt: "2026-05-01T12:00:00.000Z",
      })
    ).toEqual({
      attempt: null,
      status: "accepted",
      conflictReason: null,
      clientEventId: "client-event",
      scoredAt: "2026-05-01T12:00:00.000Z",
    });
  });

  it("maps staff scoring guard failures to non-500 response classes", () => {
    expect(getStaffScoreErrorStatus("Only staff can record qualifier scores")).toBe(403);
    expect(getStaffScoreErrorStatus("Climber not found.")).toBe(404);
    expect(getStaffScoreErrorStatus("Finals scoring is not open during the current competition phase.")).toBe(409);
  });
});


--- src\lib\staff-score-api.ts ---

export type StaffRole = "admin" | "judge";
export type StaffScoreWriteStatus = "accepted" | "projected" | "conflicted" | "ignored_as_stale";

export type StaffScoreRouteResponse<TAttempt = unknown> = {
  attempt: TAttempt | null;
  status: StaffScoreWriteStatus;
  conflictReason: string | null;
  clientEventId: string | null;
  scoredAt: string | null;
};

export function isStaffRole(role: unknown): role is StaffRole {
  return role === "admin" || role === "judge";
}

function optionalString(value: unknown) {
  return typeof value === "string" && value.trim() ? value : null;
}

export function normalizeStaffScoreRpcResult<TAttempt = unknown>(
  payload: unknown,
  fallback?: { clientEventId?: string | null; scoredAt?: string | null }
): StaffScoreRouteResponse<TAttempt> {
  const record = (Array.isArray(payload) ? payload[0] : payload) as Record<string, unknown> | null;

  if (!record || typeof record !== "object") {
    return {
      attempt: null,
      status: "accepted",
      conflictReason: null,
      clientEventId: fallback?.clientEventId ?? null,
      scoredAt: fallback?.scoredAt ?? null,
    };
  }

  const status = optionalString(record.status);
  const conflictReason = optionalString(record.conflict_reason) ?? optionalString(record.conflictReason);
  const clientEventId =
    optionalString(record.client_event_id) ??
    optionalString(record.clientEventId) ??
    fallback?.clientEventId ??
    null;
  const scoredAt = optionalString(record.scored_at) ?? optionalString(record.scoredAt) ?? fallback?.scoredAt ?? null;

  return {
    attempt: (record.attempt as TAttempt | null | undefined) ?? null,
    status:
      status === "projected" || status === "conflicted" || status === "ignored_as_stale"
        ? status
        : "accepted",
    conflictReason,
    clientEventId,
    scoredAt,
  };
}

export function getStaffScoreErrorStatus(message: string) {
  const normalized = message.toLowerCase();

  if (normalized.includes("only staff")) {
    return 403;
  }

  if (normalized.includes("not found") || normalized.includes("not recognized")) {
    return 404;
  }

  if (
    normalized.includes("not open") ||
    normalized.includes("no active") ||
    normalized.includes("only finalists") ||
    normalized.includes("different round") ||
    normalized.includes("assigned session")
  ) {
    return 409;
  }

  return 500;
}


--- src\lib\supabase.ts ---

import { createBrowserClient } from "@supabase/ssr";
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";

const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const supabaseBrowserKey =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY ??
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;

export const SUPABASE_ENV_ERROR =
  "Missing Supabase browser credentials. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY (or legacy NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY) in .env or .env.local.";

export const SUPABASE_BROWSER_KEY_ERROR =
  "Supabase browser client is using a secret key. Replace it with a publishable key (sb_publishable_...) or a legacy anon key. Never expose sb_secret_ keys in the browser.";

export const supabaseConfigured = Boolean(supabaseUrl && supabaseBrowserKey);
export const supabaseUsesSecretKey = Boolean(
  supabaseBrowserKey?.startsWith("sb_secret_")
);

export function assertSupabaseConfigured() {
  if (!supabaseConfigured) {
    throw new Error(SUPABASE_ENV_ERROR);
  }

  if (supabaseUsesSecretKey) {
    throw new Error(SUPABASE_BROWSER_KEY_ERROR);
  }
}

function createAuthenticatedBrowserClient() {
  return createBrowserClient(
    supabaseUrl ?? "https://placeholder-project.supabase.co",
    supabaseBrowserKey ?? "placeholder-browser-key"
  );
}

function createPublicBrowserClient(persistSession: boolean) {
  return createClient(
    supabaseUrl ?? "https://placeholder-project.supabase.co",
    supabaseBrowserKey ?? "placeholder-browser-key",
    {
      auth: {
        persistSession,
        autoRefreshToken: persistSession,
        detectSessionInUrl: persistSession,
      },
      realtime: {
        params: {
          eventsPerSecond: 10,
        },
      },
    }
  );
}

export const supabase = createAuthenticatedBrowserClient();

// Public screens should always read with the publishable key alone so stale staff
// sessions in local storage cannot break anonymous leaderboard queries.
export const publicSupabase = createPublicBrowserClient(false);


--- src\middleware.ts ---

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { createServerClient } from "@supabase/ssr";
import { DEMO_COMPETITION_SLUG } from "@/lib/demo";

const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const supabaseBrowserKey =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY ??
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;
const SCORECARD_PATH_PATTERN = /^\/c\/[^/]+\/scorecard$/;
const PUBLIC_DEMO_JUDGE_PATH = `/staff/c/${DEMO_COMPETITION_SLUG}/judge`;
const SENSITIVE_CACHE_CONTROL = "no-store, max-age=0";

function createMiddlewareResponse(request: NextRequest) {
  return NextResponse.next({
    request: {
      headers: request.headers,
    },
  });
}

function copyCookies(from: NextResponse, to: NextResponse) {
  from.cookies.getAll().forEach((cookie) => {
    to.cookies.set(cookie);
  });
}

function applySensitiveHeaders(request: NextRequest, response: NextResponse) {
  const hasPrivateToken = request.nextUrl.searchParams.has("token");
  const pathname = request.nextUrl.pathname;
  const isSensitivePath = pathname.startsWith("/staff") || SCORECARD_PATH_PATTERN.test(pathname);

  if (hasPrivateToken || isSensitivePath) {
    response.headers.set("Cache-Control", SENSITIVE_CACHE_CONTROL);
    response.headers.set("X-Robots-Tag", "noindex, nofollow");
  }

  if (hasPrivateToken) {
    response.headers.set("Referrer-Policy", "no-referrer");
  }

  return response;
}

async function getStaffRole(request: NextRequest) {
  if (!supabaseUrl || !supabaseBrowserKey) {
    return {
      role: null,
      response: createMiddlewareResponse(request),
    };
  }

  let response = createMiddlewareResponse(request);

  const supabase = createServerClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseBrowserKey, {
    cookies: {
      get(name: string) {
        return request.cookies.get(name)?.value;
      },
      set(name: string, value: string, options: Record<string, unknown>) {
        response.cookies.set({ name, value, ...options });
      },
      remove(name: string, options: Record<string, unknown>) {
        response.cookies.set({ name, value: "", ...options });
      },
    },
  });

  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    return {
      role: null,
      response,
    };
  }

  const { data } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("role")
    .eq("id", user.id)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (data?.role === "admin" || data?.role === "judge") {
    return {
      role: data.role,
      response,
    };
  }

  return {
    role: null,
    response,
  };
}

export async function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  const { pathname, search } = request.nextUrl;

  if (
    !pathname.startsWith("/staff") ||
    pathname.startsWith("/staff/login") ||
    pathname === "/staff/demo" ||
    pathname === PUBLIC_DEMO_JUDGE_PATH
  ) {
    return applySensitiveHeaders(request, NextResponse.next());
  }

  const { role, response } = await getStaffRole(request);
  if (role) {
    return applySensitiveHeaders(request, response);
  }

  const loginUrl = new URL("/staff/login", request.url);
  loginUrl.searchParams.set("redirect", `${pathname}${search}`);
  const redirectResponse = NextResponse.redirect(loginUrl);
  copyCookies(response, redirectResponse);
  return applySensitiveHeaders(request, redirectResponse);
}

export const config = {
  matcher: ["/((?!_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico|manifest.json|sw.js|icons/|brand-logo.png).*)"],
};

create or replace function public.registration_open_for_competition(p_competition_id uuid)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
  with competition_row as (
    select *
    from public.competitions
    where id = p_competition_id
  ),
  active_block as (
    select phase_type
    from public.competition_schedule_blocks
    where competition_id = p_competition_id and is_active = true
    limit 1
  )
  select case
    when not exists (select 1 from competition_row) then false
    when (select stage_mode from competition_row) <> 'qualifier' then false
    when exists (select 1 from active_block)
      then coalesce((select phase_type in ('check_in', 'technical_meeting', 'qualifier_round', 'custom') from active_block), false)
    else true
  end
$$;

create or replace function public.submit_qualifier_attempt(
  p_access_token text,
  p_competition_id uuid,
  p_climb_number integer,
  p_attempt_count integer,
  p_topped boolean
)
returns public.qualifier_attempts
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_climber public.climbers;
  v_attempt public.qualifier_attempts;
begin
  if not public.qualifier_self_scoring_open_for_competition(p_competition_id) then
    raise exception 'Qualifier self-scoring is not open for this competition';
  end if;

  select *
  into v_climber
  from public.climbers
  where access_token = trim(p_access_token)
    and competition_id = p_competition_id
  limit 1;

  if v_climber.id is null then
    raise exception 'Private qualifier link not recognized';
  end if;

  insert into public.qualifier_attempts (
    competition_id,
    climber_id,
    climb_number,
    attempt_count,
    zone,
    topped,
    attempts_to_top,
    attempts_to_zone,
    entered_by
  )
  values (
    p_competition_id,
    v_climber.id,
    p_climb_number,
    greatest(p_attempt_count, 0),
    p_topped,
    p_topped,
    case when p_topped then greatest(p_attempt_count, 1) else null end,
    case when p_topped then greatest(p_attempt_count, 1) else null end,
    'climber'
  )
  on conflict (climber_id, climb_number) do update
  set
    attempt_count = excluded.attempt_count,
    zone = excluded.zone,
    topped = excluded.topped,
    attempts_to_top = excluded.attempts_to_top,
    attempts_to_zone = excluded.attempts_to_zone,
    entered_by = 'climber',
    updated_at = now()
  returning *
  into v_attempt;

  return v_attempt;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.advance_competition_to_finals(p_competition_id uuid)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_competition public.competitions;
begin
  if not public.is_admin() then
    raise exception 'Only admins can advance a competition to finals';
  end if;

  select *
  into v_competition
  from public.competitions
  where id = p_competition_id
  for update;

  if v_competition.id is null then
    raise exception 'Competition not found';
  end if;

  if v_competition.stage_mode <> 'qualifier' then
    raise exception 'Competition is not in qualifiers';
  end if;

  delete from public.final_attempts where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.competition_finalists where competition_id = p_competition_id;

  with climber_scores as (
    select
      c.id as climber_id,
      c.name,
      c.category_id,
      c.display_category,
      c.gender_division,
      c.age_group,
      q.climb_number,
      q.attempt_count,
      coalesce(q.zone, q.topped, false) as zone,
      q.topped,
      q.attempts_to_top,
      q.attempts_to_zone,
      case
        when v_competition.format = 'flash_format'
          then greatest(
            case
              when q.topped then greatest(0::numeric, 25 - (greatest(coalesce(q.attempts_to_top, q.attempt_count, 1), 1) - 1) * 0.1)
              else 0::numeric
            end,
            case
              when coalesce(q.zone, q.topped, false)
                then greatest(0::numeric, 10 - (greatest(coalesce(q.attempts_to_zone, q.attempts_to_top, q.attempt_count, 1), 1) - 1) * 0.1)
              else 0::numeric
            end
          )
        when q.topped
          then greatest(0, q.climb_number * 1000 - least(greatest(q.attempt_count - 1, 0), 3) * 200)
        else 0::numeric
      end as score
    from public.climbers c
    left join public.qualifier_attempts q on q.climber_id = c.id
    where c.competition_id = p_competition_id
  ),
  counting_scores as (
    select *
    from (
      select
        climber_scores.*,
        row_number() over (
          partition by climber_id
          order by score desc, climb_number desc, attempt_count asc
        ) as score_row
      from climber_scores
      where score > 0::numeric
    ) ranked_scores
    where score_row <= case
      when v_competition.format = 'flash_format' then v_competition.total_climbs
      else v_competition.qualifier_counting_climbs
    end
  ),
  qualifier_totals as (
    select
      c.id as climber_id,
      c.name,
      c.category_id,
      c.display_category,
      c.gender_division,
      c.age_group,
      coalesce(sum(cs.score), 0::numeric) as total_score,
      coalesce(count(*) filter (where cs.topped), 0) as topped_count,
      coalesce(count(*) filter (where cs.zone), 0) as zone_count,
      coalesce(
        sum(
          case
            when cs.topped then greatest(coalesce(cs.attempts_to_top, cs.attempt_count, 0), 0)
            when cs.zone then greatest(coalesce(cs.attempts_to_zone, cs.attempt_count, 0), 0)
            else greatest(coalesce(cs.attempt_count, 0), 0)
          end
        ),
        0
      ) as counting_attempt_total
    from public.climbers c
    left join counting_scores cs on cs.climber_id = c.id
    where c.competition_id = p_competition_id
    group by c.id, c.name, c.category_id, c.display_category, c.gender_division, c.age_group
  ),
  ranked as (
    select
      qualifier_totals.*,
      row_number() over (
        partition by category_id
        order by total_score desc, topped_count desc, zone_count desc, counting_attempt_total asc, name asc
      ) as category_rank
    from qualifier_totals
    where gender_division in ('Men', 'Women')
      and age_group in (
        select jsonb_array_elements_text(v_competition.finals_eligible_age_groups)
      )
  ),
  cutoff as (
    select
      category_id,
      total_score,
      topped_count,
      zone_count,
      counting_attempt_total
    from ranked
    where category_rank = v_competition.finals_cutoff
  )
  insert into public.competition_finalists (
    competition_id,
    climber_id,
    name,
    category_id,
    display_category,
    gender_division,
    age_group,
    qualifier_rank,
    advanced_with_tie
  )
  select
    p_competition_id,
    ranked.climber_id,
    ranked.name,
    ranked.category_id,
    ranked.display_category,
    ranked.gender_division,
    ranked.age_group,
    ranked.category_rank,
    ranked.category_rank > v_competition.finals_cutoff
  from ranked
  left join cutoff using (category_id)
  where ranked.category_rank <= v_competition.finals_cutoff
     or (
       v_competition.finals_tie_advances
       and cutoff.category_id is not null
       and ranked.category_rank > v_competition.finals_cutoff
       and ranked.total_score = cutoff.total_score
       and ranked.topped_count = cutoff.topped_count
       and ranked.zone_count = cutoff.zone_count
       and ranked.counting_attempt_total = cutoff.counting_attempt_total
     );

  update public.competitions
  set
    format = 'ifsc_finals_format',
    stage_mode = 'finals',
    qualifier_locked_at = now(),
    finals_started_at = now(),
    finals_problem_count = 4
  where id = p_competition_id;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.reset_competition(p_competition_id uuid)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
begin
  if not public.is_admin() then
    raise exception 'Only admins can reset a competition';
  end if;

  delete from public.final_attempts where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.competition_finalists where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.qualifier_attempts where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.climbers where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.competition_schedule_blocks where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.competition_categories where competition_id = p_competition_id;

  insert into public.competition_categories (
    id,
    competition_id,
    gender_division,
    age_group,
    display_name,
    sort_order
  )
  select
    division || '::' || age_group,
    p_competition_id,
    division,
    age_group,
    division || ' / ' || age_group,
    row_number() over (order by division, age_group) - 1
  from (
    values ('Men'), ('Women'), ('X')
  ) as divisions(division)
  cross join (
    values ('Youth D'), ('Youth C'), ('Youth B'), ('Youth A'), ('Junior'), ('Rec'), ('Masters'), ('Open')
  ) as ages(age_group);

  update public.competitions
  set
    format = 'scramble',
    stage_mode = 'qualifier',
    total_climbs = 30,
    max_climbers = 80,
    qualifier_counting_climbs = 6,
    finals_cutoff = 6,
    finals_tie_advances = true,
    qualifier_eligible_age_groups = '["Youth D","Youth C","Youth B","Youth A","Junior","Rec","Masters","Open"]'::jsonb,
    finals_eligible_age_groups = '["Open"]'::jsonb,
    qualifier_locked_at = null,
    finals_started_at = null,
    finals_problem_count = 4
  where id = p_competition_id;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.phase_to_stage_mode(p_phase text)
returns text
language sql
immutable
as $$
  select case
    when p_phase in ('observation', 'finals_open', 'finals_closed', 'results') then 'finals'
    else 'qualifier'
  end
$$;

create or replace function public.compute_qualifier_standings(p_competition_id uuid)
returns table (
  climber_id uuid,
  name text,
  climber_number text,
  province text,
  category_id text,
  display_category text,
  gender_division text,
  age_group text,
  time_slot_id uuid,
  total_score numeric,
  topped_count integer,
  zone_count integer,
  counting_attempt_total integer,
  highest_counting_climb integer,
  overall_rank integer,
  category_rank integer
)
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
  with competition_row as (
    select *
    from public.competitions
    where id = p_competition_id
  ),
  base_rows as (
    select
      c.id as climber_id,
      c.name,
      c.climber_number,
      c.province,
      c.category_id,
      c.display_category,
      c.gender_division,
      c.age_group,
      c.time_slot_id,
      gs.climb_number,
      coalesce(qa.topped, false) as topped,
      coalesce(qa.zone, qa.topped, false) as zone,
      case
        when coalesce(qa.topped, false) then greatest(coalesce(qa.attempts_to_top, qa.attempt_count, 1), 1)
        else null
      end as attempts_to_top,
      case
        when coalesce(qa.zone, qa.topped, false) then greatest(coalesce(qa.attempts_to_zone, qa.attempts_to_top, qa.attempt_count, 1), 1)
        else null
      end as attempts_to_zone,
      case
        when (select format from competition_row) in ('flash_format', 'five_on_five_off', 'ifsc_finals_format') then
          case
            when coalesce(qa.topped, false) then greatest(coalesce(qa.attempts_to_top, qa.attempt_count, 1), 1)
            when coalesce(qa.zone, qa.topped, false) then greatest(coalesce(qa.attempts_to_zone, qa.attempts_to_top, qa.attempt_count, 1), 1)
            else 0
          end
        else coalesce(qa.attempt_count, 0)
      end as scoring_attempt_count,
      case
        when (select format from competition_row) in ('flash_format', 'five_on_five_off', 'ifsc_finals_format') then
          round(greatest(
            case
              when coalesce(qa.topped, false) then greatest(0::numeric, 25 - (greatest(coalesce(qa.attempts_to_top, qa.attempt_count, 1), 1) - 1) * 0.1)
              else 0::numeric
            end,
            case
              when coalesce(qa.zone, qa.topped, false) then greatest(0::numeric, 10 - (greatest(coalesce(qa.attempts_to_zone, qa.attempts_to_top, qa.attempt_count, 1), 1) - 1) * 0.1)
              else 0::numeric
            end
          )::numeric, 1)
        when coalesce(qa.topped, false) then
          greatest(0::numeric, (gs.climb_number * 1000) - least(greatest(coalesce(qa.attempt_count, 0) - 1, 0), 3) * 200)
        else 0::numeric
      end as score
    from public.climbers c
    cross join generate_series(
      1,
      greatest(coalesce((select total_climbs from competition_row), 1), 1)
    ) as gs(climb_number)
    left join public.qualifier_attempts qa
      on qa.climber_id = c.id
     and qa.climb_number = gs.climb_number
    where c.competition_id = p_competition_id
  ),
  ranked_scores as (
    select
      base_rows.*,
      row_number() over (
        partition by climber_id
        order by score desc, climb_number desc, scoring_attempt_count asc
      ) as scoring_row,
      case
        when (select format from competition_row) in ('flash_format', 'five_on_five_off', 'ifsc_finals_format') then true
        when score > 0::numeric then true
        else false
      end as eligible_for_counting
    from base_rows
  ),
  counting_scores as (
    select *
    from ranked_scores
    where eligible_for_counting
      and scoring_row <= case
        when (select format from competition_row) in ('flash_format', 'five_on_five_off', 'ifsc_finals_format')
          then greatest(coalesce((select total_climbs from competition_row), 1), 1)
        else greatest(coalesce((select qualifier_counting_climbs from competition_row), 1), 1)
      end
  ),
  qualifier_totals as (
    select
      c.id as climber_id,
      c.name,
      c.climber_number,
      c.province,
      c.category_id,
      c.display_category,
      c.gender_division,
      c.age_group,
      c.time_slot_id,
      coalesce(sum(cs.score), 0::numeric) as total_score,
      coalesce(count(*) filter (where cs.topped), 0)::integer as topped_count,
      coalesce(count(*) filter (where cs.zone), 0)::integer as zone_count,
      coalesce(sum(
        case
          when cs.topped then coalesce(cs.attempts_to_top, cs.scoring_attempt_count, 0)
          when cs.zone then coalesce(cs.attempts_to_zone, cs.scoring_attempt_count, 0)
          else coalesce(cs.scoring_attempt_count, 0)
        end
      ), 0)::integer as counting_attempt_total,
      coalesce((array_agg(cs.climb_number order by cs.score desc, cs.climb_number desc, cs.scoring_attempt_count asc))[1], 0)::integer as highest_counting_climb
    from public.climbers c
    left join counting_scores cs on cs.climber_id = c.id
    where c.competition_id = p_competition_id
    group by c.id, c.name, c.climber_number, c.province, c.category_id, c.display_category, c.gender_division, c.age_group, c.time_slot_id
  ),
  ranked as (
    select
      qualifier_totals.*,
      rank() over (
        order by total_score desc, topped_count desc, zone_count desc, counting_attempt_total asc, highest_counting_climb desc
      )::integer as overall_rank,
      rank() over (
        partition by category_id
        order by total_score desc, topped_count desc, zone_count desc, counting_attempt_total asc, highest_counting_climb desc
      )::integer as category_rank
    from qualifier_totals
  )
  select *
  from ranked
  order by total_score desc, topped_count desc, zone_count desc, counting_attempt_total asc, highest_counting_climb desc, name asc;
$$;

create or replace function public.compute_finalist_selection(p_competition_id uuid)
returns table (
  climber_id uuid,
  name text,
  category_id text,
  display_category text,
  gender_division text,
  age_group text,
  qualifier_rank integer,
  advanced_with_tie boolean,
  climbing_order integer
)
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
  with competition_row as (
    select *
    from public.competitions
    where id = p_competition_id
  ),
  ranked as (
    select *
    from public.compute_qualifier_standings(p_competition_id)
    where gender_division in ('Men', 'Women')
      and age_group in (
        select jsonb_array_elements_text((select finals_eligible_age_groups from competition_row))
      )
  ),
  cutoff as (
    select
      category_id,
      total_score,
      topped_count,
      zone_count,
      counting_attempt_total,
      highest_counting_climb
    from ranked
    where category_rank = (select finals_cutoff from competition_row)
  ),
  selected as (
    select
      ranked.climber_id,
      ranked.name,
      ranked.category_id,
      ranked.display_category,
      ranked.gender_division,
      ranked.age_group,
      ranked.category_rank as qualifier_rank,
      ranked.category_rank > (select finals_cutoff from competition_row) as advanced_with_tie
    from ranked
    left join cutoff using (category_id)
    where ranked.category_rank <= (select finals_cutoff from competition_row)
       or (
         (select finals_tie_advances from competition_row)
         and cutoff.category_id is not null
         and ranked.category_rank > (select finals_cutoff from competition_row)
         and ranked.total_score = cutoff.total_score
         and ranked.topped_count = cutoff.topped_count
         and ranked.zone_count = cutoff.zone_count
         and ranked.counting_attempt_total = cutoff.counting_attempt_total
         and ranked.highest_counting_climb = cutoff.highest_counting_climb
       )
  )
  select
    selected.*,
    row_number() over (
      partition by selected.display_category
      order by selected.qualifier_rank desc, selected.name asc
    )::integer as climbing_order
  from selected
  order by selected.display_category, selected.qualifier_rank, selected.name;
$$;

create or replace function public.set_competition_phase(
  p_competition_id uuid,
  p_next_phase text,
  p_note text default null
)
returns public.competitions
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_competition public.competitions;
  v_previous_phase text;
begin
  if not public.is_admin() then
    raise exception 'Only admins can change competition phases';
  end if;

  if p_next_phase not in ('qualifier_open', 'qualifier_closed', 'wall_reset', 'observation', 'finals_open', 'finals_closed', 'results') then
    raise exception 'Unsupported competition phase';
  end if;

  select *
  into v_competition
  from public.competitions
  where id = p_competition_id
  for update;

  if v_competition.id is null then
    raise exception 'Competition not found';
  end if;

  v_previous_phase := v_competition.current_phase;

  update public.competitions
  set
    current_phase = p_next_phase,
    stage_mode = public.phase_to_stage_mode(p_next_phase),
    qualifier_locked_at = case
      when p_next_phase in ('observation', 'finals_open', 'finals_closed', 'results') then coalesce(qualifier_locked_at, now())
      when p_next_phase = 'qualifier_open' then null
      else qualifier_locked_at
    end,
    finals_started_at = case
      when p_next_phase = 'finals_open' then coalesce(finals_started_at, now())
      when p_next_phase in ('qualifier_open', 'qualifier_closed', 'wall_reset') then null
      else finals_started_at
    end
  where id = p_competition_id
  returning * into v_competition;

  perform public.log_competition_phase_change(p_competition_id, v_previous_phase, p_next_phase, p_note);

  return v_competition;
end;
$$;

drop function if exists public.advance_competition_to_finals(uuid);

create or replace function public.advance_competition_to_finals(p_competition_id uuid)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_competition public.competitions;
begin
  if not public.is_admin() then
    raise exception 'Only admins can advance a competition to finals';
  end if;

  select *
  into v_competition
  from public.competitions
  where id = p_competition_id
  for update;

  if v_competition.id is null then
    raise exception 'Competition not found';
  end if;

  if v_competition.current_phase not in ('qualifier_open', 'qualifier_closed', 'wall_reset') then
    raise exception 'Competition is not ready to advance to finals';
  end if;

  perform public.save_competition_operation(p_competition_id, 'advance');

  delete from public.final_attempts where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.competition_finalists where competition_id = p_competition_id;

  insert into public.competition_finalists (
    competition_id,
    climber_id,
    name,
    category_id,
    display_category,
    gender_division,
    age_group,
    qualifier_rank,
    advanced_with_tie,
    climbing_order
  )
  select
    p_competition_id,
    climber_id,
    name,
    category_id,
    display_category,
    gender_division,
    age_group,
    qualifier_rank,
    advanced_with_tie,
    climbing_order
  from public.compute_finalist_selection(p_competition_id);

  update public.competitions
  set
    current_phase = 'finals_open',
    stage_mode = public.phase_to_stage_mode('finals_open'),
    qualifier_locked_at = coalesce(qualifier_locked_at, now()),
    finals_started_at = coalesce(finals_started_at, now())
  where id = p_competition_id;

  perform public.log_competition_phase_change(p_competition_id, v_competition.current_phase, 'finals_open', 'Advanced to finals');
end;
$$;

drop function if exists public.reset_competition(uuid);

create or replace function public.reset_competition(p_competition_id uuid)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
begin
  if not public.is_admin() then
    raise exception 'Only admins can reset a competition';
  end if;

  perform public.save_competition_operation(p_competition_id, 'reset');

  delete from public.final_attempts where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.competition_finalists where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.qualifier_attempts where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.climbers where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.competition_schedule_blocks where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.competition_categories where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.competition_rounds where competition_id = p_competition_id;

  insert into public.competition_categories (
    id,
    competition_id,
    gender_division,
    age_group,
    display_name,
    sort_order
  )
  select
    division || '::' || age_group,
    p_competition_id,
    division,
    age_group,
    division || ' / ' || age_group,
    row_number() over (order by division, age_group) - 1
  from (
    values ('Men'), ('Women'), ('X')
  ) as divisions(division)
  cross join (
    values ('Youth D'), ('Youth C'), ('Youth B'), ('Youth A'), ('Junior'), ('Rec'), ('Masters'), ('Open')
  ) as ages(age_group);

  update public.competitions
  set
    current_phase = 'qualifier_open',
    stage_mode = 'qualifier',
    qualifier_locked_at = null,
    finals_started_at = null,
    finals_problem_count = 4
  where id = p_competition_id;

  perform public.log_competition_phase_change(p_competition_id, null, 'qualifier_open', 'Competition reset');
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.undo_last_competition_operation(p_competition_id uuid)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_operation public.competition_operations;
begin
  if not public.is_admin() then
    raise exception 'Only admins can undo competition operations';
  end if;

  select *
  into v_operation
  from public.competition_operations
  where competition_id = p_competition_id
    and consumed_at is null
    and expires_at > now()
  order by created_at desc
  limit 1
  for update;

  if v_operation.id is null then
    raise exception 'No undoable competition operation is available';
  end if;

  perform public.restore_competition_snapshot(p_competition_id, v_operation.snapshot);

  update public.competition_operations
  set consumed_at = now()
  where id = v_operation.id;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.build_competition_snapshot_json(p_competition_id uuid)
returns jsonb
language sql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'competition', (
      select to_jsonb(c)
      from public.competitions c
      where c.id = p_competition_id
    ),
    'categories', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(cc) order by cc.sort_order, cc.display_name)
      from public.competition_categories cc
      where cc.competition_id = p_competition_id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'schedule_blocks', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(sb) order by sb.start_time, sb.label)
      from public.competition_schedule_blocks sb
      where sb.competition_id = p_competition_id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'climbers', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) order by c.registered_at, c.name)
      from public.climbers c
      where c.competition_id = p_competition_id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'qualifier_attempts', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(qa) order by qa.climber_id, qa.climb_number)
      from public.qualifier_attempts qa
      where qa.competition_id = p_competition_id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'finalists', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(cf) order by cf.display_category, cf.climbing_order, cf.qualifier_rank, cf.name)
      from public.competition_finalists cf
      where cf.competition_id = p_competition_id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'final_attempts', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(fa) order by fa.climber_id, fa.climb_number)
      from public.final_attempts fa
      where fa.competition_id = p_competition_id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'rounds', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(cr) order by cr.round_number)
      from public.competition_rounds cr
      where cr.competition_id = p_competition_id
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  );
$$;

create or replace function public.save_competition_operation(
  p_competition_id uuid,
  p_operation_type text
)
returns uuid
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_operation_id uuid;
begin
  insert into public.competition_operations (
    competition_id,
    operation_type,
    snapshot,
    expires_at,
    created_by
  )
  values (
    p_competition_id,
    p_operation_type,
    public.build_competition_snapshot_json(p_competition_id),
    now() + interval '30 seconds',
