create or replace function public.round_is_phase_compatible(
  p_phase text,
  p_round_type text,
  p_scoring_bucket text,
  p_runtime_phase text,
  p_is_enabled boolean,
  p_is_active boolean
)
returns boolean
language sql
immutable
as $$
  select
    p_is_enabled = true
    and p_is_active = true
    and p_runtime_phase = p_phase
    and (
      case
        when public.phase_to_stage_mode(p_phase) = 'qualifier' then p_scoring_bucket = 'qualifier'
        else p_scoring_bucket = 'finals'
      end
    );
$$;

create or replace function public.sync_competition_round_runtime_state(
  p_competition_id uuid,
  p_phase text default null
)
returns uuid
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_phase text;
  v_now timestamptz := now();
  v_active_round_id uuid;
begin
  select coalesce(p_phase, c.current_phase)
  into v_phase
  from public.competitions c
  where c.id = p_competition_id;

  if v_phase is null then
    raise exception 'Competition not found';
  end if;

  with candidate_rounds as (
    select
      cr.id,
      cr.sort_order,
      cr.round_number,
      cr.is_enabled,
      cr.is_active,
      cr.runtime_phase,
      cr.scoring_bucket,
      exists (
        select 1
        from public.competition_schedule_blocks csb
        where csb.competition_id = p_competition_id
          and csb.round_id = cr.id
          and csb.is_active = true
      ) as block_is_active
    from public.competition_rounds cr
    where cr.competition_id = p_competition_id
  ),
  preferred_round as (
    select cr.id
    from candidate_rounds cr
    order by
      case
        when cr.block_is_active
          and public.round_is_phase_compatible(v_phase, 'n/a', cr.scoring_bucket, cr.runtime_phase, cr.is_enabled, true) then 0
        when cr.is_active
          and public.round_is_phase_compatible(v_phase, 'n/a', cr.scoring_bucket, cr.runtime_phase, cr.is_enabled, true) then 1
        when cr.runtime_phase = v_phase
          and cr.is_enabled
          and cr.scoring_bucket = case when public.phase_to_stage_mode(v_phase) = 'qualifier' then 'qualifier' else 'finals' end then 2
        when cr.is_enabled
          and cr.scoring_bucket = case when public.phase_to_stage_mode(v_phase) = 'qualifier' then 'qualifier' else 'finals' end then 3
        when cr.runtime_phase = v_phase and cr.is_enabled then 4
        when cr.is_enabled then 5
        else 6
      end,
      cr.sort_order,
      cr.round_number
    limit 1
  ),
  updated as (
    update public.competition_rounds cr
    set
      is_active = cr.id = (select id from preferred_round),
      activated_at = case
        when cr.id = (select id from preferred_round) then coalesce(cr.activated_at, v_now)
        else cr.activated_at
      end,
      closed_at = case
        when cr.id <> (select id from preferred_round)
          and cr.scoring_bucket in ('qualifier', 'finals')
          and cr.activated_at is not null
          and (
            cr.scoring_bucket <> case when public.phase_to_stage_mode(v_phase) = 'qualifier' then 'qualifier' else 'finals' end
            or v_phase in ('finals_closed', 'results')
          ) then coalesce(cr.closed_at, v_now)
        else cr.closed_at
      end,
      status = case
        when cr.scoring_bucket = 'qualifier' then
          case
            when v_phase in ('qualifier_open', 'qualifier_closed', 'wall_reset') and cr.id = (select id from preferred_round) then 'active'
            when cr.activated_at is not null or cr.closed_at is not null or v_phase not in ('qualifier_open', 'qualifier_closed', 'wall_reset') then 'closed'
            else 'pending'
          end
        when cr.scoring_bucket = 'finals' then
          case
            when v_phase in ('observation', 'finals_open') and cr.id = (select id from preferred_round) then 'active'
            when cr.activated_at is not null or cr.closed_at is not null or v_phase in ('finals_closed', 'results') then 'closed'
            else 'pending'
          end
        else cr.status
      end
    where cr.competition_id = p_competition_id
    returning cr.id
  )
  select id
  into v_active_round_id
  from preferred_round;

  return v_active_round_id;
end;
$$;

grant execute on function public.sync_competition_round_runtime_state(uuid, text) to authenticated;

create or replace function public.set_competition_phase(
  p_competition_id uuid,
  p_next_phase text,
  p_note text default null
)
returns public.competitions
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_competition public.competitions;
  v_previous_phase text;
begin
  if not public.is_admin() then
    raise exception 'Only admins can change competition phases';
  end if;

  if p_next_phase not in ('qualifier_open', 'qualifier_closed', 'wall_reset', 'observation', 'finals_open', 'finals_closed', 'results') then
    raise exception 'Unsupported competition phase';
  end if;

  select *
  into v_competition
  from public.competitions
  where id = p_competition_id
  for update;

  if v_competition.id is null then
    raise exception 'Competition not found';
  end if;

  v_previous_phase := v_competition.current_phase;

  update public.competitions
  set
    current_phase = p_next_phase,
    stage_mode = public.phase_to_stage_mode(p_next_phase),
    qualifier_locked_at = case
      when p_next_phase in ('observation', 'finals_open', 'finals_closed', 'results') then coalesce(qualifier_locked_at, now())
      when p_next_phase = 'qualifier_open' then null
      else qualifier_locked_at
    end,
    finals_started_at = case
      when p_next_phase = 'finals_open' then coalesce(finals_started_at, now())
      when p_next_phase in ('qualifier_open', 'qualifier_closed', 'wall_reset') then null
      else finals_started_at
    end
  where id = p_competition_id
  returning * into v_competition;

  perform public.sync_competition_round_runtime_state(p_competition_id, p_next_phase);
  perform public.log_competition_phase_change(p_competition_id, v_previous_phase, p_next_phase, p_note);

  select *
  into v_competition
  from public.competitions
  where id = p_competition_id;

  return v_competition;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.resolve_climber_linked_qualifier_round_id(
  p_competition_id uuid,
  p_climber_id uuid,
  p_requested_round_id uuid default null
)
returns uuid
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_competition public.competitions%rowtype;
  v_climber public.climbers%rowtype;
  v_slot public.competition_schedule_blocks%rowtype;
  v_round public.competition_rounds%rowtype;
begin
  select *
  into v_competition
  from public.competitions
  where id = p_competition_id;

  if v_competition.id is null then
    raise exception 'Competition not found.';
  end if;

  select *
  into v_climber
  from public.climbers
  where id = p_climber_id
    and competition_id = p_competition_id;

  if v_climber.id is null then
    raise exception 'Climber not found.';
  end if;

  if v_climber.time_slot_id is null then
    raise exception 'This climber must be assigned to a session before qualifier scores can be recorded.';
  end if;

  select *
  into v_slot
  from public.competition_schedule_blocks
  where id = v_climber.time_slot_id
    and competition_id = p_competition_id;

  if v_slot.id is null then
    raise exception 'This climber is assigned to a session that no longer exists.';
  end if;

  if v_slot.round_id is null then
    raise exception 'This climber''s assigned session is not linked to a scoring round.';
  end if;

  select *
  into v_round
  from public.competition_rounds
  where id = v_slot.round_id
    and competition_id = p_competition_id;

  if v_round.id is null then
    raise exception 'This climber''s assigned session is not linked to a scoring round.';
  end if;

  if v_round.scoring_bucket <> 'qualifier' then
    raise exception 'That schedule block is not connected to a qualifier scoring round.';
  end if;

  if not v_round.is_enabled then
    raise exception 'That schedule block belongs to a round that is currently disabled.';
  end if;

  if not public.round_is_phase_compatible(
    v_competition.current_phase,
    v_round.round_type,
    v_round.scoring_bucket,
    v_round.runtime_phase,
    v_round.is_enabled,
    v_round.is_active
  ) then
    raise exception 'That schedule block belongs to a round that is not active for the current phase.';
  end if;

  if p_requested_round_id is not null and p_requested_round_id <> v_round.id then
    raise exception 'This climber is assigned to a different round or session than the one currently being scored.';
  end if;

  return v_round.id;
end;
$$;

grant execute on function public.resolve_climber_linked_qualifier_round_id(uuid, uuid, uuid) to authenticated;

create or replace function public.register_climber_for_competition(
  p_competition_id uuid,
  p_name text,
  p_climber_number text,
  p_province text,
  p_category_id text,
  p_time_slot_id uuid default null,
  p_access_token text default null
)
returns public.climbers
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_competition public.competitions%rowtype;
  v_category public.competition_categories%rowtype;
  v_slot public.competition_schedule_blocks%rowtype;
  v_round public.competition_rounds%rowtype;
  v_total_count integer;
  v_slot_count integer;
  v_access_token text;
  v_climber public.climbers%rowtype;
begin
  select *
  into v_competition
  from public.competitions
  where id = p_competition_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Competition not found.';
  end if;

  if not public.registration_open_for_competition(p_competition_id) then
    raise exception 'Registration is not open for this competition.';
  end if;

  select count(*)
  into v_total_count
  from public.climbers
  where competition_id = p_competition_id;

  if v_total_count >= v_competition.max_climbers then
    raise exception 'This competition is already at the configured climber capacity.';
  end if;

  select *
  into v_category
  from public.competition_categories
  where competition_id = p_competition_id
    and id = p_category_id;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Please choose a valid category.';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_array_elements_text(v_competition.qualifier_eligible_age_groups) age_group
    where age_group = v_category.age_group
  ) then
    raise exception 'That age group is not enabled for qualifier registration in this competition.';
  end if;

  if p_time_slot_id is not null then
    select *
    into v_slot
    from public.competition_schedule_blocks
    where id = p_time_slot_id
      and competition_id = p_competition_id
    for update;

    if not found then
      raise exception 'Please choose a valid schedule block.';
    end if;

    if v_slot.phase_type <> 'qualifier_round' then
      raise exception 'That schedule block is not open for registration.';
    end if;

    if v_slot.round_id is not null then
      select *
      into v_round
      from public.competition_rounds
      where id = v_slot.round_id
        and competition_id = p_competition_id;

      if v_round.id is null then
        raise exception 'That schedule block is no longer linked to a valid round.';
      end if;

      if v_round.scoring_bucket <> 'qualifier' then
        raise exception 'That schedule block is not connected to a qualifier scoring round.';
      end if;

      if not v_round.is_enabled then
        raise exception 'That schedule block belongs to a round that is currently disabled.';
      end if;

      if not public.round_is_phase_compatible(
        v_competition.current_phase,
        v_round.round_type,
        v_round.scoring_bucket,
        v_round.runtime_phase,
        v_round.is_enabled,
        v_round.is_active
      ) then
        raise exception 'That schedule block belongs to a round that is not active for the current phase.';
      end if;
    elsif not exists (
      select 1
      from public.competition_rounds cr
      where cr.competition_id = p_competition_id
        and public.round_is_phase_compatible(
          v_competition.current_phase,
          cr.round_type,
          cr.scoring_bucket,
          cr.runtime_phase,
          cr.is_enabled,
          cr.is_active
        )
    ) then
      raise exception 'That schedule block belongs to a round that is not active for the current phase.';
    end if;

    if jsonb_array_length(v_slot.eligible_category_ids) > 0 and not exists (
      select 1
      from jsonb_array_elements_text(v_slot.eligible_category_ids) category_id
      where category_id = p_category_id
    ) then
      raise exception 'That schedule block is not available for the selected category.';
    end if;

    select count(*)
    into v_slot_count
    from public.climbers
    where time_slot_id = p_time_slot_id;

    if v_slot_count >= v_slot.capacity then
      raise exception 'That schedule block is already full.';
    end if;
  elsif exists (
    select 1
    from public.competition_schedule_blocks
    where competition_id = p_competition_id
      and capacity > 0
      and phase_type = 'qualifier_round'
  ) then
    raise exception 'Please choose a schedule block.';
  end if;

  v_access_token := nullif(trim(coalesce(p_access_token, '')), '');
  if v_access_token is null then
    v_access_token := encode(gen_random_bytes(16), 'hex');
  end if;

  insert into public.climbers (
    competition_id,
    name,
    climber_number,
    province,
    category_id,
    gender_division,
    age_group,
    display_category,
    time_slot_id,
    access_token
  )
  values (
    p_competition_id,
    trim(coalesce(p_name, '')),
    trim(coalesce(p_climber_number, '')),
    trim(coalesce(p_province, '')),
    v_category.id,
    v_category.gender_division,
    v_category.age_group,
    v_category.display_name,
    p_time_slot_id,
    v_access_token
  )
  returning *
  into v_climber;

  return v_climber;
exception
  when unique_violation then
    raise exception 'That climber number is already registered for this competition.';
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.submit_qualifier_attempt(
  p_access_token text,
  p_competition_id uuid,
  p_climb_number integer,
  p_attempt_count integer,
  p_topped boolean,
  p_round_id uuid default null
)
returns public.qualifier_attempts
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_climber public.climbers%rowtype;
  v_attempt public.qualifier_attempts;
  v_round_id uuid;
begin
  if not public.qualifier_self_scoring_open_for_competition(p_competition_id) then
    raise exception 'Qualifier self-scoring is not open for this competition';
  end if;

  select *
  into v_climber
  from public.climbers
  where access_token = trim(p_access_token)
    and competition_id = p_competition_id
  limit 1;

  if v_climber.id is null then
    raise exception 'Private qualifier link not recognized';
  end if;

  v_round_id := public.resolve_climber_linked_qualifier_round_id(p_competition_id, v_climber.id, p_round_id);

  insert into public.qualifier_attempts (
    competition_id,
    round_id,
    climber_id,
    climb_number,
    attempt_count,
    zone,
    topped,
    attempts_to_top,
    attempts_to_zone,
    entered_by
  )
  values (
    p_competition_id,
    v_round_id,
    v_climber.id,
    p_climb_number,
    greatest(p_attempt_count, 0),
    p_topped,
    p_topped,
    case when p_topped then greatest(p_attempt_count, 1) else null end,
    case when p_topped then greatest(p_attempt_count, 1) else null end,
    'climber'
  )
  on conflict (competition_id, round_id, climber_id, climb_number) do update
  set
    attempt_count = excluded.attempt_count,
    zone = excluded.zone,
    topped = excluded.topped,
    attempts_to_top = excluded.attempts_to_top,
    attempts_to_zone = excluded.attempts_to_zone,
    entered_by = 'climber',
    updated_at = now()
  returning *
  into v_attempt;

  return v_attempt;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.submit_staff_qualifier_attempt(
  p_competition_id uuid,
  p_climber_id uuid,
  p_climb_number integer,
  p_attempt_count integer,
  p_topped boolean,
  p_zone boolean default null,
  p_attempts_to_top integer default null,
  p_attempts_to_zone integer default null,
  p_round_id uuid default null
)
returns public.qualifier_attempts
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_attempt public.qualifier_attempts;
  v_round_id uuid;
begin
  if not public.is_staff() then
    raise exception 'Only staff can record qualifier scores';
  end if;

  if not public.qualifier_staff_scoring_open_for_competition(p_competition_id) then
    raise exception 'Qualifier scoring is not open during the current competition phase.';
  end if;

  v_round_id := public.resolve_climber_linked_qualifier_round_id(p_competition_id, p_climber_id, p_round_id);

  insert into public.qualifier_attempts (
    competition_id,
    round_id,
    climber_id,
    climb_number,
    attempt_count,
    zone,
    topped,
    attempts_to_top,
    attempts_to_zone,
    entered_by
  )
  values (
    p_competition_id,
    v_round_id,
    p_climber_id,
    p_climb_number,
    greatest(p_attempt_count, 0),
    coalesce(p_zone, p_topped),
    p_topped,
    p_attempts_to_top,
    p_attempts_to_zone,
    'staff'
  )
  on conflict (competition_id, round_id, climber_id, climb_number) do update
  set
    attempt_count = excluded.attempt_count,
    zone = excluded.zone,
    topped = excluded.topped,
    attempts_to_top = excluded.attempts_to_top,
    attempts_to_zone = excluded.attempts_to_zone,
    entered_by = 'staff',
    updated_at = now()
  returning *
  into v_attempt;

  return v_attempt;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.advance_competition_to_finals(p_competition_id uuid)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_competition public.competitions;
  v_finals_round public.competition_rounds;
  v_source_round_id uuid;
  v_cutoff integer;
begin
  if not public.is_admin() then
    raise exception 'Only admins can advance a competition to finals';
  end if;

  select *
  into v_competition
  from public.competitions
  where id = p_competition_id
  for update;

  if v_competition.id is null then
    raise exception 'Competition not found';
  end if;

  if v_competition.stage_mode <> 'qualifier' then
    raise exception 'Competition is not in qualifiers';
  end if;

  perform public.save_competition_operation(p_competition_id, 'advance');

  select *
  into v_finals_round
  from public.competition_rounds
  where id = public.resolve_competition_scoring_round_id(p_competition_id, 'finals', null);

  v_source_round_id := coalesce(
    v_finals_round.advancement_source_round_id,
    public.resolve_competition_scoring_round_id(p_competition_id, 'qualifier', null)
  );
  v_cutoff := coalesce(v_finals_round.advancement_cutoff, v_finals_round.finals_cutoff, v_competition.finals_cutoff);

  delete from public.final_attempts where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.competition_finalists where competition_id = p_competition_id;

  insert into public.competition_finalists (
    competition_id,
    climber_id,
    name,
    category_id,
    display_category,
    gender_division,
    age_group,
    qualifier_rank,
    advanced_with_tie,
    climbing_order
  )
  select
    p_competition_id,
    climber_id,
    name,
    category_id,
    display_category,
    gender_division,
    age_group,
    qualifier_rank,
    advanced_with_tie,
    climbing_order
  from public.compute_finalist_selection(p_competition_id, v_source_round_id, v_cutoff);

  update public.competitions
  set
    current_phase = 'finals_open',
    stage_mode = public.phase_to_stage_mode('finals_open'),
    qualifier_locked_at = coalesce(qualifier_locked_at, now()),
    finals_started_at = coalesce(finals_started_at, now())
  where id = p_competition_id;

  perform public.sync_competition_round_runtime_state(p_competition_id, 'finals_open');
  perform public.log_competition_phase_change(p_competition_id, v_competition.current_phase, 'finals_open', 'Advanced to finals');
end;
$$;

  received_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  client_event_id text not null,
  replayed_from_offline boolean not null default false,
  supersedes_event_id uuid references public.final_score_events(id) on delete set null,
  conflict_flag boolean not null default false,
  conflict_reason text,
  check (attempts_to_top is null or attempts_to_top > 0),
  check (attempts_to_zone is null or attempts_to_zone > 0),
  unique (client_event_id)
);

create index if not exists qualifier_score_events_projection_idx
on public.qualifier_score_events (competition_id, round_id, climber_id, climb_number, scored_at desc, received_at desc, client_event_id desc);

create index if not exists final_score_events_projection_idx
on public.final_score_events (competition_id, round_id, climber_id, climb_number, scored_at desc, received_at desc, client_event_id desc);

alter table public.qualifier_score_events enable row level security;
alter table public.final_score_events enable row level security;

do $$
begin
  if not exists (
    select 1
    from pg_policies
    where schemaname = 'public'
      and tablename = 'qualifier_score_events'
      and policyname = 'qualifier_score_events_select_authenticated'
  ) then
    create policy qualifier_score_events_select_authenticated
    on public.qualifier_score_events for select
    to authenticated
    using (true);
  end if;
end $$;

do $$
begin
  if not exists (
    select 1
    from pg_policies
    where schemaname = 'public'
      and tablename = 'final_score_events'
      and policyname = 'final_score_events_select_authenticated'
  ) then
    create policy final_score_events_select_authenticated
    on public.final_score_events for select
    to authenticated
    using (true);
  end if;
end $$;

insert into public.qualifier_score_events (
  competition_id,
  round_id,
  climber_id,
  climb_number,
  attempt_count,
  zone,
  topped,
  attempts_to_top,
  attempts_to_zone,
  entered_by,
  scored_at,
  received_at,
  client_event_id,
  replayed_from_offline,
  conflict_flag
)
select
  qa.competition_id,
  qa.round_id,
  qa.climber_id,
  qa.climb_number,
  qa.attempt_count,
  qa.zone,
  qa.topped,
  qa.attempts_to_top,
  qa.attempts_to_zone,
  qa.entered_by,
  coalesce(qa.updated_at, now()),
  coalesce(qa.updated_at, now()),
  concat('backfill-qualifier-', qa.id::text),
  false,
  false
from public.qualifier_attempts qa
where not exists (
  select 1
  from public.qualifier_score_events qse
  where qse.client_event_id = concat('backfill-qualifier-', qa.id::text)
);

insert into public.final_score_events (
  competition_id,
  round_id,
  climber_id,
  climb_number,
  top,
  zone,
  attempts_to_top,
  attempts_to_zone,
  entered_by,
  scored_at,
  received_at,
  client_event_id,
  replayed_from_offline,
  conflict_flag
)
select
  fa.competition_id,
  fa.round_id,
  fa.climber_id,
  fa.climb_number,
  fa.top,
  fa.zone,
  fa.attempts_to_top,
  fa.attempts_to_zone,
  fa.entered_by,
  coalesce(fa.updated_at, now()),
  coalesce(fa.updated_at, now()),
  concat('backfill-final-', fa.id::text),
  false,
  false
from public.final_attempts fa
where not exists (
  select 1
  from public.final_score_events fse
  where fse.client_event_id = concat('backfill-final-', fa.id::text)
);

create or replace function public.project_latest_qualifier_attempt(
  p_competition_id uuid,
  p_round_id uuid,
  p_climber_id uuid,
  p_climb_number integer
)
returns public.qualifier_attempts
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_latest public.qualifier_score_events;
  v_attempt public.qualifier_attempts;
begin
  select *
  into v_latest
  from public.qualifier_score_events
  where competition_id = p_competition_id
    and round_id = p_round_id
    and climber_id = p_climber_id
    and climb_number = p_climb_number
  order by scored_at desc, received_at desc, client_event_id desc
  limit 1;

  if v_latest.id is null then
    raise exception 'No qualifier score events are available for this cell.';
  end if;

  insert into public.qualifier_attempts (
    competition_id,
    round_id,
    climber_id,
    climb_number,
    attempt_count,
    zone,
    topped,
    attempts_to_top,
    attempts_to_zone,
    entered_by,
    updated_at
  )
  values (
    v_latest.competition_id,
    v_latest.round_id,
    v_latest.climber_id,
    v_latest.climb_number,
    v_latest.attempt_count,
    v_latest.zone,
    v_latest.topped,
    v_latest.attempts_to_top,
    v_latest.attempts_to_zone,
    v_latest.entered_by,
    v_latest.scored_at
  )
  on conflict (competition_id, round_id, climber_id, climb_number) do update
  set
    attempt_count = excluded.attempt_count,
    zone = excluded.zone,
    topped = excluded.topped,
    attempts_to_top = excluded.attempts_to_top,
    attempts_to_zone = excluded.attempts_to_zone,
    entered_by = excluded.entered_by,
    updated_at = excluded.updated_at
  returning *
  into v_attempt;

  return v_attempt;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.append_qualifier_score_event(
  p_competition_id uuid,
  p_round_id uuid,
  p_climber_id uuid,
  p_climb_number integer,
  p_attempt_count integer,
  p_topped boolean,
  p_zone boolean default null,
  p_attempts_to_top integer default null,
  p_attempts_to_zone integer default null,
  p_entered_by text default 'staff',
  p_client_event_id text default null,
  p_scored_at timestamptz default now(),
  p_judge_device_id text default null,
  p_judge_session_id text default null,
  p_replayed_from_offline boolean default false
)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_client_event_id text := coalesce(nullif(trim(p_client_event_id), ''), gen_random_uuid()::text);
  v_event public.qualifier_score_events;
  v_previous_winner public.qualifier_score_events;
  v_latest public.qualifier_score_events;
  v_attempt public.qualifier_attempts;
  v_status text := 'accepted';
  v_conflict_reason text := null;
begin
  select *
  into v_previous_winner
  from public.qualifier_score_events
  where competition_id = p_competition_id
    and round_id = p_round_id
    and climber_id = p_climber_id
    and climb_number = p_climb_number
  order by scored_at desc, received_at desc, client_event_id desc
  limit 1;

  insert into public.qualifier_score_events (
    competition_id,
    round_id,
    climber_id,
    climb_number,
    attempt_count,
    zone,
    topped,
    attempts_to_top,
    attempts_to_zone,
    entered_by,
    judge_device_id,
    judge_session_id,
    scored_at,
    client_event_id,
    replayed_from_offline
  )
  values (
    p_competition_id,
    p_round_id,
    p_climber_id,
    p_climb_number,
    greatest(p_attempt_count, 0),
    coalesce(p_zone, p_topped),
    p_topped,
    p_attempts_to_top,
    p_attempts_to_zone,
    p_entered_by,
    nullif(trim(coalesce(p_judge_device_id, '')), ''),
    nullif(trim(coalesce(p_judge_session_id, '')), ''),
    coalesce(p_scored_at, now()),
    v_client_event_id,
    coalesce(p_replayed_from_offline, false)
  )
  on conflict (client_event_id) do update
  set client_event_id = excluded.client_event_id
  returning *
  into v_event;

  select *
  into v_latest
  from public.qualifier_score_events
  where competition_id = p_competition_id
    and round_id = p_round_id
    and climber_id = p_climber_id
    and climb_number = p_climb_number
  order by scored_at desc, received_at desc, client_event_id desc
  limit 1;

  if v_latest.id = v_event.id then
    update public.qualifier_score_events
    set
      supersedes_event_id = v_previous_winner.id,
      conflict_flag = case
        when v_previous_winner.id is null then false
        when v_previous_winner.attempt_count = v_event.attempt_count
          and v_previous_winner.zone = v_event.zone
          and v_previous_winner.topped = v_event.topped
          and coalesce(v_previous_winner.attempts_to_top, -1) = coalesce(v_event.attempts_to_top, -1)
          and coalesce(v_previous_winner.attempts_to_zone, -1) = coalesce(v_event.attempts_to_zone, -1)
          then false
        when coalesce(v_previous_winner.judge_device_id, '') <> coalesce(v_event.judge_device_id, '')
          or coalesce(v_previous_winner.judge_session_id, '') <> coalesce(v_event.judge_session_id, '')
          then true
        else false
      end,
      conflict_reason = case
        when v_previous_winner.id is null then null
        when v_previous_winner.attempt_count = v_event.attempt_count
          and v_previous_winner.zone = v_event.zone
          and v_previous_winner.topped = v_event.topped
          and coalesce(v_previous_winner.attempts_to_top, -1) = coalesce(v_event.attempts_to_top, -1)
          and coalesce(v_previous_winner.attempts_to_zone, -1) = coalesce(v_event.attempts_to_zone, -1)
          then null
        when coalesce(v_previous_winner.judge_device_id, '') <> coalesce(v_event.judge_device_id, '')
          or coalesce(v_previous_winner.judge_session_id, '') <> coalesce(v_event.judge_session_id, '')
          then 'replaced_existing_score'
        else null
      end
    where id = v_event.id
    returning *
    into v_event;

    if v_event.conflict_flag then
      v_status := 'conflicted';
      v_conflict_reason := v_event.conflict_reason;
    elsif v_previous_winner.id is not null then
      v_status := 'projected';
    end if;
  else
    update public.qualifier_score_events
    set
      conflict_flag = true,
      conflict_reason = 'ignored_as_stale'
    where id = v_event.id
    returning *
    into v_event;

    v_status := 'ignored_as_stale';
    v_conflict_reason := 'ignored_as_stale';
  end if;

  v_attempt := public.project_latest_qualifier_attempt(
    p_competition_id,
    p_round_id,
    p_climber_id,
    p_climb_number
  );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'status', v_status,
    'conflict_reason', v_conflict_reason,
    'attempt', to_jsonb(v_attempt),
    'event_id', v_event.id,
    'client_event_id', v_event.client_event_id,
    'scored_at', v_event.scored_at
  );
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.append_final_score_event(
  p_competition_id uuid,
  p_round_id uuid,
  p_climber_id uuid,
  p_climb_number integer,
  p_top boolean,
  p_zone boolean,
  p_attempts_to_top integer default null,
  p_attempts_to_zone integer default null,
  p_client_event_id text default null,
  p_scored_at timestamptz default now(),
  p_judge_device_id text default null,
  p_judge_session_id text default null,
  p_replayed_from_offline boolean default false
)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_client_event_id text := coalesce(nullif(trim(p_client_event_id), ''), gen_random_uuid()::text);
  v_event public.final_score_events;
  v_previous_winner public.final_score_events;
  v_latest public.final_score_events;
  v_attempt public.final_attempts;
  v_status text := 'accepted';
  v_conflict_reason text := null;
begin
  select *
  into v_previous_winner
  from public.final_score_events
  where competition_id = p_competition_id
    and round_id = p_round_id
    and climber_id = p_climber_id
    and climb_number = p_climb_number
  order by scored_at desc, received_at desc, client_event_id desc
  limit 1;

  insert into public.final_score_events (
    competition_id,
    round_id,
    climber_id,
    climb_number,
    top,
    zone,
    attempts_to_top,
    attempts_to_zone,
    entered_by,
    judge_device_id,
    judge_session_id,
    scored_at,
    client_event_id,
    replayed_from_offline
  )
  values (
    p_competition_id,
    p_round_id,
    p_climber_id,
    p_climb_number,
    p_top,
    p_zone,
    p_attempts_to_top,
    p_attempts_to_zone,
    'staff',
    nullif(trim(coalesce(p_judge_device_id, '')), ''),
    nullif(trim(coalesce(p_judge_session_id, '')), ''),
    coalesce(p_scored_at, now()),
    v_client_event_id,
    coalesce(p_replayed_from_offline, false)
  )
  on conflict (client_event_id) do update
  set client_event_id = excluded.client_event_id
  returning *
  into v_event;

  select *
  into v_latest
  from public.final_score_events
  where competition_id = p_competition_id
    and round_id = p_round_id
    and climber_id = p_climber_id
    and climb_number = p_climb_number
  order by scored_at desc, received_at desc, client_event_id desc
  limit 1;

  if v_latest.id = v_event.id then
    update public.final_score_events
    set
      supersedes_event_id = v_previous_winner.id,
      conflict_flag = case
        when v_previous_winner.id is null then false
        when v_previous_winner.top = v_event.top
          and v_previous_winner.zone = v_event.zone
          and coalesce(v_previous_winner.attempts_to_top, -1) = coalesce(v_event.attempts_to_top, -1)
          and coalesce(v_previous_winner.attempts_to_zone, -1) = coalesce(v_event.attempts_to_zone, -1)
          then false
        when coalesce(v_previous_winner.judge_device_id, '') <> coalesce(v_event.judge_device_id, '')
          or coalesce(v_previous_winner.judge_session_id, '') <> coalesce(v_event.judge_session_id, '')
          then true
        else false
      end,
      conflict_reason = case
        when v_previous_winner.id is null then null
        when v_previous_winner.top = v_event.top
          and v_previous_winner.zone = v_event.zone
          and coalesce(v_previous_winner.attempts_to_top, -1) = coalesce(v_event.attempts_to_top, -1)
          and coalesce(v_previous_winner.attempts_to_zone, -1) = coalesce(v_event.attempts_to_zone, -1)
          then null
        when coalesce(v_previous_winner.judge_device_id, '') <> coalesce(v_event.judge_device_id, '')
          or coalesce(v_previous_winner.judge_session_id, '') <> coalesce(v_event.judge_session_id, '')
          then 'replaced_existing_score'
        else null
      end
    where id = v_event.id
    returning *
    into v_event;

    if v_event.conflict_flag then
      v_status := 'conflicted';
      v_conflict_reason := v_event.conflict_reason;
    elsif v_previous_winner.id is not null then
      v_status := 'projected';
    end if;
  else
    update public.final_score_events
    set
      conflict_flag = true,
      conflict_reason = 'ignored_as_stale'
    where id = v_event.id
    returning *
    into v_event;

    v_status := 'ignored_as_stale';
    v_conflict_reason := 'ignored_as_stale';
  end if;

  v_attempt := public.project_latest_final_attempt(
    p_competition_id,
    p_round_id,
    p_climber_id,
    p_climb_number
  );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'status', v_status,
    'conflict_reason', v_conflict_reason,
    'attempt', to_jsonb(v_attempt),
    'event_id', v_event.id,
    'client_event_id', v_event.client_event_id,
    'scored_at', v_event.scored_at
  );
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.submit_qualifier_attempt(
  p_access_token text,
  p_competition_id uuid,
  p_climb_number integer,
  p_attempt_count integer,
  p_topped boolean,
  p_round_id uuid default null
)
returns public.qualifier_attempts
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_climber public.climbers;
  v_round_id uuid;
  v_result jsonb;
  v_attempt public.qualifier_attempts;
begin
  if not public.qualifier_self_scoring_open_for_competition(p_competition_id) then
    raise exception 'Qualifier self-scoring is not open for this competition';
  end if;

  select *
  into v_climber
  from public.climbers
  where access_token = trim(p_access_token)
    and competition_id = p_competition_id
  limit 1;

  if v_climber.id is null then
    raise exception 'Private qualifier link not recognized';
  end if;

  v_round_id := public.resolve_climber_linked_qualifier_round_id(p_competition_id, v_climber.id, p_round_id);

  v_result := public.append_qualifier_score_event(
    p_competition_id,
    v_round_id,
    v_climber.id,
    p_climb_number,
    greatest(p_attempt_count, 0),
    p_topped,
    p_topped,
    case when p_topped then greatest(p_attempt_count, 1) else null end,
    case when p_topped then greatest(p_attempt_count, 1) else null end,
    'climber'
  );

  select *
  into v_attempt
  from jsonb_populate_record(null::public.qualifier_attempts, v_result -> 'attempt');

  return v_attempt;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.submit_staff_qualifier_attempt(
  p_competition_id uuid,
  p_climber_id uuid,
  p_climb_number integer,
  p_attempt_count integer,
  p_topped boolean,
  p_zone boolean default null,
  p_attempts_to_top integer default null,
  p_attempts_to_zone integer default null,
  p_round_id uuid default null
)
returns public.qualifier_attempts
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_round_id uuid;
  v_result jsonb;
  v_attempt public.qualifier_attempts;
begin
  if not public.is_staff() then
    raise exception 'Only staff can record qualifier scores';
  end if;

  if not public.qualifier_staff_scoring_open_for_competition(p_competition_id) then
    raise exception 'Qualifier scoring is not open during the current competition phase.';
  end if;

  v_round_id := public.resolve_climber_linked_qualifier_round_id(p_competition_id, p_climber_id, p_round_id);

  v_result := public.append_qualifier_score_event(
    p_competition_id,
    v_round_id,
    p_climber_id,
    p_climb_number,
    greatest(p_attempt_count, 0),
    p_topped,
    coalesce(p_zone, p_topped),
    p_attempts_to_top,
    p_attempts_to_zone,
    'staff'
  );

  select *
  into v_attempt
  from jsonb_populate_record(null::public.qualifier_attempts, v_result -> 'attempt');

  return v_attempt;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.build_competition_snapshot_json(p_competition_id uuid)
returns jsonb
language sql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'competition', (
      select to_jsonb(c)
      from public.competitions c
      where c.id = p_competition_id
    ),
    'categories', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(cc) order by cc.sort_order, cc.display_name)
      from public.competition_categories cc
      where cc.competition_id = p_competition_id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'schedule_blocks', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(sb) order by sb.start_time, sb.label)
      from public.competition_schedule_blocks sb
      where sb.competition_id = p_competition_id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'climbers', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) order by c.registered_at, c.name)
      from public.climbers c
      where c.competition_id = p_competition_id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'qualifier_attempts', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(qa) order by qa.round_id, qa.climber_id, qa.climb_number)
      from public.qualifier_attempts qa
      where qa.competition_id = p_competition_id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'qualifier_score_events', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(qse) order by qse.scored_at, qse.received_at, qse.client_event_id)
      from public.qualifier_score_events qse
      where qse.competition_id = p_competition_id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'finalists', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(cf) order by cf.display_category, cf.climbing_order, cf.qualifier_rank, cf.name)
      from public.competition_finalists cf
      where cf.competition_id = p_competition_id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'final_attempts', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(fa) order by fa.round_id, fa.climber_id, fa.climb_number)
      from public.final_attempts fa
      where fa.competition_id = p_competition_id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'final_score_events', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(fse) order by fse.scored_at, fse.received_at, fse.client_event_id)
      from public.final_score_events fse
      where fse.competition_id = p_competition_id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'rounds', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(cr) order by cr.sort_order, cr.round_number)
      from public.competition_rounds cr
      where cr.competition_id = p_competition_id
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  );
$$;

create or replace function public.restore_competition_snapshot(
  p_competition_id uuid,
  p_snapshot jsonb
)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_competition jsonb;
  v_has_qualifier_events boolean;
  v_has_final_events boolean;
begin
  v_competition := p_snapshot -> 'competition';

  if v_competition is null or v_competition = 'null'::jsonb then
    raise exception 'Competition snapshot missing competition row';
  end if;

  v_has_qualifier_events := jsonb_typeof(p_snapshot -> 'qualifier_score_events') = 'array';
  v_has_final_events := jsonb_typeof(p_snapshot -> 'final_score_events') = 'array';

  delete from public.final_score_events where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.qualifier_score_events where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.final_attempts where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.competition_finalists where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.qualifier_attempts where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.climbers where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.competition_schedule_blocks where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.competition_categories where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.competition_rounds where competition_id = p_competition_id;

  update public.competitions
  set
    slug = coalesce(v_competition ->> 'slug', slug),
    name = coalesce(v_competition ->> 'name', name),
    is_demo = coalesce((v_competition ->> 'is_demo')::boolean, is_demo),
    status = coalesce(v_competition ->> 'status', status),
    format = coalesce(v_competition ->> 'format', format),
    current_phase = coalesce(v_competition ->> 'current_phase', current_phase),
    discipline_label = coalesce(v_competition ->> 'discipline_label', discipline_label),
    stage_mode = coalesce(v_competition ->> 'stage_mode', stage_mode),
    location_name = coalesce(v_competition ->> 'location_name', location_name),
    start_date = coalesce((v_competition ->> 'start_date')::date, start_date),
    end_date = coalesce((v_competition ->> 'end_date')::date, end_date),
    registration_opens_at = coalesce((v_competition ->> 'registration_opens_at')::timestamptz, registration_opens_at),
    registration_closes_at = coalesce((v_competition ->> 'registration_closes_at')::timestamptz, registration_closes_at),
    description = coalesce(v_competition ->> 'description', description),
    hero_image_url = coalesce(v_competition ->> 'hero_image_url', hero_image_url),
    official_event_url = coalesce(v_competition ->> 'official_event_url', official_event_url),
    official_registration_url = coalesce(v_competition ->> 'official_registration_url', official_registration_url),
    official_schedule_url = coalesce(v_competition ->> 'official_schedule_url', official_schedule_url),
    total_climbs = coalesce((v_competition ->> 'total_climbs')::integer, total_climbs),
    max_climbers = coalesce((v_competition ->> 'max_climbers')::integer, max_climbers),
    qualifier_counting_climbs = coalesce((v_competition ->> 'qualifier_counting_climbs')::integer, qualifier_counting_climbs),
    has_finals = coalesce((v_competition ->> 'has_finals')::boolean, has_finals),
    finals_cutoff = coalesce((v_competition ->> 'finals_cutoff')::integer, finals_cutoff),
    finals_tie_advances = coalesce((v_competition ->> 'finals_tie_advances')::boolean, finals_tie_advances),
    qualifier_eligible_age_groups = coalesce(array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(v_competition -> 'qualifier_eligible_age_groups')), qualifier_eligible_age_groups),
    finals_eligible_age_groups = coalesce(array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(v_competition -> 'finals_eligible_age_groups')), finals_eligible_age_groups),
    qualifier_locked_at = coalesce((v_competition ->> 'qualifier_locked_at')::timestamptz, qualifier_locked_at),
    finals_started_at = coalesce((v_competition ->> 'finals_started_at')::timestamptz, finals_started_at),
    finals_problem_count = coalesce((v_competition ->> 'finals_problem_count')::integer, finals_problem_count)
  where id = p_competition_id;

  insert into public.competition_categories
  select *
  from jsonb_populate_recordset(null::public.competition_categories, coalesce(p_snapshot -> 'categories', '[]'::jsonb));

  insert into public.competition_schedule_blocks
  select *
  from jsonb_populate_recordset(null::public.competition_schedule_blocks, coalesce(p_snapshot -> 'schedule_blocks', '[]'::jsonb));

  insert into public.climbers
  select *
  from jsonb_populate_recordset(null::public.climbers, coalesce(p_snapshot -> 'climbers', '[]'::jsonb));

  insert into public.competition_rounds
  select *
  from jsonb_populate_recordset(null::public.competition_rounds, coalesce(p_snapshot -> 'rounds', '[]'::jsonb));

  insert into public.qualifier_attempts
  select *
  from jsonb_populate_recordset(null::public.qualifier_attempts, coalesce(p_snapshot -> 'qualifier_attempts', '[]'::jsonb));

  insert into public.competition_finalists
  select *
  from jsonb_populate_recordset(null::public.competition_finalists, coalesce(p_snapshot -> 'finalists', '[]'::jsonb));

  insert into public.final_attempts
  select *
  from jsonb_populate_recordset(null::public.final_attempts, coalesce(p_snapshot -> 'final_attempts', '[]'::jsonb));

  if v_has_qualifier_events then
    insert into public.qualifier_score_events
    select *
    from jsonb_populate_recordset(null::public.qualifier_score_events, coalesce(p_snapshot -> 'qualifier_score_events', '[]'::jsonb));
  else
    insert into public.qualifier_score_events (
      competition_id,
      round_id,
      climber_id,
      climb_number,
      attempt_count,
      zone,
      topped,
      attempts_to_top,
      attempts_to_zone,
      entered_by,
      scored_at,
      received_at,
      client_event_id,
      replayed_from_offline,
      conflict_flag
    )
    select
      qa.competition_id,
      qa.round_id,
      qa.climber_id,
      qa.climb_number,
      qa.attempt_count,
      qa.zone,
      qa.topped,
      qa.attempts_to_top,
      qa.attempts_to_zone,
      qa.entered_by,
      coalesce(qa.updated_at, now()),
      coalesce(qa.updated_at, now()),
      concat('restore-qualifier-', qa.id::text),
      false,
      false
    from public.qualifier_attempts qa
    where qa.competition_id = p_competition_id;
  end if;

  if v_has_final_events then
    insert into public.final_score_events
    select *
    from jsonb_populate_recordset(null::public.final_score_events, coalesce(p_snapshot -> 'final_score_events', '[]'::jsonb));
  else
    insert into public.final_score_events (
      competition_id,
      round_id,
      climber_id,
      climb_number,
      top,
      zone,
      attempts_to_top,
      attempts_to_zone,
      entered_by,
      scored_at,
      received_at,
      client_event_id,
      replayed_from_offline,
      conflict_flag
    )
    select
      fa.competition_id,
      fa.round_id,
      fa.climber_id,
      fa.climb_number,
      fa.top,
      fa.zone,
      fa.attempts_to_top,
      fa.attempts_to_zone,
      fa.entered_by,
      coalesce(fa.updated_at, now()),
      coalesce(fa.updated_at, now()),
      concat('restore-final-', fa.id::text),
      false,
      false
    from public.final_attempts fa
    where fa.competition_id = p_competition_id;
  end if;
end;
$$;

-- Security-first hardening for public visibility and staff scoring writes.
-- Keeps the current global admin/judge model while removing direct browser access
-- to internal score-event helpers.

create or replace function public.competition_publicly_readable(p_competition_id uuid)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
  select coalesce((
    select c.status = 'active' or coalesce(c.is_demo, false)
    from public.competitions c
    where c.id = p_competition_id
  ), false)
$$;

create or replace function public.can_read_competition_scope(p_competition_id uuid)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
  select public.competition_publicly_readable(p_competition_id) or public.is_staff()
$$;

drop policy if exists "competitions public read" on public.competitions;
create policy "competitions active demo or staff read"
on public.competitions for select
using (status = 'active' or coalesce(is_demo, false) or public.is_staff());

drop policy if exists "competition categories public read" on public.competition_categories;
create policy "competition categories scoped read"
on public.competition_categories for select
using (public.can_read_competition_scope(competition_id));

drop policy if exists "competition schedule public read" on public.competition_schedule_blocks;
create policy "competition schedule scoped read"
on public.competition_schedule_blocks for select
using (public.can_read_competition_scope(competition_id));

drop policy if exists "competition rounds public read" on public.competition_rounds;
create policy "competition rounds scoped read"
on public.competition_rounds for select
using (public.can_read_competition_scope(competition_id));

drop policy if exists "climbers public read" on public.climbers;
create policy "climbers scoped read"
on public.climbers for select
using (public.can_read_competition_scope(competition_id));

drop policy if exists "qualifier attempts public read" on public.qualifier_attempts;
create policy "qualifier attempts scoped read"
on public.qualifier_attempts for select
using (public.can_read_competition_scope(competition_id));

drop policy if exists "competition finalists public read" on public.competition_finalists;
create policy "competition finalists scoped read"
on public.competition_finalists for select
using (public.can_read_competition_scope(competition_id));

drop policy if exists "final attempts public read" on public.final_attempts;
create policy "final attempts scoped read"
on public.final_attempts for select
using (public.can_read_competition_scope(competition_id));

drop policy if exists "competition boulder queue public read" on public.competition_boulder_queue;
create policy "competition boulder queue scoped read"
on public.competition_boulder_queue for select
using (public.can_read_competition_scope(competition_id));

drop policy if exists qualifier_score_events_select_authenticated on public.qualifier_score_events;
create policy qualifier_score_events_select_staff
on public.qualifier_score_events for select
to authenticated
using (public.is_staff() and public.can_read_competition_scope(competition_id));

drop policy if exists final_score_events_select_authenticated on public.final_score_events;
create policy final_score_events_select_staff
on public.final_score_events for select
to authenticated
using (public.is_staff() and public.can_read_competition_scope(competition_id));

create or replace function public.submit_staff_qualifier_score_event(
  p_competition_id uuid,
  p_climber_id uuid,
  p_climb_number integer,
  p_attempt_count integer,
  p_topped boolean,
  p_zone boolean default null,
  p_attempts_to_top integer default null,
  p_attempts_to_zone integer default null,
  p_client_event_id text default null,
  p_scored_at timestamptz default now(),
  p_judge_device_id text default null,
  p_judge_session_id text default null,
  p_replayed_from_offline boolean default false,
  p_round_id uuid default null
)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_round_id uuid;
begin
  if not public.is_staff() then
    raise exception 'Only staff can record qualifier scores';
  end if;

  if not public.qualifier_staff_scoring_open_for_competition(p_competition_id) then
    raise exception 'Qualifier scoring is not open during the current competition phase.';
  end if;

  v_round_id := public.resolve_climber_linked_qualifier_round_id(
    p_competition_id,
    p_climber_id,
    p_round_id
  );

  if v_round_id is null then
    raise exception 'No active qualifier-style round is configured for scoring.';
  end if;

  return public.append_qualifier_score_event(
    p_competition_id,
    v_round_id,
    p_climber_id,
    p_climb_number,
    greatest(p_attempt_count, 0),
    p_topped,
    coalesce(p_zone, p_topped),
    p_attempts_to_top,
    p_attempts_to_zone,
    'staff',
    p_client_event_id,
    p_scored_at,
    p_judge_device_id,
    p_judge_session_id,
    coalesce(p_replayed_from_offline, false)
  );
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.submit_staff_final_score_event(
  p_competition_id uuid,
  p_climber_id uuid,
  p_climb_number integer,
  p_top boolean,
  p_zone boolean,
  p_attempts_to_top integer default null,
  p_attempts_to_zone integer default null,
  p_client_event_id text default null,
  p_scored_at timestamptz default now(),
  p_judge_device_id text default null,
  p_judge_session_id text default null,
  p_replayed_from_offline boolean default false,
  p_round_id uuid default null
)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_round_id uuid;
begin
  if not public.is_staff() then
    raise exception 'Only staff can record finals scores';
  end if;

  if not public.finals_staff_scoring_open_for_competition(p_competition_id) then
    raise exception 'Finals scoring is not open during the current competition phase.';
  end if;

  v_round_id := public.resolve_competition_scoring_round_id(p_competition_id, 'finals', p_round_id);

  if v_round_id is null then
    raise exception 'No active finals round is configured for scoring.';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.competition_finalists cf
    where cf.competition_id = p_competition_id
      and cf.climber_id = p_climber_id
  ) then
    raise exception 'Only finalists can receive finals scores.';
  end if;

  return public.append_final_score_event(
    p_competition_id,
    v_round_id,
    p_climber_id,
    p_climb_number,
    p_top,
    coalesce(p_zone, p_top),
    p_attempts_to_top,
    p_attempts_to_zone,
    p_client_event_id,
    p_scored_at,
    p_judge_device_id,
    p_judge_session_id,
    coalesce(p_replayed_from_offline, false)
  );
end;
$$;

-- Security Pass 2: browser clients no longer call legacy staff/admin mutation RPCs directly.
-- Protected Next.js route handlers execute these functions with the service role after server-side auth checks.

create or replace function public.current_user_role()
returns text
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
  select case
    when auth.role() = 'service_role' then 'admin'
    else (
      select role
      from public.profiles
      where id = auth.uid()
    )
  end
$$;

--- supabase\README.md ---

# Supabase Migrations

This repo is now set up for a safer split:

- Vercel deploys the Next.js app
- GitHub Actions pushes Supabase migrations on `main`
- test or fixture SQL stays manual unless you choose to run it

## Files

- [config.toml](./config.toml)
- [20260331193000_current_schema.sql](./migrations/20260331193000_current_schema.sql)
- [supabase-deploy.yml](../.github/workflows/supabase-deploy.yml)

## First-time setup

1. Confirm [config.toml](./config.toml) points at the intended Supabase project ref.
2. Add these GitHub repository secrets:
   - `SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN`
   - `SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF`
   - `SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD`
3. Pick the matching starting point for your remote database.

If the remote database is empty and you want migrations to build it from scratch:

- run `supabase link --project-ref YOUR_PROJECT_REF`
- run `npm run db:push`

If the remote database already matches the schema in this repo, mark the baseline migration as already applied before enabling the workflow:

```bash
supabase link --project-ref YOUR_PROJECT_REF
supabase migration repair 20260331193000 --status applied --linked
```

That prevents the baseline migration from being replayed against an already-live project. After the repair, future schema changes should go through normal migration files and `supabase db push`.

## Everyday workflow

Create a new migration locally:

```bash
npm run db:migration:new -- add_schedule_phase_rules
```

Push migrations manually from your machine:

```bash
npm run db:push
```

Preview what would run:

```bash
npm run db:push:dry
```

Pull remote schema changes back into the repo if needed:

```bash
npm run db:pull
```

Generate local TypeScript database/RPC types after the project is linked:

```bash
npm run db:types
```

This writes `src/lib/database.types.ts`. If local credentials are unavailable, skip this command and generate it after running `supabase link --project-ref YOUR_PROJECT_REF`.

Verify the Security Pass 2 RPC/RLS boundary checks against a local or linked database:

```bash
psql "$DATABASE_URL" -f supabase/security-boundary-verification.sql
```

## Important note about seed data

Files like [supabase-seed.sql](../supabase-seed.sql) and [supabase-test-100-athletes.sql](../supabase-test-100-athletes.sql) are intentionally not part of the GitHub Action. They are manual test/setup scripts and should not run automatically on production deploys.


--- supabase\security-boundary-verification.sql ---

-- Security boundary verification for Security Pass 2.
-- Run against a local/linked Supabase database as an owner role that may SET ROLE.
-- The boolean privilege checks should all match the "expected" column.

select
  'anon cannot execute append_qualifier_score_event' as check_name,
  false as expected,
  has_function_privilege(
    'anon',
    'public.append_qualifier_score_event(uuid, uuid, uuid, integer, integer, boolean, boolean, integer, integer, text, text, timestamptz, text, text, boolean)',
    'execute'
  ) as actual;

select
  'authenticated cannot execute append_qualifier_score_event' as check_name,
  false as expected,
  has_function_privilege(
    'authenticated',

    'execute'
  ) as actual;

begin;
  set local role anon;
  select
    'anon archived/non-demo competition rows visible' as check_name,
    0 as expected,
    count(*) as actual
  from public.competitions
  where status = 'archived'
    and coalesce(is_demo, false) = false;
rollback;

  display_name text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create or replace function public.handle_new_user()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (id, role, display_name)
  values (
    new.id,
    coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'role', 'climber'),
    new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'display_name'
  )
  on conflict (id) do nothing;

  return new;
end;
$$;

for each row execute procedure public.handle_new_user();

create table public.competitions (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  slug text not null unique,
  name text not null,
  status text not null default 'active' check (status in ('active', 'archived')),
  format text not null default 'scramble' check (format in ('scramble', 'five_on_five_off', 'flash_format', 'ifsc_finals_format')),
  discipline_label text not null default 'Boulder',
  stage_mode text not null default 'qualifier' check (stage_mode in ('qualifier', 'finals')),
  location_name text not null default '',
  start_date date,
  end_date date,
  registration_opens_at timestamptz,
  registration_closes_at timestamptz,
  description text not null default '',
  hero_image_url text not null default '',
  total_climbs integer not null default 30 check (total_climbs between 1 and 200),
  max_climbers integer not null default 80 check (max_climbers between 1 and 1000),
  qualifier_counting_climbs integer not null default 6 check (qualifier_counting_climbs between 1 and 20),
  finals_cutoff integer not null default 6 check (finals_cutoff in (6, 8)),
  finals_tie_advances boolean not null default true,
  qualifier_eligible_age_groups jsonb not null default '["Youth D","Youth C","Youth B","Youth A","Junior","Rec","Masters","Open"]'::jsonb,
  finals_eligible_age_groups jsonb not null default '["Open"]'::jsonb,
  qualifier_locked_at timestamptz,
  finals_started_at timestamptz,
  finals_problem_count integer not null default 4 check (finals_problem_count = 4),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  check (jsonb_typeof(qualifier_eligible_age_groups) = 'array'),
  check (jsonb_typeof(finals_eligible_age_groups) = 'array')
);

create trigger competitions_set_updated_at
before update on public.competitions
for each row execute procedure public.set_updated_at();

create table public.competition_categories (
  id text not null,
  competition_id uuid not null references public.competitions(id) on delete cascade,
  gender_division text not null,
  age_group text not null,
  display_name text not null,
  sort_order integer not null default 0,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key (competition_id, id),
  unique (competition_id, gender_division, age_group)
);

create table public.competition_schedule_blocks (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  competition_id uuid not null references public.competitions(id) on delete cascade,
  label text not null,
  phase_type text not null check (phase_type in ('check_in', 'technical_meeting', 'isolation', 'qualifier_round', 'wall_reset', 'observation', 'finals_round', 'results', 'custom')),
  audience_label text not null default '',
  is_active boolean not null default false,
  start_time text,
  end_time text,
  capacity integer not null default 20 check (capacity > 0),
  eligible_category_ids jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  check (jsonb_typeof(eligible_category_ids) = 'array')
);

create table public.climbers (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  competition_id uuid not null references public.competitions(id) on delete cascade,
  name text not null,
  climber_number text not null,
  province text not null,
  category_id text,
  gender_division text not null,
  age_group text not null,
  display_category text not null,
  time_slot_id uuid references public.competition_schedule_blocks(id) on delete set null,
  access_token text not null unique,
  access_token_created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  registered_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  foreign key (competition_id, category_id) references public.competition_categories(competition_id, id),
  unique (competition_id, climber_number)
);

create table public.qualifier_attempts (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  competition_id uuid not null references public.competitions(id) on delete cascade,
  climber_id uuid not null references public.climbers(id) on delete cascade,
  climb_number integer not null check (climb_number > 0),
  attempt_count integer not null check (attempt_count >= 0),
  zone boolean not null default false,
  topped boolean not null default false,
  attempts_to_top integer,
  attempts_to_zone integer,
  entered_by text not null check (entered_by in ('climber', 'staff')),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  check (not topped or zone),
  check (attempts_to_top is null or attempts_to_top > 0),
  check (attempts_to_zone is null or attempts_to_zone > 0),
  unique (climber_id, climb_number)
);

create table public.competition_finalists (
  competition_id uuid not null references public.competitions(id) on delete cascade,
  climber_id uuid not null references public.climbers(id) on delete cascade,
  name text not null,
  category_id text,
  display_category text not null,
  gender_division text not null,
  age_group text not null,
  qualifier_rank integer not null,
  advanced_with_tie boolean not null default false,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  foreign key (competition_id, category_id) references public.competition_categories(competition_id, id),
  primary key (competition_id, climber_id)
);

on public.competition_categories (competition_id, sort_order, gender_division, age_group);

create index competition_schedule_blocks_competition_idx

create index climbers_competition_idx
on public.climbers (competition_id, registered_at, display_category);

on public.qualifier_attempts (competition_id, climber_id, climb_number);

create index competition_finalists_competition_idx
on public.competition_finalists (competition_id, display_category, qualifier_rank);

create table public.final_attempts (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  competition_id uuid not null references public.competitions(id) on delete cascade,
  climber_id uuid not null references public.climbers(id) on delete cascade,
  climb_number integer not null check (climb_number between 1 and 4),
  top boolean not null default false,
  zone boolean not null default false,
  attempts_to_top integer,
  attempts_to_zone integer,
  entered_by text not null default 'staff' check (entered_by = 'staff'),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (climber_id, climb_number)
);

create index final_attempts_competition_idx
on public.final_attempts (competition_id, climber_id, climb_number);

create or replace function public.registration_open_for_competition(p_competition_id uuid)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
  with competition_row as (
    select *
    from public.competitions
    where id = p_competition_id
  ),
  active_block as (
    select phase_type
    from public.competition_schedule_blocks
    where competition_id = p_competition_id and is_active = true
    limit 1
  )
  select case
    when not exists (select 1 from competition_row) then false
    when (select stage_mode from competition_row) <> 'qualifier' then false
    when exists (select 1 from active_block)
      then coalesce((select phase_type in ('check_in', 'technical_meeting', 'qualifier_round', 'custom') from active_block), false)
    else true
  end
$$;

create or replace function public.qualifier_staff_scoring_open_for_competition(p_competition_id uuid)
returns boolean

stable
security definer

    from public.competition_schedule_blocks
    where competition_id = p_competition_id and is_active = true
    limit 1
  )
  select case
    when not exists (select 1 from competition_row) then false
    when (select stage_mode from competition_row) <> 'qualifier' then false
    when exists (select 1 from active_block)
      then coalesce((select phase_type in ('qualifier_round', 'custom') from active_block), false)

  end
$$;

create or replace function public.qualifier_self_scoring_open_for_competition(p_competition_id uuid)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
  with competition_row as (
    select *
    from public.competitions
    where id = p_competition_id
  ),
  active_block as (
    select phase_type
    from public.competition_schedule_blocks
    where competition_id = p_competition_id and is_active = true
    limit 1
  )
  select case
    when not exists (select 1 from competition_row) then false
    when (select stage_mode from competition_row) <> 'qualifier' then false
    when (select format from competition_row) <> 'scramble' then false
    when exists (select 1 from active_block)
      then coalesce((select phase_type in ('qualifier_round', 'custom') from active_block), false)
    else true
  end
$$;

returns boolean

stable
security definer

    from public.competitions

  ),

    when (select stage_mode from competition_row) <> 'finals' then false

create or replace function public.submit_qualifier_attempt(
  p_access_token text,
  p_competition_id uuid,
  p_climb_number integer,
  p_attempt_count integer,
  p_topped boolean
)
returns public.qualifier_attempts
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_climber public.climbers;
  v_attempt public.qualifier_attempts;
begin
  if not public.qualifier_self_scoring_open_for_competition(p_competition_id) then
    raise exception 'Qualifier self-scoring is not open for this competition';
  end if;

  select *
  into v_climber
  from public.climbers
  where access_token = trim(p_access_token)
    and competition_id = p_competition_id
  limit 1;

  if v_climber.id is null then
    raise exception 'Private qualifier link not recognized';
  end if;

  insert into public.qualifier_attempts (
    competition_id,
    climber_id,
    climb_number,
    attempt_count,
    zone,
    topped,
    attempts_to_top,
    attempts_to_zone,
    entered_by
  )
  values (
    p_competition_id,
    v_climber.id,
    p_climb_number,
    greatest(p_attempt_count, 0),
    p_topped,
    p_topped,
    case when p_topped then greatest(p_attempt_count, 1) else null end,
    case when p_topped then greatest(p_attempt_count, 1) else null end,
    'climber'
  )
  on conflict (climber_id, climb_number) do update
  set
    attempt_count = excluded.attempt_count,
    zone = excluded.zone,
    topped = excluded.topped,
    attempts_to_top = excluded.attempts_to_top,
    attempts_to_zone = excluded.attempts_to_zone,
    entered_by = 'climber',
    updated_at = now()
  returning *
  into v_attempt;

  return v_attempt;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.advance_competition_to_finals(p_competition_id uuid)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_competition public.competitions;
begin
  if not public.is_admin() then
    raise exception 'Only admins can advance a competition to finals';
  end if;

  select *
  into v_competition
  from public.competitions
  where id = p_competition_id
  for update;

  if v_competition.id is null then
    raise exception 'Competition not found';
  end if;

  if v_competition.stage_mode <> 'qualifier' then
    raise exception 'Competition is not in qualifiers';
  end if;

  delete from public.final_attempts where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.competition_finalists where competition_id = p_competition_id;

  with climber_scores as (
    select
      c.id as climber_id,
      c.name,
      c.category_id,
      c.display_category,
      c.gender_division,
      c.age_group,
      q.climb_number,
      q.attempt_count,
      coalesce(q.zone, q.topped, false) as zone,
      q.topped,
      q.attempts_to_top,
      q.attempts_to_zone,
      case
        when v_competition.format = 'flash_format'
          then greatest(
            case
              when q.topped then greatest(0::numeric, 25 - (greatest(coalesce(q.attempts_to_top, q.attempt_count, 1), 1) - 1) * 0.1)
              else 0::numeric
            end,
            case
              when coalesce(q.zone, q.topped, false)
                then greatest(0::numeric, 10 - (greatest(coalesce(q.attempts_to_zone, q.attempts_to_top, q.attempt_count, 1), 1) - 1) * 0.1)
              else 0::numeric
            end
          )
        when q.topped
          then greatest(0, q.climb_number * 1000 - least(greatest(q.attempt_count - 1, 0), 3) * 200)
        else 0::numeric
      end as score
    from public.climbers c
    left join public.qualifier_attempts q on q.climber_id = c.id
    where c.competition_id = p_competition_id
  ),
  counting_scores as (
    select *
    from (
      select
        climber_scores.*,
        row_number() over (
          partition by climber_id
          order by score desc, climb_number desc, attempt_count asc
        ) as score_row
      from climber_scores
      where score > 0::numeric
    ) ranked_scores
    where score_row <= case
      when v_competition.format = 'flash_format' then v_competition.total_climbs
      else v_competition.qualifier_counting_climbs
    end
  ),
  qualifier_totals as (
    select
      c.id as climber_id,
      c.name,
      c.category_id,
      c.display_category,
      c.gender_division,
      c.age_group,
      coalesce(sum(cs.score), 0::numeric) as total_score,
      coalesce(count(*) filter (where cs.topped), 0) as topped_count,
      coalesce(count(*) filter (where cs.zone), 0) as zone_count,
      coalesce(
        sum(
          case
            when cs.topped then greatest(coalesce(cs.attempts_to_top, cs.attempt_count, 0), 0)
            when cs.zone then greatest(coalesce(cs.attempts_to_zone, cs.attempt_count, 0), 0)
            else greatest(coalesce(cs.attempt_count, 0), 0)
          end
        ),
        0
      ) as counting_attempt_total
    from public.climbers c
    left join counting_scores cs on cs.climber_id = c.id
    where c.competition_id = p_competition_id
    group by c.id, c.name, c.category_id, c.display_category, c.gender_division, c.age_group
  ),
  ranked as (
    select
      qualifier_totals.*,
      row_number() over (
        partition by category_id
        order by total_score desc, topped_count desc, zone_count desc, counting_attempt_total asc, name asc
      ) as category_rank
    from qualifier_totals
    where gender_division in ('Men', 'Women')
      and age_group in (
        select jsonb_array_elements_text(v_competition.finals_eligible_age_groups)
      )
  ),
  cutoff as (
    select
      category_id,
      total_score,
      topped_count,
      zone_count,
      counting_attempt_total
    from ranked
    where category_rank = v_competition.finals_cutoff
  )
  insert into public.competition_finalists (
    competition_id,
    climber_id,
    name,
    category_id,
    display_category,
    gender_division,
    age_group,
    qualifier_rank,
    advanced_with_tie
  )
  select
    p_competition_id,
    ranked.climber_id,
    ranked.name,
    ranked.category_id,
    ranked.display_category,
    ranked.gender_division,
    ranked.age_group,
    ranked.category_rank,
    ranked.category_rank > v_competition.finals_cutoff
  from ranked
  left join cutoff using (category_id)
  where ranked.category_rank <= v_competition.finals_cutoff
     or (
       v_competition.finals_tie_advances
       and cutoff.category_id is not null
       and ranked.category_rank > v_competition.finals_cutoff
       and ranked.total_score = cutoff.total_score
       and ranked.topped_count = cutoff.topped_count
       and ranked.zone_count = cutoff.zone_count
       and ranked.counting_attempt_total = cutoff.counting_attempt_total
     );

  update public.competitions
  set
    format = 'ifsc_finals_format',
    stage_mode = 'finals',
    qualifier_locked_at = now(),
    finals_started_at = now(),
    finals_problem_count = 4
  where id = p_competition_id;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.reset_competition(p_competition_id uuid)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
begin
  if not public.is_admin() then
    raise exception 'Only admins can reset a competition';
  end if;

  delete from public.final_attempts where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.competition_finalists where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.qualifier_attempts where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.climbers where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.competition_schedule_blocks where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.competition_categories where competition_id = p_competition_id;

  insert into public.competition_categories (
    id,
    competition_id,
    gender_division,
    age_group,
    display_name,
    sort_order
  )
  select
    division || '::' || age_group,
    p_competition_id,
    division,
    age_group,
    division || ' / ' || age_group,
    row_number() over (order by division, age_group) - 1
  from (
    values ('Men'), ('Women'), ('X')
  ) as divisions(division)
  cross join (
    values ('Youth D'), ('Youth C'), ('Youth B'), ('Youth A'), ('Junior'), ('Rec'), ('Masters'), ('Open')
  ) as ages(age_group);

  update public.competitions
  set
    format = 'scramble',
    stage_mode = 'qualifier',
    total_climbs = 30,
    max_climbers = 80,
    qualifier_counting_climbs = 6,
    finals_cutoff = 6,
    finals_tie_advances = true,
    qualifier_eligible_age_groups = '["Youth D","Youth C","Youth B","Youth A","Junior","Rec","Masters","Open"]'::jsonb,
    finals_eligible_age_groups = '["Open"]'::jsonb,
    qualifier_locked_at = null,
    finals_started_at = null,
    finals_problem_count = 4
  where id = p_competition_id;
end;
$$;

create policy "profiles read own"
on public.profiles for select
to authenticated
using (id = auth.uid() or public.is_admin());

create policy "profiles update admin"
on public.profiles for update
to authenticated
using (public.is_admin())
with check (public.is_admin());

create policy "competitions public read"
on public.competitions for select
using (true);

create policy "competitions admin write"
on public.competitions for all
to authenticated
using (public.is_admin())
with check (public.is_admin());

create policy "competition categories public read"
on public.competition_categories for select
using (true);

create policy "competition categories admin write"
on public.competition_categories for all
to authenticated
using (public.is_admin())
with check (public.is_admin());

create policy "competition schedule public read"
on public.competition_schedule_blocks for select
using (true);

create policy "competition schedule admin write"
on public.competition_schedule_blocks for all
to authenticated
using (public.is_admin())
with check (public.is_admin());

create policy "climbers public read"
on public.climbers for select
using (true);

create policy "climbers public insert"
on public.climbers for insert
with check (public.registration_open_for_competition(competition_id));

create policy "climbers staff update"
on public.climbers for update
to authenticated
using (public.is_staff())
with check (public.is_staff());

create policy "climbers staff delete"
on public.climbers for delete
to authenticated
using (public.is_staff());

create policy "qualifier attempts public read"
on public.qualifier_attempts for select
using (true);

create policy "qualifier attempts staff write"
on public.qualifier_attempts for all
to authenticated
using (public.is_staff() and public.qualifier_staff_scoring_open_for_competition(competition_id))
with check (public.is_staff() and public.qualifier_staff_scoring_open_for_competition(competition_id));

create policy "competition finalists public read"
on public.competition_finalists for select
using (true);

create policy "competition finalists admin write"
on public.competition_finalists for all
to authenticated
using (public.is_admin())
with check (public.is_admin());

create policy "final attempts public read"
on public.final_attempts for select
using (true);

create policy "final attempts staff write"
on public.final_attempts for all
to authenticated
using (public.is_staff() and public.finals_staff_scoring_open_for_competition(competition_id))
with check (public.is_staff() and public.finals_staff_scoring_open_for_competition(competition_id));
